parameters.name: 密度
parameters.definition: 密度表示单位体积材料的质量，通常用于判断材料的轻重感。密度越高，在相同体积下材料越重。
parameters.designMeaning: 帮助设计师理解材料的轻重感、体量感与便携性。

materials.name: EPS
materials.description: EPS常用名称为EPS泡沫、发泡聚苯乙烯，部分地区也称保丽龙。它由可发性聚苯乙烯珠粒经过预发泡和模塑形成，内部包含大量封闭气泡，因此密度低、隔热和缓冲性能突出。常用于产品包装、保温板、头盔缓冲层、展示模型与轻量化填充，但耐热性和耐溶剂性有限。
materials.cognitiveText: EPS在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 0.019–0.032 g/cm³。

cases.description: The KASK Zenith X marks an evolution in safety helmets. From the outside, the helmet looks similar to its award-winning predecessor. Yet, this new version offers updates to every feature. The designers focused on three areas: safety, comfort, and user design. Safety was enhanced with an improved two-part EPS inner shell that consists of a lightweight core with D-Core Technology and a higher density cage with HD Crown Protection for greater all-around impact absorption with optimal airflow. The new patented Adaptive Fit System ratcheting mechanism makes the helmet even more comfortable, providing improved stability and a personalized more secure fit.

The LIND Canvas electric jetboard combines the look, handling and feel of a classic surfboard with modern drive technology. Made of EPS foam and epoxy resin with oak wood details, the board weighs just 7 kg and can be set up in less than a minute without tools. The jet and battery modules fit in a backpack. With 20 kW of power, a speed of up to 60 km/h and 45 minutes of riding time, it offers powerful performance and timeless aesthetics. Unique Art Boards made in collaboration with artists are available as collectables.

Marine-B is a neoprene-covered body board made of eco-friendly materials. The inside foam core is made of EPS (SE 2000). The cover can be removed, replaced, washed, and the board can be easily stored and carried. Furthermore, it is available in many contemporary colours. It can be used in open water or in a swimming pool.

The Overtake bicycle helmet uses a unique construction that absorbs 30 per cent more energy than traditional EPS foam, making it exceptionally impact-resistant. At the same time, the helmet is very light, weighing in at only 250 grams, and includes 21 air vents for balanced aerodynamic performance. Available in three sizes and 12 colour variations, the helmet is adjustable for a personalised and secure fit and can be partially  customised with MIPS linings.

Lelle is a bicycle helmet for younger children which was developed especially for little heads and offers great comfort, aiming for children to accept the helmet and enjoy wearing it. The helmet expresses timeless aesthetics. The air holes ensure good ventilation, without disturbing  the minimalist overall impression. The outer shell causes little friction and thus, in combination with the shock-absorbing EPS foam and the MIPS system, provides protection in the case of accidents. The front peak protects the face.

The Urbanaut bicycle helmet was developed especially for e-bike users and is specially designed to resist the significant forces that can occur during falls at higher speeds. This is achieved by the fusion of different materials. The inner shell is made of two expanded polystyrene materials of different density that provide support and also a shock-absorbing function. The outer shell features a combination of ABS layers and polycarbonate, which minimizes the helmet’s volume and weight, guaranteeing optimal shock protection. Ventilation is regulatable via integrated air vents.

The Bell Super 2R offers comprehensive and adaptable protection for the all-mountain bicycle rider through its game-changing removable chin bar; lower head coverage; and a performance-driven feature that allows the rider to tackle any terrain with confidence. With this advancement of the bicycle’s capabilities comes the need for equipment that can protect the rider for the trails they’re now able to ride. The Super 2R features a removable chin bar so that when a rider is climbing up the mountain, they’re able to have an open-face helmet for maximum cooling and ventilation. When the rider is ready to descend, they are able to mount the chin bar with three, easily attached buckles for the protection of a full-face helmet.

cases.productName: Honeywell Fibre Metal Climbing Style Helmet
cases.description: The new Climbing-Style Helmet features cutting-edge safety technology with superior protection. Its innovative suspension system leverages advanced materials and thoughtful design. By combining non-Newtonian foam with an EPS foam liner, the helmet achieves an optimal balance of force mitigation and weight reduction. It is the first technology incorporates liquid crystal polymer (LCP) yarn into the six strap, eight-point suspension system for superior force absorption. Compatible with safety accessories, it is a comprehensive protection for workers across various environments, setting new standards for head safety.

materials.name: 软木
materials.description: 软木常用名称为软木或栓皮，主要取自栓皮栎等树木的外层树皮。其蜂窝状封闭细胞结构使材料轻、可压缩、回弹、隔热、吸声并具有一定防水性。软木可制成整片、颗粒板或复合材料，常用于瓶塞、地板、墙面、鞋材、握把、包装和可持续产品表面。
materials.cognitiveText: 软木在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 0.12–0.24 g/cm³。

cases.description: Jack & Jenny is a modular, environmentally friendly organisation system for everyday objects. An innovative polymer mixture made from the renewable raw materials cork and potato starch is used to produce the Jack containers. Only natural pigments are selected for the environmentally friendly colouring. The matching Jenny support structure is made of regional beech wood. Thanks to the robust workmanship, this functional system is hard-wearing and durable.

WooSmell is the name of a range of scent carriers made from environmentally friendly cork. Available in different shapes, they create a pleasant ambient atmosphere or neutralise odours in wardrobes. The good absorbency and breathability of the material ensures that their fragrance is released steadily. The packaging concept for this product is just as ecologically sound. Durable Tyvek bags reflect the colouring and natural aesthetics of the cork and, once the products have been unpacked, offer the opportunity for practical reuse in everyday life.

The Lenovo Go Wireless Split Keyboard & Lenovo Go Wireless Vertical Mouse is designed to be easy on muscles and joints. The keys are arranged at an angle that promotes straight wrist posture and thus reduces strain. The home and arrow keys are positioned flat for easy access. The mouse also follows the anatomy of the hand to provide a high level of comfort. Mouse and keyboard have contact surfaces made of cork which are pleasant to the touch and provide a link to natural materials.

ETHO, a cabin-sized piece of luggage, focuses not only on modern aesthetics but also on the sustainability of the materials. The suitcase shell, for example, is made of recycled aluminium and the corner constructions, which provide improved impact behaviour, are made of recycled plastic. The handle and interior are made from upcycled cork. At the end of their service life, all materials are 100 per cent recyclable. Furthermore, practical security for the traveller is provided by a modern TSA lock.

The Stratus umbrella collection features a modular system of interchangeable handle components and mechanical functions. A trilobe profile forms the basis for the frame components. This shape increases torsional strength within the telescopic shaft and prevents twisting of the frame and canopy. The umbrella canopy uses 50 per cent recycled polypropylene blended with microfibre. Performance materials, such as aircraft aluminum and carbon fibre within the frame assure longevity and durability. Leather, cork, woods and quality plastics make up the handle pallet options.

The Saddle Bag Spin Dye nappy bag is an attractive, well-conceived and long-lasting accessory for mothers. Its outer appearance is characterised by the specially developed “Spin Dye” fabric in discreet, muted colours, contrasted by powerful accents from the natural material cork. The special feature of “Spin Dye” material is that it is spun from already coloured granulate, whereby the otherwise usual dye bath is omitted, thus saving water and energy. Inside the bag, there are a generously dimensioned main compartment and many further pockets for accessories.

The imaginative design of the Natura stove makes it possible not only to see the warming fire, but also to feel it with the hands. The free-standing stove has a steel body, covered with cork profiles. These are not in direct contact with the steel structure, in order to ensure that the natural material does not darken over time. The cork gives the stove, an industrial object, a natural look. It can be touched and so provides a lasting sensation of the warmth of a fire.

The Kiori collection comprises sofas, armchairs and screens characterised by their combination of innovative materials. The sassafras heartwood structure is combined with carefully hand-woven ash wood Abonos and cork. Abonos, which is sourced from riverbeds, where it undergoes a fossilisation process, boasts a number of special properties, including durability and a high resistance to moisture. The elements of the Kiori collection feature the same durability in both indoor and outdoor areas, while exhibiting a natural charm.

To achieve long-lasting stability, this hose reel is made of recyclable aluminium. Only the external surface of the aluminium frame is coated with synthetic resin to protect the hose against heat from sunlight. The recessed grips are lined with cork for a natural, pleasant feel. The precise reel system prevents the hose from deforming when being rolled up, which reduces the winding weight and friction noise.

CorkWirl is a wall panel with generative patterns inspired by biomimetic structures. Twirl movements generate organic and fluid shapes. The low-tech material of sustainable cork granulate is produced in a natural high-tech process in the course of which water vapour is injected through pellets using high pressure, creating a wide variety of shapes and patterns by means of algorithms. In addition, this attractive panel has excellent thermal and acoustic properties.

This kitchen knife set follows a distinctive design language defined by a blend of natural materials. The ergonomic cross-sectional handle shape rests comfortably in the palm of the hand. A firm arch transition connects the scratch-resistant and stainless steel blade to the handle. Both the side surfaces of the steel handle and the knife sheaths are made of fibre resin – a composite of crop straw, rice husks, starch and resin. A portable knife bag made of natural cork complements the set.

Privacy is something that everyone needs but no one gets in the workplace. Being able to change your vantage point, posture, work modes, and environment based on different tasks is human-centric and improves people’s well-being. Buffer is as simple as it gets when it comes to an acoustic divider. It features as few parts as possible: a PET panel, an aluminum structural stem, and a steel base with a cork glide. It’s easy to move, rearrange, and rotate, which makes it adaptable to the quickly changing work modes in an office space.

The Post-it® Z-Notes Natural Dispenser was designed with sustainability and life-cycle management in mind. It is constructed with natural raw materials only—just glass and 100 percent recycled cork, no plastics. Plus, while most dispensers on the market have a minimum of five pieces, this product has only two, making it very easy to assemble, disassemble and recycle.

Home fitness equipment directly in our surroundings makes us psychologically more likely to move everyday. 
But the language of the gym feels too heavy and industrial for home.
Kettler’s new Ergometer balances performance & domesticity to feel harmonious with your main living space, instead of a spare room or garage.
A patented inductive brake system for resistance control mixes with homely colourways & cork pedals. Knit-like mouldings & tubular frame soften ergonomic handlebars. Real-time sensors allow seamless cloud-based tracking. High-durability materials reduce environmental impact by lasting a lifetime.
Performance, fit for the home.

This is an eco-friendly disposable e-cigarette that features natural materials and innovative structures, aiming to provide users with a safe and convenient smoking experience while reducing its impact on the environment. With the emphasis on the selection and application of sustainable materials, the R&D team particularly uses cork material from the bark of the cork oak, which is composite treated with resin to ensure durability and safety of the product. Additionally, the modular design allows users to easily disassemble for recycling, reducing the environmental impact of e-waste.

This elegant Porsche Design Goodyear Welted Velours Lace Up men’s shoe of finest calf leather is manufactured in the traditional, very elaborate welt seam process Goodyear Welted. This results in a durable shoe which flexibly supports the complex movement sequence. The insole is provided with a cork compound which adapts to the individual wearer. Thanks to environmentally friendly Eichenloh pit tanning, an abrasion-resistant and yet flexible outer sole is created with water-repelling and breathable properties.

In an attempt to follow the SDGs Takagi considered what they could do to protect the environment and manufacture sustainably. The result in this product is a reduction in the amount of resin used and the choice of reusable aluminum and natural cork. The finish brings out the natural individuality of the material so that it matches the minimalist form. Moreover, they created a hose reel that you will love every time you use it, rather than a consumable one that needs to be replaced when it fades or breaks.

materials.name: 胡桃木
materials.description: 胡桃木常用名称为胡桃木，产品设计中常见的是黑胡桃木。它属于中等密度阔叶木材，心材多呈浅褐至深巧克力色，纹理细致并具有良好切削、雕刻和涂饰性能。常用于高档家具、饰面板、乐器、枪托和产品木质外壳，但颜色、纹理和力学性能会随树种与产地变化。
materials.cognitiveText: 胡桃木在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 0.55–0.67 g/cm³。

cases.description: Design innovations are often the product of technology transfer. In the case of Furniture Linoleum, the innovative aspect is first and foremost a carefully considered material transfer that has led to a sustainable product with aesthetic appeal. Forbo Flooring had previously focused on the production of high-quality flooring materials before deciding to diversify its portfolio and expertise in the furniture sector with Furniture Linoleum. Now the time-tested material of linoleum is captivating a new audience with its natural, warm feel and excellent durability as a contemporary surface finish for home and kitchen furniture, doors, and much more. “This product embodies our vision of creating functional, durable and environmentally conscious finishes for both flooring and furniture,” says the manufacturer. Linoleum’s climate-positive aspects also contribute to user convenience. Made from renewable and natural raw materials such as linseed oil, wood flour, pine resin and limestone, it has a naturally elegant, matt surface that is resistant to fingerprints. Being easy to clean, Furniture Linoleum is also an interesting option for the customised furnishing of public spaces. Forbo Flooring complements all of these positive properties with an attractive range of 24 colours that blend seamlessly with natural woods and stones, such as oak, walnut and maple, or marble, concrete and terrazzo. A special aesthetic has been achieved with the “Pure Linoleum” decor, which completely dispenses with colour pigments to showcase the natural shade of linseed oil. Like leather and wood, each piece is unique and alters in appearance over time. The Red Dot jurors were fascinated by the natural look and feel: “What really impressed us about Furniture Linoleum is this focus on material purity. The special yet subtle tactile warmth of the surfaces makes them feel comforting to the touch. Another remarkable aspect is the unique natural aroma of linoleum that is pleasant to perceive. This material represents tangible quality. It is honest, thoughtfully designed and delivers genuine added value for healthy interior spaces.”

The multifunctional Synthos sink with its premium accessories is not just for washing dishes, it also optimises everyday kitchen life. With a length of up to 180 cm, three working levels and well thought-out details, it makes it easier to prepare, serve and store food. Versatile bowls with glass lids double as plates or coasters, while a stainless steel tray with a removable silicone mat can be used as a drying rack or serving tray. The wooden cover made of walnut or white oak extends the work surface and conceals clutter when required.

The Smart Bedside Table (PRO) is an air purifier intended for placement in the bedroom. It was thus designed with a homely feel in mind, which comes into play in the selection of surfaces. The choices here are walnut, maple, cherry and fabric. The unit cleans and humidifies the air, ensuring good air quality. It also serves as, among other things, a USB hub, lighting element and storage space with a cooling function.

The DC SONG Walnut 2-Tier Side Table has a striking appearance defined by two stacked tabletops and the tripod frame. The table can be used in the living room or lounge area, and the rotating lower tabletop provides flexible usage options. The walnut makes a high-quality impression and conveys a tactile appeal.

Inspired by a kinetic sculpture, this table lamp consists of five wooden rods of different lengths equipped with discreet adjustable metal connections. These allow both the lamp base and the illuminated area to be aligned according to individual needs. As a battery-powered device, the lamp achieves a running time of approximately eight hours at full power and a running time of up to twelve hours at medium power. The portable table lamp is optionally available in oak, ash wood or walnut.

The JBL 4309 Studio Monitor is a small, powerful bookshelf speaker. For detailed sound, the 1-inch compression driver is mated to a horn in advanced HDI geometry. The appearance of the unit harkens back to the JBL professional studio monitor design with the iconic blue baffle and exposed horn. Two finishes are available, including satin Walnut and Black Walnut woodgrain veneer with a matching blue or black grille.

This compact wine cooler offers space for 41 bottles, which can be stored at a precise temperature. Due to its size it can also be placed under a counter. The appliance is operated via an integrated touch display, which is hidden from view when the door is closed. The ideal serving or storage temperature can be set with the “Perfect Set” function. Noteworthy features include the wide-slat walnut shelving that cushions wine from harmful vibration and the UV-blocking glass door.

Shaquda “Ubu” is a set of 17 makeup brushes to treat the entire face and specific parts in detail. The hair tips of the brush heads are designed to caress the skin with silky softness. The handles are made of oiled walnut wood; the brushes are applied to them with-out ferrules or any other movable parts. All elements of the set are manufac-tured environmentally friendly.

With its delicate lines, the bed Light manages elegantly to tame the natural characteristics of wood. Graceful, slanted legs conform to the manufacturer’s trademark style while the two broad bars of the bed head add a refined touch. The precise construction of the bed is reflected by the details: only the head of the wooden peg, for example, hints at the point where the sides of the bed are connected to each other. Light is available in walnut or oak.

The AJ7 audio system blends into a home interior just like a piece of furniture. The basic idea of the design concept is “honesty and simplicity”, manifesting in straight lines and plain elements. This approach results in a piece of fur­niture reminiscent of a small cabinet or side table. The homely appearance is underscored by the use of high-grade walnut wood, by largely dispensing with artificial materials and by atmo­spheric lighting at the bottom.

Modern interior design concepts present authentic materials with their own unique character. The feel of the surface is as important as their optical appearance. The new cover frames from Gira Esprit made of aluminium with walnut veneer are predestined for such concepts. They authentically communicate the naturalness of wood.

The Tre stool is made up of three identically designed plywood legs, which are held together by a thin aluminium plate underneath the seat and a steel ring on the inner sides of the legs. Together with the wooden structure in the middle of the seat, this specific connection lends it a distinctive appeal. The stool is available in oak, walnut and beech veneer as well as with an optional seat pad.

The Mi Shu piano stool represents a successful combination of ergonomics and aesthetics. With its height adjustable via insertable bars, the stool features a sensitive, flexible joint which supports the spine, helping the user to find optimal balance and a smooth flow of movement. This movement has a relaxing and invigorating effect on the spinal column, facilitating a comfortable sitting position even for hours on end. The curved seat not only lends an aesthetic accent but also encourages the spine to take an upright posture. Together with the matching footrest, the piano stool forms a visually coherent unit and can even be implemented for music lessons with children. So as to optically harmonise with a grand piano, the Mi Shu is available in a black coat finish as well as in domestic woods of beech, cherry and walnut.

In premium restaurants, the preparation of meat is synonymous with high art. The sknife steak cutlery perfectly reflects such sophisticated food culture in both its form and function. Developed in collaboration with top gastronomes, it fascinates with its elegant language of form and selected materials. It is forged and completed entirely by hand to reflect a special appreciation for both the materials used and the manufacturing tradition. The blade of the knife is made of durable surgical steel and can also be forged for knife lovers specifically in torsion damask steel with over 1,000 layers. This steak cutlery impresses with its expressive language of form. Made of local, stabilised ash tree or walnut wood, the handle forms a virtually seamless line with the blade, perfect for the use in gastronomy. Visually enticing and pleasing to the touch, this cutlery lies comfortably and perfectly balanced in the hand. The consciously flowing transition from the handle to the blade enables outstandingly ergonomic cutting and thanks to the optimised design the cut surface is contactless. In addition, this steak cutlery is also highly durable, as the steel blade has a four times higher corrosion resistance and high hardness of 58 HRC. The cutlery embodies a subtle and sophisticated design that has emerged as an exclusive result that fascinates with its special appeal and materiality.

Wood furniture possesses its own fascination. As a natural material wood is highly versatile, opening up indefinite design possibilities. The once spectacular invention of bending wood by steaming it, the so-called bentwood technique, has lent chair design an entirely new aesthetic. The design of the kayak chair also centres on sounding out the shaping possibilities of wood. The aim was to reduce the thicknesses of a chair as much as possible without compromising its structural integrity. The result is a wood chair with an impressively new structure and light appearance. Based on an advanced technological process, it fascinates with its particular contours as well as the design of the transitional parts from the seating area to the rest. This lightweight chair is as ergonomic as functional with a shell that hugs the body, providing high user comfort. It is manufactured in different models including natural or dark stained oak, walnut and in some stains colour finishes of more intense tones such as coral or sage green, as well as pastel shades. It is not least due to this finely attuned colour concept that kayak is suitable for versatile interior use. The design lends the wood chair a highly remarkable expressive appearance.

Architecture and furniture design are in close, creative dialogue. Together, they shape rooms and help define their atmosphere. How much potential this combination has becomes apparent in the filigree workmanship of a wooden chair by Walter Knoll based on a concept by the architectural firm Foster + Partners. “The elegant, fluid form factor and ingeniously handcrafted woodwork of the Osuu Chair are extremely impressive,” the jury said in their verdict. “It also meets the highest standards of seating comfort. This is an item of furniture that adeptly fuses aesthetics and function.” It is the skilful combination of bentwood and plywood that gives the chair its flowing lines and high degree of stability and makes for a captivating design. Solid, steam-bent roundwood curves around the body, forming the arm- and backrest then seamlessly transitioning into the chair’s front legs. The slender seat, made of moulded plywood, creates an exciting contrast. It rests lightly on wooden cross struts and is gently arched over the backrest. Its organically sweeping silhouette is the result of a finely balanced interplay of traditional artisanry and modern manufacturing techniques and ensures the chair is comfortable and pleasant to sit on. This creative lightness of touch is reflected in the chair’s weight. At a mere 6 kg, the Osuu Chair is remarkably lightweight and versatile in use. Owing to its timeless aesthetic, it harmoniously blends in with a wide variety of interiors, whether in domestic living areas or public spaces. In addition to its elegant appearance, the high-quality workmanship and carefully selected materials ensure this piece of furniture has a long life it. It is made of FSC-certified wood sourced from sustainably managed forests in southern Germany. The range includes versions in oak and walnut, finished with natural hard wax. This gives the wood a matt silk finish and allows the grain of the wood to shine through to great effect. A choice of different wood colours provides creative freedom, allowing users to match the chair to different styles of interior. A seat pad is available in saddle leather for added comfort and can be attached to the chair with the help of clasps without requiring any tools.

The Y2 Integrated Cooker, composed of a dual-flame gas hob and an extractor hood with integrated lighting, exhibits a minimalist design with precise linearity. The matte black surface is elegantly accented by the back wall and control knobs made from walnut wood. The nanocoating of the splash guard ensures hygienic cleanliness, thus making it easy to remove grease. Numerous safety features such as thermocouples or the automatic interruption of gas supply when flames are detected enhance user comfort.

This range of elliptically shaped drawer cabinets has been manufactured to a high level of craftsmanship. The cabinets come in different heights and are made of high-quality walnut with a matt, oil-finished surface. Their sophisticated appearance ensures that they are just as suited to foyers as they are to dining, living and bedrooms in the home. These cabinets, sold as Martin’s Drawer-Boards in reference to the designer’s first name, complete an approximately 30-piece furniture collection.

The Lands wood trays collection consists of six products that perfectly correspond with each other. The design concept is inspired by airy landscapes and combines meticulous craftsmanship and modern production methods. The trays are made from solid ash or walnut. They can be put together in various ways but also be used separately. The zigzag surface ensures the stability and movement of the trays.

Valet by David Rockwell explores a new furniture typology that supports everyday living, working and entertaining. With tactile and refined materials and details—including full-grain saddle leather, American walnut, black steel and brushed brass—each piece redefines the essentials of modern living and fits seamlessly into home or hospitality environments. From lounge seating to customizable shelving, each of the 14 pieces in the collection has streamlined functionality. Grouped together in endless combinations, the pieces help create natural transitions from work to play in the home or hospitality setting.

materials.name: 橡木
materials.description: 橡木常用名称为橡木或栎木，来自栎属多种树木，是家具和室内产品中常见的阔叶木材。其纹理明显，通常具有较好的强度、耐磨性和表面涂饰效果，白橡与红橡在导管结构、色泽和耐久性方面存在差异。常用于家具、地板、酒桶、饰面板和结构木制品，性能受含水率影响明显。
materials.cognitiveText: 橡木在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 0.675–0.755 g/cm³。

Unique Art Boards made in collaboration with artists are available as collectables.

The Electric Fondue Set Pro combines traditional fondue culture with the functionality and simplicity of an electric set. A heating element with a safety thermostat maintains temperatures in the range of 50 to 190 degrees Celsius to suit cheese, meat, chocolate and bouillon fondues alike. The device, made of cast iron and oak, has a splash guard with notches for the fondue forks and is largely free of plastics. Thanks to its long mains cable, it can be used flexibly.

The Loop furniture collection is characterised by an attractive interplay of contrasts. It combines a sculptural base made of solid oak wood with the softness of organically moulded textile upholstery. In addition to artfully curved armrests, which inspired the name, the aesthetics are characterised by balanced proportions that also ensure pleasant comfort. The flexible collection includes armchairs, chairs, chaise longues and footstools that bring cosiness and elegance to a variety of room layouts.

Where people move frequently for work reasons, the traditional fitted kitchen becomes a problem due to a lack of flexibility. TERMINO’s modular kitchen system addresses this problem by being modular in design and made from lightweight yet durable materials such as recycled aluminium, 316L stainless steel and European oak. With 14 highly configurable, stackable modules, it adapts to a wide variety of layouts, as well as to changes in household size, needs or preferences.

The slimline oak Heart'n'Soul dining table, with its integrated, hidden extension leaves, can seat up to twelve people. At both ends of the table there is a fabric-lined drawer for storing important items, like cutlery, within easy reach. The Heart'n'Soul dining tables are available in dark oak and black oak versions, as well as oak versions with a highly scratch resistant nanolaminate finish in various colours. The rounded corners and smooth transitions from tabletop to table legs create a high-quality aesthetic.

The Diabolo Dumbbells were developed with a special focus on exclusivity and sustainability. When customising these free weights to their personal preferences, users can choose between different FSC-certified hardwoods for the handles, including reclaimed oak, and even order a personal engraving on the slightly concave-shaped end plate. Each dumbbell set is made to order with the aim of preventing material waste and the production of superfluous equipment. The lifetime guarantee also ensures that the stylish training equipment can be repaired rather than replaced. The jury praised the Diabolo Dumbbells as “an excellent example of how elegance and sustainability can be successfully combined”.

IKA innovatively advances the design of folding chairs. The seat and legs are made of high-quality oak and are combined with a sturdy leather strap, which has two functions: it serves as a convenient backrest, but also as a carrying strap. This facilitates the transport of IKA when folded. The iron fittings are deliberately used as a striking design feature.

Distinctive visual accents with a contrast between gloss and matt surfaces, along with a combination of oak and aluminium, characterise this compact wine cooler. The frameless door with its tinted, UV-absorbent glass, together with the appealing interior lighting, presents the contents in an attractive light. The wine cooler offers a satisfying user experience with a pull-out shelf and two temperature zones that can be controlled individually.

The handle-free built-under Siemens Freestanding Wine Cooler cools and elegantly showcases fine wines. Its dark metal body, which tastefully complements the graphite-grey interior, creates an effective display for white and red wines. From the solid oak shelves to the door with UV filter, the materials and overall design exude strong value.

Inspired by a kinetic sculpture, this table lamp consists of five wooden rods of different lengths equipped with discreet adjustable metal connections. These allow both the lamp base and the illuminated area to be aligned according to individual needs. As a battery-powered device, the lamp achieves a running time of approximately eight hours at full power and a running time of up to twelve hours at medium power. The portable table lamp is optionally available in oak, ash wood or walnut.

The Siemens Freestanding Wine Cooler provides plenty of room for fine wines that are showcased in an appealing manner. Dark grey tones in the interior frame the stored bottles, while the metallic-grey tinted glass door protects the bottles from harmful UV light. The exclusive overall appearance is enhanced by solid aluminium profiles on the front of the real oak shelves. The presenter shelf that can be set at an angle allows special treasures to be beautifully arranged.

This robust pizza peel was designed in the style of a garden shovel and equipped with a handle made of solid oak wood. This patented handle enables one-handed use, as its smoothly sanded wooden surface rests firmly against the forearm during use. The blade made of high-quality aluminium boasts an only 2 mm thick edge that easily slides under the pizza base. The pizza peel is suitable for pizzas with a diameter of up to 30 cm.

The Siemens BU30 wine cooler is characterised by high-quality features and a modern functionality and was designed for fitted kitchens. The slender appliance with 30 cm width has a dark surface with a milled, black anodised bar handle made of genuine metal. The graphite grey interior is combined with oak wood shelves, which have solid aluminium profiles on the front. A tinted UV protection of the door as well as innovative temperature regulation and control by touch operation ensure optimised storage conditions.

The characteristic style element of this bathroom furniture series is the shape it is named after – oval. The collection is furthermore defined by a high-contrast material combination that blends warm oak or ash wood with dark grey powder-coated metal elements. The versatile and functionally sophisticated components merge into a homogeneous entity. With its highly distinctive design, the collection lends bathrooms a unique and exclusive style.

Reverse Conference is a series of conference tables, available with one or multiple bases and variable tabletops in 14 sizes. The table displays an elegant look with its 30 mm laminated wood plate in oak veneer or lacquered style, and the contrasting thick bases tapering upward. The base frames are made of 100 per cent recyclable polyethylene and come in matt or glossy versions.

These open shelving elements in light design, used as end shelving in the cabinet area, take the interior of the kitchen to the outside and facilitate opening of the kitchen into the living and dining area. The shelves are flexible to use. In the rear panel, system rails are located which can accommodate, apart from shelves of glass or oak, also drawers or storage boxes and utensil holders.

With its delicate lines, the bed Light manages elegantly to tame the natural characteristics of wood. Graceful, slanted legs conform to the manufacturer’s trademark style while the two broad bars of the bed head add a refined touch. The precise construction of the bed is reflected by the details: only the head of the wooden peg, for example, hints at the point where the sides of the bed are connected to each other. Light is available in walnut or oak.

This entrance door is 220 mm thick and its exterior is completely covered with glass, thus allowing it to blend in harmoniously with the house entrance. On the side is a functional channel in black anodised aluminium which contains the bell and a door-opening module together with the letterbox. The inside of the door is made of fine woods, such as varnished German wild oak, a feature which underlines its exclusive character.

The AUGLETICS Eight Style ergometer is clad in a chic oak wall and can be optimally connected. It is almost noiseless as the resistance is generated by an eddy current brake. With a Virtual Coach, every stroke can be analysed in real time and the user’s technique can be continuously improved. The integrated touch display ensures simple operation. The ergometer can be stowed away in two easy steps and, folded up, fits in any corner.

materials.name: 竹材
materials.description: 竹材常用名称为竹材或竹木，来源于竹秆，经干燥、防护、剖分、层压或重组后可形成板材和构件。其纤维沿生长方向排列，具有较高比强度和鲜明纹理，但性能受竹种、部位、含水率及胶合方式影响。常用于家具、餐具、地板、包装、建筑构件和可持续产品设计。
materials.cognitiveText: 竹材在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 0.68–1.02 g/cm³。

cases.description: The continuation of the work-at-home trend is associated with challenges to remote workers. Their homes do not always have enough space for the integration of an attractive and ergonomic workstation that leaves the look and feel of the room fundamentally intact. Float Mini offers the perfect solution with its compact design and cosy aesthetics. The rounded corners, slim profile and matt textures help it blend harmoniously into a home environment without sacrificing functionality – a feature that only becomes obvious during use. An off-centre base ensures that no table legs get in the way when the users change their sitting position, and the infinitely variable height adjustment feature permits ergonomic working while standing. Humanscale is both the name and the mission of the manufacturer, whose products are consistently designed for user-centric functionality. Float Mini can also be fitted with castors for mobility, and the desktop options of bamboo, MDF or linoleum in a warm colour palette cater to personal preferences. “Float Mini is reminiscent of the wabi-sabi aesthetic,” commented the Red Dot jurors. “The asymmetrical design ensures that it can perfectly fulfil its function. It offers a remarkable level of quality and user convenience, and the desk is adaptable to a variety of settings beyond the home office, such as hotels or living spaces.” The product designers spent a long time fine-tuning Float Mini to achieve its intuitive functionality and unique character. Every detail, from the geometry of the base to the mechanical feel of the height adjustment, was worked on until perfection was achieved. The materials were intentionally chosen to balance aesthetic appeal, eco-friendliness and longevity. Last but not least, the minimalist design reflects the modern-day consumer demand for products that are repairable and made of just a few components. “Fewer parts mean fewer potential points of failure, easier disassembly and better recyclability,” said the product designers. All variants of Float Mini prove that this approach produces beautiful results.

The Float Mini table seamlessly blends classic residential aesthetics with Humanscale’s renowned ergonomic design, offering a compact, versatile solution for both home and workspaces. Designed to promote natural movement, Float Mini effortlessly adjusts to various heights, providing an essential component for an ergonomic setup that enhances user well-being. Available in a refined palette of colors, Float Mini complements any environment, with surface options that include sustainable bamboo and a new natural linoleum material. This eco-friendly linoleum is wear-resistant, anti-static, and fingerprint-proof, featuring a soft matte finish.

Bathtubs, in particular stand-alone ones, offer little to no space to store items like towels, shampoo, books, glasses, and tablets. TUBLER, the bathroom butler, is a flexible piece of furniture for stand-alone bathtubs that can also be used with built-in bathtubs. TUBLER is manufactured mainly from eco-friendly bamboo, cotton, and stainless steel, withstands the bathroom environment, and is fully recyclable. TUBLER is a space-saving, highly practical combination of shelf and table for almost all bathtubs on the market.

materials.name: PP
materials.description: PP常用名称为聚丙烯或PP塑料，是密度较低、用途广泛的热塑性聚合物。它耐化学品、耐湿、易注塑和挤出，并具有良好的反复弯折疲劳性能，可制作一体式活铰链。常见于食品容器、家居用品、医疗耗材、汽车内饰、无纺布和包装薄膜，但低温冲击性能及耐候性需要关注。
materials.cognitiveText: PP在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 0.92–0.94 g/cm³。

cases.description: We integrate the function of the handle into the pull rod, and the top is inlaid with the pp environmental protection material panel to create a flat and high-quality mobile desk, so that users are no longer limited by the scene when they are on business travel, whether they are processing documents or reading and writing. We have adopted the latest NFC technology, which is fully compatible with IOS and Android systems. The trolley case can be unlocked when the mobile phone is close to it, which improves the convenience of unpacking and cancels the password design to further improve the security of the luggage.

With the increasing number of luggage, environmental protection is also a very important issue. The ITP FN-A uses environmentally friendly materials and is designed with a 3-to-7 ratio to increase visual beauty.What sets the ITP FN-A apart is not just its aesthetic appeal but also its commitment to responsible travel. Embrace sustainability with the option of 83% recycled PP or 83% 0BP certified recycled PP making it the conscientious choice for themodern traveler. Meet the FN-A ITP's latest innovation in trunk cases.Elevate your travel experience with this stylish and functional luggage companions.

“Understated in its design, versatile in its use and equipped with impressive features that ensure a high level of wearing comfort,” said the jury, highlighting the various advantages of the extremely lightweight, two-piece down jacket. Down or woollen materials are used in different areas of the inner and outer jacket to provide a high-precision combination of thermal insulation and moisture absorption. The outer layer, with its timeless design, is made of 100 per cent recycled wind- and waterproof Windstopper fabric, making the garment an uncomplicated accessory for use in the city, on camping trips and for various types of sports.

Especially developed for the Asian market, these bottles can be transformed into a storage box in an instant thanks to the included sealing cap. Thus, the bottles can still be used when the child has grown out of babyhood. The ergonomic handles support the development of motor skills, and the teats are available in different textures for younger and older babies.

PPSU, a high-strength and temperature-resistant material also employed in vehicle construction, was used for these characterful hexagonal glasses. This enables a direct connection between the front of the glasses and the temples – without additional reinforcement. For the first time, the Titanflex components are dowelled directly in the plastic with pins. This construction ensures light weight while providing stability. Also extraordinary is the radiance of the colours.

The Ca Go FS 200 electric cargo bike stands out for the design of its innovative cargo box. The EPP safety box has adjustable headrests and 5-point seatbelts, providing space for two children. The low loading platform with the dual batteries installed under the cargo box shifts the centre of gravity further downwards and optimises the weight distribution over the front wheel, ensuring stable travel and cornering, even unloaded. Short pedal crank arms ensure that the feet of the rider can safely reach the ground at all times.

This product for the Chinese market connects the extractor hood to the wall edge of the hob. A multistage water filter is integrated into the 10 cm deep connector, which cleans the water with PP cotton, activated carbon and reverse osmosis. The water flows directly into the pot through a lateral faucet. Smoke outlets halfway up and at the top of the hood are specially designed to suit Chinese cooking habits, since the preparation of wok dishes produces a lot of smoke.

The cleaning of floor drains is often very cumbersome. The design goal of Kun was to optimise this process and reduce the cleaning effort. Inspired by a seesaw, the floor drain can be lifted quickly by pressing down on any of the four corners. The integrated filter components can be removed with a simple rotating movement. The corrosion- and temperature-resistant polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) material significantly extends the service life of Kun.

The Bottle Mate serves as an adapter and filter for water bottles and turns tap water into healthy drinking water. On business trips, on the road or at school, it is extremely practical. With carbon fibre inside, it reduces lead and other heavy metals harmful to the human body. Residual chlorine and organic pollutants are also removed, thus improving the taste and quality of the water. With dimensions of 35 × 35 × 65 mm and a weight of 36 grams, the compact adapter is BPA-free and made of PP and silica gel.

The soft and smooth curve modelling lends the Grace basin faucet a noble appearance. It can therefore be easily integrated into modern bathroom spaces. Its thinly shaped handle ensures a comfortable operating experience. The water is injected into a waterfall bubbler to provide a soft and delicate jet to save water. The faucet body contains a water channel structure made of heat-resistant PPA material, which prevents the water from being contaminated with heavy metals.

The pump group is designed to meet the growing demands placed on technical devices and systems in boiler rooms. The exterior of MeiFlow Top S is characterised by rounded edges as well as a colour and material combination that is rich in contrast. The housing features EPP insulation. The sophisticated technology is cleverly hidden behind the white, distinctively smooth and homogeneously designed front.

With their replaceable cup heads and teats, the Avent PPSU Straw Cups adapt to the changing needs of babies and toddlers. In particular, they facilitate a smooth transition from the teat to the straw. The latter features an air pressure valve that prevents fluids from spilling while drinking, and the hinged lid provides reliable sealing on the go. The handles are ergonomically shaped, and thanks to a separate sealing cap, the cups can also be used as storage containers.

The shape of Guide-C is characterised by elegant and concise lines. The faucet outlet is cleverly implanted in the button panel. It can be turned on by one button to provide a clean and comfortable shower experience. By incorporating a silica gel pores-pressurised water outlet design, it can shower a larger area at the same water flow rate. The faucet body contains a water channel structure made of a heat-resistant PPA material to prevent contamination of the water with heavy metals.

Barocco filters the outside air and transports fresh air into the living space. The streamlined inner ducts are made of the environmentally-friendly expanded polypropylene (EPP), which effectively reduces air resistance and thus also noise when in operation. Thanks to its very slim form, Barocco is suitable for installation in small spaces and easy to maintain as replacing the filter does not require much space due to an inclined pull-out angle.

The side-lock solid wood flooring is a glue-free, keel-free, flat push floor that can be installed easily and cost-efficiently. Its remarkable advantages are that the PPR plastic lock saves wood and increases the surface utilisation rate by more than 10 per cent, that it is easy to install and that it can be reused. The floor is resistant to high temperatures, waterproof as well as resistant to deformation and ageing, which ensures a long and healthy service life thanks to environmentally friendly materials and processing. This system is known as a recognised DIY solid wood flooring.

The Trama Basket recovers in a unique way the concept of “Brazilianess” found in indigenous handicraft, more precisely in the art of weaving and looming, where the designers sought inspiration to create a novel product. The designers’ greatest challenge was to transform the concept of hand weaving and looming into an industrialized product and apply an alternative raw material from natural fibers used by indigenous artisans.  The Trama Basket is produced in polypropylene (PP) with a 40% addition of natural resin fibers extracted from sugar cane, thus reducing plastic polymer consumption. The basket is injection molded and bonded together by a special binding system without using glue or welding.

The D-cloud sofa was designed to help ease the anxiety and uneasiness caused by a modern, fast-paced life. By extending the backrest and adjusting the shape of the sofa, users can create a sense of being enveloped, giving them privacy and distance from the outside world. D-cloud replaces foam with EPP (expanded polypropylene) to enhance the fluidity of the sofa’s shape to better fit the human body. The fluidity of EPP particles, its superior elasticity, and its shock resistance provide a comfortable sitting experience. EPP can be recycled and reused; it also decomposes naturally.

Oriented toward young users in China, the Mi Standing Fan Pro features an ultra-slim design that addresses the common challenges, such as limited living space and storage during off-seasons. Its unique design allows for easy storage when not in use, supporting desktop and floor standing use. The Type-C charging port and power bank make it an ideal choice in various scenarios, such as outdoor camping and in-vehicle storage. The box, made from eco-friendly EPP foam materials, not only protects the fan but also serves as a storage container, reducing material waste compared to traditional ones.

BYD YangWang U8 is a luxury new energy  off-road vehicle, designed to provide users with the extreme performance and safety off-road experience. Taking inspiration from the Chinese  traditional  culture and the  universe.U8 show YangWang's design understanding in the era of "EV Power" through a prospective and hardcore exterior and luxury interior. U8 equipped with BYD's new technologies, such as"Yi Si Fang" four-electric motor platform, "Yunian-P" intelligent suspension system , "IP68" waterproofing, bring extreme safety and performance to the users.

The Ninebot electric bike B series follows a simple and fashionable design style, and its goal is to create a light urban transportation tool for young consumers. The lightweight size and bright and beautiful body colors reflect the vitality of young people. The Ninebot electric bike B features the original "rideygo!" intelligent system designed for share & ride public transport. Users can automatically unlock the scooters using their phones thanks to the Ninebot airlock inductive unlocking technology.

materials.name: ABS
materials.description: ABS常用名称为ABS塑料或ABS树脂，中文全称为丙烯腈—丁二烯—苯乙烯共聚物。它综合了刚性、韧性、尺寸稳定性和较好的表面加工性能，可通过注塑、挤出、机加工与表面涂装制成复杂外壳。常见于家电、电子产品、玩具、工具外壳、汽车内饰和模型制作。
materials.cognitiveText: ABS在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 1.04–1.18 g/cm³。

cases.description: This patented suitcase system features a hard top and bottom crafted from ABS with 600D polyester lamination. The rest of the suitcase is made of a robust nylon fabric, which is otherwise commonly used in hiking boots. Fibreglass connecting rods reinforce the construction and reduce its overall weight. Apart from the trolley rods, the suitcase offers an integrated handle and allows quick access to selected items thanks to pockets on the front panel.

The Sky fountain pen focuses on the essential. The combination of a plain design and good price-performance ratio with high-quality materials make this a practical pen for daily use. Sky is made of ABS and is available in a wide range of colours. In addition to opaque options, the pen also comes in transparent plastic to reveal the inner working. Core components such as the nib are made in Germany.

The Urbanaut bicycle helmet was developed especially for e-bike users and is specially designed to resist the significant forces that can occur during falls at higher speeds. This is achieved by the fusion of different materials. The inner shell is made of two expanded polystyrene materials of different density that provide support and also a shock-absorbing function. The outer shell features a combination of ABS layers and polycarbonate, which minimizes the helmet’s volume and weight, guaranteeing optimal shock protection. Ventilation is regulatable via integrated air vents.

ZUS is a smart car charger and locating device. As soon as the car has been parked, ZUS stores the actual location on the owner’s smartphone so that the car can be found again at any time. The device charges connected devices twice as quickly as conventional chargers with 4.8 amperes. By the use of a special PC / ABS plastic and titanium-coated metal components, ZUS can withstand temperatures of up to 100 degrees Celsius.

The CE5X computer series offers modular desktop PCs with customisable I/O panels and flexible hardware configuration for a wide range of working environments. This makes it compatible with various motherboards and hardware configurations and enables easy reconfiguration of the ports. Tool-free assembly and an integrated handle facilitate use and maintenance. The status display provides real-time information on system load and dust accumulation via light signals.

The Husqvarna Skutta electric scooter is an advanced solution for urban mobility with a look reminiscent of modern motorbikes. The scooter is easy to operate and is characterised by a removable battery and a specially developed folding design around the front axle. Thanks to the larger front tyre and the low riding position, the Husqvarna Skutta offers stability when cornering and responsive braking performance. The high-quality components and suitability for everyday use are combined in a robust and modern package.

This selfie stick is tailored to the needs of video bloggers and can be used as a floor-standing stick. Despite its compact dimensions, it offers three-axis stability. Thanks to its ergonomic design and rubberised handle, the stick is easy to hold for longer periods of time and can be used with one hand. The use of aluminium alloys and ABS plastic makes the stick durable and informs its contemporary appearance.

Performance, durability and rugged aesthetics are at the forefront of the SanDisk Extreme SSD. It consists of a rigid ABS core with a silicone exterior that is water-repellent, dustproof and protects against damage from impact. In addition, the silicone is silky smooth and has a pleasant feel. The recess for a carabiner and the discreet perforated pattern give the SSD a distinctive look with high recognition value.

The design of the ONE fountain pen was inspired by traditional writing quills, and the width of the nib corresponds to common Chinese handwriting customs. The casing is made from high-quality ABS material, which makes it robust and resistant to damage through falling or wear. Its surface is roughened, so that the fountain pen lies comfortably in the hand. Thanks to its low weight it facilitates writing by hand for a long time without causing fatigue.

The compact steriliser was designed for the disinfection of milk bottles. It is characterised by a clear and friendly design language. The asymmetrical form of the front door clearly emphasises the black touch panel, which enables easy operation. In addition to UV disinfection, the appliance offers features for safe bottle storage and hot air drying. A body made of high-quality ABS plastic with an interior made of stainless steel guarantees a durable use.

The tankless water purifier from LG impresses with its slim design and a faucet that can be turned by 180 degrees. Therefore, the appliance can be easily installed in any area of the kitchen. Moreover, the faucet detects the height of the vessel and adjusts automatically to avoid splashes when pouring. The body is made of metallic ABS plastic with a hairline pattern and provides a particularly high-quality appearance. The control panels have a user-friendly design.

The instax mini Link 2 connects the real world with the virtual in a simple yet fun way. This smartphone printer features a new AR function that can be used to draw in the air with a variety of effects when taking pictures. With a wide range of unique functions to enjoy creating photos, it inspires creativity and priceless interactions with friends and family.

cases.productName: SmartAppGuided™ Sonic Warm & Cool Mask I 9 in 1
cases.description: The Sonic Warm & Cool Mask was developed for an all-around spa-like facial treatment. The pore-opening deep-warming technology primes the skin for the optimal absorption of serums and creams. For closing the pores and a depuffing effect, the structured ABS surface turns cold in seconds.

This can opener is easier and safer to use than traditional versions. A user locks onto the can and simply turns the knob to cut off the lid, eliminating the need to continually compress the handles. The opener pierces the lid and locks securely onto cans of all sizes. A magnet with a release lever lifts the lid and releases it for safe and easy disposal. Simply press a button to release the lid – hands never touch it. Handles are ABS-covered with Santoprene rubber for a durable, non-slip grip.

Venova is a wind instrument that lets beginners enjoy tenor saxophone-like playing feel and performance. The Venova’s branched pipe structure and meandering shape produce a saxophone-like tone from a compact portable form with few keys. It is made of light impact-resistant washable ABS resin. The simple maintainability and recorder-style fingering help inexperienced players learn to play the instrument. It offers a feel and tone that satisfies advanced players as well. The series includes soprano and alto versions too, offering the enjoyment of playing in three registers.

The Square Solidity door lock series redefines home security as a lifestyle statement, offering three models tailored to modern living: the premium push-pull type, the standard lever type, and the practical mini lever type. At its core is the rectangular, angular handle, designed not only for a sturdy, ergonomic grip but also as a refined lifestyle object that complements modern home aesthetics. As American lifestyles diversify and elevate with rising economic prosperity, homes increasingly reflect personalized values and tastes. In this context, Square Solidity transcends its role as a security device, becoming a curated design element that enhances daily rituals and home identity. Constructed from PC, ABS, and metal, the locks balance durability with aesthetic excellence, while the minimized parting lines and absence of decorative pieces reinforce a sleek, modern profile. Ultimately, Square Solidity offers functional elegance, transforming the entryway into a personalized design statement that reflects contemporary lifestyles.

cases.productName: Electric Pumice Foot Smoothing Spinning Sphere
cases.description: The SmartAppGuided™ Electric Pumice Foot Smoothing Spinning Sphere | 8 in 1 delivers advanced, customizable foot care with professional-grade results. This compact device features an array of attachments—'Regular', 'Precise', and 'Comfort'—for versatile exfoliation and smoothing. Its innovative technology includes a Dry and Dead Cell Removing System, painless exfoliation, and adjustable spin speed to cater to all skin types. The Easy Exchange Discs and protective cap ensure convenience and longevity. It represents the pinnacle of luxury foot care at home.

cases.productName: Electric Pumice Foot Smoothing Roller with Handle
cases.description: The SmartAppGuided™ Electric Pumice Foot Smoothing Roller | 7 in 1 by GESKE is a cutting-edge foot care device designed for effortless foot rejuvenation. Its professional-grade VelvetSole System and multiple exfoliation modes ensure smooth, callus-free feet. Equipped with a durable pumice stone and adjustable spin speed, it tailors to different skin needs. The sleek design includes a protective cap and easy-click attachments for maximum hygiene and convenience. Supported by the GESKE app, users receive personalized routines and AI-powered skin scans.

The industrial design of the Leica Cine Play 1 is based on Leica's core guiding principle, "das Wesentliche". The mini projector is designed in accordance to our philosophy of simplicity and reduction, authenticity in materials, excellence of execution and precision in the details. The swing arm and the variation between baseplates for table use and a floorbased use without disturbing power cords is one of the main features of the product design. The design features and highlights demonstate how the design language of our products is always consistent with the underlying engineering with function playing a central role to all product design.

PURE ONE STATION is a self-cleaning vacuum station that offers an intelligent, efficient, and healthy home cleaning solution. Integrated with the vacuum cleaner, it has an automatic cleaning mechanism that activates after each use, ensuring a dust-free state. Equipped with a 6-liter ABS dustbin, users can use it for up to 60 days without frequent waste handling or additional consumables. The pet grooming attachment addresses hair scattering issues. This innovative solution embodies advanced technology and user-friendliness, providing a convenient, effective, and hygienic home cleaning experience.

materials.name: PA
materials.description: PA常用名称为尼龙或PA塑料，材料学名称为聚酰胺。其分子链含有酰胺基团，通常具有较高强度、耐磨性、耐疲劳性和良好的自润滑特征。不同尼龙牌号及含水状态会显著影响尺寸和力学性能。常用于齿轮、轴承、扣件、织物纤维、工具零件及结构性注塑件。
materials.cognitiveText: PA在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 1.13–1.14 g/cm³。

cases.description: JBL Wind 3 delivers sound via Bluetooth and is equipped with an AUX input and FM radio. Its compact design also features an LED-backlit LCD. The device is IPX7 certified and can be installed on old and new handlebars by using the supplied nylon handlebar mount. Undocked, JBL Wind 3 can be clipped onto a backpack’s shoulder strap or attached to a lanyard, for example. Thus, the speaker can easily be used on the street or cycle path.

Less is More is a flush plate for toilets, which is available in black, white, brushed or polished. Its designer, Alessio Pinto, was inspired by Ludwig Mies van der Rohe and his design principle “less is more”, as well as by the history of the mechanism, and wanted to give it an innovative and sustainable form. “Plus and minus, not more and not less” is his motto. The plate therefore displays neither signs nor symbols, but simply offers two grey nylon cords as the control options.

The Crescent Lufkin Shockforce has been developed for experts, in particular for professionals in the building trade. In this context, impact protection, durability and tape stand out are the main criteria for a good tape measure. This is taken into account by the choice of materials, a reduction in weight and sophisticated details such as the blade geometry. Further features are the good legibility and the durable nylon coating of the tape, which is printed on both sides. The tape hook has a diamond-coated finish that grips almost any surface. The tether point likewise serves as a pivot point for marking arches.

Laughing Owl is a very light and roomy three-pole tunnel tent for four people. The fly sheet is made of Gorlyn 30 nylon ripstop fabric, which is a 6.6 nylon that has a higher tensile strength than most tent constructions. The spacious living area has three large windows made of FabVue material, which has the look and feel of a mesh but is actually a woven fabric and thus lighter and more durable. The light and strong 13.55 mm DAC-PL aluminium poles are characterised by a high degree of elasticity.

Mobility by bicycle is part of a modern urban lifestyle. This handlebar bag combines an elegant appearance with sophisticated functionality and a design that is oriented to the flowing use between the office, daily routines and leisure time. The robust and water-resistant nylon material with a textile look ensures a long life and high functionality. By means of the self-explanatory Klickfix adapters, the bag attaches to all standard handlebars.

Snowflake is a pendant luminaire made of FSC-certified bamboo plywood. It is sold as a kit, which reduces the volume for shipping to a minimum. Furthermore, this gives users the fun and satisfaction of having easily assembled their own lighting system. Push-in nylon clips keep the pieces together and ensure that the lamp automatically takes up its shape during assembly. The design of the luminaire, which is available in three different sizes, was inspired by a trip to the Antarctic.

The Nikau pendant luminaire is made of FSC-certified bamboo plywood and sold as a kit of single parts. It can easily be assembled on site via push-in nylon clips. The lamp comes in two versions: the long version works best in the corner of a room and several of them serve as a room divider, whereas the short version shown here is suited for direct illumination, for example of tables. The shadow play of the luminaire yields a dynamic effect. The name Nikau refers to the name of the only indigenous palm tree in New Zealand.

Wind was developed with the objective of designing a new archetype of a bookcase. The modular aluminium bookcase system features extruded shelves and die-cast uprights. The aesthetics of the system are defined both horizontally and vertically by the filigree aluminium uprights, while the nylon fibre joints ensure a high degree of stability. Closing element of each composition is an aluminium laminated, lacquered MDF panel.

This patented suitcase system features a hard top and bottom crafted from ABS with 600D polyester lamination. The rest of the suitcase is made of a robust nylon fabric, which is otherwise commonly used in hiking boots. Fibreglass connecting rods reinforce the construction and reduce its overall weight. Apart from the trolley rods, the suitcase offers an integrated handle and allows quick access to selected items thanks to pockets on the front panel.

The main idea behind the DAYFARER is to offer a backpack that allows a smooth transition from the world of work to sports activities. Accordingly, a ventilated shoe compartment at the bottom of the bag keeps trainers away from other belongings, while an upholstered laptop pocket ensures the transport of the work equipment. The spacious main compartment opens flat like a suitcase, shoulder straps and back are well cushioned. The backpack is made of ballistic nylon fabric with water-repelling external coating.

The Portree backpack bag combines an elegant design with sophisticated functionality. Made of robust, water-repellent nylon material, it has been tailored to the flowing use between the office, everyday life and leisure. It can be attached to standard bicycle racks by means of Vario hooks and, thanks to an integrated strap, serve as a practical backpack. A padded notebook compartment is included for professional use.

Norco Lifestyle is a bag made of nylon fabric with an inherently stable top cover and a magnetic rotary fastener fashioned from aluminium. The fastener closes automatically and opens with a half turn. The bag is available in two sizes and features backside hooks, which allow it to be securely fixed and quickly removed from conventional bicycle racks. It contains a cushioned notebook or iPad compartment and various organiser pockets.

The bicycle fork mount was developed for the professional and secure transport of road and mountain bikes. The major component parts of the product are made of aluminium and nylon. It is based on a quick-exchange system for mounting a conventional 9-mm fork or a 15-mm through-axle fork using a quick-release mechanism. The configuration does not necessitate the use of tools. A central locking system secures the bicycle to the carrier.

The multifunctional CBS chair programme embodies a modern vision of a chair series conceived to satisfy the expectations of a broad target group. The elegant design underscores the chair’s comfort with a wide, enveloping back, which is based on an extremely thin one-piece nylon shell. Finely cut in the lumbar area, the back provides enhanced freedom of movement during sitting. The CBS chair is available with a black or white shell, each with or without coloured pads. There is also an optional metal frame, allowing for several different configurations.

This eyewear collection features a special coating, which creates a glossy look and striking patterns on very light polymer frames. Hand-stitched elastic nylon strings connected to the joints put less stress on the material and enhance flexibility of the temple movement. With the aid of metal components, the titanium temples can function with spring effect during folding and unfolding.

The Freeride Pro 20L daypack was developed for freeriders and freeskiers, featuring a variety of storage compartments, attachment possibilities, as well as an integrated back protector that can also be detached and used separately. The design concept focuses on important functions required for use on mountains: ergonomic neoprene shoulder straps and a wide hip-belt with Velcro and buckle fastenings ensure high wearing comfort, while a signalling whistle and a quickly accessible avalanche compartment allow users to react expeditiously in case of emergency.

This tyre for utility terrain vehicles (UTV), with its innovative design using a nylon material, conforms to the current trend of making UTV tyres, like sedan tyres, out of polyester and with a steel belt. The result is a reinforced radial tyre which is also given a newly developed, concave profile. This means that the tyre is not only flatter than usual but above all offers better and more stable driving on rough terrain.

The Tapole Series T is manufactured in an innovative process which enables production of the frame of nylon and titanium without the use of screws or adhesives. Based on the properties of titanium alloy, by laser cutting and bending the sheet of titanium, a consistent hinge structure is created. The temples of the frame, which weighs less than 6.5 grams, are very flexible and easily adjustable.

With only 11 x 22 cm the Lofoten 1 ULW exhibits an exceptionally small pack size, and with 490 grams an extremely low weight for a double-walled one person tent. Stable aluminium poles with particularly short segments enable the reduced pack size, and the seven denier nylon of 26g/sqm with a thread count of 580 the extreme low weight. On both sides the fabric is siliconised in three layers thus guaranteeing high elasticity, and the water column of 1,600 mm creates a pleasant microclimate.

The design of this facial cleansing device is inspired by the shape of an egg and a bird’s nest. Its translucent body provides a view of one of the soft brushes inside. While the silicone brush is suitable for daily use, the nylon brush has been specially developed for the cleansing of oily skin and the puff head helps to remove makeup. Using high-frequency sonic vibration, the device removes dead skin and massages skincare products deeply into the skin.

materials.name: PMMA
materials.description: PMMA常用名称为亚克力、有机玻璃或压克力，化学名称为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯。它是透明度较高的无定形热塑性塑料，具有良好的耐候性、着色性和机械加工性能，常作为玻璃替代材料。典型应用包括灯具、展示架、标识、透明罩、汽车灯具和光学件，但抗冲击性低于PC。
materials.cognitiveText: PMMA在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 1.18–1.2 g/cm³。

cases.description: The Lenovo Tab is a 10.1-inch tablet designed by Lenovo specifically for children and families. This tablet has a carefully designed appearance and meaningful accessories. The play suite, tailored for children, offers versatile usability in horizontal and vertical orientations, ensuring convenience for young users. The included stylus empowers children to express their creativity freely. The tablet ingeniously combines metal and PMMA to fulfil antenna requirements while exuding a unique, high-quality appearance. Furthermore, the tablet has a transparent case featuring a built-in stand and a folio case, providing users with versatile options.

materials.name: TPU
materials.description: TPU常用名称为热塑性聚氨酯或TPU弹性体，是可熔融加工的聚氨酯类弹性材料。它兼具橡胶般的弹性与热塑性塑料的成型效率，通常具有耐磨、抗撕裂、耐油和良好回弹性。常用于手机保护套、鞋材、软管、电缆护套、薄膜、滚轮及可穿戴产品，不同软硬段配方差异较大。
materials.cognitiveText: TPU在“密度”尺度中的参数区间为 1.05–1.34 g/cm³。

cases.description: The soundcore AeroClip is a C-shaped open-ear clip-on headphone: the larger part is positioned behind the ear, while the smaller sound chamber sits in front of the ear canal. Memory titanium and TPU ensure a secure fit without any pressure. The housing has a simple design and is available in a choice of two colours. The device is operated by tapping anywhere on the earbuds, ensuring easy use when commuting, exercising or at work. Four microphones with AI noise cancellation make phone calls easier.

The Totectors Rushden AT WP combines the features of a safety shoe with the aesthetics and comfort of sports shoes. The reinforced toe box has been discreetly integrated into the shoe. The TPU reinforcements protect the high-wear zones and blend harmoniously into the mesh upper, giving the shoe a light and sporty appearance. The colour scheme further underlines this impression. The shoe offers a high level of comfort and is waterproof so that it can be worn all year round.

The ASUS Chromebook Detachable CZ1 helps students to reach their full potential. Equipped with a range of protective features, including a durable chassis and a shockproof cover, it is ideal for use in the classroom. The surface of the cover is made of TPU and plastic to protect against scratches and stains. The versatile device can be used as a tablet or laptop in different modes, inspiring creativity with a garaged stylus for taking notes or sketching.

When designing the ThinkReality A3, the main focus was on streamlining tasks and increasing productivity. It provides interactive information mapped into the physical space. As the design emulates the look of traditional glasses, the ThinkReality A3 can be used anywhere. The control buttons are differentiated by texture so users can control the glasses intuitively. Soft TPU cushions all skin contact areas.

This minimalistic designed and completely waterproof backpack can save lives. The patented double zippers prevent water from entering the backpack or air from escaping. In this way, it can act as a buoyancy aid in an emergency. Made from eco-friendly and quick-drying TPU, the backpack is also reinforced on the back with a multi-layered, bulletproof Kevlar layer. Detachable shoulder straps allow additional carrying methods, for example as hand luggage or a shoulder bag.

“Flex Go” removable modular interior suitcase is a suitcase made from recycled materials that is suitable for many modes of travel，it is different from the traditional design, the inner liner adopts magnetic zipper quick disassembly technology, and is equipped with three inner tubes: “Flow-Clsssic、Flow-Business、Flow-Vacuum” supports the free switching of multiple scenes such as business, parent-child, and sports travel, and reassembles the layer in 3 seconds, and a box achieves “deformation”. Innovative mist TPU dry and wet separation bin, 0.3mm waterproof layer to prevent leakage, swimsuit and computer can coexist with the box. The inner selection of baby grade RPET recycled fabric (each set of recycling 10 plastic bottles), can be completely disassembled and washed into the washing machine, ending the box health dead corner. The magnetic accessory system extends service life, is environmentally friendly and functional, and redefines the “smart suitcase that breathes”.

cases.productName: AlgaMatrix: A Modular Algae-Based Bioreactor System for Sustainable Indoor Environments
cases.description: AlgaMatrix is our scalable, adaptable, algae-based bioreactor system designed to redefine sustainable architecture. In response to global climate challenges and the escalating demand for eco-friendly buildings, AlgaMatrix integrates biophilic design with advanced materials and computational technology. Our system harnesses the carbon-capturing ability of microalgae, specifically Chlorella Vulgaris, to reduce a building’s carbon footprint while improving indoor air quality. AlgaMatrix employs 3D-printed PLA frameworks and TPU membranes in an optimized tetrahedral configuration for maximum material efficiency and flexible deployment. An integrated IoT mobile application provides real-time algae growth monitoring and control, ensuring consistent performance. Preliminary tests indicate that AlgaMatrix can significantly enhance environmental performance by capturing CO₂ and producing reusable biomass. This project embodies a new paradigm in bio-fabrication for the built environment, merging material innovation, digital computation, and nature-inspired design to foster resilient, carbon-neutral urban habitats.

cases.productName: Anta artificial exoskeleton technology basketball shoe
cases.description: The artificial exoskeleton technology basketball shoe, tailored for basketball players, aims to meet the needs of different users in different intensities and scenarios. It offers multiple ways of control: intelligent posture identification (touching the ground with toes), the smart APP (for remote control), the brain-machine interface (utilizing brain waves), and the flexible film sensor (applied to the skin). Through those ways, users can instantly and conveniently adjust the stiffness of the forefoot area to effortlessly tackle exercise and daily life. Additionally, the TPU sidewall, coupled with the anti-torsion plate in the midsole, provides strong support and stability for wearers during movements.

Agibot-X2 is a robot designed to achieve nearly human-like mobility and can have close contact with people. It has over 28 degrees of freedom throughout its body, with powerful joint torque. The robot's full range of motion reaches 360°. The exposed parts are wrapped in TPU foam material to enhance safety. The entire machine is designed in a modular way, using only 3 types of motors. The robot is equipped with a naked eye 3D display and a multimodal large model, allowing the robot body and the user to interact with each other through natural language in a multifunctional way. The cost of the robot body can be less than 8000 euros.

cases.productName: Sogou E2 AI Translation and Recorder
cases.description: Sogou E2 AI recorder is a professional device for high-definition recording in meetings, training, interviews, music, and other scenes. The latest Sogou AI Engine for Speech Recognition and Translation enables voice recording, transcription, and translation. The transcribed texts are summarized and output automatically. The AI engine can handle inter-translation among 63 languages and offline translation in 18 languages. The front LED screen displays the results of multilingual translation in real-time and plays an audio version on the built-in speaker.
