This tyre for utility terrain vehicles (UTV), with its innovative design using a nylon material, conforms to the current trend of making UTV tyres, like sedan tyres, out of polyester and with a steel belt. The result is a reinforced radial tyre which is also given a newly developed, concave profile. This means that the tyre is not only flatter than usual but above all offers better and more stable driving on rough terrain.

The Tapole Series T is manufactured in an innovative process which enables production of the frame of nylon and titanium without the use of screws or adhesives. Based on the properties of titanium alloy, by laser cutting and bending the sheet of titanium, a consistent hinge structure is created. The temples of the frame, which weighs less than 6.5 grams, are very flexible and easily adjustable.

With only 11 x 22 cm the Lofoten 1 ULW exhibits an exceptionally small pack size, and with 490 grams an extremely low weight for a double-walled one person tent. Stable aluminium poles with particularly short segments enable the reduced pack size, and the seven denier nylon of 26g/sqm with a thread count of 580 the extreme low weight. On both sides the fabric is siliconised in three layers thus guaranteeing high elasticity, and the water column of 1,600 mm creates a pleasant microclimate.

The design of this facial cleansing device is inspired by the shape of an egg and a bird’s nest. Its translucent body provides a view of one of the soft brushes inside. While the silicone brush is suitable for daily use, the nylon brush has been specially developed for the cleansing of oily skin and the puff head helps to remove makeup. Using high-frequency sonic vibration, the device removes dead skin and massages skincare products deeply into the skin.

materials.name: PMMA
materials.description: PMMA常用名称为亚克力、有机玻璃或压克力，化学名称为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯。它是透明度较高的无定形热塑性塑料，具有良好的耐候性、着色性和机械加工性能，常作为玻璃替代材料。典型应用包括灯具、展示架、标识、透明罩、汽车灯具和光学件，但抗冲击性低于PC。
materials.cognitiveText: PMMA在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 2.8–3.3 GPa。

cases.description: The Lenovo Tab is a 10.1-inch tablet designed by Lenovo specifically for children and families. This tablet has a carefully designed appearance and meaningful accessories. The play suite, tailored for children, offers versatile usability in horizontal and vertical orientations, ensuring convenience for young users. The included stylus empowers children to express their creativity freely. The tablet ingeniously combines metal and PMMA to fulfil antenna requirements while exuding a unique, high-quality appearance. Furthermore, the tablet has a transparent case featuring a built-in stand and a folio case, providing users with versatile options.

materials.name: 羊毛纤维
materials.description: 羊毛纤维常用名称为羊毛或毛纤维，是羊等动物毛被中取得的天然蛋白质纤维。其表面鳞片和天然卷曲赋予良好的保温、弹性、吸湿与毡化特性，同时具有一定阻燃性。羊毛可纺成纱线、织物、毡和吸声材料，常用于服装、家居软装、鞋材、隔热吸声产品及复合材料。
materials.cognitiveText: 羊毛纤维在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 2.3–5 GPa。

cases.description: The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

“Understated in its design, versatile in its use and equipped with impressive features that ensure a high level of wearing comfort,” said the jury, highlighting the various advantages of the extremely lightweight, two-piece down jacket. Down or woollen materials are used in different areas of the inner and outer jacket to provide a high-precision combination of thermal insulation and moisture absorption. The outer layer, with its timeless design, is made of 100 per cent recycled wind- and waterproof Windstopper fabric, making the garment an uncomplicated accessory for use in the city, on camping trips and for various types of sports.

GEN_VMT is the name of a range of acoustic panels. VMT stands for virtual material technology and is an acoustic solution made of VicPET wool, a non-woven fabric predominantly made of recycled plastic bottles. Thanks to an innovative dyeing technique, it can imitate the look of concrete, marble, wood and other materials. The generative design of this collection is based on geometric research relating to pentagonal tiling and obeys a shape grammar that makes it possible to create a variety of panels with different appearances.

Hello! Moon is a knitted woollen hat with an unusual pompom that has re-flective fibres woven through it. When light is shined on it, it appears to glow. This provides increased safety on the roads, particularly during the long win-ter nights. Wearers can, for example, be seen much better and earlier by drivers. The inspiration for this hat comes from a fascination with the moon and moonlight.

Thanks to this simple key rack users will always be able to find their keys as they can easily be inserted into the felt. Optional extras on the design ledge such as rings, buttons or test-tube holders offer space for glasses, flowers or jewellery. The combination of aluminium and replaceable designer felt, which is made of pure wool and is available in 20 different colours, offers a range of different value-added design options.

The design of the Mickey, Tom und Zaya children’s beds is inspired by animated cartoons. The headboards take the shape of animal heads and convey a happy impression. The bed frames, including the headboards, are covered with a deep black woollen fabric, so that the beds contrast with the surroundings while still making a soft impression. These beds are manufactured in a width of 90 or 120 cm and a length of 190 or 200 cm.

This teapot with knitted tea cosy not only keeps the tea hot for longer – it radiates warmth and cosiness. The elastic wool sleeve is offered in a variety of colours and patterns and is machine-washable. The teapot itself has a simplistic form, is made of white porcelain and has a large handle of stainless steel. The teapot holds 1.5 litres which can be poured cleanly thanks to a drip-free spout.

By its nature, wool is meant to retain warmth. Yet humans sweat in order to cool the body. This wool jacket and matching pants unite both characteristics: complex, three-dimensional knitting structures utilise perspiration so as to ensure a comfortable temperature and optimal body-climate management along the chest, back and tailbone. Thanks to pure Saxon Merino wool, APANI® creates a new look that is characterised by sustainability. Reinforcements on the elbows and insets at the hollow of the knees guarantee form stability and unlimited freedom of movement. A feature that is not visible but provides noticeable extra comfort is located at the front of the knee: air channels on the inside keep warmth close to the joints, even when the knee is bent.

The original Lodenofen is a wood fireplace with a unique textile surface. Loden fabric has been made in the Austrian Alps from sheep’s wool for over a hundred years. Its soft, smooth form lends the Lodenofen a pleasing timelessness and permanence. The horizontal structure in combination with the fine Loden and matt-black metal surfaces gives it the appearance of a design element in any room. The wood fire behind the panoramic door to the combustion chamber exudes cosy warmth.

A number of sophisticated technologies, such as the 3D BionicSphere® System, make the X-Technology Swiss wool intelligent, so that Apani Merino cools, warms and dries naturally. The result is an ecological product with a fine yarn, spun in Germany and made of only 18.5 micrometre thick Saxon-Merino wool. The combination of elastic and natural components guarantees a high degree of stability and comfort. It features a 3D system of high-tech fibres on the chest and the back, which maintains a thin film of sweat on the skin to support cooling.

Woven from 100 per cent wool in a combination of waffle weave and herringbone weave, the Heritage Throw blanket is particularly pleasant to the touch. The differing textures also create a vibrant appearance, with a design that was inspired by an antique floor clock with carvings. Strong colour contrasts and fringes of varying lengths on the long and short sides complement the fresh reinterpretation of traditional craftsmanship.

Biatain Fiber is a gel-forming fibre dressing used for deeper wounds and wound cavities that present a moderate to high degree of exudation. The new HexaLock technology integrates the gelling fibres into reinforced hexagonal netting and traps exudate and bacteria. It minimises shrinkage of the dressing and forms a dimensionally stable gel for easy removal in one piece. The hexagonal embossing pattern is inspired by nature.

The Libratone Loop standing or wall-mounted wireless speaker delivers superior audio performance precisely because of its round shape. Loop replaces the traditional, clunky black box speakers of old with a sleek, modern design that can be incorporated anywhere in the home. It is wrapped in vibrantly colored interchangeable wool and equipped with wireless Airplay/DLNA streaming along with PlayDirect capabilities.

The Chilote House Shoe’s highly innovative low-tech manufacturing methodology and aesthetics speak directly to the conscious consumers’ sensibilities that expect highly responsible and ethical production models to manifested noble, useful and beautiful products. It uses free-range Patagonian sheep wool and repurposed and up-cycled salmon leather combined with guided craftsmanship to appeal to the growing eco-premium market.

The CrossOver Scarf combines the natural benefits of merino wool with heat-conductive smart textiles. By knitting these materials together, the scarf becomes a comfortable and breathable accessory that can provide gentle heat therapy to the neck. Once the scarf is plugged into the power bank, it gives the wearer the gentle sensation of sunshine.

Did you know that scientists have observed over 1,500 species having gay sex? And sheep are the real deal. Around 1 in 12 sheep are gay, but since gay rams can’t be used for breeding, it doesn’t end well for them. Openly gay farmer Michael Stücke found a way to help gay sheep—and gay humans at the same time. Rainbow Wool. The first gay textile fiber. The raw wool is processed and turned into fashion, presented by German queer icon, Tokio Hotel singer Bill Kaulitz. Rainbow Wool was promoted through magazine covers, OOH, and activations across Germany, making it a hot topic and a symbol of queer rights worldwide.

materials.name: PET
materials.description: PET常用名称为PET塑料或聚酯，化学名称为聚对苯二甲酸乙二酯。它可制成透明容器、薄膜、片材和纤维，具有较好的强度、气体阻隔性、尺寸稳定性和可回收性。结晶程度与加工状态会改变透明度和耐热性，常用于饮料瓶、食品包装、电子薄膜、纺织纤维及工程塑料。
materials.cognitiveText: PET在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 3.5–11 GPa。

cases.description: This hammock is reminiscent of a Venetian gondola which floats gently over the water. The height-adjustable lying surface is made from recycled plastic bottles and adapts itself to the user’s requirements. The reinforced frame, along with well-considered connecting elements and fourfold tilt protection, assures the necessary safety. The hammock may also be equipped with an awning.

The BULLET is a robust polycarbonate piece of luggage with a rugged look and feel, inspired by off-road SUVs. It is made from RCS-certified, recycled PET bottles. The two handles on the top combine comfort and functionality and make it easier to lift the suitcase when it is heavy. Shock-absorbing edges, inner padding and anti-theft zips offer optimum protection. Functions such as an integrated laundry compartment for separating worn and clean clothes make it easier to keep things tidy when travelling.

This heat-repellent film for car windows is an efficient thermal insulator. It uses XIR PRO technology which reflects infrared waves with a wavelength greater than 1,350 mm, thus preventing a rise in temperature in the car interior. The film, in addition, affords further safety protection. The use of an environmentally friendly PET substrate not only reduces glare and improves visibility but furthermore limits the shattering of glass in case of an accident.

The WNC LAXY 5G CPE + Wi-Fi 7 Extender consists of networked 5G end devices for home use that combine high connection speed with a resource-saving design. They support the Matter smart home standard and Wi-Fi 7 and are manufactured using recycled materials, including PCR plastics, PET fibres and oyster shells. The devices are based on a symmetrical three-component structure that is manufactured using two injection moulds, thus reducing production waste.

The colourful woven rugs in the Strata collection were created as part of a fruitful collaboration between the traditional carpet manufacturer Rols and the textile design studio Wallace#Sewell. Both are united not only by high-quality standards, but also by an appreciation of traditional craftsmanship, innovative thinking and, not least, a sustainable philosophy. Designed according to the motto “Archive of Earth Memories” by Wallace#Sewell and produced at the Rols weaving mills, these rugs pay homage to our planet’s diverse landscapes and colours. Rols has been using the traditional Wilton knotting technique for more than a century and, over the years, has passed the necessary skills down from one generation to the next. The partners have endeavoured to preserve this special rug-making expertise, while at the same time creating an aesthetic, contemporary look. Vibrant patterns and colours as well as precise workmanship are key building blocks in this process. Rols has a strong commitment to sustainability, which is why energy-efficient production, the use of local yarn processing partners and a considered choice of materials are important priorities. Recycled post-consumer PET bottles are used to create the yarn for eight differently patterned Strata rugs. As a material it is remarkably well-suited for making rugs, even ones with complex patterns, and it offers decisive functional advantages. Thanks to the extreme durability of the innovative yarn and UV treatment, the rugs are perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. “The surface of the Strata rugs feels absolutely natural and soft. They are a pleasure to walk on and meticulously executed. Craftsmanship and functionality have come together here to make a great product,” said the impressed jury. “We were also captivated by the brilliant colours.” This luminosity is typical of designs by Wallace#Sewell, and they add a vibrancy and energy to living spaces. Strata literally weaves together a poetic idea, a dramatic look, an innovative material and meticulous craftsmanship – these rugs represent originality that is both beautiful and functional.

Securipak2.0 is an improved anti-theft backpack in which the main compartment and all pockets are only accessible from the back. A cut-resistant fabric provides additional protection against theft. The backpack has been ergonomically designed for greater carrying comfort and, despite its minimalist aesthetics, it has numerous functions, including an RFID-protected compartment, zip pockets and two open pockets for quick access. For the sake of the environment, the outer material is made from recycled PET bottles using a dope-dyeing process.

The design of the Orbis Circular Collection bags is focused on the complete recyclability of the material used. In order to guarantee a closed material cycle in the production of the luggage and not produce any new waste, all elements – from the upper material to the zips and lining – are made from one and the same material: PET/polyester. “The consistent recycling of existing materials conserves valuable resources,” said the jury, highlighting the special sustainability aspect of the modern bag series. The collection consists of two rucksacks with practical, minimalistic designs, a laptop bag with a handle and a travel or sports bag with several compartments.

With its compact design, the RASPAIL Soft Trunk – a combination of trolley suitcase and duffle bag – is exceptionally versatile. It can be carried, lifted and tucked away using the handle on the front, and pulled over longer distances thanks to integrated wheels and a retractable telescopic tube. The trolley features a separate shoe compartment and is closed with a security zipper. The product was also designed with sustainability in mind as the water-repellent outer material is made from recycled water bottles.

The containers of the modular Jive Recycling Bin system are used for space-saving waste separation. A wide front flap is easy to open and facilitates the disposal of glass, paper, PET, can, cardboard and plastic waste. The two large handles are connected to the securely closing lid and ensure comfortable transport. With enclosed, graphically reduced stickers, the containers can be marked for different types of waste.

The main compartment of this backpack is only accessible from the back. This feature protects against theft, as do the hidden side pockets, of which one is RFID-protected. Behind the body fabric, there is a cut-resistant layer. The bag is equipped with an integrated and hidden USB port to connect easily with electronic devices carried inside. The outer material is a special fabric created by using 100 per cent recycled PET bottles. The backpack comes in eleven colours and two different dimensions.

Curio-city is a wall-mounted playground for cats. The material made from PET (polyethylene terephthalate) is not only environmentally friendly, sound-absorbing and fireproof, but, thanks to its soft texture, also represents an ideal wall panelling cats like to scratch and rub against. An L-shaped metal bracket provides a simple stand construction whose fittings hide expertly in the flexibly placeable elements that are different in size. They consist of laterally stacked panels and offer superb playing possibilities.

EcoFusionAI is a next-generation recycling and 3D printing system that transforms discarded PET bottles directly into filament using AI-driven automation. By eliminating traditional grinding steps, it lowers energy consumption and costs, making it accessible for schools, makerspaces, and small businesses. Its cutting bar precisely slices bottles for direct heating and extrusion, while a robotic arm autonomously loads new material. Semi-transparent panels foster user engagement, and intelligent dashboards provide real-time progress and environmental insights. This streamlined process not only reduces plastic waste but also promotes hands-on sustainability education. Through advanced simulation, development costs were minimized, ensuring a polished, user-friendly product. As a result, EcoFusionAI stands out as a unique, practical solution in the sustainable manufacturing sector, bridging creativity, efficiency, and environmental responsibility.

The IONIQ 5 N, the N series’ first high-performance EV, represents Hyundai’s long-standing legacy of offering high-quality mobility alongside driver-focused N models. Sustainable materials are applied throughout IONIQ 5 N, including recyclable paperette door decorative garnish, BIO PET yarn from sugarcane, recycled PET yarn from recycled PET bottles, BIO TPO from sugarcane, and eco-processed leather. IONIQ 5 N also adds recycled tire pigment paint and recycled poly Alcantara seat cover cloth. Under the hood, it combines the standard model’s Electrified-Global Modular Platform (E-GMP) with N’s motorsport-bred technologies and leverages N’s expertise from electrified Rolling Labs to maximize the EV’s high-performance capabilities.

cases.productName: Circular Plastics – Returning Waste to Use in Africa
cases.description: Circular Plastics is a collaboration between three universities and one NGO in the UK with project partners in Kenya, Rwanda, and Nigeria. Together they developed a technology-led strategy to reduce waste by transforming used plastic water bottles into products that support entrepreneurship in low-to-middle-income countries. The team devised an extruding process that converts polyethylene terephthalate (PET) from plastic bottles into 3D printer filament. To date, six innovative products have been launched that support self-sufficiency and economic development in the agriculture, mineral extraction, fishing, and mobility sectors in LMIC areas.

This design challenge involved creating a design to take the Ramlösa brand of mineral water from glass to plastic PET without reducing the premium impression and positioning of Ramlösa in restaurants. In addition to the bottle’s sculpted design, the label and the graphics enhance the high-end feeling by creating an unbroken seal that assures quality.

Attaching to ubiquitous drop-ceiling T-grids, the three-dimensional magnetic TURF Acoustic Ceiling Tiles, made from recycled PET, allows for endless customization. Acoustic levels and noise within modern open spaces and hard-surface environments are a constant distraction that impact productivity and focus. Solutions are limited, very expensive and many times require specialized installation. The TURF Acoustic Ceiling Tile System is an intelligent solution to environmental noise that leverages inspiring aesthetics, customer expression and customization, functional design and engineering, low-cost manufacturing, recycled materials, and magnetic plug-n-play contractor-friendly installation onto drop ceiling grids. TURF’s ability to offer functional performance and transformative aesthetics without compromise while complementing existing construction workflows and budgets sets this product apart in the market. Any trade can install TURF: ceiling contractors, painters, electricians, facilities management—virtually anyone.

The ECO 6L Refillable Filtered Water Bottle was designed to be refilled in any ECO Filtration Fountain, allowing the whole family to opt for more conscious, sustainable water consumption. It is made of recyclable PET (BPA free), with a UV filter that protects water from sunlight. Offering two positions of use, vertical and horizontal, the bottle is easy to transport and store in the refrigerator on its side. The drop present in the brand logo defines the shape of the bottle, and the shape of the bottle allows it to be stored horizontally—a synergy of form, function, and branding.

This provides a new twist on the traditional recycling container. Made entirely from post-consumer recycled PET soda and water bottles, the bin encourages people to recycle at the same time as it showcases the design potential of recycled plastic. It ships flat for maximum transport and deployment efficiency.

The ADITUSEcoLanyard is an innovative holder for wearing badges, specifically designed for sustainable event management. It is only made from 100% recycled and recyclable PET (rPET), making it ideal for trade shows and conferences. Badges, which are central to networking, can be worn optimally. Unlike conventional lanyards that are difficult to recycle and often end up in the trash, the ADITUSEcoLanyard does not require metal clips or carabiners. Its unique design features notches that securely hold the badge and allows for easy local recycling after the event, similar to PET bottles. It is stable, safe, and environmentally friendly.

The robust Armox travel bag is built for outdoor adventures thanks to a hybrid construction that combines a flexible front panel made of tear-resistant, coated ripstop fabric with a sturdy ABS hard shell back panel laminated with fabric to achieve seamless surface integration. The travel bag offers an enhanced user experience thanks to its suspension wheels which absorb shocks and noise. It also features two practical front pockets and has an exterior fabric and lining made entirely of recycled PET plastic.

materials.name: 橡木
materials.description: 橡木常用名称为橡木或栎木，来自栎属多种树木，是家具和室内产品中常见的阔叶木材。其纹理明显，通常具有较好的强度、耐磨性和表面涂饰效果，白橡与红橡在导管结构、色泽和耐久性方面存在差异。常用于家具、地板、酒桶、饰面板和结构木制品，性能受含水率影响明显。
materials.cognitiveText: 橡木在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 10.6–12.3 GPa。

cases.description: Design innovations are often the product of technology transfer. In the case of Furniture Linoleum, the innovative aspect is first and foremost a carefully considered material transfer that has led to a sustainable product with aesthetic appeal. Forbo Flooring had previously focused on the production of high-quality flooring materials before deciding to diversify its portfolio and expertise in the furniture sector with Furniture Linoleum. Now the time-tested material of linoleum is captivating a new audience with its natural, warm feel and excellent durability as a contemporary surface finish for home and kitchen furniture, doors, and much more. “This product embodies our vision of creating functional, durable and environmentally conscious finishes for both flooring and furniture,” says the manufacturer. Linoleum’s climate-positive aspects also contribute to user convenience. Made from renewable and natural raw materials such as linseed oil, wood flour, pine resin and limestone, it has a naturally elegant, matt surface that is resistant to fingerprints. Being easy to clean, Furniture Linoleum is also an interesting option for the customised furnishing of public spaces. Forbo Flooring complements all of these positive properties with an attractive range of 24 colours that blend seamlessly with natural woods and stones, such as oak, walnut and maple, or marble, concrete and terrazzo. A special aesthetic has been achieved with the “Pure Linoleum” decor, which completely dispenses with colour pigments to showcase the natural shade of linseed oil. Like leather and wood, each piece is unique and alters in appearance over time. The Red Dot jurors were fascinated by the natural look and feel: “What really impressed us about Furniture Linoleum is this focus on material purity. The special yet subtle tactile warmth of the surfaces makes them feel comforting to the touch. Another remarkable aspect is the unique natural aroma of linoleum that is pleasant to perceive. This material represents tangible quality. It is honest, thoughtfully designed and delivers genuine added value for healthy interior spaces.”

The LIND Canvas electric jetboard combines the look, handling and feel of a classic surfboard with modern drive technology. Made of EPS foam and epoxy resin with oak wood details, the board weighs just 7 kg and can be set up in less than a minute without tools. The jet and battery modules fit in a backpack. With 20 kW of power, a speed of up to 60 km/h and 45 minutes of riding time, it offers powerful performance and timeless aesthetics. Unique Art Boards made in collaboration with artists are available as collectables.

The Electric Fondue Set Pro combines traditional fondue culture with the functionality and simplicity of an electric set. A heating element with a safety thermostat maintains temperatures in the range of 50 to 190 degrees Celsius to suit cheese, meat, chocolate and bouillon fondues alike. The device, made of cast iron and oak, has a splash guard with notches for the fondue forks and is largely free of plastics. Thanks to its long mains cable, it can be used flexibly.

The Loop furniture collection is characterised by an attractive interplay of contrasts. It combines a sculptural base made of solid oak wood with the softness of organically moulded textile upholstery. In addition to artfully curved armrests, which inspired the name, the aesthetics are characterised by balanced proportions that also ensure pleasant comfort. The flexible collection includes armchairs, chairs, chaise longues and footstools that bring cosiness and elegance to a variety of room layouts.

Where people move frequently for work reasons, the traditional fitted kitchen becomes a problem due to a lack of flexibility. TERMINO’s modular kitchen system addresses this problem by being modular in design and made from lightweight yet durable materials such as recycled aluminium, 316L stainless steel and European oak. With 14 highly configurable, stackable modules, it adapts to a wide variety of layouts, as well as to changes in household size, needs or preferences.

The slimline oak Heart'n'Soul dining table, with its integrated, hidden extension leaves, can seat up to twelve people. At both ends of the table there is a fabric-lined drawer for storing important items, like cutlery, within easy reach. The Heart'n'Soul dining tables are available in dark oak and black oak versions, as well as oak versions with a highly scratch resistant nanolaminate finish in various colours. The rounded corners and smooth transitions from tabletop to table legs create a high-quality aesthetic.

The Diabolo Dumbbells were developed with a special focus on exclusivity and sustainability. When customising these free weights to their personal preferences, users can choose between different FSC-certified hardwoods for the handles, including reclaimed oak, and even order a personal engraving on the slightly concave-shaped end plate. Each dumbbell set is made to order with the aim of preventing material waste and the production of superfluous equipment. The lifetime guarantee also ensures that the stylish training equipment can be repaired rather than replaced. The jury praised the Diabolo Dumbbells as “an excellent example of how elegance and sustainability can be successfully combined”.

IKA innovatively advances the design of folding chairs. The seat and legs are made of high-quality oak and are combined with a sturdy leather strap, which has two functions: it serves as a convenient backrest, but also as a carrying strap. This facilitates the transport of IKA when folded. The iron fittings are deliberately used as a striking design feature.

Distinctive visual accents with a contrast between gloss and matt surfaces, along with a combination of oak and aluminium, characterise this compact wine cooler. The frameless door with its tinted, UV-absorbent glass, together with the appealing interior lighting, presents the contents in an attractive light. The wine cooler offers a satisfying user experience with a pull-out shelf and two temperature zones that can be controlled individually.

The handle-free built-under Siemens Freestanding Wine Cooler cools and elegantly showcases fine wines. Its dark metal body, which tastefully complements the graphite-grey interior, creates an effective display for white and red wines. From the solid oak shelves to the door with UV filter, the materials and overall design exude strong value.

Inspired by a kinetic sculpture, this table lamp consists of five wooden rods of different lengths equipped with discreet adjustable metal connections. These allow both the lamp base and the illuminated area to be aligned according to individual needs. As a battery-powered device, the lamp achieves a running time of approximately eight hours at full power and a running time of up to twelve hours at medium power. The portable table lamp is optionally available in oak, ash wood or walnut.

The Siemens Freestanding Wine Cooler provides plenty of room for fine wines that are showcased in an appealing manner. Dark grey tones in the interior frame the stored bottles, while the metallic-grey tinted glass door protects the bottles from harmful UV light. The exclusive overall appearance is enhanced by solid aluminium profiles on the front of the real oak shelves. The presenter shelf that can be set at an angle allows special treasures to be beautifully arranged.

This robust pizza peel was designed in the style of a garden shovel and equipped with a handle made of solid oak wood. This patented handle enables one-handed use, as its smoothly sanded wooden surface rests firmly against the forearm during use. The blade made of high-quality aluminium boasts an only 2 mm thick edge that easily slides under the pizza base. The pizza peel is suitable for pizzas with a diameter of up to 30 cm.

The Siemens BU30 wine cooler is characterised by high-quality features and a modern functionality and was designed for fitted kitchens. The slender appliance with 30 cm width has a dark surface with a milled, black anodised bar handle made of genuine metal. The graphite grey interior is combined with oak wood shelves, which have solid aluminium profiles on the front. A tinted UV protection of the door as well as innovative temperature regulation and control by touch operation ensure optimised storage conditions.

The characteristic style element of this bathroom furniture series is the shape it is named after – oval. The collection is furthermore defined by a high-contrast material combination that blends warm oak or ash wood with dark grey powder-coated metal elements. The versatile and functionally sophisticated components merge into a homogeneous entity. With its highly distinctive design, the collection lends bathrooms a unique and exclusive style.

Reverse Conference is a series of conference tables, available with one or multiple bases and variable tabletops in 14 sizes. The table displays an elegant look with its 30 mm laminated wood plate in oak veneer or lacquered style, and the contrasting thick bases tapering upward. The base frames are made of 100 per cent recyclable polyethylene and come in matt or glossy versions.

These open shelving elements in light design, used as end shelving in the cabinet area, take the interior of the kitchen to the outside and facilitate opening of the kitchen into the living and dining area. The shelves are flexible to use. In the rear panel, system rails are located which can accommodate, apart from shelves of glass or oak, also drawers or storage boxes and utensil holders.

With its delicate lines, the bed Light manages elegantly to tame the natural characteristics of wood. Graceful, slanted legs conform to the manufacturer’s trademark style while the two broad bars of the bed head add a refined touch. The precise construction of the bed is reflected by the details: only the head of the wooden peg, for example, hints at the point where the sides of the bed are connected to each other. Light is available in walnut or oak.

This entrance door is 220 mm thick and its exterior is completely covered with glass, thus allowing it to blend in harmoniously with the house entrance. On the side is a functional channel in black anodised aluminium which contains the bell and a door-opening module together with the letterbox. The inside of the door is made of fine woods, such as varnished German wild oak, a feature which underlines its exclusive character.

The AUGLETICS Eight Style ergometer is clad in a chic oak wall and can be optimally connected. It is almost noiseless as the resistance is generated by an eddy current brake. With a Virtual Coach, every stroke can be analysed in real time and the user’s technique can be continuously improved. The integrated touch display ensures simple operation. The ergometer can be stowed away in two easy steps and, folded up, fits in any corner.

materials.name: PET聚酯纤维
materials.description: PET聚酯纤维常用名称为涤纶或聚酯纤维，是以聚对苯二甲酸乙二酯为主要成分制成的合成纤维。它具有强度较高、耐磨、易洗快干和尺寸稳定等特点，可制成长丝、短纤、织物或非织造材料。常用于服装、箱包、家具面料、绳带、过滤材料及纤维增强复合材料。
materials.cognitiveText: PET聚酯纤维在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 10–15 GPa。

cases.description: The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

Sustainability was prioritised in the development of the IN/OUT collection. The minimalist design boasts a timeless sophistication with handcrafted details. All materials are sourced from local suppliers in order to reduce the products’ carbon footprint. Made from durable stainless steel, the chairs are easily stackable. Their comfortable seat cushions feature a quick-drying surface, and their attractive backrests are made from weather-resistant polyester ropes.

To conserve resources and minimise waste, this sporty safety shoe is made from environmentally friendly and recycled materials. For example, recycled foam and polyester fibres were used for the footbed. The properties of the breathable, cushioning material ensure a pleasant foot climate, offer comfort and support the foot in its natural rolling movement. The sustainable profile is rounded off by the tear-resistant textile fibres made from PET bottles for penetration protection.

The HP OMEN bags allow gamers to carry large amounts of computing equipment in a compact way. The bags are the size of a backpack or duffel bag and offer large openings so that the contents can be accessed from several sides. They are made of waterproof, coated polyester with cleverly arranged zippers. The series follows a uniform design concept and includes bags of various sizes, including a travelling bag with a separate shoe compartment.

This hammock is reminiscent of a Venetian gondola which floats gently over the water. The height-adjustable lying surface is made from recycled plastic bottles and adapts itself to the user’s requirements. The reinforced frame, along with well-considered connecting elements and fourfold tilt protection, assures the necessary safety. The hammock may also be equipped with an awning.

This tyre for utility terrain vehicles (UTV), with its innovative design using a nylon material, conforms to the current trend of making UTV tyres, like sedan tyres, out of polyester and with a steel belt. The result is a reinforced radial tyre which is also given a newly developed, concave profile. This means that the tyre is not only flatter than usual but above all offers better and more stable driving on rough terrain.

The BULLET is a robust polycarbonate piece of luggage with a rugged look and feel, inspired by off-road SUVs. It is made from RCS-certified, recycled PET bottles. The two handles on the top combine comfort and functionality and make it easier to lift the suitcase when it is heavy. Shock-absorbing edges, inner padding and anti-theft zips offer optimum protection. Functions such as an integrated laundry compartment for separating worn and clean clothes make it easier to keep things tidy when travelling.

The aim of the Filo messenger bag, made  of water-repellent polyester, was to  enhance safety for the cyclist. The cover flap features a reflective fabric that makes the cyclist more visible in the dark. The spacious interior can even be increased when pulling the two zippers  on the sides. The bag can be worn diagonally across only one shoulder or – for better weight distribution – like a rucksack on both shoulders.

This heat-repellent film for car windows is an efficient thermal insulator. It uses XIR PRO technology which reflects infrared waves with a wavelength greater than 1,350 mm, thus preventing a rise in temperature in the car interior. The film, in addition, affords further safety protection. The use of an environmentally friendly PET substrate not only reduces glare and improves visibility but furthermore limits the shattering of glass in case of an accident.

The WNC LAXY 5G CPE + Wi-Fi 7 Extender consists of networked 5G end devices for home use that combine high connection speed with a resource-saving design. They support the Matter smart home standard and Wi-Fi 7 and are manufactured using recycled materials, including PCR plastics, PET fibres and oyster shells. The devices are based on a symmetrical three-component structure that is manufactured using two injection moulds, thus reducing production waste.

The colourful woven rugs in the Strata collection were created as part of a fruitful collaboration between the traditional carpet manufacturer Rols and the textile design studio Wallace#Sewell. Both are united not only by high-quality standards, but also by an appreciation of traditional craftsmanship, innovative thinking and, not least, a sustainable philosophy. Designed according to the motto “Archive of Earth Memories” by Wallace#Sewell and produced at the Rols weaving mills, these rugs pay homage to our planet’s diverse landscapes and colours. Rols has been using the traditional Wilton knotting technique for more than a century and, over the years, has passed the necessary skills down from one generation to the next. The partners have endeavoured to preserve this special rug-making expertise, while at the same time creating an aesthetic, contemporary look. Vibrant patterns and colours as well as precise workmanship are key building blocks in this process. Rols has a strong commitment to sustainability, which is why energy-efficient production, the use of local yarn processing partners and a considered choice of materials are important priorities. Recycled post-consumer PET bottles are used to create the yarn for eight differently patterned Strata rugs. As a material it is remarkably well-suited for making rugs, even ones with complex patterns, and it offers decisive functional advantages. Thanks to the extreme durability of the innovative yarn and UV treatment, the rugs are perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. “The surface of the Strata rugs feels absolutely natural and soft. They are a pleasure to walk on and meticulously executed. Craftsmanship and functionality have come together here to make a great product,” said the impressed jury. “We were also captivated by the brilliant colours.” This luminosity is typical of designs by Wallace#Sewell, and they add a vibrancy and energy to living spaces. Strata literally weaves together a poetic idea, a dramatic look, an innovative material and meticulous craftsmanship – these rugs represent originality that is both beautiful and functional.

Securipak2.0 is an improved anti-theft backpack in which the main compartment and all pockets are only accessible from the back. A cut-resistant fabric provides additional protection against theft. The backpack has been ergonomically designed for greater carrying comfort and, despite its minimalist aesthetics, it has numerous functions, including an RFID-protected compartment, zip pockets and two open pockets for quick access. For the sake of the environment, the outer material is made from recycled PET bottles using a dope-dyeing process.

The design of the Orbis Circular Collection bags is focused on the complete recyclability of the material used. In order to guarantee a closed material cycle in the production of the luggage and not produce any new waste, all elements – from the upper material to the zips and lining – are made from one and the same material: PET/polyester. “The consistent recycling of existing materials conserves valuable resources,” said the jury, highlighting the special sustainability aspect of the modern bag series. The collection consists of two rucksacks with practical, minimalistic designs, a laptop bag with a handle and a travel or sports bag with several compartments.

With its compact design, the RASPAIL Soft Trunk – a combination of trolley suitcase and duffle bag – is exceptionally versatile. It can be carried, lifted and tucked away using the handle on the front, and pulled over longer distances thanks to integrated wheels and a retractable telescopic tube. The trolley features a separate shoe compartment and is closed with a security zipper. The product was also designed with sustainability in mind as the water-repellent outer material is made from recycled water bottles.

Carrying babies close to the body is both practical and strengthens the bond between parents and child. The design of the Konny Baby Carrier set out in 2017 to develop a new baby carrier from scratch. One of the main differences to competing products is that this carrier can be easily slipped on like a T-shirt. The SUMMER version differs from the original product in that it is specifically optimised for use in warm weather. The biggest challenge in the development process was to find a fabric that is as comfortable and resilient as the originally chosen fabric, but at the same time introduces additional properties such as breathability and UV protection. Since such a fabric did not yet exist, it was newly created in a months-long research and development process. The result is an innovative soft air mesh fabric made of a polyester/elastane blend with four-way stretch that is ultra-lightweight, breathable and has moisture-wicking properties. In addition, this fabric also offers 85 per cent UV protection and is antibacterial. The Konny Baby Carrier SUMMER is made entirely from this new type of mesh fabric. The breathable and cooling material absorbs sweat and discharges it towards the outside. The baby carrier is easy to slip on and features an ergonomic design that evenly distributes the baby’s weight and supports a healthy hip development.

The containers of the modular Jive Recycling Bin system are used for space-saving waste separation. A wide front flap is easy to open and facilitates the disposal of glass, paper, PET, can, cardboard and plastic waste. The two large handles are connected to the securely closing lid and ensure comfortable transport. With enclosed, graphically reduced stickers, the containers can be marked for different types of waste.

This highly elastic, hardwearing pillow helps the user to adopt a comfortable, natural posture when sleeping. It adapts to the body from the head down along the cervical spine, relieving pressure and stimulating blood flow. The innovative, breathable pillow is made of polyester and thermoplastic elastomer that is also found in medical devices, kitchen utensils and baby bottles. The triangular mesh surface is exceptionally soft.

Biatain Fiber is a gel-forming fibre dressing used for deeper wounds and wound cavities that present a moderate to high degree of exudation. The new HexaLock technology integrates the gelling fibres into reinforced hexagonal netting and traps exudate and bacteria. It minimises shrinkage of the dressing and forms a dimensionally stable gel for easy removal in one piece. The hexagonal embossing pattern is inspired by nature.

The main compartment of this backpack is only accessible from the back. This feature protects against theft, as do the hidden side pockets, of which one is RFID-protected. Behind the body fabric, there is a cut-resistant layer. The bag is equipped with an integrated and hidden USB port to connect easily with electronic devices carried inside. The outer material is a special fabric created by using 100 per cent recycled PET bottles. The backpack comes in eleven colours and two different dimensions.

Curio-city is a wall-mounted playground for cats. The material made from PET (polyethylene terephthalate) is not only environmentally friendly, sound-absorbing and fireproof, but, thanks to its soft texture, also represents an ideal wall panelling cats like to scratch and rub against. An L-shaped metal bracket provides a simple stand construction whose fittings hide expertly in the flexibly placeable elements that are different in size. They consist of laterally stacked panels and offer superb playing possibilities.

materials.name: 竹材
materials.description: 竹材常用名称为竹材或竹木，来源于竹秆，经干燥、防护、剖分、层压或重组后可形成板材和构件。其纤维沿生长方向排列，具有较高比强度和鲜明纹理，但性能受竹种、部位、含水率及胶合方式影响。常用于家具、餐具、地板、包装、建筑构件和可持续产品设计。
materials.cognitiveText: 竹材在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 5–25 GPa。

cases.description: The continuation of the work-at-home trend is associated with challenges to remote workers. Their homes do not always have enough space for the integration of an attractive and ergonomic workstation that leaves the look and feel of the room fundamentally intact. Float Mini offers the perfect solution with its compact design and cosy aesthetics. The rounded corners, slim profile and matt textures help it blend harmoniously into a home environment without sacrificing functionality – a feature that only becomes obvious during use. An off-centre base ensures that no table legs get in the way when the users change their sitting position, and the infinitely variable height adjustment feature permits ergonomic working while standing. Humanscale is both the name and the mission of the manufacturer, whose products are consistently designed for user-centric functionality. Float Mini can also be fitted with castors for mobility, and the desktop options of bamboo, MDF or linoleum in a warm colour palette cater to personal preferences. “Float Mini is reminiscent of the wabi-sabi aesthetic,” commented the Red Dot jurors. “The asymmetrical design ensures that it can perfectly fulfil its function. It offers a remarkable level of quality and user convenience, and the desk is adaptable to a variety of settings beyond the home office, such as hotels or living spaces.” The product designers spent a long time fine-tuning Float Mini to achieve its intuitive functionality and unique character. Every detail, from the geometry of the base to the mechanical feel of the height adjustment, was worked on until perfection was achieved. The materials were intentionally chosen to balance aesthetic appeal, eco-friendliness and longevity. Last but not least, the minimalist design reflects the modern-day consumer demand for products that are repairable and made of just a few components. “Fewer parts mean fewer potential points of failure, easier disassembly and better recyclability,” said the product designers. All variants of Float Mini prove that this approach produces beautiful results.

The Float Mini table seamlessly blends classic residential aesthetics with Humanscale’s renowned ergonomic design, offering a compact, versatile solution for both home and workspaces. Designed to promote natural movement, Float Mini effortlessly adjusts to various heights, providing an essential component for an ergonomic setup that enhances user well-being. Available in a refined palette of colors, Float Mini complements any environment, with surface options that include sustainable bamboo and a new natural linoleum material. This eco-friendly linoleum is wear-resistant, anti-static, and fingerprint-proof, featuring a soft matte finish.

Bathtubs, in particular stand-alone ones, offer little to no space to store items like towels, shampoo, books, glasses, and tablets. TUBLER, the bathroom butler, is a flexible piece of furniture for stand-alone bathtubs that can also be used with built-in bathtubs. TUBLER is manufactured mainly from eco-friendly bamboo, cotton, and stainless steel, withstands the bathroom environment, and is fully recyclable. TUBLER is a space-saving, highly practical combination of shelf and table for almost all bathtubs on the market.

materials.name: 混凝土
materials.description: 混凝土常用名称为混凝土，工程中也简称“砼”，由水泥、骨料、水及必要外加剂拌合并硬化形成。它抗压能力较强、可浇筑成复杂形状且成本相对可控，但抗拉性能较弱，常与钢筋组合使用。除建筑结构外，也用于家具、灯具、花器和公共设施等产品，表观性能受配比、养护和孔隙影响。
materials.cognitiveText: 混凝土在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 14–41 GPa。

This material represents tangible quality. It is honest, thoughtfully designed and delivers genuine added value for healthy interior spaces.”

The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

The planning concept for the SHIROYAMA commercial space combines concrete walls and brickwork with new furnishings and modern fittings. Open ceilings create visual interaction between the different levels. The multifunctional zones for dining, exhibitions and product displays are based on principles of the experience economy. Inspired by the theme “Immersed in a Dialogue with the Mountains”, the interior design unites nature, culture and people, fostering a space for contemplation and social interaction that goes beyond conventional usage concepts.

The litter bin Bien was designed for public spaces and is available in different sizes and designs depending on the city's needs – optionally with a practical sorting function. It impresses with its timeless shape and high-quality design. A key feature of Bien is the material harmony between concrete and steel, which ensures high processing quality and great resistance to natural elements. The successful contrast between the opening and the container underlines the function and use of the litter bin.

The soap dispenser, toothbrush tumbler and toilet brush of the TIME bathroom series are made of concrete. The matching pedal bin of the series is made of ABS plastic. The equally stable and soft material concrete can be fired at low temperatures. This saves energy during production and is easily recyclable. A silicone layer under the bottom of the products prevents possible surface scratches. “The timeless and simple material sets aesthetic accents in the bathroom and is also a convincing choice from a sustainability point of view,” was the jury’s verdict. The bathroom accessories are available in concrete, black and soft grey.

The Line is a range of timelessly elegant street lighting. The noticeable micro-faceted optic modules integrated into the vertical slim pole deliver a high light output with standard-compliant glare control. As the main body can be given a steel, concrete or bronze surface, it is possible visually to match the luminaire to its surroundings. The range comprises stacks, bollards, pole or wall lights, thereby guaranteeing a wide range of uses in the urban context.

Inspired by architect Antoni Gaudí’s mosaic tile from the year 1906, this minimalist concrete paving slab is also innovative and hexagonal in shape. Two optical dummy joints divide the tile into three sections, one of which is characterised by a precise groove structure. This produces a noticeable, dark shadow effect. The main slab, with its symmetrical design, is complemented by two additional slab formats. Together, the slabs can be used to compose a large variety of different effects by orienting them in different ways.

The Staircase Object 004 is the central element of a comprehensive interior design for the editorial department floor of the fischerAppelt PR- and Marketing agency. It comprises a bar/kitchen, terraced seating, cupboards and display cases and a staircase in a range of materials consisting of concrete, larch and raw steel. At the heart of the complex is the staircase which seems to tower down from the roof garden above and is made of ten “Us” of suitably bent, 15 mm thick, slightly corroded, untreated steel panels that are simply bolted onto the supporting structure. These components vary only in height.

Greenpad is an environmentally friendly concrete system for car parks, roads and walkways as well as landscaping. It has a high capacity for absorbing rain water, because the concrete surface is interrupted by grass areas. In addition, it minimises heat reflection off the surface. The method applied here combines four different modules to create a wide range of patterns. The grass has already been planted in the modules, which are firmly fixed in place using a load bearing structure made of iron rods and concrete.

A newly developed technique has made it possible to create urban concrete benches with flexible shapes. This technique has led to immaculate surfaces and flowing lines that leave traditional, rigid forms far behind. An ordinary material such as concrete has been transformed into a high-quality piece of work. The solid bench looks like an upholstered one. The buttons in the upholstery here serve as drainage holes for rainwater. Structure and surface remain unchanged over time.

In order to make the Monka Hotel blend into its surroundings, its design is deliberately ambiguous, on the border between traditional architecture and more modern styles. The facade features grey concrete, the large windows of different sizes have black frames to give the building a calm exterior. The lobby is fitted with unadulterated materials. A wall clad with original ancient cave stones goes with the concrete floor and the wooden partition. The stairs have an open construction which allows them to reflect the light from outside.

The Shihlien Chemical Biotech Salt Plant Laboratory is a 900-sqm building located in the Chinese city of Huai’an. The laboratory, which is part of a new world-class medical-grade salt production plant, is used by technicians to carry out extensive quality controls and testing procedures. Reflecting this function, the architectural plan is inspired by the form of salt crystals. As an essential focus of the salt production process, the notion of “purity” has also become a motif and the driving concept of visualising the spatial design. Accordingly, the floor plan of the building is conceived as a regular array of salt crystals, featuring a series of offset cubic protrusions to accommodate each of the key functions. While the main building geometries are rectilinear, entrances and key elevations are highlighted by contrasting fluid curvatures to create welcoming gestures to users. Meanwhile, the building interior showcases a crisp and restrained design: white walls, linear strip lighting, as well as light-coloured tiles that lend the ambience a fresh and clear appeal. In key rooms, a warmer atmosphere is conjured by combining wood and exposed concrete. Full-height low-emissivity glazing provides ample daylighting and allows people working inside pleasant views of the surrounding picturesque Jiangsu countryside from their workspaces.

Storm System brings together various ceiling elements mounted in an installation ring, which is flush with the ceiling. Using the innovative “snap lock” technique, various fixtures are easily mounted into the ring. Users have a choice of 17 elements such as lighting, speakers, cameras, smoke detectors, ventilation systems, motion detectors and cable outputs. The entire range of fixtures has the same streamlined design and all elements are made of high-quality materials such as aluminium, brass, wood, glass, concrete or leather.

This cheese fondue set takes up the current copper trend but also uses the functional properties of the heat conducting material. The fondue pan, which comes in a retro-look, distributes heat evenly so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. Thanks to this configuration, the heat is effectively directed upwards, so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. In combination with the traditional look of the copper, the high-gloss polished stainless steel handle forms a strong contrast. Moreover, the base, which is made of concrete and stainless steel, lends the set both a stable and decorative appearance.

Inspired by raw industrial aesthetics, the surfaces of RAUVISIO cube feature the cool visual appeal and irregular texture of concrete. With their natural air pores and individually unique surface structure, the panels make a bold statement in any room. A matching edgeband is incorporated to create the appearance of a solid concrete slab. The matt finish obscures fingerprints and smudges so that nothing diminishes the elegant overall impression. The sturdy material can also be processed with standard woodworking tools.

Boost Expression is a collection of porcelain and wall tiles characterised by their textured, three-dimensional concrete effect. Inspired by iconic forms such as circles, lines and ellipses, the tiles provide plenty of scope for indoor and outdoor applications. Natural textures are paired with a pastel colour palette, giving the tiles considerable depth and a distinctive look. The cutting-edge Sensitech surfaces ensure a soft touch, excellent anti-slip properties and outstanding durability.

The TRAX TRUNK Bench aims to enhance public spaces as an emotionally appealing and functional seating option. Inspired by traditional Japanese gardens, the bench is characterised by an innovative design where three laminated pieces of lumber sit atop concrete pillars reinforced with steel plates for stability. The TRAX TRUNK Bench allows for various configurations according to the modular principle. It offers an affordable and sustainable option for municipalities and promotes vibrant community spaces for people of all ages.

Ideally, the interior design of shops and flagship stores creates a parallel world that immediately attracts visitors and in which products can be staged effectively. The aim in designing the JINS Shop in the Shanghai World Financial Center (SWFC) was to create an appealing effect of huge emptiness within a shopping mall which is usually crowded with goods and people. The interior space was to be presented and perceived in the sense of a sculptural architecture. The result has emerged as an impressive solution that stands out for its puristic effect. The interior space of the sales room is composed of five cantilever tables, each made of concrete and with a maximum length of up to 12 metres. The overall concept combines extreme dimensions, a maximum length and a minimum width and depth, in such a manner that it ensures a maximum linear display and freedom of movement for customers. The void space of the shop is divided into six different parts that can contain a large amount of stocks or fulfil other functions such as offering a workshop of glasses fabrication between tables no. 4 and 5. In this shop, the steel structure encased in concrete makes the interior work in an architectural manner. Even the furniture serves as a piece of the structure. Inviting visitors to experience the interior space like a low extending landscape, all tables are arranged horizontally and at a just level, 80 cm high from ground.

The premium X2 Pro Master Edition features a surprisingly artistic approach towards the product. The aim is to pay homage to two of the most common construction materials – concrete and brick – and to convey a sense of solidity and stability, so as to highlight the connection between the real world and the world of technology. The design of this smartphone, with an appealing look and feel, attempts to bridge this gap. It lends new vitality to an industrial product in an imposing combination of art and industrialism, sensitivity and rationality.

This private museum houses a collection of dried fish maws, also known as swim bladders. One of its striking design features is a visible concrete joist pierced by a wooden beam. The entrance hall is fitted out with oak furniture which, together with the oak staircase, gives the space a sober aesthetics. A painting on the subject of man and fish tempts visitors into the exhibition space which is equipped with museum display cases and a strict lighting design so that the shape and texture of the concave exhibits are accentuated to their advantage.

materials.name: 镁合金
materials.description: 镁合金是以镁为基体并加入铝、锌、锰、稀土等元素形成的轻金属材料，常用名称即镁合金。其密度低、比强度较好、减振和电磁屏蔽性能突出，适合压铸和机加工，但耐腐蚀、燃烧风险及表面防护需要重点控制。常用于电子外壳、汽车零件、航空部件和轻量化器材。
materials.cognitiveText: 镁合金在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 44.8–45 GPa。

cases.description: The lightweight TravelMate P6 14 AI laptop is designed as a companion for mobile working. It combines a powerful NPU with over 45 TOPS for local AI applications with a robust casing made of carbon fibre and magnesium alloy. The device is optimised for hybrid working environments and features a triple microphone and numerous functions that simplify the workflow. PCR materials and an energy-efficient construction ensure sustainability.

The FDR ES II X-ray detector panels offer high-resolution, low-radiation imaging for efficient diagnostics. The ISS technology reduces radiation exposure for patients and ensures high X-ray conversion efficiency, while a special noise reduction circuit optimises image quality. The slim magnesium housing with bevelled edges and the smooth, easy-to-clean surface with anti-slip elements improve handling. LED indicators, a magnetic connector and one-handed battery replacement support an efficient workflow.

The YH-5000SE headphones are equipped with planar magnetic drivers that have been newly developed using modern technologies for authentic sound. For an optimised listening experience, all non-essential parts have been eliminated. The open housing is protected by a triaxial mesh material that characterises the texture and appearance of the headphones. By taking into account aspects such as side pressure and headband curvature, as well as the magnesium housing frame, which weighs just 320 grams, the YH-5000SE offers a comfortable fit for extended listening sessions.

“Intelligent urban mobility must evolve from the needs of the users. The ultimate goal is to provide users with a smarter and more comfortable solution for getting around in the city,” is the claim of the Niu Design Team in developing its electric vehicles. SQi was to become the first product in the class of light electric scooters on the Chinese market that conveys the riding experience of a motorbike. Functionally, the vehicle, which also has two pedals, is somewhere between an e-bike and an e-moped, while in terms of appearance it is based on an electric motorbike. In the design process, the designers challenged the traditional layout of conventional motorbikes to create space for a truly original solution. The biggest challenges were to make the scooter very light and to find the optimal centre of gravity of the vehicle to achieve a comfortable riding position while allowing easy removal of the battery. The result is the SQi, whose striking appearance is defined by its purist frame design, which the manufacturer itself describes as “industrial exoskeleton” style. The innovative unibody frame is made of an ultra-light magnesium alloy in a high-precision die-casting process, which not only keeps the total weight of the scooter below 55 kg, but also improves rigidity, impact resistance and corrosion resistance. Other striking design elements include the side-opening battery compartment, which ensures convenient access, and the lighting system with its eye-catching halo headlight that appears to float in front of the handlebars. “The SQi is a futuristic two-wheeler that draws the eye. Its design breaks with the idea that an e-vehicle is merely the further development of a vehicle with a combustion engine. Instead, it defines a new language of form, a new style for this type of e-mobility, which could remain relevant for several years to come and is thus trend-setting,” the jury said, explaining their decision. Furthermore, the SQi convinces with many modern and clever details and its extremely high quality in design technology.

When designing and constructing the EVO Nano+ drone, one of the key requirements was to create a product weighing less than 250 grams. This was done to comply with registration requirements under USA law which make exceptions for recreational drones that weigh in beneath this cut-off point. The result of this development process is a drone that, when folded up, is not much larger than a smartphone and which, at 249 grams in weight, is about as heavy as an orange, yet still has a gimbal-mounted 50-MP camera on board, capable of recording detailed images even in poor light conditions. Such miniaturisation is made possible firstly by a drone architecture in which every element has been thoughtfully positioned within the smallest possible space, and secondly by deliberately selecting components and materials according to their weight. Thus, for example, the underside of the die-cast housing is made of a semi-rigid magnesium alloy, making it not only slim, light and robust but also highly heat-dissipating. The design of the EVO Nano+ is minimalistic, focused on aerodynamism and well-balanced, making the drone easy to control and ensuring stable flying properties and high wind resistance. Three-way binocular vision sensors also enable the drone to perceive obstructions in three directions and avoid collisions. The drone is steered via an ergonomic controller whose design is reminiscent of a gamepad.

This laptop’s 17.3" 2.5K OLED folding display offers the benefits of a large display with versatile viewing configurations in a size smaller than an A4 sheet. The magnesium-alloy chassis is finished with a silky coating that resists fingerprints and is comfortable to the touch. The Zenbook can be used as a large tablet or, in combination with a Bluetooth keyboard, as a laptop. Thanks to the folding feature, it can also be held like a book to view content.

To solve the problem that LED displays available on the market weigh around 20 kg/sqm, a product composed of carbon fibre in combination with a magnesium alloy was developed to reduce the overall weight to only about 13 kg. Thickness and shape of the skeleton were modified in such a way that both the structural strength of the display screen and the size of the box body could be optimised. This allows for single assembly and disassembly at the installation site and reduces the costs for assembly personnel and transport.

The special feature of this tripod is its innovative hinge. The ball-head construction allows videos to be taken from different angles, for example views from below and above or in portrait and landscape formats. The tripod can also be used in various modes, for example in hand-held and selfie stick mode. In addition, it is easy to handle and foldable. A panoramic turntable allows a 360-degree seamless horizontal rotation. Stability and robustness are ensured by the magnesium alloy used.

In this day and age, smartphone users spend long periods of time on their phones, particularly when gaming. Weight was therefore a key factor in the design of the Aquos zero2. As a result, one of the aims was to give the smartphone a slim profile. It was also equipped with a convex magnesium frame at the sides for better finger grip. The rear of the smartphone, which is made of highly rigid material, is curved so that it rests comfortably in the hand.

The body of this compact system camera is fashioned from a magnesium alloy on the upper and lower surfaces. This makes the camera not only lightweight but also very robust. Striking features are the large aluminium control dials on the upper end, allowing for immediate access to the functions and providing familiar feedback with a click sound when rotat-ed. The leather texture of the body lends the camera a comfortable tactile feel.

The compact body of the X-T10 digital camera is essentially characterised by the base plate and cover. It is made of a magnesium alloy, which makes the camera robust yet also lightweight. It is intuitively operated by way of the easily accessible aluminium control dials. Alternatively, the photographer can select the full-auto mode with just the flip of a lever.

The ThinkPad X1 Carbon is a slim and sleek professional business PC. It references an established use of form using a convincing overall concept and was clearly developed with business use in mind. The use of carbon fibre in the top cover, as well as a magnesium alloy in the casing make the X1 Carbon incredibly lightweight and robust. Its impressive design vocabulary is seamlessly combined with the experience of an innovative, adaptive keyboard. It sets new standards of interaction. Depending on which application the user has just called up, the keyboard displays a pre-set range of controls in the form of adaptive keys. Split into four groups – Home, Browser, Conferencing and Function – the keys are then automatically launched by certain applications. This innovative technology offers more control keys to support new functions while simplifying the user interface by presenting controls dynamically as the user needs them. Thanks to a successful rethinking of the design, younger target groups in particular have the opportunity to work with intuitive interaction. The ThinkPad X1 will arrange the surface to match their individual user behaviour.

The models of this notebook series unite lightness and high performance with a slim design. In the interior of the sturdy magnesium-alloy body, honeycomb structures provide enhanced stability. A high-performance rechargeable battery enables extended operating time. HDMI and VGA interfaces allow both a monitor and a projector to be connected. Another user-friendly detail is the keyboard with a convenient pointing stick and 1.5 mm keystroke.

The Elitebook Revolve is a business notebook with touchscreen and Windows 8. Its cover, which includes the screen, can be rotated and inclined downward so that it rests on the keyboard, turning the notebook into a tablet PC. The 11.6” display is made of scratch-resistant Gorilla Glass and a durable magnesium frame. The notebook weighs 1.4 kg and includes two USB 3.0 connections and a DisplayPort. In addition, it features Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and NFC wireless technologies.

The Alienware Area-51m gaming laptop is characterised by an iconic design giving it a self-contained character. The futuristic design combines performance-oriented components with crisp lines, angled sections, abundant lighting and sophisticated cooling. Playing a role in the thermal regulation are hexagonal vents for improved airflow. The magnesium casing provides space for high-performance components, is torsion-resistant and reduces the overall weight of the laptop.

This top-class telephoto lens, which is resistant to spray and dust, is made of a magnesium alloy and is thus both robust and relatively lightweight. It can be used without problems in bad weather or under difficult climate conditions. The premium technical equipment minimises aberration and ensures a high resolution and sharp focus with beautiful bokeh. The image stabilisation system allows for taking shots without a tripod. With this potential, the lens is well suited to sports and nature photography.

The ball heads of the 050 series are the perfect match for carbon fibre tripods. They incorporate a robust magnesium body to achieve a lower weight. The ergonomic levers allow for quick and comfortable handling, while the heads are equipped with a self-lubricant ring guaranteeing particularly smooth movements. The angle selector for portraits provides a high degree of versatility for vertical shooting, both indoors and outdoors.

The innovative SL-1200G turntable is characterised by a newly designed coreless direct-drive motor guaranteeing a constant, even speed and minimal vibration. In connection with the precise motor control, the result is an excellent synchronised operation. The turntable platter is also geared for perfect rotation: it consists of three layers, giving it a high degree of rigidity and enabling vibration-free rotation. The tone arm also consists of premium materials, utilising a magnesium alloy with a high damping effect.

The tablet has been designed for use in rugged environments, where drops, vibration, rain, dust, heat, humidity and other threats are to be expected. Ultra-polymers with high compression strength protect against impacts. Magnesium alloy assures a stable basic structure. The 11.6” multi-touch display with Gorilla Glass can be operated while wearing gloves and provides full HD resolution. The integrated 4G LTE and a dedicated GPS enable the user to work independently of the location.

The children's bicycle COOGHI Smile is characterised by its "Smile Expression" frame, which not only gives it visual lightness, but also communicates the joy of riding as a theme. This idea is underlined by the vibrant colours. Children can assemble and disassemble the bike themselves thanks to simple click mechanisms, which also promotes their manual dexterity. The extremely robust monocoque frame is made of a magnesium alloy.

materials.name: 大理石
materials.description: 大理石常用名称为大理石，地质学上主要对应大理岩，是石灰岩或白云岩经变质作用形成的天然石材。其纹理、颜色和孔隙会因矿物组成而变化，表面可抛光形成装饰效果。常用于建筑饰面、台面、雕塑、家具构件和工艺品，但需要关注脆性、重量、酸敏感性及天然批次差异。
materials.cognitiveText: 大理石在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 23–74 GPa。

cases.description: Design innovations are often the product of technology transfer. In the case of Furniture Linoleum, the innovative aspect is first and foremost a carefully considered material transfer that has led to a sustainable product with aesthetic appeal. Forbo Flooring had previously focused on the production of high-quality flooring materials before deciding to diversify its portfolio and expertise in the furniture sector with Furniture Linoleum. Now the time-tested material of linoleum is captivating a new audience with its natural, warm feel and excellent durability as a contemporary surface finish for home and kitchen furniture, doors, and much more. “This product embodies our vision of creating functional, durable and environmentally conscious finishes for both flooring and furniture,” says the manufacturer. Linoleum’s climate-positive aspects also contribute to user convenience. Made from renewable and natural raw materials such as linseed oil, wood flour, pine resin and limestone, it has a naturally elegant, matt surface that is resistant to fingerprints. Being easy to clean, Furniture Linoleum is also an interesting option for the customised furnishing of public spaces. Forbo Flooring complements all of these positive properties with an attractive range of 24 colours that blend seamlessly with natural woods and stones, such as oak, walnut and maple, or marble, concrete and terrazzo. A special aesthetic has been achieved with the “Pure Linoleum” decor, which completely dispenses with colour pigments to showcase the natural shade of linseed oil. Like leather and wood, each piece is unique and alters in appearance over time. The Red Dot jurors were fascinated by the natural look and feel: “What really impressed us about Furniture Linoleum is this focus on material purity. The special yet subtle tactile warmth of the surfaces makes them feel comforting to the touch. Another remarkable aspect is the unique natural aroma of linoleum that is pleasant to perceive. This material represents tangible quality. It is honest, thoughtfully designed and delivers genuine added value for healthy interior spaces.”

The Restroom Dresser Premium Series was developed to transform the home bathroom into an oasis of well-being. Soft lighting, which switches on automatically using a motion sensor, and flowing shapes create a harmonious ambience. Touchless faucet with automatic on/off functions (wall mounted type) and ceramic-glaze basins increase user comfort. The marbled wall panel not only serves as splash protection, but also lends elegance to the ensemble.

The shower thermostat Nick seamlessly combines the geometric shapes of a circle and a rectangle and is characterised by its clear functional design. While the rotary knob on the right serves for continuous temperature adjustment, the pressure switches on the left side are used to select the respective shower mode. The modular platform design allows for uncomplicated personalisation of the surface. There is a choice of buttons with metal, leather, wood and marble finishes.

The P3-S series offers a versatile storage solution that combines purist shelving with panels made of different materials. The functionally sophisticated accessory concept allows users to combine the modules freely and at the same time achieve an overall uniform look in the room. This storage solution can be installed quickly and easily by means of a concealed fixing.
