Different lengths, colour variants and surfaces such as gold, gun, grey, elegant black and marble offer versatile possibilities for individualisation.

PIET BOON BATH combines natural materials, functional design and high-quality craftsmanship to create a bathtub collection full of character. Each of the freestanding bathtubs is made from one single block of stone or marble. Their rectangular, gently rounded basic form is generously designed and offers a comfortable reclining surface. The double rim stands out as a visual highlight and also serves as a holder for installing a purist shelf. The material combination of solid wood, stone and marble adds contrast yet projects a balanced appearance.

From the simple washbowl on a wooden table to the artistic creations of art nouveau, the history of the washbasin has produced a plethora of rich forms and variations. I Catini is a highly elaborate system with a finely detailed design that implies an impressive modularity. The system features a clear design idiom and high-quality materials, merging the models Tondo, Ovale and Doppio into an expressive overall concept. Based on stainless steel frameworks in Nero Matt or Bronzo Spazzolato, I Catini combines the various elements harmonically for individual definition. In order to match a given bathroom interior, the ceramic washbasins of the collection are available in 16 different variants of the Terre di Cielo colour palette or in shimmering white. The collection is complemented by ceramic or marble shelves and a convenient drawer for storing personal items, as well as by mirrors in different round or oval designs, with two of them coming with an additional cabinet. The I Catini collection also includes a range of stylish accessories including towel rails and holders. On the basis of an inspired design, this washbasin system presents versatility using a strikingly new design vocabulary – the materials and the forms accentuate the interior in a fascinating manner.

VERSATIKA is a flush-to-wall door with a barely visible frame just 1 mm wide and offers a wide range of design options. Each side of the door can have a different, customised finish: from veneered wood and transparent or opaque glass to marble, mirror or smart glass. Its solid aluminium structure allows heights of up to 3.7 metres and yet remains smooth-running thanks to concealed hinges. A magnetic locking system and the option of smart home integration round off the technical features.

Crafted from high-quality materials, the GROHE SPA Arina flush plates complement any modern bathroom, thanks to their minimalist aesthetic. In addition, the Silk Motion technology, with an actuation depth of only 2mm, ensures convenient operation, while the dual-flush system minimises water consumption. The variety of available finishes, including stainless steel, marble, glass and PVD coating, makes it possible to match the flush plates to existing bathroom fittings.

The Baron shower system is characterised by its clear geometric design and a straightforward user interface. Two rotary knobs with digital displays allow for precise regulation of water temperature and flow rate. Three buttons with clear pictograms enable intuitive switching between the different shower modes. Thanks to the modular construction, Baron allows the user to choose from different versions with a metal, marble, wood or leather look.

The design objective of AXOR MyEdition was to fulfil the desire for individual, creative bathroom designs. The fittings consist of a distinctively shaped body and a flat plate that is flush with the outlet. Materials such as leather, wood, marble and mirrored glass lend each plate a unique materiality and look. They can be paired with base bodies that are likewise available in different colours and finishes to create stunning combinations.

Policroma offers an aesthetic formula that incorporates the stylistic canons of classicism and an expressive code of modernism. The collection’s repertoire of large slabs features motifs that are inspired by the vein texture of rare rocks and the sophisticated colours of Marmorino plaster and refer to two materials that are central to the Italian building culture: marble and marble-like surfaces. The Policroma collection revives them, transforming them into exquisite design elements on ceramic surfaces.

The nexTouch Panel is a revolutionary product  that offers unprecedented customization, functionality, and safety in  home automation. Customers can customize the touch panel based on the titanium alloy middle frame according to their own needs.With a sleek, modern design crafted from premium  materials like AG glass, marble, and Nappa leather, it  elevates the traditional switch to a work of art. Its intelligent  features, including voice and app control, make it a powerful hub for  smart home devices.

The GROHE Arina collection is a perfect fusion of cutting-edge technology and sophisticated design. Its minimalist aesthetic, featuring premium materials such as stainless steel, marble, glass, and a range of PVD finishes, including Warm Sunset and Matte Black complement any modern bathroom. The innovative SoftTouch technology offers effortless control with just a 2mm actuation depth, creating a seamless, quiet experience. Its precise engineering, reduced use of plastics and water-saving dual-flush system enhance both functionality and sustainability, making it an ideal choice for eco-conscious users who value luxury and performance.

Baron's large button switch design makes it easier to control. You can easily switch between multiple shower modes by just pressing the button. Taking "geometric aesthetics" as the design concept, it emphasizes the beauty presented by the volume; in order to meet the more personalized needs of users, Baron adopts a modular platform design, with various patterns of metal, marble, wood grain, and leather to choose from. Adapt to different interior design styles. The flow display and temperature display remind users of hot and cold water and flow more clearly, improving the perception experience, completing precise temperature and flow control,

"NUAR" washbasin is made of stainless steel, utilizing Japanese metalworking technology, and is composed of a thin plate design that cannot be expressed in artificial marble or ceramic. By adding the soft impression of curves to the hard texture of metal, we have achieved both a dignified public feeling and a calm private feeling. When used in combination with the ceramic tile base plate, it can be integrated with the washbasin counter material, express your personal style, and create a space with uniqueness. Furthermore, the metal material is highly durable and can be used for a long period of time.

cases.productName: Low-carbon furniture made from Taiwanese materials
cases.description: Taiwan used to be the second largest stone processing and exporting country. However, the industry mainly focused on imported materials, while neglecting local high-quality stones, such as white marble, black marble and green serpentine. In recent years, energy conservation and carbon reduction have gradually become an industry trend. We have the opportunity to re-understand and apply high-quality stone and wood produced locally, design and produce exquisite handmade furniture, and realize the concept of "short chain manufacturing" and reduce the waste generated by imported materials. The carbon emissions from transportation reach 80%.

materials.name: 硼硅玻璃
materials.description: 材料简介
materials.cognitiveText: 硼硅玻璃在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 62–67 GPa。

cases.description: Healthy eating has been a consumer issue for many years. However, we often lack the time to prepare meals from fresh ingredients every day, which is why an increasing number of busy people are turning to reheating precooked meals. The Ready-To-Easy Cook Containers were developed to provide this busy target group with a solution that is both functional and aesthetic. Health and safety were an important focus in the development of the containers because they are obviously exposed to high temperatures. The product designer opted for a combination of the materials silicone and borosilicate glass, which don’t release any harmful substances during use. At the same time, the surfaces are smooth and easy to clean. All of these features together make an easy-to-use product with an aesthetic design that fascinated the jury: “Quality cookwear! The details of the containers are very well thought out and visually appealing. One feature we particularly liked was how the lid fits seamlessly around the bowls. The choice of material is another persuasive argument in favour of this product. It is both pleasant the touch and, at the same time, highly functional.” Another clever idea is the steam hole cover to keep food moist during storage and to allow pressure to escape when used in the microwave oven. A removable tray permits the drainage of fat and excess liquid when food is cooking. Wings on both sides of the lid, which are moulded over the edge of the bowl, enhance safety because they prevent contact with the hot glass when handling the containers. Not only are the containers dishwasher-safe; they can also easily withstand freezer temperatures. For space-saving storage, the symmetrically shaped lids can be placed upside down in the bowls. The judges additionally praised the fact that the containers “are ideal as elegant tableware thanks to their aesthetic design, which makes them even more versatile”. The beautiful Ready-To-Easy Cook Containers are a genuine feast for the eyes.

The stylish jug blender BL710 with “thermo resist” is a new development of the producer. The thermal shock resistant borosilicate glass provides the possibility to alternately blend hot and cold liquids without damaging the glass. Visually appealing, the robust glass container unites with the massive metal body. Speed control via rotary knob ensures easy operation.

The Melitta AMANO coffee maker is aimed at making manual coffee brewing easier. Its functionality fulfils the demands towards a ritual that is supposed to move all the senses. From the filter form and the filter ribs to the jug made of borosilicate glass, all components showcase a reduced language of form. The mount of the filter ring, which appears to be floating above the elegantly curved metal side posts, harmonises with the contours of the glass jug. Closing the drip stop ensures that the coffee is optimally dampened to unfold its full aroma.

The Balloon Goblet is inspired by balloons, which evoke happy memories and remind us of the exciting feeling while using it. Its design features a transparent glass stem and foot resembling an inflated balloon, creating a cheerful atmosphere and intuitively showing the design intent. The simple bowl shape complements the foot, giving it a modern and refined look. Crafted by skilled artisans using mouth-blown techniques in a form that is difficult to achieve with glass, this durable borosilicate glass goblet withstands temperature changes. It is suitable for various foods, from hot beverages to ice cream, and is perfect for everyday use.

cases.productName: MU16 Gala Zucchero Collection individual tea set
cases.description: The Zucchero Collection Individual Tea Set, designed for young females, is ideal for indoor settings like offices and homes. It includes a double-walled borosilicate glass cup, a V-shaped glass tea strainer inspired by coffee filters, and a silicone lid. The strainer’s 12 fine holes ensure rich tea infusion without clogging, while the double-walled cup protects hands from heat. The acid-etched glass creates a soft, candy-like aesthetic. The strainer rests neatly on the lid, offering a hygienic, convenient storage solution.

The feather-shaped mixing blade of the Migrating Bird mixer starts to turn and mix liquids when you press the lid. It rotates just like a bird soaring in the sky, swooping and turning, again and again. It is made of food-grade borosilicate glass. The green ring on top can be turned to adjust the amount of liquid poured out. Any left-over liquid can be stored in the glass container, for you to use whenever you like.

The ARTEVO TERRA window system guarantees sustainability throughout its entire life cycle. The profiles are made of bio-attributed PVC on the outside and up to 78 per cent recycled PVC in the core. The glazing beads contain up to 80 per cent recycled material. The fibre composite material makes steel superfluous in 80 per cent of applications, thus reducing CO₂ emissions. The LowE profile technology optimises thermal insulation and meets passive house standards. The system is fully recyclable; digital labelling facilitates end-of-life recycling.

The Sonnenglas Light Carafe is a hand-blown glass carafe that transforms into an atmospheric table lamp with the manufacturer’s SOMO solar light. Only recycled bottle glass collected by locals in Eswatini (Africa) is used in the production process. This work is the sole source of income for many, and it also contributes to a cleaner environment. Manufactured in a solar-powered factory, the Light Carafe is highly functional and has a timeless aesthetic.

The Wuliangye Project Vision combines the aesthetics of industrial mechanics with the Fibonacci spiral to symbolise the connection between nature, time and innovation. The outer packaging of the fine, traditional spirit hints at the precise curves and structural shape of the bottle inside. A glass window provides a glimpse of the interior. The proportions of the high-end metal bottle adhere to the golden ratio, and its spiral shape invites playful interaction.

VB600 Dual Eyes Video Bar is a video conferencing system with dual-lens technology for medium and large meeting rooms. It combines high audio and video quality with intelligent functions such as auto-framing and speaker tracking. A one-touch privacy function increases security. Thanks to its user-friendliness and flexibility, the system is suitable for various application areas, including financial consulting and medical technology, and thus meets the increasing demand for remote solutions.

The ultra-slim, foldable casing of the Xiaomi Mix Fold 4 is both lightweight and robust. Its seamless design with glass, metal and fibreglass creates a pleasant feel and an elegant look. The quad-curved glass of the display blends harmoniously into the metal casing, while the back is made of Dragon Scale Fibre, a material composed of ceramic and aramid. Combined with sophisticated hinge technology, it increases shock resistance.

The design of the Xiaomi 14 Ultra is defined by its prominently placed camera, emphasising the device's advanced photo and video capabilities. Its metal casing ensures high stability and pressure resistance, while the quad-curved screen enhances both the visual and tactile user experience. The device is complemented by accessories, such as a photo grip with a shutter button and zoom function, a 1,500 mAh battery for extended use and an adapter ring for filters.

The iPad Pro M4 is the thinnest Apple product to date. It combines high computing power with an extremely flat design. The 11" model measures 5.3 mm, the 13" model only 5.1 mm. Both versions are made from recycled aluminium and are available in silver or black. A tandem OLED display ensures precise image reproduction. An anti-reflective nano-glass surface is available as an option. Despite the reduced weight, stability is maintained, facilitating mobile work processes considerably.

The TCL 50 PRO NXTPAPER 5G is a smartphone with a focus on visual comfort and material-conscious design. Its battery cover is just 0.34 mm thin and is paired with a newly developed frame that enhances the visual experience by remaining nearly invisible. The matt screen surface features a nano-etched microstructure to reduce eye strain. This device is aimed at users who prioritise an ergonomic design language and thoughtful functionality.

The Xiaomi Civi4 Pro is a particularly slim smartphone designed for young, fashion-conscious users. Thanks to its low weight, it sits comfortably in the hand. The back combines two colours with a mother-of-pearl-like sheen, while the camera ring with its finely polished structure is reminiscent of luxury watches. A Snapdragon chip and Leica image processing ensure high image quality and smooth performance with continuous use.

The ROG Phone 9 is a gaming smartphone with features suitable for everyday use. Its integrated hybrid camera allows for precise recording, while AI-powered translation and transcription for calls provide additional convenience. A 5,800 mAh battery ensures a long runtime, while the five-part cooling system keeps performance stable. The 185 hertz AMOLED display, a lateral charging port and a headphone connector enhance the gaming experience. The device is IP68-rated and made of recycled aluminium.

The Zenfone 12 Ultra combines rugged outdoor capability with a sustainable design concept. The back is made from etched glass without additional coatings, the frame uses recycled aluminium, and the display glass contains 22 per cent recycled materials. The camera features a 6-axis gimbal with AI optimisation and an algorithm for stable 4K videos. A 6.78" display with 144 Hz, IP68 certification and a 5,500 mAh battery complete the smartphone’s high-performance profile.

With a 40.2 MP sensor and in-body image stabilisation, the FUJIFILM X100VI delivers high image quality even in low light conditions. The camera’s retro aesthetic is achieved through a tactile, analogue feel reminiscent of classic film cameras. The machined dial, non-slip exterior and aluminium top plate reinforce this impression. And advanced hybrid viewfinder and a flat, fold-out LCD display ensure flexibility. The compact and lightweight camera is available in both silver and black versions.

The Strato V enables 4K playback with Dolby Vision and lossless audio. It can be used independently or in conjunction with Terra servers. An Strato V 960GB SSD can store around ten 4K films, while the newly developed user interface makes it easy to navigate smaller film archives. Movies can be downloaded in around 10 minutes via Gigabit Ethernet during playback without compromising performance. The device is housed in a sleek, high-quality black anodised aluminium and glass case.

Flat proportions, frameless windows, flush door handles and a precisely shaped front with a shark nose characterise the appearance of the all-electric NIO ET5 Touring. A continuous glass roof visually opens up the interior, and LiDAR technology for autonomous driving functions is seamlessly integrated. Digital user interfaces, ambient lighting and an innovative battery changing system complement the vehicle’s design, which is characterised by understated elegance and user-friendliness.

materials.name: 铝合金
materials.description: 铝合金是以铝为基体并加入镁、硅、铜、锌等元素形成的轻金属材料，常用名称即铝合金。它具有低密度、较好的比强度、耐腐蚀性和加工性，可进行挤压、压铸、冲压、机加工及阳极氧化。常用于电子产品外壳、交通工具、家具、建筑型材、灯具和包装。
materials.cognitiveText: 铝合金在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 70–70 GPa。

cases.description: The T-CREATE EXPERT P32 Desk External SSD is designed for professional video production, offering up to 16 TB of storage and a write speed of 1,700 MB/s. Capable of storing over 11 hours of 4K footage, it remains impressively compact. Its CNC-machined aluminium construction with integrated cooling fins ensures efficient heat dissipation, supporting both high performance and large storage capacity. Thanks to its minimal footprint, the device fits neatly on any desk.

The high-performance T-FORCE XTREEM ARGB DDR5 Memory combines sophisticated technology with a robust design, delivering impressive efficiency and overclocking capability. A uniform Aurora light effect adds visual accents, while the heat spreader made of forged aluminium alloy with a sandblasted texture effectively dissipates heat and ensures stable high-speed data transmission. The integrated PMIC stabilises the power supply.

With a 40.2 MP sensor and in-body image stabilisation, the FUJIFILM X100VI delivers high image quality even in low light conditions. The camera’s retro aesthetic is achieved through a tactile, analogue feel reminiscent of classic film cameras. The machined dial, non-slip exterior and aluminium top plate reinforce this impression. And advanced hybrid viewfinder and a flat, fold-out LCD display ensure flexibility. The compact and lightweight camera is available in both silver and black versions.

The intelligent N5 POS system integrates QR code scanning, NFC, chip and magnetic stripe payment options into one compact device. Voice guidance, backlit buttons and an illuminated scan area with colour gradient enhance usability and ensure an intuitive payment experience. A combination of glass surfaces, aluminium and floating design elements creates a modern, technical appearance. The terminal’s elongated shape optimises its functionality on narrow counters, making it ideal for retail, banking and the service sector.

Falcon 2 is a modular, expandable business tablet designed for use in industries such as retail, hospitality and public services, offering flexible adaptation to a variety of requirements. Three accessory kits, three docking stations and a secondary display allow for custom configurations, including the integration of payment functions and identity verification. The modules connect easily via pogo pin connections, while aluminium alloys keep the device lightweight and ensure efficient heat dissipation.

The NEX E1 Ultra screwdriver set was developed with accessory storage in mind. The precision electric tool and 50 magnetic drill bits are housed in a cylindrical aluminium box. A pop-up and rotating mechanism allows the drill bits to extend outwards for easy access. Offering multiple torque settings, the tool is equipped with a powerful motor and powered by a rechargeable high-performance lithium battery.

amp is an AI-supported strength-training device that blends seamlessly into the interior thanks to its minimalist design. The compact system made of aluminium alloy and chrome-plated steel is extremely resilient and has precise rope guidance. A central rotary dial allows intuitive height and rotation adjustment, while the locking mechanism ensures safe operation. With flexibly adjustable resistance and smart training modes, it can train any muscle group, while gamification and coaching options increase motivation.

TreeRoot Quick Lock Travel Tripod (R141K-320P) is a versatile travel tripod that offers excellent stability. Made from an aluminium alloy and high-modulus carbon fibre, it combines strength with lightweight construction. The Reuleaux hybrid-shaped leg tube enhances torsional rigidity and handling. A user-friendly locking mechanism allows for set-up within seconds, while the quick-release centre column enables tool-free removal for instant transitioning to low-angle shooting.

The LED panels of the AOTO SW Series combine a modern look with advanced technology for large stages. The panels feature a robust, high-strength framework made of carbon fibre and an aluminium alloy, making them weigh less than 19 kg/m². A pronounced curvature and precise 90-degree angles allow for visually creative presentations. Thanks to practical mechanical features such as magnetic modules, quick-release fasteners, ejection systems and ergonomic handles, efficient installation and easy maintenance are achieved.

Elfin-Pro is a collaborative robot for industrial human-machine collaboration in various work environments, including welding, spraying, polishing, screwing and picking. By integrating cutting-edge technologies such as end force control and artificial intelligence, it ensures stable, reliable performance, quick response and safe collaboration. An aluminium alloy provides high rigidity with reduced weight, while the internal wiring increases interference resistance.

The almost bezel-free AOC 27T4X monitor can be used like a standless picture frame or with an individually height-adjustable stand. This also facilitates transportability. Particularly ingenious is that all interfaces are located on a small bracket at the back of the screen. This also serves for height adjustment, as well as acting as a connector between the display and the stand, which is made of an aluminium alloy.

The CreateMate High-speed Card Reader Case is a lightweight device for outdoor shooting that allows photographers to store and read memory cards with ease. It is compatible with various formats and can accommodate up to four SD cards, four TF cards and two Nano-SIM cards. The data transfer rate of up to 312 MB/s and the plug-and-play function via the Type-C interface are particularly noteworthy. To protect against shocks, dust and water, the casing is made from a single piece of an aluminium alloy and surrounded by a robust silicone cover.

The 3D scanner 3DMakerpro Seal impresses with an exceptional precision of up to 0.01 mm. Thanks to its custom-made micro-optics module, it is compact enough to be connected to smartphones, increasing flexibility and mobility. Supportive accessories such as a handle and a two-axis turntable expand the range of applications and bring playful aspects to 3D scanning. The metallic exterior gives the scanner robustness while also providing an elegant, sporty look.

LEDskin is an LED system for the construction of exhibition booths. It consists of individual modules that can be assembled as required to create large video walls in various shapes. Despite a material thickness of only 62 mm, all cables can be laid invisibly. The rear of such a video wall can be covered either with fabric or panels. The new generation of the 2024 product features improved display specifications, such as a smaller pixel pitch and a more robust LED surface.

The SmallRig Basic Cage Kit for RED KOMODO / KOMODO-X 4110 is made of an aluminium alloy and reliably protects the camera body. It also offers a simple mounting option for accessories. The top handle can be adjusted forwards and backwards and allows full access to the camera’s LCD screen. It can be easily removed, facilitating shots from low angles. The monitor mount can be tilted 180 degree and swivelled 360 degree.

The Anymaka Hammock Stand is a hammock stand made from a robust, oxidised aluminium alloy with a corrosion-resistant black finish. With its convenient snap-fold design, it can be set up for use as a hammock or armchair in just a few seconds. Thanks to good processing and robust material, the maximum load capacity is 225 kg. The padded storage bag offers secure transport with external compartments and shoulder strap.

With their integrated Wi-Fi functionality, the Unity headphones enable lossless, high-resolution audio streaming with a quality of up to 24 bit/192 kHz. This significantly improves the sound, making it clearer and more detailed. The ear cups are CNC-machined from a single block of aluminium alloy and combined with a vibration-reducing, carbon-fibre-infused nylon chassis. This combination of materials reduces outside noise and supports the ANC function. “The Unity headphones demonstrate a high level of innovation,” praised the jury. “Moreover, the materials and workmanship support the sound quality in an exemplary manner.”

The jury was impressed: “The compact CM555 docking station is characterised by a minimalist design that puts functionality in the foreground. It also offers a comprehensive selection of interfaces.” Equipped with DisplayLink technology for up to three displays at up to 8K, 10 Gbps data ports, Gigabit Ethernet, 100 watts of charging power and dual card reading, it provides access to all the peripheral devices needed for programming, editing or designing. The robust aluminium alloy chassis provides effective heat dissipation, while the top power switch directly disconnects all external devices for added security.

The Verkada CB52-E and CB62-E outdoor surveillance cameras are equipped with wide-angle lenses, and the CB52-TE and CB62-TE models with telephoto lenses. As a result, these bullet cameras offer a large field of view and a powerful zoom for magnifying distant objects. All models have an aluminium unibody housing that protects the sensitive electronic components from environmental influences and vandalism. A system-on-a-chip with a coprocessor for video processing makes it possible to read vehicle number plates. The jury was impressed by the fact that the cameras are able to simultaneously monitor up to three lanes of traffic and reliably capture the number plates of vehicles travelling at speeds of 128 km/h.

The A&futura SE180 is an elegant hi-res audio player that follows a modular design as a special feature. The DAC module and the amp module can be entirely exchanged, which allows the realisation of different audio characteristics if desired, whereby the device delivers uncompromised and detailed sound in any configuration. The audio player features an intuitive user interface with a generous display and also a rotary control including LED lighting on the side.

materials.name: 金
materials.description: 金常用名称为黄金，是具有黄色金属光泽的贵金属。它延展性和导电性突出，化学性质稳定，不易氧化，但纯金较软，工程使用中常通过加入银、铜等元素形成不同成色的合金。除珠宝和装饰外，金还用于电子触点、连接器、镀层、牙科和精密器件，其成本与资源属性非常显著。
materials.cognitiveText: 金在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 70–80 GPa。

cases.description: The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

One of the key challenges of design today seems to be to create innovative products that are tailored to the needs and personalities of consumers and are sustainable at the same time. The Busch-art linear/ALBA switch range by Busch-Jaeger and Niessen, market leader in the field of electrical installation technology and building automation, fulfils this brief exceptionally well. A prominent feature of these switches is the position of the inserts, which float above the frame and are not, as usual, enclosed by them. This gives the product range a unique sense of lightness, heightened by the sharp, slim contours that radiate clarity and elegance across a wide selection of materials and models. The breadth of the Busch-art linear/ALBA switch range is hard to beat, in particular with regard to the frames. Whether it is glass, structured glass, wood, aluminium or plastic, with fine surrounds in chrome, gold or rose gold, and glossy, matt or mirrored surfaces, the rich variety on offer will satisfy personal preferences and suit the widest possible range of interiors. The soft feel of the switches also makes for a pleasurable sensory experience. In this way, the Busch-art linear/ALBA range is not only testimony to in-depth deliberations about form, material and colour but also about the environment, responsibility and the future. The collection is made with recycled and recyclable materials and follows a cradle-to-cradle philosophy for the healthy and regenerative productivity of companies. All plastic parts are produced from at least 92 per cent (white plastic) and up to 98 per cent (black plastic) recycled materials. That translates into a total reduction in CO₂ emissions of 82 per cent and requires a considerable amount of development work as it is difficult to produce such perfect, flat surfaces from recyclate. It is clear that sustainability is not a secondary consideration for Busch-Jaeger and Niessen but a value that is at the very heart of its design and product development work. The jury recognised this. “The Busch-art linear/ALBA switch range is both an object lesson in carefully considered design – from the construction through to the execution of details and surfaces, as well as the impressive haptics – and also a benchmark for sustainable design.”

FILKA is a fully automatic filter coffee maker characterised by a high-quality and space-saving body. The contrasting surface finish made of brushed stainless steel and black plastic defines the innovative approach. The machine supports the users by means of a fully automatic cup control for optimal coffee preparation – whether for a single cup or a whole pot. In addition to a removable water tank and bean container, the washable gold-tone filter also offers a high level of user comfort.

The durable Opus lighting system was developed as a part of a product family for both residential and commercial sectors. The heart of the concept is an innovative track system, which unites central functions such as lighting, sound, air conditioning, security and multi-sensor monitoring. A wide range of available colours and surface finishes meet the demands of variability and adaptability to different interiors. In addition to discreet, timeless designs, the system allows the setting of glamorous highlights with gold-plated or chrome finishes.

The invention of pocket watches and later wristwatches gave everybody the possibility to check on the time anywhere and thus plan activities accordingly. The Apple Watch now adds a further interpretation to the measuring of time. Coming with a design language that is inspired by traditional watchmaking, it features an innovative interface that enables users to customise the watch by allowing them to choose between different, more personal watch faces. Users can thus configure the interface in the style of a classic chronograph, for instance, or opt for a more playful display such as a fluttering butterfly. Both  the interface and the housing of the Apple Watch have been created and perfectly matched specifically for such a small device. A digital crown makes navigating the watch highly intuitive and amazes users with its versatility and many possibilities. The innovative Force Touch display is extremely sensitive and recognises even the lightest touch. Another exciting experience is how it senses the difference between  a tap and a press, as the Taptic Engine enables a new vocabulary of both acoustic and sensory notifications and responses. Offering a myriad of new interactive possibilities, the Apple Watch also allows extensive customising such as the material used for the wristband or the enclosure, ranging from stainless steel to a model in gold – for a new way of experiencing time.

The Extend ring was inspired by the idea to create a piece of jewellery that would be as flexible as it is versatile and that would fit every finger. It was modelled on the pantograph of astronomer and inventor Christoph Scheiner. Just like the technical instrument, the ring is composed of separate elements that flexibly interlock. It is made of 18-carat white or yellow gold and ornamented with precious stones.

With its aesthetic design and its components, the Plutus luggage collection satisfies high demands. The robust shells display an elegant prism pattern, logos and zip fasteners are finished in premium gold-metallic materials. In their interior the suitcases offer a good number of separate pockets which help to stow high-quality shoes and clothing safely and make packing in general easy. Furthermore, the collection is equipped with a TSA-conforming lock and high-quality double wheels.

Rings are pieces of jewellery with great symbolic meaning. The ring, made of silver plated with gold, contains the Chinese character for heart, which is the focal point of this design. It can be worn on its own or be complemented by one of the other rings made of silver plated with platinum. These other rings also include characters that can be combined with the root word for heart and so create another meaning. In this way, the delicate items of jewellery are carriers of a message.

The interchangeable hearing clip combines a specially developed hearing aid with a hand-made jewellery cover in a simple, but extremely innovative way. The gold or silver mesh-like surface of this decorative earpiece ensures optimal sound quality. Form rigidly follows function and dimensions of a high-tech hearing aid. The exchangeable hearing clip combines easy handling, light looks and excellent voice quality with appealing design.

With its asymmetrical contours, this LED pendant luminaire, which creates a dynamic lighting situation, looks different depending on the viewing angle. The lamp shade is available in any of the monochrome RAL colours or as a two-tone version with different inner and outer colours. It can also be manufactured with a gold, silver or bronze edging. Krivda furthermore provides good illumination at low energy consumption levels.

The Suit mixer tap collection is characterised by the combination of soft lines with strikingly angular components, which creates an exciting contrast of form. The control levers for washbasin, shower and bathtub are ergonomically shaped and, thanks to the different heights, the mixer taps can be easily matched to the respective ceramic products. There is a choice of tarnish- and corrosion-resistant coatings in chrome, black, copper or gold for customised bathroom design.

The Ringbuds Pro ear-hook earphones are made from titanium, giving them a particularly high-quality feel – especially in combination with their gold-coloured metal accents and the finely crafted surface texture complete with TPU coating. Consideration was also given to environmental compatibility in the choice of materials. The Ringbuds Pro are equipped with a novel technology that ensures a nuanced sound image through increased vibration amplitudes for precise transmission of sound waves into the ear canal.

The SPA 2.0 earthenware tiles are produced in a slim format with a thickness of only 6 mm. The series thus not only stands for special sustainability but also opens up a high degree of creative freedom for the user. The digitally printed basic tiles are designed in black and white, with shaded decors rounding off the concept. Special accents in the kitchen, bathroom and guest WC can also be achieved by using metallic matt-gloss optics in gold, silver and rose gold.

materials.name: 银
materials.description: 银常用名称为白银，是具有明亮白色金属光泽的贵金属。它在常见金属中具有很高的导电和导热能力，同时延展性良好，但表面会与含硫物质反应而变暗。银除用于首饰、餐具和装饰外，也广泛用于电子触点、导电浆料、光伏电极、镜面镀层和抗菌材料。
materials.cognitiveText: 银在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 80–85 GPa。

cases.description: The Neato D10 vacuum robot is particularly suitable for large homes and allergy sufferers, as it is equipped with a powerful battery and a HEPA filter that captures up to 99.97 per cent of allergens and fine dust particles. Thanks to the style-defining D-shape, the robot can drive up to the edges of furniture and walls and reach into every corner. The surface in glossy brushed silver appears of high quality and robust at the same time and suits a wide variety of individual furnishing styles. The info button on the top is particularly user-friendly and provides voice-based status messages.

Even in the digital age, mechanical wristwatches are more than ever an expression of personal lifestyle. The Minimatik watch from NOMOS Glashütte fascinates at first glance with its slender and minimalist design language. Featuring refined proportions with smooth flowing lines, it fits snugly around the arm of its wearer. A small inscription on the white silver-plated dial marks it as part of NOMOS’ new neomatik series. The watch owes its exceptionally flat profile to the mere 3.2 mm thick DUW 3001 automatic movement within. This proprietary NOMOS movement is only a touch thicker than that of the hand-wound model and possesses excellent accuracy, mechanical sophistication and durability. The distinctive character of Minimatik is further enhanced by meticulous details in cyan blue that skilfully underline its elegant modern face and symbolise the innovation contained within. This wristwatch successfully merges high-grade mechanics with a contemporary form – making it stand out with a fresh and clear style.

The smaller bands of this finger ring can be twisted out of the frame and, in doing so, move into the centre of the circle.  This creates a ring band which rapidly wraps itself around the finger and eventually runs back into the frame. Ring band and ring head thus achieve a fluid transition to the frame in all available versions. These pieces of jewellery come in yellow gold, white gold, silver gold-plated or silver.

The Leilana bangle from the Flowertimes design line consists of an open-worked decoration of subtly shimmering, three-leaf blossoms. These are framed by a narrow band of sparkling, brilliant-cut zirconia. The bracelet and its flower arrangement has both a playful feminine feel, while at the same time reflecting the manufacturer’s distinctive, clear-cut form. Due to its lightweight and its shape, it is very comfortable to wear. This piece of jewellery is made of sterling silver enhanced with wire-brushed high-grade 24-carat gold plating.

Rings are pieces of jewellery with great symbolic meaning. The ring, made of silver plated with gold, contains the Chinese character for heart, which is the focal point of this design. It can be worn on its own or be complemented by one of the other rings made of silver plated with platinum. These other rings also include characters that can be combined with the root word for heart and so create another meaning. In this way, the delicate items of jewellery are carriers of a message.

The interchangeable hearing clip combines a specially developed hearing aid with a hand-made jewellery cover in a simple, but extremely innovative way. The gold or silver mesh-like surface of this decorative earpiece ensures optimal sound quality. Form rigidly follows function and dimensions of a high-tech hearing aid. The exchangeable hearing clip combines easy handling, light looks and excellent voice quality with appealing design.

With its asymmetrical contours, this LED pendant luminaire, which creates a dynamic lighting situation, looks different depending on the viewing angle. The lamp shade is available in any of the monochrome RAL colours or as a two-tone version with different inner and outer colours. It can also be manufactured with a gold, silver or bronze edging. Krivda furthermore provides good illumination at low energy consumption levels.

The organic shapes of this modular jewellery collection are inspired by a dragonfly’s metamorphosis from a larva to the adult animal. Made from silver, it features an end piece made from 3D printed nylon which has been specifically designed to be sprayed with perfume. The nylon material then holds the scent for up to two days. The individual petals and wings are exchangeable, so the wearer can adapt the jewellery to the respective outfit as required.

The FDR DEVOⅢ G80i is a wireless digital radiography detector for long-view imaging. At 32 inches, it is twice the length of conventional detector panels and covers a larger area, enabling it to capture images of the spine, femur, or even a child’s entire body with a single exposure.

The 47 Table is equal parts end table and material experiment, a striking piece that juxtaposes a natural material and a bespoke industrial process. Named for its use of the 47th element on the periodic table, the table is composed of a silver surface that envelops a solid piece of reclaimed Douglas fir using a low-VOC process.

The SPA 2.0 earthenware tiles are produced in a slim format with a thickness of only 6 mm. The series thus not only stands for special sustainability but also opens up a high degree of creative freedom for the user. The digitally printed basic tiles are designed in black and white, with shaded decors rounding off the concept. Special accents in the kitchen, bathroom and guest WC can also be achieved by using metallic matt-gloss optics in gold, silver and rose gold.

PURIR baby bodysuit is the most advanced version of baby essential clothing. It is made from a silver-infused fabric with excellent antibacterial qualities. While wearing it, the baby’s chance of being infected by germs is greatly reduced. The additional use of patented olive-shaped breathable mesh fabric under the arms offers adequate ventilation and allows moisture to evaporate quickly. Smooth seams and seamless designs reduce rubbing and ensure maximum comfort. PURIR baby bodysuits can be worn alone or under other outfits.

materials.name: 黄铜
materials.description: 黄铜是以铜和锌为主要成分的铜合金，常用名称即黄铜。它呈黄至金色金属光泽，具有良好成形、切削、耐腐蚀和装饰性能；加入铅、锡、铝等元素可形成不同用途的特殊黄铜。常用于阀门、管件、紧固件、乐器、灯具、家具五金、饰品和需要金色外观的产品部件。
materials.cognitiveText: 黄铜在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 97–110 GPa。

cases.description: The Figura Sink Set is a kitchen tap made of environmentally friendly, lead-reduced brass. Available in 20 different finishes, it offers the perfect quality and texture for any kitchen. The tap features separate hot and cold water handles, while the spout can swivel 360 degrees and is able to take an optional extendable hose. It is manufactured using a drawing technique, with a special profile that has two flat sides and two semi-circle segments.

The core components of the SmallRig Follow Focus F60 are made of brass and new composite materials that enable precise fine adjustment of the lens focus during video recordings. The product has a modular design and is equipped with a removable palm rest that provides stability for hand-held shooting. The adjustment wheel is made of solid mahogany and features a ribbed surface to improve grip. With its dynamic damping system, the SmallRig Follow Focus F60 is suitable for lenses with different diameters.

The washbasins in the Liquid collection are characterised by their minimalist design and soft, curved shapes. They are suitable for the private sphere, but also for the hospitality industry or public spaces. The round basins made of white porcelain harmonise with robust brass fittings that have been reduced to the essentials, have a high-quality feel and are intuitive to use. The smooth surfaces and the absence of sharp edges also make the products easier to clean. “The reduced design language ensures a high recognition value, and the choice of durable material is also convincing,” was the jury’s verdict.

In keeping with classical design vocabulary, the rounded contours and brass detailing of this pendant luminaire create an elegant look that harmonises with the ambience of the dining table. The light beam is reflected onto the opalised top shade by the lower shade, thus producing glare-free lighting. The distance between the lampshades is adjustable. If they are closer together, the luminaire creates downward light while a greater distance produces more diffused light.

These bathroom fittings are part of a series that harmoniously combines bold architectural forms and pleasant to the touch, tactile textures. To ensure functionality and ergonomics, minimalist cylindrical elements have been embellished with impressively diamond-cut milling for a good grip. A carefully considered labelling makes it intuitive to find the direction of rotation for hot or cold water. The scratch-resistant fittings are made of high-quality brass, either hand-polished or brushed.

This gas hob was developed specially for the Asian market, with the focus placed on a clear, streamlined design idiom. A compact surface made of a glass-ceramic material is combined with high-end brass burners, which create an interesting visual accent against the otherwise dark colour scheme. The pan supports and the black rotary knob blend beautifully into the overall design concept. The knob can be operated safely and conveniently with just one hand.

Mahjong Tea combines two Chinese traditions in its design concept: loose tea is pressed into pre-measured mahjong tiles that are stored in characteristic wooden tea boxes. The stackable boxes are decorated with crafted elements and brass inlays; a band with illustrations protects their untreated surface. Organic materials emphasise the product’s character. Together, product and packaging form an aesthetic design object.

Made famous by jazz musicians like Charlie Parker and Stan Getz, the saxophone is one of the most multifaceted musical instruments. The design of the YDS-150 digital saxophone is modelled closely on the familiar shape and playing style of an acoustic soprano saxophone. It showcases the same length and also utilises the same key layout. Musicians can therefore start playing it immediately without having to get used to it first. The digital saxophone features a brass bell typical of familiar saxophones and inspires with an elegantly rounded shape that leads from the mouthpiece to the flared bell. With only two-thirds of the weight of a conventional saxophone, it rests well-balanced in the hands. At the very heart of this saxophone is a sophisticated digital concept. The YDS-150 enables perfect control of the volume ratios over 15 levels for daily practice. The loudspeaker unit and the brass bell are linked by an acoustic tube that features the Integrated Bell Acoustic System. This tube senses the player’s breath passing through the body and makes the instrument vibrate in response. The result is a natural instrument body resonance that feels just like playing an acoustic saxophone. Featuring saxophone voices such as the soprano, alto, tenor and baritone, as well as synthesiser voices, it allows players to perform a broad repertoire.

With its logo lettering, flashing brass accents and black faux leather throughout, the Marshall Monitor II A.N.C. takes its cue from the brand’s classic design. The battery life is up to 45 hours, and thick ear and head pads ensure good wearing comfort. Ambient noise is continuously localised, measured and eliminated via active noise cancellation, while 40-mm dynamic drivers deliver excellent sound.

The Solaris Collection is made from solid brass, and thanks to its soft contours is characterised by a comfortable handhold. Alongside the finely rounded edges of the narrow, flat switches, there are push switches harmoniously embedded in the switch plate, offering the user convenience and a particular tactile experience when activating the switch. The contrast between the colour of the brushed brass plate and the circular black buttons beautifully emphasises the contours of the switch. The collection is available in numerous designs; the plate can be individually engraved with words, symbols or pictograms.

The Marshall Emberton is an extremely compact Bluetooth speaker that fits in almost any pocket. The device, reminiscent of a guitar amplifier, is covered with a metal grille at the front and back and bears the brand’s lettering. A brass knob on the top adds another accent and underlines the value of the product. The minimalist design language is supported by the simple handling, which requires only a few operating elements.

The Full Moon tableware set comprises two bowls and three plates of different sizes, as well as a cup. Each individually handcrafted piece showcases its own distinctive appearance. The design combines the traditional Korean materials of Yuhgee (brassware) and Ott-chil (lacquer) in a creative manner. Both materials possess sterilizing effects so that they can maintain the freshness of food for longer. Moreover, they preserve the temperature and thus the flavour of food with long cooking times.

This three-piece table light consists of two inversely oriented, truncated cones which are pierced by a round rod, made of either brass or stainless steel. The rod is tiltable by 24 and the lampshade pivotable by 120 degrees, both individually adjustable. An energy-efficient LED provides glare-free illumination with 11 watts, a colour temperature of 2,700 kelvins and a luminous flux of 1,400 lumens. Switching and dimming is controlled by a flush-integrated metal switch in the base of the lamp. A memory function serves to save the last selected brightness setting.

The architectural design of the Bridge Collection switches is minimalist and pure. Their appearance is defined by the geometric proportions of their commutators whose shape resemble a seesaw or bridge. They unite design, ergonomics, simplicity and tradition. The switches are available in various high-quality material finishes. The base plate, for instance, comes in stainless steel, aluminium, Corian or brass. As the aluminium commutator is also available in different colours, this provides a wide range of combination options.

The cold water high-pressure cleaner HD 8 / 18-4 M is available in two versions: mobile with large wheels and as a stationary model for wall mounting. The machine is built to last and is thus designed for economical operation. This  is evidenced by the automatic pressure relief, the brass cylinder head, a four-pole, predominantly maintenance-free motor and an efficient filter at the  water inlet. The large control switch at the front is easy to reach, even during operation.

Storm System brings together various ceiling elements mounted in an installation ring, which is flush with the ceiling. Using the innovative “snap lock” technique, various fixtures are easily mounted into the ring. Users have a choice of 17 elements such as lighting, speakers, cameras, smoke detectors, ventilation systems, motion detectors and cable outputs. The entire range of fixtures has the same streamlined design and all elements are made of high-quality materials such as aluminium, brass, wood, glass, concrete or leather.

cases.productName: Kitchen Knives and Wooden Knife Block
cases.description: The W1 series comprises five versatile kitchen knives, housed in a robust wood knife block. The handles, manufactured from Acacia wood, and the asymmetric knife block express visual harmony and unity. Their softly rounded contours facilitate handling and highlight the high-alloy metal blade. Another unique and distinct feature is the brass rivets around three holes in the handle. The stainless knives are easy to clean and fully suitable for the use in commercial kitchen environments.

The L’OR Barista by JDE Peet’s allows espresso to be prepared easily and is designed to be used with two capsule sizes. In addition to single servings, two cups of espresso or a double espresso can also be brewed at the same time. The automatic capsule recognition system measures out the correct amount of water. The high-gloss black housing accentuates both the matt black dispensing area and the double nozzle with brass-finished accents. This interplay gives the espresso machine an elegant look.

The WA is a door handle with grips made of anodised aluminium and a body of refined brass. The extruded elements are characterised by precise lines, giving them a clear geometric appearance. Both the handle and the fittings can be selected in different finishes to permit individual combinations. The contrasts between the different materials, textures and colours adds excitement to the series, making it suitable for many interior styles.

The new Jägermeister Tap Machine – Mysterious Core has been designed to communicate the DNA of the premium liquor in the hospitality industry. The IoT-ready, compact appliance has a functionally designed body with a striking cooling rib structure. The tap made of solid brass is emphasised with green light below the spout, which also highlights the displayed drinking temperature of -18 degrees centigrade. A slim handle ensures comfortable handling.

materials.name: 瓷
materials.description: 瓷常用名称为瓷器或瓷质陶瓷，是以高岭土、长石、石英等原料成形并经高温烧结得到的致密陶瓷。它通常质地坚硬、耐磨、耐化学腐蚀并具有良好电绝缘性，但脆性较高。日用瓷、建筑瓷和工程瓷在配方与烧成制度上差异明显，常用于餐具、卫浴、绝缘件、饰面和精密陶瓷部件。
materials.cognitiveText: 瓷在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 67–150 GPa。

cases.description: The particularly lightweight Zenbook A14 laptop supports mobile users in urban environments. The rounded shape of the casing and the grey and beige colour scheme, which is inspired by pebbles, ensure pleasant handling and a natural look. Made from a magnesium-aluminium alloy with a ceramic finish, the surface is resistant to scratches and dirt. The device combines high battery performance with robust suitability for everyday use.

The ultra-slim, foldable casing of the Xiaomi Mix Fold 4 is both lightweight and robust. Its seamless design with glass, metal and fibreglass creates a pleasant feel and an elegant look. The quad-curved glass of the display blends harmoniously into the metal casing, while the back is made of Dragon Scale Fibre, a material composed of ceramic and aramid. Combined with sophisticated hinge technology, it increases shock resistance.

The expressive Metalcraft tile range provides scope for creating bathrooms and living spaces in a very individual style. The colour concept encompasses silver and steel tones as well as shades of brown and black with copper, brass and petrol-coloured highlights. Finished with the easy-to-clean CeramicPlus surface, the floor tiles are slip-resistant (R10) and available in four colours and three sizes. They can be combined with large-format wall tiles (40 × 120 cm) from the same range and matching skirting to create either harmony or contrast.

Inspired by the rawness of urban landscapes, the CementEra tiles, with their eye-catching cement aesthetic, embody minimalist elegance. Combining the characteristic texture of concrete with a handmade look, the tiles offer visual depth and sensory appeal. Available in four harmonious colours, they feature traditional marbling patterns and digital marble effects that give floors, work surfaces, walls and facades a calm and modern appearance. The large-format sizes of the tiles ensure a seamless design appearance.

The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

Six bold colours and a rounded silhouette reminiscent of a highlighter define the fresh aesthetic of the Vuse Go Reload Pen. This compact vaporiser heats e-liquids to release flavour and nicotine. With a robust build, carefully chosen materials and a replaceable pod system, it was designed as a sustainable alternative to disposable devices. Integrated ceramic heating technology ensures consistent flavour, and the device can be conveniently recharged via a universal USB-C port.

The Alina collection combines a linear and subtle stylistic language with functional properties that make it ideal for commercial use. Centrally placed embossment structures the surface and creates a focal point in the middle for the presentation of food. All the individual pieces of the tableware set are made from highly resilient hard porcelain and are not only stackable, but also dishwasher, oven and microwave safe, as well as thermal shock and edge chip-resistant for the intense rigours of the hospitality sector.

The Ohtake Basin and Bathtub range comprises a countertop washbasin and a freestanding soaking tub that are inspired by motifs from nature and Japanese culture. The flowing lines and delicate edges of the fine ceramic washbasin bear a resemblance to the elegant shape of the calla lily. The Stonex tub, with its gentle forms and curved contours, is reminiscent of a Japanese Ofuro. Accordingly, this soaking tub is primarily intended for relaxation rather than cleaning.

The floor-standing Bella Smart toilet is characterised by flowing lines that are gently contrasted by the precise lid edge. The Magic Bubble technology creates a dense layer of foam to reduce odours and splashing water, while the dual-clean flush requires less water and efficiently clears the entire bowl, even at low water pressure. Thanks to a ceramic heating tube, the water is instantly heated to a pre-set temperature as soon as the shower function is activated.

Panio features all the characteristics of a porcelain tableware set specifically designed for use in the hospitality industry. It is distinguished by a radial relief based on parametric, fractal geometric patterns. Its tactile, visually appealing surface discreetly highlights the food presented without eclipsing it. With its versatile range, the collection meets all typical gastronomy requirements. All the pieces are dishwasher safe, impact resistant and the thickness of the material ensures that they can withstand intense use.

Tone is an organically shaped, glazed collection of ceramics created for professional use. The gently curved form was inspired by the appearance of scallops, the sea and the structure of textiles. The collection features three harmonising reactive glazes: Sahara, Blush and Adelfa. Made from a once-fired, virtually pore-free premium vitrified material, Tone is durable and energy efficient in manufacture. All the pieces are nestable, functional in their dimensions and crafted for fine dining.

This cookware set performs several functions with just three items. The Glasslock Chef Topf consists of a pot, a lid and a small stove, and can be used to prepare meals as well as serve them at the table. The lid also functions as a frying pan or can be used as a plate. A small air hole allows steam to escape during cooking, thus preventing contents from boiling over. Made from aluminium with a ceramic coating, the set can be used with a range of different heat sources, from electric hobs to air fryers.

The Unwasted tile collection consists of repurposed waste materials such as eggshells, straw residues, reclaimed glass and ceramic waste, thus creating a closed resource cycle. This blend of different materials also creates variously textured surfaces and unique patterns during production, giving the tiles a natural look and feel. At the same time, the waste-based mixture reduces energy consumption as the tiles can be fired at a lower temperature.

As far back as 2000 BC, tiles were being used throughout the Orient. Ornamental motifs decorated the walls and floors of buildings. Mostly the motifs were similar to those seen on oriental carpets. Even today, in some parts of the world, tiles are still baked in the same way that they have been for thousands of years. KuQua ceramic tiles build on the traditional significance of tiles and in doing so represent a symbiosis of ancient workmanship and contemporary design. One is struck above all by the three-dimensional impression of these tiles. This is mainly due to the meeting of two opposites. The ornaments shown on the tiles were developed on a computer and are infinitely repeatable thus leaving nothing to chance. The KuQua series, which comes in three options, is in fact the result of blending spherical and cubic forms and follows a strict geometrical concept. The flower-like ornament, together with the high-gloss coloured glaze, creates a noticeable contrast to the matt, smoke-black appearance of the surface of the ceramic tiles. KuQua tiles are handmade and fired at 1,000°C in an electric kiln. After screen printing, they are fired a second time then immersed in sawdust. Low fired ceramic tiles are very good at storing and regulating warmth and moisture, then releasing both. As a result, they have a positive effect on a room’s environment.

The LG Room & Style monitor was designed for home office use and entertainment. It supports streaming apps and can be used for work, with or without a PC. The device uses a tray as a stand, which also serves to store items, such as the remote control. Also suitable for mounting on a wall or in a caravan, this user-friendly monitor is easy to assemble and disassemble.

The Restroom Dresser Premium Series was developed to transform the home bathroom into an oasis of well-being. Soft lighting, which switches on automatically using a motion sensor, and flowing shapes create a harmonious ambience. Touchless faucet with automatic on/off functions (wall mounted type) and ceramic-glaze basins increase user comfort. The marbled wall panel not only serves as splash protection, but also lends elegance to the ensemble.

The design of the Portico urinal is inspired by decorative elements of traditional Italian courtyard facades. The urinal is made of a rectangular ceramic block with a stylised, gently curved bowl with raised edges at its centre. The geometry of the bowl has been carefully optimised to prevent urine splashes. The battery of the sensor-controlled flush can be replaced in a few simple steps, making maintenance easier. Portico is available in classic white as well as in an anthracite-coloured version.

The VGR-001 electric hair clipper is characterised by a stepless speed control system with an eye-catching digital speed display. With up to 9,000 rpm, it offers powerful performance for various requirements. Fixed DLC blades with ceramic moving blades ensure strength and durability. The device has a Type-C charging port and a docking station with up to 300 minutes of battery life. Other features include an LED light and ten different comb sizes.

The design of the ceramic basin Cobble is inspired by natural lines, expressed in a gentle shaping that is reminiscent of the appearance of a leaf. The 700 mm wide basin is available in various subtle colours and coated with a skin-friendly and at the same time resistant pearl glaze. Thanks to the smooth surface, it is resistant to water stains, limescale deposits and bacteria. This facilitates cleaning and reduces the consumption of environmentally harmful cleaning agents.

PURE VORTEX is based on an innovative vortex flushing system that opens up new possibilities in the design of sanitary ceramics. The water outlet at the front of the toilet, which is not visible at first glance, allows for a smooth surface without the traditional flushing rim. This makes the interior particularly easy to clean. Thanks to the newly developed technology, the flushing process is not only exceptionally quiet but also environmentally friendly, as only 4.5 litres of water are required for a complete flush.

materials.name: 钛金属（纯钛）
materials.description: 钛金属（纯钛）常用名称为纯钛或钛金属，通常指工业纯钛而非加入大量合金元素的钛合金。它呈银灰色，密度低于钢，具有良好耐腐蚀性、生物相容性和一定成形焊接能力；不同纯钛等级的强度差异明显。常用于化工设备、医疗器械、换热器、建筑饰面和轻量化产品。
materials.cognitiveText: 钛金属（纯钛）在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 102–120.2 GPa。

cases.description: Heirloom Vacuum Flask-Mini is a stewed teapot that doesn’t produce odor. The mouth and body are inspired by Oriental aesthetics. In order not to produce odor at high temperature and store water more hygienically, its inner liner is made of pure titanium and the spout is made of stainless steel. To reduce heat loss, the inner liner thickness is only 0.2 mm with a processed mirror surface. Designed by Dong Wu of Shenzhen Yiyuan Technology Co., Ltd.

materials.name: 铜
materials.description: 铜常用名称为铜，较高纯度的工业铜常称紫铜或纯铜。它具有优良的导电、导热、延展和耐腐蚀性能，表面会随环境形成由红褐到绿色的氧化或碱式碳酸盐层。铜常用于电线、电路、换热器、管材、厨具、建筑饰面和工艺品，也是黄铜、青铜等合金的主要基体。
materials.cognitiveText: 铜在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 120–129.8 GPa。

cases.description: The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

The design concept for the Polar basin mixer series is based on classic aesthetics integrating rectangles and circles as the basic elements. Slim, cylindrical bodies are complemented by clearly contoured spouts and dials. The coherent fusion of these elements results in a minimalist design language that radiates independence and elegance. Various models allow for surface or wall mounting. Manufactured from fully recyclable copper casting, Polar basin mixers make an important contribution to resource conservation.

The basin mixers in the GRACE Series combine oval and rectangular contours with softly rounded edges and transitions. The slim, cylindrical body and elliptical spout merge to form a harmonious unit. Single-lever and two-handle models are available in three heights and four colours. Made of lead-free copper, the faucets are particularly corrosion-resistant thanks to a four-layer coating. The quiet aerator with an adjustable spray angle, in combination with a cold start valve core, reduces water and energy consumption.

The Thermal Mug is a versatile container for hot and cold beverages that combines functionality with a stylish exterior. Made from high-quality stainless steel complemented by copper insulation and vacuum sealing, it maintains drinks at the desired temperature for a long time. The durable, dishwasher-proof powder coating, which is available in five colours, gives the mug a modern appearance. An anti-slip silicone base ensures stability and protects surfaces when the mug is set down.

The effective fin structure of the Mythril Radiators increases their contact surface with the air by 15 per cent, thereby improving heat exchange efficiency. To optimise the heat conduction further, the body is made entirely of copper. These two-tone accessories thus ensure high performance and powerful cooling temperatures, even at full utilisation of the latest GPUs and CPUs. Depending on its positioning, the device appears black or silver.

The Infinity New Reference Subwoofers, available in 10" and 12" versions, offer configuration flexibility through SSI and allow selection of impedance, thus ensuring compatibility with almost any audio system. These subwoofers generate the characteristic deep Infinity bass in closed or vented enclosures. Design features include a radially textured membrane, a centrally placed, copper-coloured Infinity Mobius logo and a high-gloss trim ring that conceals the mounting elements, characterising their elegant appearance.

The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

The One HomeCafe is designed to use capsules to prepare individual cups of coffee and tea. The slim appliance has a streamlined design; copper-coloured elements ensure its high-quality appearance. The slight tilt of the body also gives the appliance an interesting look. For improved handling, the coffee and tea maker does not have its own tank but can be connected directly to a water conditioner.

With its latest streaming multiprocessors and its fast GDDR6X memory, this graphics card is designed for maximum performance. It is already overclocked at the factory but offers additional headroom for overclocking, thanks to advanced cooling with an 11-blade fan, aluminium fin heat sinks and eight copper heat pipes. A special feature is the holographic finish inspired by aurora borealis. Additional RGB lighting, which can be synchronised, is situated at the top and back.

The K-fee One capsule coffee machine is characterised by an elegant design. High-gloss and matt black are paired with copper, while a wave design in the upper area sets further visual accents. Illuminated buttons allow easy operation and programmable cup fill volumes ensure convenience in use. The water tank holds 0.8 litres and can be removed for filling. The capsule machine is particularly compact with a width of just 11.3 cm.

The built-in oven EEB 6550.8JX combines a black glass front with a brilliant copper handle bar, which gives the oven a stylish impression. By electronic operation via sensors behind glass, baking and roasting programmes can be easily selected. Ökotherm catalytic technology and the triple-glazed door contribute to the contemporary and energy-saving functionality of the oven.

The ROG Maximus V Formula (M5F) motherboard is equipped with both air and water cooling. The cooling parts have been enhanced with additional heat-dissipating layers, and the radial groove design is capable of efficiently diverting heat under full load as well. Heat dissipation technology components are special water channels and heat pipes made of 100 per cent copper. Gaming PCs are thus provided with optimal cooling and also extensive overclocking options.

The heat pump outdoor unit combines its very high efficiency with a silent ­operation. The wide slats on the front ensure effective aerodynamics and low energy consumption. Their dark colour makes the fan nearly invisible in the background, lending the device a modern, non-technical appearance. The materials used: steel, copper, aluminium and ­unpainted plastics, are all recyclable.

The lever and outlet of this washbasin mixer are dominated by hollow oval shapes that lend the Ma ya its characteristic appearance. Its surface showcases two colours to underline its sophisticated appearance: The high-contrast combination of matte black and glossy copper gives the mixer an elegant, yet simultaneously modern appeal. Thanks to the distinctive opening, the lever can be easily grasped, enabling comfortable water and temperature adjustments.

Optimal temperature, ideal humidity levels and attention to details are key traits of the Smeg wine coolers for domestic wine storage. They were developed in co-operation with sommeliers and manufactured entirely in Italy. The cooling cabinets are available with stainless steel surfaces as well as in a variant with glass combined with stainless steel or copper elements. They feature a user-friendly touch display on the glass door, whereby temperature, humidity and lighting can be adjusted without the need to open the door.

With its asymmetrical contours, this LED pendant luminaire, which creates a dynamic lighting situation, looks different depending on the viewing angle. The lamp shade is available in any of the monochrome RAL colours or as a two-tone version with different inner and outer colours. It can also be manufactured with a gold, silver or bronze edging. Krivda furthermore provides good illumination at low energy consumption levels.

In order to demonstrate the high standards of craftsmanship of the manufacturer, which has existed since 1917, this copper edition was developed for the 100th anniversary. Copper enables a particularly fast and thus energy-efficient heating. The PFOA-free stainless steel coating increases both durability and food safety while a precisely milled pattern in the bottom of the cookware lets the copper shine through in a decorative way.

This cheese fondue set takes up the current copper trend but also uses the functional properties of the heat conducting material. The fondue pan, which comes in a retro-look, distributes heat evenly so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. Thanks to this configuration, the heat is effectively directed upwards, so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. In combination with the traditional look of the copper, the high-gloss polished stainless steel handle forms a strong contrast. Moreover, the base, which is made of concrete and stainless steel, lends the set both a stable and decorative appearance.

The Suit mixer tap collection is characterised by the combination of soft lines with strikingly angular components, which creates an exciting contrast of form. The control levers for washbasin, shower and bathtub are ergonomically shaped and, thanks to the different heights, the mixer taps can be easily matched to the respective ceramic products. There is a choice of tarnish- and corrosion-resistant coatings in chrome, black, copper or gold for customised bathroom design.

With their carbon fibre fabric on the face of each ear cup – enclosed in a glossy housing with a copper ring – the 900 Legacy look high-quality and original in design. The ear cushions are made of memory foam. They reliably keep ambient noise away from the user through digital hybrid technology, with touch controls ensuring intuitive operation. The headphones are foldable and come with a shockproof, waterproof case.
