cases.description: Rings are pieces of jewellery with great symbolic meaning. The ring, made of silver plated with gold, contains the Chinese character for heart, which is the focal point of this design. It can be worn on its own or be complemented by one of the other rings made of silver plated with platinum. These other rings also include characters that can be combined with the root word for heart and so create another meaning. In this way, the delicate items of jewellery are carriers of a message.

materials.name: 铸铁
materials.description: 铸铁是含碳量较高、主要通过铸造成形的铁碳合金，常用名称即铸铁。灰铸铁、球墨铸铁、白口铸铁等类型因石墨形态和组织不同，在减振、强度、耐磨和韧性上差异明显。铸铁流动性好、成本相对低，常用于机床底座、发动机部件、管件、炉具、锅具和厚壁结构件。
materials.cognitiveText: 铸铁在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 180–180 GPa。

cases.description: Thanks to precise computer-controlled machining, the STUR Cast-Iron Pan 32 cm is lighter than traditional cast-iron skillets without compromising on even heat distribution or durability. The large frying surface, high walls and ergonomic handles ensure it is convenient to use. The frying pan features no artificial, environmentally harmful coatings but has natural non-stick properties and is suited to all stove tops as well as ovens and grills.

The Electric Fondue Set Pro combines traditional fondue culture with the functionality and simplicity of an electric set. A heating element with a safety thermostat maintains temperatures in the range of 50 to 190 degrees Celsius to suit cheese, meat, chocolate and bouillon fondues alike. The device, made of cast iron and oak, has a splash guard with notches for the fondue forks and is largely free of plastics. Thanks to its long mains cable, it can be used flexibly.

AGA ERA 110i is a premium-class multifunctional cooker. Black glass and high-quality chrome elements give it a minimalist aesthetic, which is reflected in the geometric design. The equipment includes an induction hob and a large hotplate on the top, as well as a convection oven and two cast-iron radiant ovens, each concealed behind a separate door. Operation is via a generously dimensioned touch control surface with integrated LED displays and a character display.

The IoT-ready appliances of the oven range are operated with gas and equipped with a cooktop made of cast iron. The optimised layout has five burners including a grill plate placed in the centre. Convenient use is, among other things, achieved by the wide window and the inclined control panel, which also make for a high-quality appearance. Further details are the LG InstaView technology and the interior illuminated in blue, which allows the user to keep an eye on the food without opening the oven door.

Three gas burners upraising from the smooth, black vitroceramic surface and the cast iron, ring-shaped pan holders characterise the distinctive appearance of this one metre wide hob. The high efficiency of the three burners (2 x 5 kW, 1 x 4.3 kW) allows for professional use. It is operated by a touch control panel. The hob is easy to clean due to the smooth surface and the upraised burners.

Precisely formed design details, such as the metallic control knobs and the cast iron fixings, visualise a high excellence standard and a quality that can be sensuously perceived. The burner arrangement ensures that large cookware can be used. There is a 4 kW dual-circuit wok burner in the centre.

The Peloton Bootcamp Weights are an ergonomically shaped pair of cast iron dumbbells with polyurethane coated ends. They are characterised by a clear, reduced design and stand out due to their striking transition from square weight plates to circular handle. Whenever and wherever you are, they offer the opportunity for strength and ­endurance training.

This gas hob visualises a high quality standard: metallic control knobs and cast iron fixings demonstrate a quality that is sensuously tangible. The energy efficient burners and the dishwasher safe pan supports complement the hob panel, which can either be mounted flush or integrated into the work surface in a classical, additive fashion.

The Stiga Villa 520 compact ride-on lawn mower combines sophisticated mowing technology with a pleasant driving experience. Its cast-iron frame and housing are made in one piece, assuring its stability. The front-mounted mowing head allows a comprehensive view of the working area while simultaneously providing good cutting results, even under bushes and benches. Cutting height adjustment can be easily set from the driver’s seat. Additional accessories for autumn and winter operation allow the machine to be converted for sweeping and snow-clearing functions.

The generous burner arrangement and the clear division into different cooking zones allow professional cooking with large cookware. The stainless steel, which is used for the hob, and the cast iron pan supports along with the energy efficient burners underline the high quality of the hob.

The elegant appearance of this gas hob is due to a flat, stainless steel surface of minimalist design. The cooking zone is divided into two sections: four gas burners are located equally spaced on the right side, while the particularly powerful, triple-flame burner on the left provides room for very big cooking utensils. The cast iron trivets are sturdy and form a contrast to the smooth, stainless steel surface.

This gas hob with a large cooktop has a flat, enamelled surface which is durable and easy to clean. The cast iron, asymmetrically designed pot supports are so designed that they form together one large cooking surface, which extends over the whole cooktop, allowing the pots to be easily shifted. A powerful wok burner is located at the front, thus easing the use of heavy pots. Thanks to ergonomic pot supports and self-ignition, one-handed operation is possible.

The multifunctional kitchen machine Kenwood Cooking Chef is made of anthracite-coloured cast aluminium. This not only ensures durability and stability, but also gives the device a high-quality look and feel. Black high-gloss components replace the familiar chrome applications. The features include an adjustable touch display, numerous presets and recipes, an integrated set of scales and a precise induction cooking system. Cloud connectivity and an app ensure seamless ease of use.

The cast-iron wood-burning stoves of the Jøtul F 170 series have a roughly cylindrical shape that widens gently towards the centre. Integrated into the elegantly rounded front is a large glass door that provides a 156-degree view of the fire. A portion of the stoves’ surface texture is reminiscent of woodchip wallpaper, creating a link to the traditional craftsmanship of cast iron. The Jøtul F 170 series uses intelligent Zensoric technology to optimise firewood consumption and increase energy efficiency.

The Casarte C7 Smart Gas Stove combines the colour piano black with decorative stripes in champagne gold on the main surface, giving rise to a fascinating appearance. This impression is enhanced by the differentiated design of the cast-iron support frames, which also enable energy-efficient use. Discreet control elements and simplified cleaning options were included in the design and emphasise strong practical value.

This large gas hob fascinates with a functional concept defined by distinctive lines and the use of selected materials. For example, a shiny glass surface with cohesive control elements is combined with pot rests made of durable cast iron. In addition to white, shiny numerals on the glass surface, the rotary knobs with a luminous ring are a special feature. It appears when the cooktop is turned on, thus facilitating safe use.

The hob series of the Rinnai G line consists of three modules that can be arranged freely: a glass ceramic hob and two hobs with pan supports made of high-quality cast iron. Digital function displays ensure user-friendly operation. Thanks to the flat installation height and elegant appearance of the individual elements, the series is also suitable for small worktops and open kitchens.

This gas hob combines an elegant and puristic design with state-of-the-art technology. The appearance is characterised by the cast-iron gas grids and black burners on the dark-enamelled stainless-steel hob. In terms of functionality, the hob integrates a very powerful 5 kW double-crown burner and also innovative Preci-Flame technology. This technology allows a selection of nine preprogrammed heat levels, each of which ensures a precise and constant temperature setting.

The Voronoi cast iron grating is suitable for use with the manufacturer’s drainage systems in both horticulture and landscape gardening. The seemingly random arrangement of geometric shapes recalls the markings of a giraffe or cracks in dry soil. With this organic motif, the grating easily blends into mineral and planted settings. It is made of a robust iron-carbon alloy and thus offers good corrosion resistance. A special coating offers protection against the weather.

This cast-iron cookware series was especially designed for outdoor use and is particularly suitable for outdoor gas stoves and fireplaces. The robust pots, lids and pans are each cast in one piece without the need for welding. Thanks to their bulbous contours, the pots feature a large base for effective heat conduction. The wide handle openings facilitate easy handling, while the different lids fit flexibly on all pots.

materials.name: 316/316L不锈钢
materials.description: 316/316L不锈钢常用名称为316不锈钢和低碳316L不锈钢，是含铬、镍、钼的奥氏体不锈钢。钼能提高耐点蚀和耐氯化物腐蚀能力，316L因碳含量较低，更适合焊接后仍需保持耐蚀性的构件。它常用于医疗器械、食品设备、海洋附件、紧固件及精密产品外壳。
materials.cognitiveText: 316/316L不锈钢在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 193–200 GPa。

cases.description: Singly ONE is a robust charging station designed for both private and commercial use. Its elegant, timeless stainless steel case blends seamlessly into any environment. An integrated display presents all key information at a glance – from charging power to status notifications. Maximum safety is ensured by the built-in residual current circuit breaker, which reliably protects both user and vehicle in the event of a fault. Replaceable components simplify maintenance and help extend the unit’s service life.

The Harman Kardon sound system in the Volvo XC90 combines high-quality audio technology with a sophisticated design. The front door grilles are made of etched stainless steel, coated in matt-black and have a laser-engraved logo. Seamlessly integrated into the interior, the grilles also house the seat adjustment controls, thus combining functionality and aesthetics. The central speaker cover runs behind the dashboard, with precisely positioned hole patterns ensuring a harmonious appearance.

NWP500 is a heating pump water heater for the centralised supply of residential buildings. By utilising ambient air, the system works much more energy-efficiently than conventional electric water heaters and also reduces CO₂ emissions. The well-thought-out arrangement of the connections enables space-saving and simple installation. It is operated via an ergonomically positioned touchscreen display or a clearly organised app. The inner container is made of corrosion-resistant stainless steel and the thermal insulation is made of climate-friendly HFO foam.

The RICHARTZ KEY TOOLS compact series is the particularly handy version of the original RICHARTZ KEY TOOLS and combine up to 17 functions in a minimal space. Made from matt-finished stainless steel, these multi-tools impress with their precise finish and clearly recognisable, embossed functional surfaces. Whether as a shopping aid (shop), DIY tool (work) or versatile all-rounder (13+), each version offers well-thought-out solutions for everyday life, the household and hobbies. It is compact, robust and always ready for use.

The timeless design of Tangente 2date is offset by a contemporary dual date display. A ring date around the edge of the dial keeps the entire month in view, while a small window highlights the current date in red. A finely balanced contrast between the polished stainless steel case and black leather strap adds to the visual appeal of this handcrafted timepiece. The manually wound movement evokes a sense of nostalgia, while the sapphire crystal glass back offers a view of the mechanical calibre inside.

The SmartAppGuided Spiral Epilation Tweezer Pen 5-in-1 uses a precision stainless steel coil to safely remove hair at the root for long-lastingly smooth skin. It is designed to minimise skin irritation and can be used on both small and large facial areas such as the chin, upper lip, cheeks, forehead and eyebrows. Thanks to its compact, slightly tapered shape, the pen is suitable for easy, intuitive and precise operation. An app is also available to guide the user through the application.

The EDC29 is a thin tactical torch with a run time of over 60 hours that combines outstanding light output, intelligent functions and a robust design. It has a light output of 6,500 lumens, a range of up to 400 metres and a dual LED system with 18 cores for different types of light, such as spotlighting or floodlighting. A light shield mode provides protection, while randomly changing light frequencies can create a dizzying effect. The robust construction of stainless steel and carbon fibre weighs just 160 grams and fits securely in the hand.

The Perun 3 Mini is a 63 mm short, 85-gram torch for a wide range of applications, such as outdoor use, signalling and emergencies. It delivers white and red light with an output of up to 1,300 lumens. The magnetic tailcap allows hands-free use, while the stainless steel knob and a removable clip ensure easy operation and effortless portability. With the included headband, the Perun 3 Mini becomes a headlamp. The stepless brightness control and the long standby time increase safety.

The Thermal Mug is a versatile container for hot and cold beverages that combines functionality with a stylish exterior. Made from high-quality stainless steel complemented by copper insulation and vacuum sealing, it maintains drinks at the desired temperature for a long time. The durable, dishwasher-proof powder coating, which is available in five colours, gives the mug a modern appearance. An anti-slip silicone base ensures stability and protects surfaces when the mug is set down.

The Gibraltar lounge furniture creates a cosy, welcoming ambience. The aesthetics of the lines are characterised by the delicate lightness of the thin, round tube profiles made of stainless steel, which in their double execution ensure robust stability. The opulent design of the high-quality seat and back cushions creates an appealing contrast. The open strapping on the backrest guarantees a high level of seating comfort, while the modular design offers great flexibility with many combination options for the individual elements.

The Elegant Scenery bathroom cabinet set includes two washbasins with a separate cover, as well as a mirror with touch-sensitive lighting. The stacked and seemingly interlocking ensemble of individual elements gives the arrangement an architectural aesthetic that is visually accentuated by the combination of multilayer solid wood, natural stone, stainless steel and Corian, each with its own colour scheme. A drawer with a clearly structured interior allows for the organised storage of cosmetics and care utensils.

WMF Element One, a sparkling water maker made of high-quality stainless steel, is characterised by its ease of use: the knurled control knob on the top precisely regulates the degree of carbonation, adapting it to the user’s taste preferences. Preparation is as easy as pressing a button. An elegant water cylinder and soft curves characterise the design of the compact device, which, thanks to its slim silhouette, requires little space on the work surface.

The development of this tableware concept for the Economy Class of Etihad Airways was focused on sustainability and an enhanced passenger experience. The reusable tableware is made entirely from recycled plastic and is part of a closed-loop recycling system. At the end of their life cycle, the parts are collected, washed, ground and reused to create new products. Complementing the system is cutlery made from stainless steel and pressed paper, as well as paper cups and bamboo stirrers.

The Office Desktop Giant 3.0 thermal drinking bottle combines functional details with a gracefully contoured stylistic idiom and visually striking pastel pink as the primary colour. A push-button spout, a removable filter insert and other well-thought-out details make it convenient for everyday use. The bottom section of the container is gently conically tapered, making it easy to hold. Interchangeable decorative elements allow users to personalise their bottle. High-quality materials such as Tritan, 316L stainless steel and silicone ensure safe, long-term use.

Conum for One is a mug with a filter that enables effortless preparation of loose-leaf tea directly in the mug. The fine-mesh stainless steel filter allows the flavours to unfold fully. Afterwards, the lid doubles as a convenient holder for the filter. Made from heat-resistant borosilicate glass, the mug is neutral in odour and taste as well as dishwasher-proof. The mug’s exceptional resistance to temperature fluctuations makes it extremely durable – ideal for daily use, whether in the home or in the office.

With its elegant stainless steel finish and integrated MoodLight, the Liebherr French Door fridge-freezer is a high-quality addition to any modern kitchen. The compact design is characterised by flush-fitting doors and distinctive handle recesses. The flexible interior offers various temperature zones, including a VarioTempZone that can be used as a refrigeration or freezer compartment. The innovative sealing system of the appliance doors, which can be opened independently of each other, ensures good energy efficiency.

The TANGO XP bean-to-cup coffee machine is designed for professional use and is characterised by its robust construction. Three bean containers, a double brewing group and a manual steam element offer a wide range of preparation options. Stainless steel surfaces in a matt and glossy finish complement the black control panel with full-touch display, which allows the selection of recipes and the control of the grind setting as well as the brewing temperature. Flowing transitions and the slightly inclined front ensure a bold appearance.

Improvisational cooking can produce excellent cuisine, but compromises should never be made when it comes to choice of knife. Blunt blades have driven many an amateur cook crazy, and professional chefs won’t even put on their aprons unless their knives are precision-sharpened. That’s why the Kuhn Rikon Black Coated Knives Series is such an exciting proposition. The elegant black blades are seamlessly connected to the handle, creating a harmonious, aesthetic overall appearance. It also features perfectly balanced weight and an ergonomic shape for a positive tactile experience. Six knives ensure that the right blade for different food items is always to hand, and a pair of household scissors completes the functional set. A matching magnetic knife block reflects the designers’ intent to create a product that looks good in the kitchen setting. The knives nestle almost flush against the block, where they are transformed into a stylish eye-catcher. A non-slip chopping board with a juice groove completes the convenient and consistently designed set. The purist appearance of the knives is the ultimate outcome of a lengthy test phase. Finding the perfect shape for the handle and the exact blade angle for precise cutting results are also aspects that the designers intensively considered. “Achieving the perfect balance between the blade and handle was crucial. We spent a great deal of time refining the length and weight of each aspect to maintain an elegant, streamlined design while optimising function,” they commented. Choice of materials was also decisive to functional excellence. The knives are made from Japanese stainless steel, which is renowned for its hardness, sharpness and durability. A non-stick coating on the blades further enhances cutting performance and the cooking experience. “The Kuhn Rikon Black Coated Knives Series stands out for its exceptional quality and captivating aesthetics,” was the jury’s verdict. “Every detail is precision manufactured and ergonomically designed. In combination, the colours and design make an elegant and sophisticated statement that reflects the first-class choice of materials.”

Luxe Café Premier is a 3-in-1 coffee machine for preparing espresso, cold brew drinks and filter coffee. It features a conical grinder with 25 grind settings and integrated scales. It is operated via precise buttons, control dials and an easy-to-read, clearly structured display. The housing, made of stainless steel and matt black plastic, is functionally designed and characterised by the harmonious combination of flat surfaces, clear lines and rounded edges.

The Liebherr Side-by-Side is a fridge-freezer combination with a wine temperature control compartment. This offers separate temperature zones for white and red wine, humidity control and adjustable wooden shelves. The wine is also protected from vibrations and UV rays. The appearance is characterised by BlackSteel or SmartSteel – a specially polished and sealed stainless steel. This material is also used on the inner door, inner rear wall and decorative strips. The refrigerator door closes softly and quietly.

materials.name: 不锈钢
materials.description: 不锈钢常用名称为不锈钢或耐蚀钢，是以铁为基体、含有足够铬并可加入镍、钼等元素的合金体系。铬在表面形成钝化膜，使其具有较好的耐腐蚀和清洁维护性能。奥氏体、铁素体、马氏体等类别在强度、磁性和加工性上不同，常用于厨具、建筑、医疗、交通及产品外壳。
materials.cognitiveText: 不锈钢在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 200–220 GPa。

The combi-steamer Convotherm mini pro was developed for small professional kitchens with high capacity utilisation. AI-supported functions such as optical food recognition, sensor-based cooking processes and a self-dosing cleaning system minimise the operating effort. The stainless steel and glass housing is hygienic and robust. The operating elements are clearly structured; only the antibacterial handle needs to be fully grasped by hand. The unobtrusive form, with its flush installation option, fits well into various room concepts.

materials.name: 碳纤维
materials.description: 碳纤维常用简称为碳纤，是含碳量很高的细丝状材料，通常由聚丙烯腈等前驱体经稳定化和碳化制成。它具有低密度、高比强度、高比模量和明显方向性，多与环氧等树脂组合成复合材料。常用于航空航天、运动器材、自行车、汽车部件、机器人和高端产品外壳。
materials.cognitiveText: 碳纤维在“弹性模量”尺度中的参数区间为 220–400 GPa。

cases.description: The A80 keyboard was created for high-end gamers and tech enthusiasts, delivering mechanical precision in combination with a dynamic appearance. The CNC-machined metal case references sports car aesthetics while the LED light strip creates customisable, futuristic lighting effects. A palm rest is set at an ergonomic angle to support the hand and lower arm during extended gaming sessions. This greater angle also results in faster keyboard reaction times. The forged carbon surface of the case is resistant to dirt and extremely durable.

The lightweight TravelMate P6 14 AI laptop is designed as a companion for mobile working. It combines a powerful NPU with over 45 TOPS for local AI applications with a robust casing made of carbon fibre and magnesium alloy. The device is optimised for hybrid working environments and features a triple microphone and numerous functions that simplify the workflow. PCR materials and an energy-efficient construction ensure sustainability.

The Mountaineering Exoskeleton combines electric assistance technology with intelligent kinematics to reduce the physical strain of climbing. The adaptive construction with an anti-slip system ensures stability on rough terrain. Flexible sizing and quick donning and removal make it suitable for a range of users. Lightweight carbon fibre and efficient energy management optimise wearability and duration of use. Intelligent human-machine interaction synchronises movements and supports the natural gait.

The EDC29 is a thin tactical torch with a run time of over 60 hours that combines outstanding light output, intelligent functions and a robust design. It has a light output of 6,500 lumens, a range of up to 400 metres and a dual LED system with 18 cores for different types of light, such as spotlighting or floodlighting. A light shield mode provides protection, while randomly changing light frequencies can create a dizzying effect. The robust construction of stainless steel and carbon fibre weighs just 160 grams and fits securely in the hand.

The Amflow PL is an ultra-light electric mountain bike. Weighing just over 2 kg, its carbon frame ensures agility and an effortless riding experience. The bike features internal cable routing, a short front fork for more stability when cornering and a four-link structure for improved pedalling feedback. The DJI Avinox drive offers high performance with a compact design and is integrated inconspicuously into the frame. Despite the electric components, the Amflow PL resembles a classic mountain bike.

TreeRoot Quick Lock Travel Tripod (R141K-320P) is a versatile travel tripod that offers excellent stability. Made from an aluminium alloy and high-modulus carbon fibre, it combines strength with lightweight construction. The Reuleaux hybrid-shaped leg tube enhances torsional rigidity and handling. A user-friendly locking mechanism allows for set-up within seconds, while the quick-release centre column enables tool-free removal for instant transitioning to low-angle shooting.

As a modern redesign of the iconic boom box of the 1980s, the iP4 audio system combines yesterday’s look with today’s technology. Beneath the rubberised surface, the device features specially designed carbon fibre woofers, a highly efficient class-D amplifier, and digital sound processing developed and licensed by SRS Labs. Additional features include a magnetically attached remote control, a five-band graphic equaliser, and an output-level indicator.

The LED panels of the AOTO SW Series combine a modern look with advanced technology for large stages. The panels feature a robust, high-strength framework made of carbon fibre and an aluminium alloy, making them weigh less than 19 kg/m². A pronounced curvature and precise 90-degree angles allow for visually creative presentations. Thanks to practical mechanical features such as magnetic modules, quick-release fasteners, ejection systems and ergonomic handles, efficient installation and easy maintenance are achieved.

Matching the ambience of a loft living space, this kitchen provides cabinet modules that are particularly suited for the presentation of decorative items. The Loft kitchen is based on a stringent design concept favouring the use of high quality materials such as carbon, stainless steel, veneer and glass. Its striking contour is determined by a segment-shaped structure. The geometric proportions emphasise the appeal of the cabinet elements. The kitchen island includes a hidden cupboard, which can be accessed from two sides. It features an electromechanical drive for automatic opening.

Thanks to its innovative construction with four joints, the Orca garden shears optimise power transmission compared to conventional shears by approximately 50 per cent. The four main components, made of high-quality, carbon fibre-reinforced polyamide, minimise weight and springiness. Despite their slim design, the shears achieve a stability and rigidity that matches that of professional aluminium shears. Both blades can be removed for sharpening or replacement. Orca includes a hand guard and is available in two sizes.

The PurMop BLACK C1 carbon fibre mop system was developed for cleaning cleanrooms. It fulfils the strictest hygiene requirements and impresses with its user-friendliness, ergonomics and efficiency. The system has a non-contact mechanism for picking up and dropping the mops. Its low weight of just 650 grams and flexibly adjustable length facilitate ergonomic use - even overhead. The matt black colour and the strikingly patterned handle give PurMop BLACK C1 a slightly futuristic look. The matching mops are made entirely from recycled material.

The Ultra High Resolution Spectral 3D Microscopy Scanning Measurement System is characterised by high precision, resolution and scanning speed. It represents an efficient quality inspection solution for high-tech industries. The device has an ultra-fine light point that captures the smallest details while simultaneously offering a wide range with ultra-high resolution. It achieves an image processing speed of up to 15.4 billion pixels per second and scans 3D contours at a sampling rate of 7 kHz in full-screen mode.

The Vision-1 is a versatile pair of sunglasses that offers seamless tint adjustment and optimal eye protection. The glasses utilise innovative IRID X-10 lenses, which combine a small solar cell with a special liquid crystal film to provide battery-free autonomous tint adaptation in less than a second, depending on the ambient light. The lenses can cover any tint from 60 to 6 per cent of light transmittance. The frame, made of carbon fibre-reinforced Grilamid, is both durable and lightweight, while its adjustable temples enhance comfort.

The carbon e-bike i:SY Skyfly is characterised by its light weight of 18.2 kg and the minimalist appearance with striking frame openings and nearly identical frame angles. Components such as the Bosch SX drive unit, the battery and the system control are form-fittingly integrated. Despite its compact dimensions, the e-bike offers riders from 165 cm to 195 cm the opportunity to adjust the ergonomic sitting position that suits them. Mounting points on the frame allow for the installation of a luggage rack on both the front and rear wheel.

The Enya NEXG 2 Carbon Fiber Smart Guitar combines traditional guitar craftsmanship with the essence of new technologies. The use of third-generation acoustic carbon fibre makes the guitar lighter and more robust and promotes a powerful acoustic performance. Thanks to its handcrafted production in combination with high-quality materials, the guitar impresses with its quality and elegant appearance. Technical features such as AR speakers, a new DSP chip and AI tone cloning technology offer ambitious music lovers plenty of scope.

“Designing Dreams” was the title of the exhibition with which Flavio Manzoni and the Ferrari Design Team presented themselves as Red Dot: Design Team of the Year 2019 at the Red Dot Design Museum and provided an insight into their work. To mark the brand’s 75th anniversary, the Ferrari Design Team created another dream for the Gran Turismo video game: the Ferrari of the future in the form of the Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo concept car. Even though the study will only be on the road on virtual racetracks for the time being, its design already defines what Ferrari calls a “speed form” and thus gives insight into the future vocabulary of form. At the same time, the Ferrari Vision GT builds a bridge to the history of the brand, as its aggressive design is directly inspired by the legendary Ferrari sports prototypes of the 1960s and 1970s. The new design language is characterised by very sharp and angular lines, which are, however, at the same time based on a very organic design. This strong contrast, based on the plasticity of the surfaces in interaction with the geometric precision of the lines, has a disruptive effect that shapes the highly independent, futuristic character of the single-seater. At the heart of the Ferrari Vision GT’s architecture is a progressive aerodynamic concept based on two imposing side channels. This patented solution directs the airflow from the front underbody, around the cockpit and over the striking side pods. The sleek, aerodynamic body appears to float above the flat carbon-fibre underbody that houses all the car’s technical components. The interior design continues the design language of the exterior and offers optimal functionality and driver ergonomics. The jury was enthusiastic about the concept: “The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo embodies the Ferrari heritage and manifests a vision for the future of the brand. The entire appearance of this concept study, designed for the greatest possible aerodynamics, conveys dynamism, speed and uncompromising determination. The fascination of the play of contrasts celebrated here, this retro-futuristic design language, is hard to resist.”

Scotsman is a fully connected carbon fibre e-scooter characterised by its streamlined design with organic curves. The frame is 3D-printed in a single pass from patented thermoplastic carbon fibre composite, resulting in a strong yet lightweight structure free of joints or screws that is recyclable and more durable than steel or aluminium. Smart features such as GPS, auto-lock, a mobile app and dashcam allow the user to make informed decisions on the ride.

The Canyon Spectral:ON CFR mountain bike combines a full carbon frame with a high-torque motor and offers significantly more range than the previous model thanks to the discreetly integrated battery with up to 900 Wh capacity. Flowing transitions between stem, cockpit and front triangle underline the claim in terms of performance, lightness and dynamics. A light, manoeuvrable piece of sports equipment, it offers a natural riding feel with reliable resistance.

The frame of the Superstrata bicycle consists of a single piece of carbon fibre composite formed using a 3D printing process – without joints, screws or adhesives – which means a gain for both the strength and the aesthetics of the bike. Each model is unique, as the frame is made specifically for the body measurements of the buyer. The durable structure made of the composite material is fully recyclable at the end of the bicycle’s life cycle.

The Zero Y Carbon Fiber travel tripod is suitable for both photographers and videographers. After flipping an ergonomically designed release lever, the user can remove the centre column and use it as a selfie stick. In addition, the centre column can be shortened for a low camera position or inverted so that the camera hangs below the tripod legs. An integrated bubble level can be used for checking the alignment. The ball head is equipped with an Arca-Swiss-compatible quick-release plate. The jury praised the fact that, despite its light weight, the tripod boasts a wide range of possible uses.

parameters.name: 导热系数
parameters.definition: 导热系数表示材料传递热量的能力。数值越高，材料越容易传递热量，触摸时更容易产生冷感或热传递感。
parameters.designMeaning: 帮助设计师理解材料的热传递速度与接触温感。

materials.name: 软木
materials.description: 软木常用名称为软木或栓皮，主要取自栓皮栎等树木的外层树皮。其蜂窝状封闭细胞结构使材料轻、可压缩、回弹、隔热、吸声并具有一定防水性。软木可制成整片、颗粒板或复合材料，常用于瓶塞、地板、墙面、鞋材、握把、包装和可持续产品表面。
materials.cognitiveText: 软木在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.035–0.048 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: Jack & Jenny is a modular, environmentally friendly organisation system for everyday objects. An innovative polymer mixture made from the renewable raw materials cork and potato starch is used to produce the Jack containers. Only natural pigments are selected for the environmentally friendly colouring. The matching Jenny support structure is made of regional beech wood. Thanks to the robust workmanship, this functional system is hard-wearing and durable.

WooSmell is the name of a range of scent carriers made from environmentally friendly cork. Available in different shapes, they create a pleasant ambient atmosphere or neutralise odours in wardrobes. The good absorbency and breathability of the material ensures that their fragrance is released steadily. The packaging concept for this product is just as ecologically sound. Durable Tyvek bags reflect the colouring and natural aesthetics of the cork and, once the products have been unpacked, offer the opportunity for practical reuse in everyday life.

The Lenovo Go Wireless Split Keyboard & Lenovo Go Wireless Vertical Mouse is designed to be easy on muscles and joints. The keys are arranged at an angle that promotes straight wrist posture and thus reduces strain. The home and arrow keys are positioned flat for easy access. The mouse also follows the anatomy of the hand to provide a high level of comfort. Mouse and keyboard have contact surfaces made of cork which are pleasant to the touch and provide a link to natural materials.

ETHO, a cabin-sized piece of luggage, focuses not only on modern aesthetics but also on the sustainability of the materials. The suitcase shell, for example, is made of recycled aluminium and the corner constructions, which provide improved impact behaviour, are made of recycled plastic. The handle and interior are made from upcycled cork. At the end of their service life, all materials are 100 per cent recyclable. Furthermore, practical security for the traveller is provided by a modern TSA lock.

The Stratus umbrella collection features a modular system of interchangeable handle components and mechanical functions. A trilobe profile forms the basis for the frame components. This shape increases torsional strength within the telescopic shaft and prevents twisting of the frame and canopy. The umbrella canopy uses 50 per cent recycled polypropylene blended with microfibre. Performance materials, such as aircraft aluminum and carbon fibre within the frame assure longevity and durability. Leather, cork, woods and quality plastics make up the handle pallet options.

The Saddle Bag Spin Dye nappy bag is an attractive, well-conceived and long-lasting accessory for mothers. Its outer appearance is characterised by the specially developed “Spin Dye” fabric in discreet, muted colours, contrasted by powerful accents from the natural material cork. The special feature of “Spin Dye” material is that it is spun from already coloured granulate, whereby the otherwise usual dye bath is omitted, thus saving water and energy. Inside the bag, there are a generously dimensioned main compartment and many further pockets for accessories.

The imaginative design of the Natura stove makes it possible not only to see the warming fire, but also to feel it with the hands. The free-standing stove has a steel body, covered with cork profiles. These are not in direct contact with the steel structure, in order to ensure that the natural material does not darken over time. The cork gives the stove, an industrial object, a natural look. It can be touched and so provides a lasting sensation of the warmth of a fire.

The Kiori collection comprises sofas, armchairs and screens characterised by their combination of innovative materials. The sassafras heartwood structure is combined with carefully hand-woven ash wood Abonos and cork. Abonos, which is sourced from riverbeds, where it undergoes a fossilisation process, boasts a number of special properties, including durability and a high resistance to moisture. The elements of the Kiori collection feature the same durability in both indoor and outdoor areas, while exhibiting a natural charm.

To achieve long-lasting stability, this hose reel is made of recyclable aluminium. Only the external surface of the aluminium frame is coated with synthetic resin to protect the hose against heat from sunlight. The recessed grips are lined with cork for a natural, pleasant feel. The precise reel system prevents the hose from deforming when being rolled up, which reduces the winding weight and friction noise.

CorkWirl is a wall panel with generative patterns inspired by biomimetic structures. Twirl movements generate organic and fluid shapes. The low-tech material of sustainable cork granulate is produced in a natural high-tech process in the course of which water vapour is injected through pellets using high pressure, creating a wide variety of shapes and patterns by means of algorithms. In addition, this attractive panel has excellent thermal and acoustic properties.

This kitchen knife set follows a distinctive design language defined by a blend of natural materials. The ergonomic cross-sectional handle shape rests comfortably in the palm of the hand. A firm arch transition connects the scratch-resistant and stainless steel blade to the handle. Both the side surfaces of the steel handle and the knife sheaths are made of fibre resin – a composite of crop straw, rice husks, starch and resin. A portable knife bag made of natural cork complements the set.

Privacy is something that everyone needs but no one gets in the workplace. Being able to change your vantage point, posture, work modes, and environment based on different tasks is human-centric and improves people’s well-being. Buffer is as simple as it gets when it comes to an acoustic divider. It features as few parts as possible: a PET panel, an aluminum structural stem, and a steel base with a cork glide. It’s easy to move, rearrange, and rotate, which makes it adaptable to the quickly changing work modes in an office space.

The Post-it® Z-Notes Natural Dispenser was designed with sustainability and life-cycle management in mind. It is constructed with natural raw materials only—just glass and 100 percent recycled cork, no plastics. Plus, while most dispensers on the market have a minimum of five pieces, this product has only two, making it very easy to assemble, disassemble and recycle.

Home fitness equipment directly in our surroundings makes us psychologically more likely to move everyday. 
But the language of the gym feels too heavy and industrial for home.
Kettler’s new Ergometer balances performance & domesticity to feel harmonious with your main living space, instead of a spare room or garage.
A patented inductive brake system for resistance control mixes with homely colourways & cork pedals. Knit-like mouldings & tubular frame soften ergonomic handlebars. Real-time sensors allow seamless cloud-based tracking. High-durability materials reduce environmental impact by lasting a lifetime.
Performance, fit for the home.

This is an eco-friendly disposable e-cigarette that features natural materials and innovative structures, aiming to provide users with a safe and convenient smoking experience while reducing its impact on the environment. With the emphasis on the selection and application of sustainable materials, the R&D team particularly uses cork material from the bark of the cork oak, which is composite treated with resin to ensure durability and safety of the product. Additionally, the modular design allows users to easily disassemble for recycling, reducing the environmental impact of e-waste.

This elegant Porsche Design Goodyear Welted Velours Lace Up men’s shoe of finest calf leather is manufactured in the traditional, very elaborate welt seam process Goodyear Welted. This results in a durable shoe which flexibly supports the complex movement sequence. The insole is provided with a cork compound which adapts to the individual wearer. Thanks to environmentally friendly Eichenloh pit tanning, an abrasion-resistant and yet flexible outer sole is created with water-repelling and breathable properties.

In an attempt to follow the SDGs Takagi considered what they could do to protect the environment and manufacture sustainably. The result in this product is a reduction in the amount of resin used and the choice of reusable aluminum and natural cork. The finish brings out the natural individuality of the material so that it matches the minimalist form. Moreover, they created a hose reel that you will love every time you use it, rather than a consumable one that needs to be replaced when it fades or breaks.

materials.name: 橡木
materials.description: 橡木常用名称为橡木或栎木，来自栎属多种树木，是家具和室内产品中常见的阔叶木材。其纹理明显，通常具有较好的强度、耐磨性和表面涂饰效果，白橡与红橡在导管结构、色泽和耐久性方面存在差异。常用于家具、地板、酒桶、饰面板和结构木制品，性能受含水率影响明显。
materials.cognitiveText: 橡木在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.136–0.19 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: Design innovations are often the product of technology transfer. In the case of Furniture Linoleum, the innovative aspect is first and foremost a carefully considered material transfer that has led to a sustainable product with aesthetic appeal. Forbo Flooring had previously focused on the production of high-quality flooring materials before deciding to diversify its portfolio and expertise in the furniture sector with Furniture Linoleum. Now the time-tested material of linoleum is captivating a new audience with its natural, warm feel and excellent durability as a contemporary surface finish for home and kitchen furniture, doors, and much more. “This product embodies our vision of creating functional, durable and environmentally conscious finishes for both flooring and furniture,” says the manufacturer. Linoleum’s climate-positive aspects also contribute to user convenience. Made from renewable and natural raw materials such as linseed oil, wood flour, pine resin and limestone, it has a naturally elegant, matt surface that is resistant to fingerprints. Being easy to clean, Furniture Linoleum is also an interesting option for the customised furnishing of public spaces. Forbo Flooring complements all of these positive properties with an attractive range of 24 colours that blend seamlessly with natural woods and stones, such as oak, walnut and maple, or marble, concrete and terrazzo. A special aesthetic has been achieved with the “Pure Linoleum” decor, which completely dispenses with colour pigments to showcase the natural shade of linseed oil. Like leather and wood, each piece is unique and alters in appearance over time. The Red Dot jurors were fascinated by the natural look and feel: “What really impressed us about Furniture Linoleum is this focus on material purity. The special yet subtle tactile warmth of the surfaces makes them feel comforting to the touch. Another remarkable aspect is the unique natural aroma of linoleum that is pleasant to perceive. This material represents tangible quality. It is honest, thoughtfully designed and delivers genuine added value for healthy interior spaces.”

The LIND Canvas electric jetboard combines the look, handling and feel of a classic surfboard with modern drive technology. Made of EPS foam and epoxy resin with oak wood details, the board weighs just 7 kg and can be set up in less than a minute without tools. The jet and battery modules fit in a backpack. With 20 kW of power, a speed of up to 60 km/h and 45 minutes of riding time, it offers powerful performance and timeless aesthetics. Unique Art Boards made in collaboration with artists are available as collectables.

The Electric Fondue Set Pro combines traditional fondue culture with the functionality and simplicity of an electric set. A heating element with a safety thermostat maintains temperatures in the range of 50 to 190 degrees Celsius to suit cheese, meat, chocolate and bouillon fondues alike. The device, made of cast iron and oak, has a splash guard with notches for the fondue forks and is largely free of plastics. Thanks to its long mains cable, it can be used flexibly.

The Loop furniture collection is characterised by an attractive interplay of contrasts. It combines a sculptural base made of solid oak wood with the softness of organically moulded textile upholstery. In addition to artfully curved armrests, which inspired the name, the aesthetics are characterised by balanced proportions that also ensure pleasant comfort. The flexible collection includes armchairs, chairs, chaise longues and footstools that bring cosiness and elegance to a variety of room layouts.

Where people move frequently for work reasons, the traditional fitted kitchen becomes a problem due to a lack of flexibility. TERMINO’s modular kitchen system addresses this problem by being modular in design and made from lightweight yet durable materials such as recycled aluminium, 316L stainless steel and European oak. With 14 highly configurable, stackable modules, it adapts to a wide variety of layouts, as well as to changes in household size, needs or preferences.

The slimline oak Heart'n'Soul dining table, with its integrated, hidden extension leaves, can seat up to twelve people. At both ends of the table there is a fabric-lined drawer for storing important items, like cutlery, within easy reach. The Heart'n'Soul dining tables are available in dark oak and black oak versions, as well as oak versions with a highly scratch resistant nanolaminate finish in various colours. The rounded corners and smooth transitions from tabletop to table legs create a high-quality aesthetic.

The Diabolo Dumbbells were developed with a special focus on exclusivity and sustainability. When customising these free weights to their personal preferences, users can choose between different FSC-certified hardwoods for the handles, including reclaimed oak, and even order a personal engraving on the slightly concave-shaped end plate. Each dumbbell set is made to order with the aim of preventing material waste and the production of superfluous equipment. The lifetime guarantee also ensures that the stylish training equipment can be repaired rather than replaced. The jury praised the Diabolo Dumbbells as “an excellent example of how elegance and sustainability can be successfully combined”.

IKA innovatively advances the design of folding chairs. The seat and legs are made of high-quality oak and are combined with a sturdy leather strap, which has two functions: it serves as a convenient backrest, but also as a carrying strap. This facilitates the transport of IKA when folded. The iron fittings are deliberately used as a striking design feature.

Distinctive visual accents with a contrast between gloss and matt surfaces, along with a combination of oak and aluminium, characterise this compact wine cooler. The frameless door with its tinted, UV-absorbent glass, together with the appealing interior lighting, presents the contents in an attractive light. The wine cooler offers a satisfying user experience with a pull-out shelf and two temperature zones that can be controlled individually.

The handle-free built-under Siemens Freestanding Wine Cooler cools and elegantly showcases fine wines. Its dark metal body, which tastefully complements the graphite-grey interior, creates an effective display for white and red wines. From the solid oak shelves to the door with UV filter, the materials and overall design exude strong value.

Inspired by a kinetic sculpture, this table lamp consists of five wooden rods of different lengths equipped with discreet adjustable metal connections. These allow both the lamp base and the illuminated area to be aligned according to individual needs. As a battery-powered device, the lamp achieves a running time of approximately eight hours at full power and a running time of up to twelve hours at medium power. The portable table lamp is optionally available in oak, ash wood or walnut.

The Siemens Freestanding Wine Cooler provides plenty of room for fine wines that are showcased in an appealing manner. Dark grey tones in the interior frame the stored bottles, while the metallic-grey tinted glass door protects the bottles from harmful UV light. The exclusive overall appearance is enhanced by solid aluminium profiles on the front of the real oak shelves. The presenter shelf that can be set at an angle allows special treasures to be beautifully arranged.

This robust pizza peel was designed in the style of a garden shovel and equipped with a handle made of solid oak wood. This patented handle enables one-handed use, as its smoothly sanded wooden surface rests firmly against the forearm during use. The blade made of high-quality aluminium boasts an only 2 mm thick edge that easily slides under the pizza base. The pizza peel is suitable for pizzas with a diameter of up to 30 cm.

The Siemens BU30 wine cooler is characterised by high-quality features and a modern functionality and was designed for fitted kitchens. The slender appliance with 30 cm width has a dark surface with a milled, black anodised bar handle made of genuine metal. The graphite grey interior is combined with oak wood shelves, which have solid aluminium profiles on the front. A tinted UV protection of the door as well as innovative temperature regulation and control by touch operation ensure optimised storage conditions.

The characteristic style element of this bathroom furniture series is the shape it is named after – oval. The collection is furthermore defined by a high-contrast material combination that blends warm oak or ash wood with dark grey powder-coated metal elements. The versatile and functionally sophisticated components merge into a homogeneous entity. With its highly distinctive design, the collection lends bathrooms a unique and exclusive style.

Reverse Conference is a series of conference tables, available with one or multiple bases and variable tabletops in 14 sizes. The table displays an elegant look with its 30 mm laminated wood plate in oak veneer or lacquered style, and the contrasting thick bases tapering upward. The base frames are made of 100 per cent recyclable polyethylene and come in matt or glossy versions.

These open shelving elements in light design, used as end shelving in the cabinet area, take the interior of the kitchen to the outside and facilitate opening of the kitchen into the living and dining area. The shelves are flexible to use. In the rear panel, system rails are located which can accommodate, apart from shelves of glass or oak, also drawers or storage boxes and utensil holders.

With its delicate lines, the bed Light manages elegantly to tame the natural characteristics of wood. Graceful, slanted legs conform to the manufacturer’s trademark style while the two broad bars of the bed head add a refined touch. The precise construction of the bed is reflected by the details: only the head of the wooden peg, for example, hints at the point where the sides of the bed are connected to each other. Light is available in walnut or oak.

This entrance door is 220 mm thick and its exterior is completely covered with glass, thus allowing it to blend in harmoniously with the house entrance. On the side is a functional channel in black anodised aluminium which contains the bell and a door-opening module together with the letterbox. The inside of the door is made of fine woods, such as varnished German wild oak, a feature which underlines its exclusive character.

The AUGLETICS Eight Style ergometer is clad in a chic oak wall and can be optimally connected. It is almost noiseless as the resistance is generated by an eddy current brake. With a Virtual Coach, every stroke can be analysed in real time and the user’s technique can be continuously improved. The integrated touch display ensures simple operation. The ergometer can be stowed away in two easy steps and, folded up, fits in any corner.

materials.name: PMMA
materials.description: PMMA常用名称为亚克力、有机玻璃或压克力，化学名称为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯。它是透明度较高的无定形热塑性塑料，具有良好的耐候性、着色性和机械加工性能，常作为玻璃替代材料。典型应用包括灯具、展示架、标识、透明罩、汽车灯具和光学件，但抗冲击性低于PC。
materials.cognitiveText: PMMA在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.17–0.19 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: The Lenovo Tab is a 10.1-inch tablet designed by Lenovo specifically for children and families. This tablet has a carefully designed appearance and meaningful accessories. The play suite, tailored for children, offers versatile usability in horizontal and vertical orientations, ensuring convenience for young users. The included stylus empowers children to express their creativity freely. The tablet ingeniously combines metal and PMMA to fulfil antenna requirements while exuding a unique, high-quality appearance. Furthermore, the tablet has a transparent case featuring a built-in stand and a folio case, providing users with versatile options.

materials.name: PP
materials.description: PP常用名称为聚丙烯或PP塑料，是密度较低、用途广泛的热塑性聚合物。它耐化学品、耐湿、易注塑和挤出，并具有良好的反复弯折疲劳性能，可制作一体式活铰链。常见于食品容器、家居用品、医疗耗材、汽车内饰、无纺布和包装薄膜，但低温冲击性能及耐候性需要关注。
materials.cognitiveText: PP在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.15–0.22 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: We integrate the function of the handle into the pull rod, and the top is inlaid with the pp environmental protection material panel to create a flat and high-quality mobile desk, so that users are no longer limited by the scene when they are on business travel, whether they are processing documents or reading and writing. We have adopted the latest NFC technology, which is fully compatible with IOS and Android systems. The trolley case can be unlocked when the mobile phone is close to it, which improves the convenience of unpacking and cancels the password design to further improve the security of the luggage.

With the increasing number of luggage, environmental protection is also a very important issue. The ITP FN-A uses environmentally friendly materials and is designed with a 3-to-7 ratio to increase visual beauty.What sets the ITP FN-A apart is not just its aesthetic appeal but also its commitment to responsible travel. Embrace sustainability with the option of 83% recycled PP or 83% 0BP certified recycled PP making it the conscientious choice for themodern traveler. Meet the FN-A ITP's latest innovation in trunk cases.Elevate your travel experience with this stylish and functional luggage companions.

“Understated in its design, versatile in its use and equipped with impressive features that ensure a high level of wearing comfort,” said the jury, highlighting the various advantages of the extremely lightweight, two-piece down jacket. Down or woollen materials are used in different areas of the inner and outer jacket to provide a high-precision combination of thermal insulation and moisture absorption. The outer layer, with its timeless design, is made of 100 per cent recycled wind- and waterproof Windstopper fabric, making the garment an uncomplicated accessory for use in the city, on camping trips and for various types of sports.

Especially developed for the Asian market, these bottles can be transformed into a storage box in an instant thanks to the included sealing cap. Thus, the bottles can still be used when the child has grown out of babyhood. The ergonomic handles support the development of motor skills, and the teats are available in different textures for younger and older babies.

PPSU, a high-strength and temperature-resistant material also employed in vehicle construction, was used for these characterful hexagonal glasses. This enables a direct connection between the front of the glasses and the temples – without additional reinforcement. For the first time, the Titanflex components are dowelled directly in the plastic with pins. This construction ensures light weight while providing stability. Also extraordinary is the radiance of the colours.

The Ca Go FS 200 electric cargo bike stands out for the design of its innovative cargo box. The EPP safety box has adjustable headrests and 5-point seatbelts, providing space for two children. The low loading platform with the dual batteries installed under the cargo box shifts the centre of gravity further downwards and optimises the weight distribution over the front wheel, ensuring stable travel and cornering, even unloaded. Short pedal crank arms ensure that the feet of the rider can safely reach the ground at all times.

This product for the Chinese market connects the extractor hood to the wall edge of the hob. A multistage water filter is integrated into the 10 cm deep connector, which cleans the water with PP cotton, activated carbon and reverse osmosis. The water flows directly into the pot through a lateral faucet. Smoke outlets halfway up and at the top of the hood are specially designed to suit Chinese cooking habits, since the preparation of wok dishes produces a lot of smoke.

The cleaning of floor drains is often very cumbersome. The design goal of Kun was to optimise this process and reduce the cleaning effort. Inspired by a seesaw, the floor drain can be lifted quickly by pressing down on any of the four corners. The integrated filter components can be removed with a simple rotating movement. The corrosion- and temperature-resistant polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) material significantly extends the service life of Kun.

The Bottle Mate serves as an adapter and filter for water bottles and turns tap water into healthy drinking water. On business trips, on the road or at school, it is extremely practical. With carbon fibre inside, it reduces lead and other heavy metals harmful to the human body. Residual chlorine and organic pollutants are also removed, thus improving the taste and quality of the water. With dimensions of 35 × 35 × 65 mm and a weight of 36 grams, the compact adapter is BPA-free and made of PP and silica gel.

The soft and smooth curve modelling lends the Grace basin faucet a noble appearance. It can therefore be easily integrated into modern bathroom spaces. Its thinly shaped handle ensures a comfortable operating experience. The water is injected into a waterfall bubbler to provide a soft and delicate jet to save water. The faucet body contains a water channel structure made of heat-resistant PPA material, which prevents the water from being contaminated with heavy metals.

The pump group is designed to meet the growing demands placed on technical devices and systems in boiler rooms. The exterior of MeiFlow Top S is characterised by rounded edges as well as a colour and material combination that is rich in contrast. The housing features EPP insulation. The sophisticated technology is cleverly hidden behind the white, distinctively smooth and homogeneously designed front.

With their replaceable cup heads and teats, the Avent PPSU Straw Cups adapt to the changing needs of babies and toddlers. In particular, they facilitate a smooth transition from the teat to the straw. The latter features an air pressure valve that prevents fluids from spilling while drinking, and the hinged lid provides reliable sealing on the go. The handles are ergonomically shaped, and thanks to a separate sealing cap, the cups can also be used as storage containers.

The shape of Guide-C is characterised by elegant and concise lines. The faucet outlet is cleverly implanted in the button panel. It can be turned on by one button to provide a clean and comfortable shower experience. By incorporating a silica gel pores-pressurised water outlet design, it can shower a larger area at the same water flow rate. The faucet body contains a water channel structure made of a heat-resistant PPA material to prevent contamination of the water with heavy metals.

Barocco filters the outside air and transports fresh air into the living space. The streamlined inner ducts are made of the environmentally-friendly expanded polypropylene (EPP), which effectively reduces air resistance and thus also noise when in operation. Thanks to its very slim form, Barocco is suitable for installation in small spaces and easy to maintain as replacing the filter does not require much space due to an inclined pull-out angle.

The side-lock solid wood flooring is a glue-free, keel-free, flat push floor that can be installed easily and cost-efficiently. Its remarkable advantages are that the PPR plastic lock saves wood and increases the surface utilisation rate by more than 10 per cent, that it is easy to install and that it can be reused. The floor is resistant to high temperatures, waterproof as well as resistant to deformation and ageing, which ensures a long and healthy service life thanks to environmentally friendly materials and processing. This system is known as a recognised DIY solid wood flooring.

The Trama Basket recovers in a unique way the concept of “Brazilianess” found in indigenous handicraft, more precisely in the art of weaving and looming, where the designers sought inspiration to create a novel product. The designers’ greatest challenge was to transform the concept of hand weaving and looming into an industrialized product and apply an alternative raw material from natural fibers used by indigenous artisans.  The Trama Basket is produced in polypropylene (PP) with a 40% addition of natural resin fibers extracted from sugar cane, thus reducing plastic polymer consumption. The basket is injection molded and bonded together by a special binding system without using glue or welding.

The D-cloud sofa was designed to help ease the anxiety and uneasiness caused by a modern, fast-paced life. By extending the backrest and adjusting the shape of the sofa, users can create a sense of being enveloped, giving them privacy and distance from the outside world. D-cloud replaces foam with EPP (expanded polypropylene) to enhance the fluidity of the sofa’s shape to better fit the human body. The fluidity of EPP particles, its superior elasticity, and its shock resistance provide a comfortable sitting experience. EPP can be recycled and reused; it also decomposes naturally.

Oriented toward young users in China, the Mi Standing Fan Pro features an ultra-slim design that addresses the common challenges, such as limited living space and storage during off-seasons. Its unique design allows for easy storage when not in use, supporting desktop and floor standing use. The Type-C charging port and power bank make it an ideal choice in various scenarios, such as outdoor camping and in-vehicle storage. The box, made from eco-friendly EPP foam materials, not only protects the fan but also serves as a storage container, reducing material waste compared to traditional ones.

BYD YangWang U8 is a luxury new energy  off-road vehicle, designed to provide users with the extreme performance and safety off-road experience. Taking inspiration from the Chinese  traditional  culture and the  universe.U8 show YangWang's design understanding in the era of "EV Power" through a prospective and hardcore exterior and luxury interior. U8 equipped with BYD's new technologies, such as"Yi Si Fang" four-electric motor platform, "Yunian-P" intelligent suspension system , "IP68" waterproofing, bring extreme safety and performance to the users.

The Ninebot electric bike B series follows a simple and fashionable design style, and its goal is to create a light urban transportation tool for young consumers. The lightweight size and bright and beautiful body colors reflect the vitality of young people. The Ninebot electric bike B features the original "rideygo!" intelligent system designed for share & ride public transport. Users can automatically unlock the scooters using their phones thanks to the Ninebot airlock inductive unlocking technology.

materials.name: PC
materials.description: PC常用名称为聚碳酸酯或PC塑料，部分地区也称防弹胶。它是一种透明热塑性工程塑料，突出特点是抗冲击能力强、尺寸稳定、可透光并能进行注塑和热成型。PC常用于透明防护罩、电子产品外壳、头盔镜片、灯具、医疗器械及光学部件，但需要关注表面耐刮擦和耐化学性。
materials.cognitiveText: PC在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.19–0.22 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: The Urbanaut bicycle helmet was developed especially for e-bike users and is specially designed to resist the significant forces that can occur during falls at higher speeds. This is achieved by the fusion of different materials. The inner shell is made of two expanded polystyrene materials of different density that provide support and also a shock-absorbing function. The outer shell features a combination of ABS layers and polycarbonate, which minimizes the helmet’s volume and weight, guaranteeing optimal shock protection. Ventilation is regulatable via integrated air vents.

ZUS is a smart car charger and locating device. As soon as the car has been parked, ZUS stores the actual location on the owner’s smartphone so that the car can be found again at any time. The device charges connected devices twice as quickly as conventional chargers with 4.8 amperes. By the use of a special PC / ABS plastic and titanium-coated metal components, ZUS can withstand temperatures of up to 100 degrees Celsius.

The Husqvarna Skutta electric scooter is an advanced solution for urban mobility with a look reminiscent of modern motorbikes. The scooter is easy to operate and is characterised by a removable battery and a specially developed folding design around the front axle. Thanks to the larger front tyre and the low riding position, the Husqvarna Skutta offers stability when cornering and responsive braking performance. The high-quality components and suitability for everyday use are combined in a robust and modern package.

The portable Mr Charger 10000 CH07 charging device combines an AC wall charger and power bank. Thanks to the built-in cables, it can be used to quickly charge iPhones and Android devices. Because of its discreetly integrated, detachable UK, EU and AU standard plugs, it can be used in multiple countries. To provide greater safety, PC V0 fireproof material is used for this robust charger.

The ROG Azoth Extreme is a customizable 75% gaming keyboard with premium aluminum-alloy chassis and metal frame, redefining gaming keyboards by offering customization and comfort. Featuring a full-colored OLED touch screen with three-way control knob, a paddle switch to adjust the gasket mount offering two typing experience, and a carbon fiber positioning plate. It also offers tri-mode connectivity and can achieve an up to 8K Hz polling rate with ROG Polling Rate Booster. Designed for durability and versatility, it sets a new standard in the keyboard industry for gamers, DIY enthusiasts and office workers.

The HIVE BSM has an understated elegance. The dark appearance and neutral design convey the feeling that the HIVE BSM is a reliable and professional product. The shell material is first PC injection molded then further molded by ultrasonic welding technology, making the product fully waterproof. It is affixed to the motorcycle using Velcro, which allows for quick and easy installation or removal. The purpose of the HIVE BSM is to give the rider additional monitoring support to eliminate blindspots.

Realme's first bean-shape TWS earphone is a collaboration between realme and the renowned Hermès home designer, José Lévy. He took his design inspiration from the shape of pebbles on the beach to create this realme trendsetting design. The realme Buds Q features a full curved body that is super lightweight. The device is fashionable, compact, and easy to use.

The trackball mouse “Expert Mouse TB800 EQ” enables precise input, is ergonomically shaped and reduces strain on the hand. Thanks to its symmetrical design, it is suitable for both left- and right-handed users. Four DPI levels allow for customisable speed, while a scroll ring facilitates smooth vertical navigation. The trackball supports wired and wireless connections with AES-128 encryption.

As a compact outdoor antenna unit, the TCL HH526 5G ODU provides wireless internet access in both urban and rural areas. Its IP65 weatherproof housing, with a ribbed surface, supports effective heat dissipation. An integrated 13 dBi antenna and the app-based alignment tool ensure easy installation. The accessory is available for four different mounting scenarios. Made of 95 per cent post-consumer recycled (PCR) material, the device also features an eco mode for energy-efficient operation.

The TCL Fiber Gateway Family combines Wi-Fi 7 and GPON technology to provide exceptional network performance with speeds of up to 7.2 Gbps and wired access of 2.5 Gbps. The casing is mainly made of PCR materials and all the hardware is recyclable. The packaging made from recyclable paper also stands for sustainability, while an energy-saving mode uses intelligent algorithms to reduce power consumption. The product also features an accessible design with Braille characters and voice instructions.

This espresso maker with an integrated cup can be used with either coffee powder or capsules. The water reaches brewing temperature in no time; in combination with a high-pressure system of 19 bar, an espresso extraction is achieved in just 25 seconds. The slim cylindrical housing rests comfortably in the hand. It is made of PCTG, a heat- and corrosion-resistant material that is food-safe. The product can also be used as a power bank when you’re on the go.

The ASUS ExpertBook B5 series was developed especially for businesspeople on the go. The architectural black casing is dirt-repellent and made from recycled PIR and PCR materials. The series offers various configurations, including models with and without a touch screen. With the help of four blue-bordered buttons, the pre-installed ASUS ExpertWidget software facilitates individual customisations of the stylish everyday helper.

The Bluetooth speaker JBL Go 4 delivers voluminous sound despite its compact design. The IP75 certification attests its dust and water resistance. The integrated loop facilitates transport. The battery life of up to seven hours is very practical when on the go and can be further increased via the Outdoor Boost function. The device incorporates PCR plastic and fabric for the speaker cover, while the packaging is made from FSC-certified paper with soy ink.

The Jacqueline kettle was designed with regard to an elegant preparation of tea. Its shape recalls an iconic bag and it is inspired by traditional ceramic teapots. It is made of 18 / 10 stainless steel with a PCT Tritan handle. All stages of the heating process and the infusion can be controlled and regulated: from the temperature, that can be set at a precise degree from 40 to 100 degrees Celsius, to the “keep warm” function. When in use, its base becomes bright. Simple and intuitive, the B Chef app (based on IoT) allows to programme and customise the preparation.

The WNC LAXY 5G CPE + Wi-Fi 7 Extender consists of networked 5G end devices for home use that combine high connection speed with a resource-saving design. They support the Matter smart home standard and Wi-Fi 7 and are manufactured using recycled materials, including PCR plastics, PET fibres and oyster shells. The devices are based on a symmetrical three-component structure that is manufactured using two injection moulds, thus reducing production waste.

The front compartment of the SPLIT trolley can be opened vertically, granting access to electric devices and documents. The main compartment opens horizontally. The suitcase is produced from highly impact-resistant PC-ABS through injection moulding and the front and back panel are reinforced with polycarbonate. Thanks to the wide pull handle, the case has more loading volume and can be moved around easily. It is equipped with a double TSA lock, a built-in USB port and a removable divider for flexible packing.

DoorCam is an AI-powered door-mounted security camera designed specifically for single female and elderly households. DoorCam allows users to monitor their front doors remotely through a mobile app, easily checking visitors or delivered packages. Its advanced AI recognizes visitors, categorizing them as family, friends, delivery personnel, or others, and alerts users instantly about suspicious activity. The product is carefully designed to minimize visual prominence, blending naturally with doors considering standard door heights and users’ line of sight. Its color matches darker door shades commonly used in Korean apartments, creating a harmonious appearance and reducing visual burden associated with traditional surveillance cameras. DoorCam also prioritizes environmental sustainability by using PCR plastic ( Post-Consumer Recycled) and sustainable packaging materials like soy inks and FSC-certified packaging, aligning with ESG principles.

The Square Solidity door lock series redefines home security as a lifestyle statement, offering three models tailored to modern living: the premium push-pull type, the standard lever type, and the practical mini lever type. At its core is the rectangular, angular handle, designed not only for a sturdy, ergonomic grip but also as a refined lifestyle object that complements modern home aesthetics. As American lifestyles diversify and elevate with rising economic prosperity, homes increasingly reflect personalized values and tastes. In this context, Square Solidity transcends its role as a security device, becoming a curated design element that enhances daily rituals and home identity. Constructed from PC, ABS, and metal, the locks balance durability with aesthetic excellence, while the minimized parting lines and absence of decorative pieces reinforce a sleek, modern profile. Ultimately, Square Solidity offers functional elegance, transforming the entryway into a personalized design statement that reflects contemporary lifestyles.

ZTE Qi CPE series leverages 5G technology to provide Wi-Fi via SIM, enhancing connectivity in underserved areas. Rooted in the philosophy of "Founding on Stones, Surprising with Ingenuity," it embodies robustness, stability, and sustainability. Its unique tower-like base ensures desk stability, split evenly with textured top. Crafted in eco-friendly inkstone gray PCR material, it promotes recycling. With ZTE's AI antenna, it optimizes signal selection, reducing power consumption. This series harmoniously blends technology and design, meeting internet needs while balancing functionality, aesthetics, and environmental responsibility.

BULL Wing switch series is designed in Italy. It is an ultra-thin switch developed according to the minimalist design trend of home decoration, with a completely new form of interaction. Compared with metal lever switches on the market, the button uses flexible materials to reduce the user's psychological danger concerns. The switch provides a comfortable interactive experience through a secondary injection molding process. In addition to traditional PC coating materials, we also offer users a wider selection of material colors to match their home environment.

materials.name: PA
materials.description: PA常用名称为尼龙或PA塑料，材料学名称为聚酰胺。其分子链含有酰胺基团，通常具有较高强度、耐磨性、耐疲劳性和良好的自润滑特征。不同尼龙牌号及含水状态会显著影响尺寸和力学性能。常用于齿轮、轴承、扣件、织物纤维、工具零件及结构性注塑件。
materials.cognitiveText: PA在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.23–0.25 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: JBL Wind 3 delivers sound via Bluetooth and is equipped with an AUX input and FM radio. Its compact design also features an LED-backlit LCD. The device is IPX7 certified and can be installed on old and new handlebars by using the supplied nylon handlebar mount. Undocked, JBL Wind 3 can be clipped onto a backpack’s shoulder strap or attached to a lanyard, for example. Thus, the speaker can easily be used on the street or cycle path.

Less is More is a flush plate for toilets, which is available in black, white, brushed or polished. Its designer, Alessio Pinto, was inspired by Ludwig Mies van der Rohe and his design principle “less is more”, as well as by the history of the mechanism, and wanted to give it an innovative and sustainable form. “Plus and minus, not more and not less” is his motto. The plate therefore displays neither signs nor symbols, but simply offers two grey nylon cords as the control options.

The Crescent Lufkin Shockforce has been developed for experts, in particular for professionals in the building trade. In this context, impact protection, durability and tape stand out are the main criteria for a good tape measure. This is taken into account by the choice of materials, a reduction in weight and sophisticated details such as the blade geometry. Further features are the good legibility and the durable nylon coating of the tape, which is printed on both sides. The tape hook has a diamond-coated finish that grips almost any surface. The tether point likewise serves as a pivot point for marking arches.

Laughing Owl is a very light and roomy three-pole tunnel tent for four people. The fly sheet is made of Gorlyn 30 nylon ripstop fabric, which is a 6.6 nylon that has a higher tensile strength than most tent constructions. The spacious living area has three large windows made of FabVue material, which has the look and feel of a mesh but is actually a woven fabric and thus lighter and more durable. The light and strong 13.55 mm DAC-PL aluminium poles are characterised by a high degree of elasticity.
