Mobility by bicycle is part of a modern urban lifestyle. This handlebar bag combines an elegant appearance with sophisticated functionality and a design that is oriented to the flowing use between the office, daily routines and leisure time. The robust and water-resistant nylon material with a textile look ensures a long life and high functionality. By means of the self-explanatory Klickfix adapters, the bag attaches to all standard handlebars.

Snowflake is a pendant luminaire made of FSC-certified bamboo plywood. It is sold as a kit, which reduces the volume for shipping to a minimum. Furthermore, this gives users the fun and satisfaction of having easily assembled their own lighting system. Push-in nylon clips keep the pieces together and ensure that the lamp automatically takes up its shape during assembly. The design of the luminaire, which is available in three different sizes, was inspired by a trip to the Antarctic.

The Nikau pendant luminaire is made of FSC-certified bamboo plywood and sold as a kit of single parts. It can easily be assembled on site via push-in nylon clips. The lamp comes in two versions: the long version works best in the corner of a room and several of them serve as a room divider, whereas the short version shown here is suited for direct illumination, for example of tables. The shadow play of the luminaire yields a dynamic effect. The name Nikau refers to the name of the only indigenous palm tree in New Zealand.

Wind was developed with the objective of designing a new archetype of a bookcase. The modular aluminium bookcase system features extruded shelves and die-cast uprights. The aesthetics of the system are defined both horizontally and vertically by the filigree aluminium uprights, while the nylon fibre joints ensure a high degree of stability. Closing element of each composition is an aluminium laminated, lacquered MDF panel.

This patented suitcase system features a hard top and bottom crafted from ABS with 600D polyester lamination. The rest of the suitcase is made of a robust nylon fabric, which is otherwise commonly used in hiking boots. Fibreglass connecting rods reinforce the construction and reduce its overall weight. Apart from the trolley rods, the suitcase offers an integrated handle and allows quick access to selected items thanks to pockets on the front panel.

The main idea behind the DAYFARER is to offer a backpack that allows a smooth transition from the world of work to sports activities. Accordingly, a ventilated shoe compartment at the bottom of the bag keeps trainers away from other belongings, while an upholstered laptop pocket ensures the transport of the work equipment. The spacious main compartment opens flat like a suitcase, shoulder straps and back are well cushioned. The backpack is made of ballistic nylon fabric with water-repelling external coating.

The Portree backpack bag combines an elegant design with sophisticated functionality. Made of robust, water-repellent nylon material, it has been tailored to the flowing use between the office, everyday life and leisure. It can be attached to standard bicycle racks by means of Vario hooks and, thanks to an integrated strap, serve as a practical backpack. A padded notebook compartment is included for professional use.

Norco Lifestyle is a bag made of nylon fabric with an inherently stable top cover and a magnetic rotary fastener fashioned from aluminium. The fastener closes automatically and opens with a half turn. The bag is available in two sizes and features backside hooks, which allow it to be securely fixed and quickly removed from conventional bicycle racks. It contains a cushioned notebook or iPad compartment and various organiser pockets.

The bicycle fork mount was developed for the professional and secure transport of road and mountain bikes. The major component parts of the product are made of aluminium and nylon. It is based on a quick-exchange system for mounting a conventional 9-mm fork or a 15-mm through-axle fork using a quick-release mechanism. The configuration does not necessitate the use of tools. A central locking system secures the bicycle to the carrier.

The multifunctional CBS chair programme embodies a modern vision of a chair series conceived to satisfy the expectations of a broad target group. The elegant design underscores the chair’s comfort with a wide, enveloping back, which is based on an extremely thin one-piece nylon shell. Finely cut in the lumbar area, the back provides enhanced freedom of movement during sitting. The CBS chair is available with a black or white shell, each with or without coloured pads. There is also an optional metal frame, allowing for several different configurations.

This eyewear collection features a special coating, which creates a glossy look and striking patterns on very light polymer frames. Hand-stitched elastic nylon strings connected to the joints put less stress on the material and enhance flexibility of the temple movement. With the aid of metal components, the titanium temples can function with spring effect during folding and unfolding.

The Freeride Pro 20L daypack was developed for freeriders and freeskiers, featuring a variety of storage compartments, attachment possibilities, as well as an integrated back protector that can also be detached and used separately. The design concept focuses on important functions required for use on mountains: ergonomic neoprene shoulder straps and a wide hip-belt with Velcro and buckle fastenings ensure high wearing comfort, while a signalling whistle and a quickly accessible avalanche compartment allow users to react expeditiously in case of emergency.

This tyre for utility terrain vehicles (UTV), with its innovative design using a nylon material, conforms to the current trend of making UTV tyres, like sedan tyres, out of polyester and with a steel belt. The result is a reinforced radial tyre which is also given a newly developed, concave profile. This means that the tyre is not only flatter than usual but above all offers better and more stable driving on rough terrain.

The Tapole Series T is manufactured in an innovative process which enables production of the frame of nylon and titanium without the use of screws or adhesives. Based on the properties of titanium alloy, by laser cutting and bending the sheet of titanium, a consistent hinge structure is created. The temples of the frame, which weighs less than 6.5 grams, are very flexible and easily adjustable.

With only 11 x 22 cm the Lofoten 1 ULW exhibits an exceptionally small pack size, and with 490 grams an extremely low weight for a double-walled one person tent. Stable aluminium poles with particularly short segments enable the reduced pack size, and the seven denier nylon of 26g/sqm with a thread count of 580 the extreme low weight. On both sides the fabric is siliconised in three layers thus guaranteeing high elasticity, and the water column of 1,600 mm creates a pleasant microclimate.

The design of this facial cleansing device is inspired by the shape of an egg and a bird’s nest. Its translucent body provides a view of one of the soft brushes inside. While the silicone brush is suitable for daily use, the nylon brush has been specially developed for the cleansing of oily skin and the puff head helps to remove makeup. Using high-frequency sonic vibration, the device removes dead skin and massages skincare products deeply into the skin.

materials.name: ABS
materials.description: ABS常用名称为ABS塑料或ABS树脂，中文全称为丙烯腈—丁二烯—苯乙烯共聚物。它综合了刚性、韧性、尺寸稳定性和较好的表面加工性能，可通过注塑、挤出、机加工与表面涂装制成复杂外壳。常见于家电、电子产品、玩具、工具外壳、汽车内饰和模型制作。
materials.cognitiveText: ABS在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.17–0.34 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: This patented suitcase system features a hard top and bottom crafted from ABS with 600D polyester lamination. The rest of the suitcase is made of a robust nylon fabric, which is otherwise commonly used in hiking boots. Fibreglass connecting rods reinforce the construction and reduce its overall weight. Apart from the trolley rods, the suitcase offers an integrated handle and allows quick access to selected items thanks to pockets on the front panel.

The Sky fountain pen focuses on the essential. The combination of a plain design and good price-performance ratio with high-quality materials make this a practical pen for daily use. Sky is made of ABS and is available in a wide range of colours. In addition to opaque options, the pen also comes in transparent plastic to reveal the inner working. Core components such as the nib are made in Germany.

The Urbanaut bicycle helmet was developed especially for e-bike users and is specially designed to resist the significant forces that can occur during falls at higher speeds. This is achieved by the fusion of different materials. The inner shell is made of two expanded polystyrene materials of different density that provide support and also a shock-absorbing function. The outer shell features a combination of ABS layers and polycarbonate, which minimizes the helmet’s volume and weight, guaranteeing optimal shock protection. Ventilation is regulatable via integrated air vents.

ZUS is a smart car charger and locating device. As soon as the car has been parked, ZUS stores the actual location on the owner’s smartphone so that the car can be found again at any time. The device charges connected devices twice as quickly as conventional chargers with 4.8 amperes. By the use of a special PC / ABS plastic and titanium-coated metal components, ZUS can withstand temperatures of up to 100 degrees Celsius.

The CE5X computer series offers modular desktop PCs with customisable I/O panels and flexible hardware configuration for a wide range of working environments. This makes it compatible with various motherboards and hardware configurations and enables easy reconfiguration of the ports. Tool-free assembly and an integrated handle facilitate use and maintenance. The status display provides real-time information on system load and dust accumulation via light signals.

The Husqvarna Skutta electric scooter is an advanced solution for urban mobility with a look reminiscent of modern motorbikes. The scooter is easy to operate and is characterised by a removable battery and a specially developed folding design around the front axle. Thanks to the larger front tyre and the low riding position, the Husqvarna Skutta offers stability when cornering and responsive braking performance. The high-quality components and suitability for everyday use are combined in a robust and modern package.

This selfie stick is tailored to the needs of video bloggers and can be used as a floor-standing stick. Despite its compact dimensions, it offers three-axis stability. Thanks to its ergonomic design and rubberised handle, the stick is easy to hold for longer periods of time and can be used with one hand. The use of aluminium alloys and ABS plastic makes the stick durable and informs its contemporary appearance.

Performance, durability and rugged aesthetics are at the forefront of the SanDisk Extreme SSD. It consists of a rigid ABS core with a silicone exterior that is water-repellent, dustproof and protects against damage from impact. In addition, the silicone is silky smooth and has a pleasant feel. The recess for a carabiner and the discreet perforated pattern give the SSD a distinctive look with high recognition value.

The design of the ONE fountain pen was inspired by traditional writing quills, and the width of the nib corresponds to common Chinese handwriting customs. The casing is made from high-quality ABS material, which makes it robust and resistant to damage through falling or wear. Its surface is roughened, so that the fountain pen lies comfortably in the hand. Thanks to its low weight it facilitates writing by hand for a long time without causing fatigue.

The compact steriliser was designed for the disinfection of milk bottles. It is characterised by a clear and friendly design language. The asymmetrical form of the front door clearly emphasises the black touch panel, which enables easy operation. In addition to UV disinfection, the appliance offers features for safe bottle storage and hot air drying. A body made of high-quality ABS plastic with an interior made of stainless steel guarantees a durable use.

The tankless water purifier from LG impresses with its slim design and a faucet that can be turned by 180 degrees. Therefore, the appliance can be easily installed in any area of the kitchen. Moreover, the faucet detects the height of the vessel and adjusts automatically to avoid splashes when pouring. The body is made of metallic ABS plastic with a hairline pattern and provides a particularly high-quality appearance. The control panels have a user-friendly design.

The instax mini Link 2 connects the real world with the virtual in a simple yet fun way. This smartphone printer features a new AR function that can be used to draw in the air with a variety of effects when taking pictures. With a wide range of unique functions to enjoy creating photos, it inspires creativity and priceless interactions with friends and family.

cases.productName: SmartAppGuided™ Sonic Warm & Cool Mask I 9 in 1
cases.description: The Sonic Warm & Cool Mask was developed for an all-around spa-like facial treatment. The pore-opening deep-warming technology primes the skin for the optimal absorption of serums and creams. For closing the pores and a depuffing effect, the structured ABS surface turns cold in seconds.

This can opener is easier and safer to use than traditional versions. A user locks onto the can and simply turns the knob to cut off the lid, eliminating the need to continually compress the handles. The opener pierces the lid and locks securely onto cans of all sizes. A magnet with a release lever lifts the lid and releases it for safe and easy disposal. Simply press a button to release the lid – hands never touch it. Handles are ABS-covered with Santoprene rubber for a durable, non-slip grip.

Venova is a wind instrument that lets beginners enjoy tenor saxophone-like playing feel and performance. The Venova’s branched pipe structure and meandering shape produce a saxophone-like tone from a compact portable form with few keys. It is made of light impact-resistant washable ABS resin. The simple maintainability and recorder-style fingering help inexperienced players learn to play the instrument. It offers a feel and tone that satisfies advanced players as well. The series includes soprano and alto versions too, offering the enjoyment of playing in three registers.

The Square Solidity door lock series redefines home security as a lifestyle statement, offering three models tailored to modern living: the premium push-pull type, the standard lever type, and the practical mini lever type. At its core is the rectangular, angular handle, designed not only for a sturdy, ergonomic grip but also as a refined lifestyle object that complements modern home aesthetics. As American lifestyles diversify and elevate with rising economic prosperity, homes increasingly reflect personalized values and tastes. In this context, Square Solidity transcends its role as a security device, becoming a curated design element that enhances daily rituals and home identity. Constructed from PC, ABS, and metal, the locks balance durability with aesthetic excellence, while the minimized parting lines and absence of decorative pieces reinforce a sleek, modern profile. Ultimately, Square Solidity offers functional elegance, transforming the entryway into a personalized design statement that reflects contemporary lifestyles.

cases.productName: Electric Pumice Foot Smoothing Spinning Sphere
cases.description: The SmartAppGuided™ Electric Pumice Foot Smoothing Spinning Sphere | 8 in 1 delivers advanced, customizable foot care with professional-grade results. This compact device features an array of attachments—'Regular', 'Precise', and 'Comfort'—for versatile exfoliation and smoothing. Its innovative technology includes a Dry and Dead Cell Removing System, painless exfoliation, and adjustable spin speed to cater to all skin types. The Easy Exchange Discs and protective cap ensure convenience and longevity. It represents the pinnacle of luxury foot care at home.

cases.productName: Electric Pumice Foot Smoothing Roller with Handle
cases.description: The SmartAppGuided™ Electric Pumice Foot Smoothing Roller | 7 in 1 by GESKE is a cutting-edge foot care device designed for effortless foot rejuvenation. Its professional-grade VelvetSole System and multiple exfoliation modes ensure smooth, callus-free feet. Equipped with a durable pumice stone and adjustable spin speed, it tailors to different skin needs. The sleek design includes a protective cap and easy-click attachments for maximum hygiene and convenience. Supported by the GESKE app, users receive personalized routines and AI-powered skin scans.

The industrial design of the Leica Cine Play 1 is based on Leica's core guiding principle, "das Wesentliche". The mini projector is designed in accordance to our philosophy of simplicity and reduction, authenticity in materials, excellence of execution and precision in the details. The swing arm and the variation between baseplates for table use and a floorbased use without disturbing power cords is one of the main features of the product design. The design features and highlights demonstate how the design language of our products is always consistent with the underlying engineering with function playing a central role to all product design.

PURE ONE STATION is a self-cleaning vacuum station that offers an intelligent, efficient, and healthy home cleaning solution. Integrated with the vacuum cleaner, it has an automatic cleaning mechanism that activates after each use, ensuring a dust-free state. Equipped with a 6-liter ABS dustbin, users can use it for up to 60 days without frequent waste handling or additional consumables. The pet grooming attachment addresses hair scattering issues. This innovative solution embodies advanced technology and user-friendliness, providing a convenient, effective, and hygienic home cleaning experience.

materials.name: PET
materials.description: PET常用名称为PET塑料或聚酯，化学名称为聚对苯二甲酸乙二酯。它可制成透明容器、薄膜、片材和纤维，具有较好的强度、气体阻隔性、尺寸稳定性和可回收性。结晶程度与加工状态会改变透明度和耐热性，常用于饮料瓶、食品包装、电子薄膜、纺织纤维及工程塑料。
materials.cognitiveText: PET在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.17–0.4 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: This hammock is reminiscent of a Venetian gondola which floats gently over the water. The height-adjustable lying surface is made from recycled plastic bottles and adapts itself to the user’s requirements. The reinforced frame, along with well-considered connecting elements and fourfold tilt protection, assures the necessary safety. The hammock may also be equipped with an awning.

The BULLET is a robust polycarbonate piece of luggage with a rugged look and feel, inspired by off-road SUVs. It is made from RCS-certified, recycled PET bottles. The two handles on the top combine comfort and functionality and make it easier to lift the suitcase when it is heavy. Shock-absorbing edges, inner padding and anti-theft zips offer optimum protection. Functions such as an integrated laundry compartment for separating worn and clean clothes make it easier to keep things tidy when travelling.

This heat-repellent film for car windows is an efficient thermal insulator. It uses XIR PRO technology which reflects infrared waves with a wavelength greater than 1,350 mm, thus preventing a rise in temperature in the car interior. The film, in addition, affords further safety protection. The use of an environmentally friendly PET substrate not only reduces glare and improves visibility but furthermore limits the shattering of glass in case of an accident.

The WNC LAXY 5G CPE + Wi-Fi 7 Extender consists of networked 5G end devices for home use that combine high connection speed with a resource-saving design. They support the Matter smart home standard and Wi-Fi 7 and are manufactured using recycled materials, including PCR plastics, PET fibres and oyster shells. The devices are based on a symmetrical three-component structure that is manufactured using two injection moulds, thus reducing production waste.

The colourful woven rugs in the Strata collection were created as part of a fruitful collaboration between the traditional carpet manufacturer Rols and the textile design studio Wallace#Sewell. Both are united not only by high-quality standards, but also by an appreciation of traditional craftsmanship, innovative thinking and, not least, a sustainable philosophy. Designed according to the motto “Archive of Earth Memories” by Wallace#Sewell and produced at the Rols weaving mills, these rugs pay homage to our planet’s diverse landscapes and colours. Rols has been using the traditional Wilton knotting technique for more than a century and, over the years, has passed the necessary skills down from one generation to the next. The partners have endeavoured to preserve this special rug-making expertise, while at the same time creating an aesthetic, contemporary look. Vibrant patterns and colours as well as precise workmanship are key building blocks in this process. Rols has a strong commitment to sustainability, which is why energy-efficient production, the use of local yarn processing partners and a considered choice of materials are important priorities. Recycled post-consumer PET bottles are used to create the yarn for eight differently patterned Strata rugs. As a material it is remarkably well-suited for making rugs, even ones with complex patterns, and it offers decisive functional advantages. Thanks to the extreme durability of the innovative yarn and UV treatment, the rugs are perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. “The surface of the Strata rugs feels absolutely natural and soft. They are a pleasure to walk on and meticulously executed. Craftsmanship and functionality have come together here to make a great product,” said the impressed jury. “We were also captivated by the brilliant colours.” This luminosity is typical of designs by Wallace#Sewell, and they add a vibrancy and energy to living spaces. Strata literally weaves together a poetic idea, a dramatic look, an innovative material and meticulous craftsmanship – these rugs represent originality that is both beautiful and functional.

Securipak2.0 is an improved anti-theft backpack in which the main compartment and all pockets are only accessible from the back. A cut-resistant fabric provides additional protection against theft. The backpack has been ergonomically designed for greater carrying comfort and, despite its minimalist aesthetics, it has numerous functions, including an RFID-protected compartment, zip pockets and two open pockets for quick access. For the sake of the environment, the outer material is made from recycled PET bottles using a dope-dyeing process.

The design of the Orbis Circular Collection bags is focused on the complete recyclability of the material used. In order to guarantee a closed material cycle in the production of the luggage and not produce any new waste, all elements – from the upper material to the zips and lining – are made from one and the same material: PET/polyester. “The consistent recycling of existing materials conserves valuable resources,” said the jury, highlighting the special sustainability aspect of the modern bag series. The collection consists of two rucksacks with practical, minimalistic designs, a laptop bag with a handle and a travel or sports bag with several compartments.

With its compact design, the RASPAIL Soft Trunk – a combination of trolley suitcase and duffle bag – is exceptionally versatile. It can be carried, lifted and tucked away using the handle on the front, and pulled over longer distances thanks to integrated wheels and a retractable telescopic tube. The trolley features a separate shoe compartment and is closed with a security zipper. The product was also designed with sustainability in mind as the water-repellent outer material is made from recycled water bottles.

The containers of the modular Jive Recycling Bin system are used for space-saving waste separation. A wide front flap is easy to open and facilitates the disposal of glass, paper, PET, can, cardboard and plastic waste. The two large handles are connected to the securely closing lid and ensure comfortable transport. With enclosed, graphically reduced stickers, the containers can be marked for different types of waste.

The main compartment of this backpack is only accessible from the back. This feature protects against theft, as do the hidden side pockets, of which one is RFID-protected. Behind the body fabric, there is a cut-resistant layer. The bag is equipped with an integrated and hidden USB port to connect easily with electronic devices carried inside. The outer material is a special fabric created by using 100 per cent recycled PET bottles. The backpack comes in eleven colours and two different dimensions.

Curio-city is a wall-mounted playground for cats. The material made from PET (polyethylene terephthalate) is not only environmentally friendly, sound-absorbing and fireproof, but, thanks to its soft texture, also represents an ideal wall panelling cats like to scratch and rub against. An L-shaped metal bracket provides a simple stand construction whose fittings hide expertly in the flexibly placeable elements that are different in size. They consist of laterally stacked panels and offer superb playing possibilities.

EcoFusionAI is a next-generation recycling and 3D printing system that transforms discarded PET bottles directly into filament using AI-driven automation. By eliminating traditional grinding steps, it lowers energy consumption and costs, making it accessible for schools, makerspaces, and small businesses. Its cutting bar precisely slices bottles for direct heating and extrusion, while a robotic arm autonomously loads new material. Semi-transparent panels foster user engagement, and intelligent dashboards provide real-time progress and environmental insights. This streamlined process not only reduces plastic waste but also promotes hands-on sustainability education. Through advanced simulation, development costs were minimized, ensuring a polished, user-friendly product. As a result, EcoFusionAI stands out as a unique, practical solution in the sustainable manufacturing sector, bridging creativity, efficiency, and environmental responsibility.

The IONIQ 5 N, the N series’ first high-performance EV, represents Hyundai’s long-standing legacy of offering high-quality mobility alongside driver-focused N models. Sustainable materials are applied throughout IONIQ 5 N, including recyclable paperette door decorative garnish, BIO PET yarn from sugarcane, recycled PET yarn from recycled PET bottles, BIO TPO from sugarcane, and eco-processed leather. IONIQ 5 N also adds recycled tire pigment paint and recycled poly Alcantara seat cover cloth. Under the hood, it combines the standard model’s Electrified-Global Modular Platform (E-GMP) with N’s motorsport-bred technologies and leverages N’s expertise from electrified Rolling Labs to maximize the EV’s high-performance capabilities.

cases.productName: Circular Plastics – Returning Waste to Use in Africa
cases.description: Circular Plastics is a collaboration between three universities and one NGO in the UK with project partners in Kenya, Rwanda, and Nigeria. Together they developed a technology-led strategy to reduce waste by transforming used plastic water bottles into products that support entrepreneurship in low-to-middle-income countries. The team devised an extruding process that converts polyethylene terephthalate (PET) from plastic bottles into 3D printer filament. To date, six innovative products have been launched that support self-sufficiency and economic development in the agriculture, mineral extraction, fishing, and mobility sectors in LMIC areas.

This design challenge involved creating a design to take the Ramlösa brand of mineral water from glass to plastic PET without reducing the premium impression and positioning of Ramlösa in restaurants. In addition to the bottle’s sculpted design, the label and the graphics enhance the high-end feeling by creating an unbroken seal that assures quality.

Attaching to ubiquitous drop-ceiling T-grids, the three-dimensional magnetic TURF Acoustic Ceiling Tiles, made from recycled PET, allows for endless customization. Acoustic levels and noise within modern open spaces and hard-surface environments are a constant distraction that impact productivity and focus. Solutions are limited, very expensive and many times require specialized installation. The TURF Acoustic Ceiling Tile System is an intelligent solution to environmental noise that leverages inspiring aesthetics, customer expression and customization, functional design and engineering, low-cost manufacturing, recycled materials, and magnetic plug-n-play contractor-friendly installation onto drop ceiling grids. TURF’s ability to offer functional performance and transformative aesthetics without compromise while complementing existing construction workflows and budgets sets this product apart in the market. Any trade can install TURF: ceiling contractors, painters, electricians, facilities management—virtually anyone.

The ECO 6L Refillable Filtered Water Bottle was designed to be refilled in any ECO Filtration Fountain, allowing the whole family to opt for more conscious, sustainable water consumption. It is made of recyclable PET (BPA free), with a UV filter that protects water from sunlight. Offering two positions of use, vertical and horizontal, the bottle is easy to transport and store in the refrigerator on its side. The drop present in the brand logo defines the shape of the bottle, and the shape of the bottle allows it to be stored horizontally—a synergy of form, function, and branding.

This provides a new twist on the traditional recycling container. Made entirely from post-consumer recycled PET soda and water bottles, the bin encourages people to recycle at the same time as it showcases the design potential of recycled plastic. It ships flat for maximum transport and deployment efficiency.

The ADITUSEcoLanyard is an innovative holder for wearing badges, specifically designed for sustainable event management. It is only made from 100% recycled and recyclable PET (rPET), making it ideal for trade shows and conferences. Badges, which are central to networking, can be worn optimally. Unlike conventional lanyards that are difficult to recycle and often end up in the trash, the ADITUSEcoLanyard does not require metal clips or carabiners. Its unique design features notches that securely hold the badge and allows for easy local recycling after the event, similar to PET bottles. It is stable, safe, and environmentally friendly.

The robust Armox travel bag is built for outdoor adventures thanks to a hybrid construction that combines a flexible front panel made of tear-resistant, coated ripstop fabric with a sturdy ABS hard shell back panel laminated with fabric to achieve seamless surface integration. The travel bag offers an enhanced user experience thanks to its suspension wheels which absorb shocks and noise. It also features two practical front pockets and has an exterior fabric and lining made entirely of recycled PET plastic.

materials.name: 竹材
materials.description: 竹材常用名称为竹材或竹木，来源于竹秆，经干燥、防护、剖分、层压或重组后可形成板材和构件。其纤维沿生长方向排列，具有较高比强度和鲜明纹理，但性能受竹种、部位、含水率及胶合方式影响。常用于家具、餐具、地板、包装、建筑构件和可持续产品设计。
materials.cognitiveText: 竹材在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.39–0.59 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: The continuation of the work-at-home trend is associated with challenges to remote workers. Their homes do not always have enough space for the integration of an attractive and ergonomic workstation that leaves the look and feel of the room fundamentally intact. Float Mini offers the perfect solution with its compact design and cosy aesthetics. The rounded corners, slim profile and matt textures help it blend harmoniously into a home environment without sacrificing functionality – a feature that only becomes obvious during use. An off-centre base ensures that no table legs get in the way when the users change their sitting position, and the infinitely variable height adjustment feature permits ergonomic working while standing. Humanscale is both the name and the mission of the manufacturer, whose products are consistently designed for user-centric functionality. Float Mini can also be fitted with castors for mobility, and the desktop options of bamboo, MDF or linoleum in a warm colour palette cater to personal preferences. “Float Mini is reminiscent of the wabi-sabi aesthetic,” commented the Red Dot jurors. “The asymmetrical design ensures that it can perfectly fulfil its function. It offers a remarkable level of quality and user convenience, and the desk is adaptable to a variety of settings beyond the home office, such as hotels or living spaces.” The product designers spent a long time fine-tuning Float Mini to achieve its intuitive functionality and unique character. Every detail, from the geometry of the base to the mechanical feel of the height adjustment, was worked on until perfection was achieved. The materials were intentionally chosen to balance aesthetic appeal, eco-friendliness and longevity. Last but not least, the minimalist design reflects the modern-day consumer demand for products that are repairable and made of just a few components. “Fewer parts mean fewer potential points of failure, easier disassembly and better recyclability,” said the product designers. All variants of Float Mini prove that this approach produces beautiful results.

The Float Mini table seamlessly blends classic residential aesthetics with Humanscale’s renowned ergonomic design, offering a compact, versatile solution for both home and workspaces. Designed to promote natural movement, Float Mini effortlessly adjusts to various heights, providing an essential component for an ergonomic setup that enhances user well-being. Available in a refined palette of colors, Float Mini complements any environment, with surface options that include sustainable bamboo and a new natural linoleum material. This eco-friendly linoleum is wear-resistant, anti-static, and fingerprint-proof, featuring a soft matte finish.

Bathtubs, in particular stand-alone ones, offer little to no space to store items like towels, shampoo, books, glasses, and tablets. TUBLER, the bathroom butler, is a flexible piece of furniture for stand-alone bathtubs that can also be used with built-in bathtubs. TUBLER is manufactured mainly from eco-friendly bamboo, cotton, and stainless steel, withstands the bathroom environment, and is fully recyclable. TUBLER is a space-saving, highly practical combination of shelf and table for almost all bathtubs on the market.

materials.name: 钢化玻璃
materials.description: 钢化玻璃常用名称为钢化玻璃或强化玻璃，是普通玻璃经热处理或化学强化形成表面压应力的安全玻璃。它的抗弯和抗热冲击能力通常高于未强化玻璃，破碎时热钢化玻璃会形成较小颗粒。常用于建筑门窗、家具、家电面板、汽车侧窗、手机保护盖板和展示装置。
materials.cognitiveText: 钢化玻璃在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.94–1.1 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: The ARTEVO TERRA window system guarantees sustainability throughout its entire life cycle. The profiles are made of bio-attributed PVC on the outside and up to 78 per cent recycled PVC in the core. The glazing beads contain up to 80 per cent recycled material. The fibre composite material makes steel superfluous in 80 per cent of applications, thus reducing CO₂ emissions. The LowE profile technology optimises thermal insulation and meets passive house standards. The system is fully recyclable; digital labelling facilitates end-of-life recycling.

The Sonnenglas Light Carafe is a hand-blown glass carafe that transforms into an atmospheric table lamp with the manufacturer’s SOMO solar light. Only recycled bottle glass collected by locals in Eswatini (Africa) is used in the production process. This work is the sole source of income for many, and it also contributes to a cleaner environment. Manufactured in a solar-powered factory, the Light Carafe is highly functional and has a timeless aesthetic.

The Wuliangye Project Vision combines the aesthetics of industrial mechanics with the Fibonacci spiral to symbolise the connection between nature, time and innovation. The outer packaging of the fine, traditional spirit hints at the precise curves and structural shape of the bottle inside. A glass window provides a glimpse of the interior. The proportions of the high-end metal bottle adhere to the golden ratio, and its spiral shape invites playful interaction.

VB600 Dual Eyes Video Bar is a video conferencing system with dual-lens technology for medium and large meeting rooms. It combines high audio and video quality with intelligent functions such as auto-framing and speaker tracking. A one-touch privacy function increases security. Thanks to its user-friendliness and flexibility, the system is suitable for various application areas, including financial consulting and medical technology, and thus meets the increasing demand for remote solutions.

The ultra-slim, foldable casing of the Xiaomi Mix Fold 4 is both lightweight and robust. Its seamless design with glass, metal and fibreglass creates a pleasant feel and an elegant look. The quad-curved glass of the display blends harmoniously into the metal casing, while the back is made of Dragon Scale Fibre, a material composed of ceramic and aramid. Combined with sophisticated hinge technology, it increases shock resistance.

The design of the Xiaomi 14 Ultra is defined by its prominently placed camera, emphasising the device's advanced photo and video capabilities. Its metal casing ensures high stability and pressure resistance, while the quad-curved screen enhances both the visual and tactile user experience. The device is complemented by accessories, such as a photo grip with a shutter button and zoom function, a 1,500 mAh battery for extended use and an adapter ring for filters.

The iPad Pro M4 is the thinnest Apple product to date. It combines high computing power with an extremely flat design. The 11" model measures 5.3 mm, the 13" model only 5.1 mm. Both versions are made from recycled aluminium and are available in silver or black. A tandem OLED display ensures precise image reproduction. An anti-reflective nano-glass surface is available as an option. Despite the reduced weight, stability is maintained, facilitating mobile work processes considerably.

The TCL 50 PRO NXTPAPER 5G is a smartphone with a focus on visual comfort and material-conscious design. Its battery cover is just 0.34 mm thin and is paired with a newly developed frame that enhances the visual experience by remaining nearly invisible. The matt screen surface features a nano-etched microstructure to reduce eye strain. This device is aimed at users who prioritise an ergonomic design language and thoughtful functionality.

The Xiaomi Civi4 Pro is a particularly slim smartphone designed for young, fashion-conscious users. Thanks to its low weight, it sits comfortably in the hand. The back combines two colours with a mother-of-pearl-like sheen, while the camera ring with its finely polished structure is reminiscent of luxury watches. A Snapdragon chip and Leica image processing ensure high image quality and smooth performance with continuous use.

The ROG Phone 9 is a gaming smartphone with features suitable for everyday use. Its integrated hybrid camera allows for precise recording, while AI-powered translation and transcription for calls provide additional convenience. A 5,800 mAh battery ensures a long runtime, while the five-part cooling system keeps performance stable. The 185 hertz AMOLED display, a lateral charging port and a headphone connector enhance the gaming experience. The device is IP68-rated and made of recycled aluminium.

The Zenfone 12 Ultra combines rugged outdoor capability with a sustainable design concept. The back is made from etched glass without additional coatings, the frame uses recycled aluminium, and the display glass contains 22 per cent recycled materials. The camera features a 6-axis gimbal with AI optimisation and an algorithm for stable 4K videos. A 6.78" display with 144 Hz, IP68 certification and a 5,500 mAh battery complete the smartphone’s high-performance profile.

With a 40.2 MP sensor and in-body image stabilisation, the FUJIFILM X100VI delivers high image quality even in low light conditions. The camera’s retro aesthetic is achieved through a tactile, analogue feel reminiscent of classic film cameras. The machined dial, non-slip exterior and aluminium top plate reinforce this impression. And advanced hybrid viewfinder and a flat, fold-out LCD display ensure flexibility. The compact and lightweight camera is available in both silver and black versions.

The Strato V enables 4K playback with Dolby Vision and lossless audio. It can be used independently or in conjunction with Terra servers. An Strato V 960GB SSD can store around ten 4K films, while the newly developed user interface makes it easy to navigate smaller film archives. Movies can be downloaded in around 10 minutes via Gigabit Ethernet during playback without compromising performance. The device is housed in a sleek, high-quality black anodised aluminium and glass case.

Flat proportions, frameless windows, flush door handles and a precisely shaped front with a shark nose characterise the appearance of the all-electric NIO ET5 Touring. A continuous glass roof visually opens up the interior, and LiDAR technology for autonomous driving functions is seamlessly integrated. Digital user interfaces, ambient lighting and an innovative battery changing system complement the vehicle’s design, which is characterised by understated elegance and user-friendliness.

The SV-M4K200 Series Medical Endoscopic Camera System is an integrated platform for endoscopic imaging using a crane and trolley. It supports various light sources, control devices and 2D/3D controllers for different needs. A washable 8″ glass panel and an IPX7-certified ergonomic handle meet high hygiene standards and prevent fatigue. The integrated electronic 3D optics enable automatic image correction and switching between 2D and 3D. High-resolution images facilitate the identification of difficult-to-observe lesions.

The intelligent N5 POS system integrates QR code scanning, NFC, chip and magnetic stripe payment options into one compact device. Voice guidance, backlit buttons and an illuminated scan area with colour gradient enhance usability and ensure an intuitive payment experience. A combination of glass surfaces, aluminium and floating design elements creates a modern, technical appearance. The terminal’s elongated shape optimises its functionality on narrow counters, making it ideal for retail, banking and the service sector.

The SANTAK Micro Data Center is a compact, integrated IT infrastructure solution. It consolidates essential IT components into pre-fabricated, self-contained modules and was designed to offer rapid deployment, flexible expansion and easy maintenance. Asymmetrical shapes, smooth surfaces and a full-glass screen characterise its visual appearance. The operation units are integrated onto the back side of the screen, which simplifies the overall design and also allows for effortless operation.

NWP500 is a heating pump water heater for the centralised supply of residential buildings. By utilising ambient air, the system works much more energy-efficiently than conventional electric water heaters and also reduces CO₂ emissions. The well-thought-out arrangement of the connections enables space-saving and simple installation. It is operated via an ergonomically positioned touchscreen display or a clearly organised app. The inner container is made of corrosion-resistant stainless steel and the thermal insulation is made of climate-friendly HFO foam.

HYSTYLE WOOD is a versatile glazing system that combines high energy efficiency with architectural restraint. The large glazing areas create open spaces. The system is available with single, double or triple glazing and is suitable for classic inswing opening mechanisms as well as top hung or side hung outswing openings. HYSTYLE WOOD is available in two wood finishes: with pressure-glued natural wood profiles or as a hybrid combination of recycled wood and recycled aluminium.

The COLMO Whole-House Smart Series integrates lighting, climate, security and appliance functions via a central control unit with a 12.3" display. It enables a natural interaction through face, voiceprint and fingerprint recognition. The system supports five communication protocols, connects up to 128 devices and responds in less than 0.1 seconds. Dark colours and coated glass surfaces blend unobtrusively into modern living spaces, while uniform dimensions and shapes allow for flexible, harmonious interior design.

materials.name: 混凝土
materials.description: 混凝土常用名称为混凝土，工程中也简称“砼”，由水泥、骨料、水及必要外加剂拌合并硬化形成。它抗压能力较强、可浇筑成复杂形状且成本相对可控，但抗拉性能较弱，常与钢筋组合使用。除建筑结构外，也用于家具、灯具、花器和公共设施等产品，表观性能受配比、养护和孔隙影响。
materials.cognitiveText: 混凝土在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 1.4–2 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: Design innovations are often the product of technology transfer. In the case of Furniture Linoleum, the innovative aspect is first and foremost a carefully considered material transfer that has led to a sustainable product with aesthetic appeal. Forbo Flooring had previously focused on the production of high-quality flooring materials before deciding to diversify its portfolio and expertise in the furniture sector with Furniture Linoleum. Now the time-tested material of linoleum is captivating a new audience with its natural, warm feel and excellent durability as a contemporary surface finish for home and kitchen furniture, doors, and much more. “This product embodies our vision of creating functional, durable and environmentally conscious finishes for both flooring and furniture,” says the manufacturer. Linoleum’s climate-positive aspects also contribute to user convenience. Made from renewable and natural raw materials such as linseed oil, wood flour, pine resin and limestone, it has a naturally elegant, matt surface that is resistant to fingerprints. Being easy to clean, Furniture Linoleum is also an interesting option for the customised furnishing of public spaces. Forbo Flooring complements all of these positive properties with an attractive range of 24 colours that blend seamlessly with natural woods and stones, such as oak, walnut and maple, or marble, concrete and terrazzo. A special aesthetic has been achieved with the “Pure Linoleum” decor, which completely dispenses with colour pigments to showcase the natural shade of linseed oil. Like leather and wood, each piece is unique and alters in appearance over time. The Red Dot jurors were fascinated by the natural look and feel: “What really impressed us about Furniture Linoleum is this focus on material purity. The special yet subtle tactile warmth of the surfaces makes them feel comforting to the touch. Another remarkable aspect is the unique natural aroma of linoleum that is pleasant to perceive. This material represents tangible quality. It is honest, thoughtfully designed and delivers genuine added value for healthy interior spaces.”

The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

The planning concept for the SHIROYAMA commercial space combines concrete walls and brickwork with new furnishings and modern fittings. Open ceilings create visual interaction between the different levels. The multifunctional zones for dining, exhibitions and product displays are based on principles of the experience economy. Inspired by the theme “Immersed in a Dialogue with the Mountains”, the interior design unites nature, culture and people, fostering a space for contemplation and social interaction that goes beyond conventional usage concepts.

The litter bin Bien was designed for public spaces and is available in different sizes and designs depending on the city's needs – optionally with a practical sorting function. It impresses with its timeless shape and high-quality design. A key feature of Bien is the material harmony between concrete and steel, which ensures high processing quality and great resistance to natural elements. The successful contrast between the opening and the container underlines the function and use of the litter bin.

The soap dispenser, toothbrush tumbler and toilet brush of the TIME bathroom series are made of concrete. The matching pedal bin of the series is made of ABS plastic. The equally stable and soft material concrete can be fired at low temperatures. This saves energy during production and is easily recyclable. A silicone layer under the bottom of the products prevents possible surface scratches. “The timeless and simple material sets aesthetic accents in the bathroom and is also a convincing choice from a sustainability point of view,” was the jury’s verdict. The bathroom accessories are available in concrete, black and soft grey.

The Line is a range of timelessly elegant street lighting. The noticeable micro-faceted optic modules integrated into the vertical slim pole deliver a high light output with standard-compliant glare control. As the main body can be given a steel, concrete or bronze surface, it is possible visually to match the luminaire to its surroundings. The range comprises stacks, bollards, pole or wall lights, thereby guaranteeing a wide range of uses in the urban context.

Inspired by architect Antoni Gaudí’s mosaic tile from the year 1906, this minimalist concrete paving slab is also innovative and hexagonal in shape. Two optical dummy joints divide the tile into three sections, one of which is characterised by a precise groove structure. This produces a noticeable, dark shadow effect. The main slab, with its symmetrical design, is complemented by two additional slab formats. Together, the slabs can be used to compose a large variety of different effects by orienting them in different ways.

The Staircase Object 004 is the central element of a comprehensive interior design for the editorial department floor of the fischerAppelt PR- and Marketing agency. It comprises a bar/kitchen, terraced seating, cupboards and display cases and a staircase in a range of materials consisting of concrete, larch and raw steel. At the heart of the complex is the staircase which seems to tower down from the roof garden above and is made of ten “Us” of suitably bent, 15 mm thick, slightly corroded, untreated steel panels that are simply bolted onto the supporting structure. These components vary only in height.

Greenpad is an environmentally friendly concrete system for car parks, roads and walkways as well as landscaping. It has a high capacity for absorbing rain water, because the concrete surface is interrupted by grass areas. In addition, it minimises heat reflection off the surface. The method applied here combines four different modules to create a wide range of patterns. The grass has already been planted in the modules, which are firmly fixed in place using a load bearing structure made of iron rods and concrete.

A newly developed technique has made it possible to create urban concrete benches with flexible shapes. This technique has led to immaculate surfaces and flowing lines that leave traditional, rigid forms far behind. An ordinary material such as concrete has been transformed into a high-quality piece of work. The solid bench looks like an upholstered one. The buttons in the upholstery here serve as drainage holes for rainwater. Structure and surface remain unchanged over time.

In order to make the Monka Hotel blend into its surroundings, its design is deliberately ambiguous, on the border between traditional architecture and more modern styles. The facade features grey concrete, the large windows of different sizes have black frames to give the building a calm exterior. The lobby is fitted with unadulterated materials. A wall clad with original ancient cave stones goes with the concrete floor and the wooden partition. The stairs have an open construction which allows them to reflect the light from outside.

The Shihlien Chemical Biotech Salt Plant Laboratory is a 900-sqm building located in the Chinese city of Huai’an. The laboratory, which is part of a new world-class medical-grade salt production plant, is used by technicians to carry out extensive quality controls and testing procedures. Reflecting this function, the architectural plan is inspired by the form of salt crystals. As an essential focus of the salt production process, the notion of “purity” has also become a motif and the driving concept of visualising the spatial design. Accordingly, the floor plan of the building is conceived as a regular array of salt crystals, featuring a series of offset cubic protrusions to accommodate each of the key functions. While the main building geometries are rectilinear, entrances and key elevations are highlighted by contrasting fluid curvatures to create welcoming gestures to users. Meanwhile, the building interior showcases a crisp and restrained design: white walls, linear strip lighting, as well as light-coloured tiles that lend the ambience a fresh and clear appeal. In key rooms, a warmer atmosphere is conjured by combining wood and exposed concrete. Full-height low-emissivity glazing provides ample daylighting and allows people working inside pleasant views of the surrounding picturesque Jiangsu countryside from their workspaces.

Storm System brings together various ceiling elements mounted in an installation ring, which is flush with the ceiling. Using the innovative “snap lock” technique, various fixtures are easily mounted into the ring. Users have a choice of 17 elements such as lighting, speakers, cameras, smoke detectors, ventilation systems, motion detectors and cable outputs. The entire range of fixtures has the same streamlined design and all elements are made of high-quality materials such as aluminium, brass, wood, glass, concrete or leather.

This cheese fondue set takes up the current copper trend but also uses the functional properties of the heat conducting material. The fondue pan, which comes in a retro-look, distributes heat evenly so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. Thanks to this configuration, the heat is effectively directed upwards, so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. In combination with the traditional look of the copper, the high-gloss polished stainless steel handle forms a strong contrast. Moreover, the base, which is made of concrete and stainless steel, lends the set both a stable and decorative appearance.

Inspired by raw industrial aesthetics, the surfaces of RAUVISIO cube feature the cool visual appeal and irregular texture of concrete. With their natural air pores and individually unique surface structure, the panels make a bold statement in any room. A matching edgeband is incorporated to create the appearance of a solid concrete slab. The matt finish obscures fingerprints and smudges so that nothing diminishes the elegant overall impression. The sturdy material can also be processed with standard woodworking tools.

Boost Expression is a collection of porcelain and wall tiles characterised by their textured, three-dimensional concrete effect. Inspired by iconic forms such as circles, lines and ellipses, the tiles provide plenty of scope for indoor and outdoor applications. Natural textures are paired with a pastel colour palette, giving the tiles considerable depth and a distinctive look. The cutting-edge Sensitech surfaces ensure a soft touch, excellent anti-slip properties and outstanding durability.

The TRAX TRUNK Bench aims to enhance public spaces as an emotionally appealing and functional seating option. Inspired by traditional Japanese gardens, the bench is characterised by an innovative design where three laminated pieces of lumber sit atop concrete pillars reinforced with steel plates for stability. The TRAX TRUNK Bench allows for various configurations according to the modular principle. It offers an affordable and sustainable option for municipalities and promotes vibrant community spaces for people of all ages.

Ideally, the interior design of shops and flagship stores creates a parallel world that immediately attracts visitors and in which products can be staged effectively. The aim in designing the JINS Shop in the Shanghai World Financial Center (SWFC) was to create an appealing effect of huge emptiness within a shopping mall which is usually crowded with goods and people. The interior space was to be presented and perceived in the sense of a sculptural architecture. The result has emerged as an impressive solution that stands out for its puristic effect. The interior space of the sales room is composed of five cantilever tables, each made of concrete and with a maximum length of up to 12 metres. The overall concept combines extreme dimensions, a maximum length and a minimum width and depth, in such a manner that it ensures a maximum linear display and freedom of movement for customers. The void space of the shop is divided into six different parts that can contain a large amount of stocks or fulfil other functions such as offering a workshop of glasses fabrication between tables no. 4 and 5. In this shop, the steel structure encased in concrete makes the interior work in an architectural manner. Even the furniture serves as a piece of the structure. Inviting visitors to experience the interior space like a low extending landscape, all tables are arranged horizontally and at a just level, 80 cm high from ground.

The premium X2 Pro Master Edition features a surprisingly artistic approach towards the product. The aim is to pay homage to two of the most common construction materials – concrete and brick – and to convey a sense of solidity and stability, so as to highlight the connection between the real world and the world of technology. The design of this smartphone, with an appealing look and feel, attempts to bridge this gap. It lends new vitality to an industrial product in an imposing combination of art and industrialism, sensitivity and rationality.

This private museum houses a collection of dried fish maws, also known as swim bladders. One of its striking design features is a visible concrete joist pierced by a wooden beam. The entrance hall is fitted out with oak furniture which, together with the oak staircase, gives the space a sober aesthetics. A painting on the subject of man and fish tempts visitors into the exhibition space which is equipped with museum display cases and a strict lighting design so that the shape and texture of the concave exhibits are accentuated to their advantage.

materials.name: 瓷
materials.description: 瓷常用名称为瓷器或瓷质陶瓷，是以高岭土、长石、石英等原料成形并经高温烧结得到的致密陶瓷。它通常质地坚硬、耐磨、耐化学腐蚀并具有良好电绝缘性，但脆性较高。日用瓷、建筑瓷和工程瓷在配方与烧成制度上差异明显，常用于餐具、卫浴、绝缘件、饰面和精密陶瓷部件。
materials.cognitiveText: 瓷在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 1.8–6.5 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: The particularly lightweight Zenbook A14 laptop supports mobile users in urban environments. The rounded shape of the casing and the grey and beige colour scheme, which is inspired by pebbles, ensure pleasant handling and a natural look. Made from a magnesium-aluminium alloy with a ceramic finish, the surface is resistant to scratches and dirt. The device combines high battery performance with robust suitability for everyday use.

The ultra-slim, foldable casing of the Xiaomi Mix Fold 4 is both lightweight and robust. Its seamless design with glass, metal and fibreglass creates a pleasant feel and an elegant look. The quad-curved glass of the display blends harmoniously into the metal casing, while the back is made of Dragon Scale Fibre, a material composed of ceramic and aramid. Combined with sophisticated hinge technology, it increases shock resistance.

The expressive Metalcraft tile range provides scope for creating bathrooms and living spaces in a very individual style. The colour concept encompasses silver and steel tones as well as shades of brown and black with copper, brass and petrol-coloured highlights. Finished with the easy-to-clean CeramicPlus surface, the floor tiles are slip-resistant (R10) and available in four colours and three sizes. They can be combined with large-format wall tiles (40 × 120 cm) from the same range and matching skirting to create either harmony or contrast.

Inspired by the rawness of urban landscapes, the CementEra tiles, with their eye-catching cement aesthetic, embody minimalist elegance. Combining the characteristic texture of concrete with a handmade look, the tiles offer visual depth and sensory appeal. Available in four harmonious colours, they feature traditional marbling patterns and digital marble effects that give floors, work surfaces, walls and facades a calm and modern appearance. The large-format sizes of the tiles ensure a seamless design appearance.

The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

Six bold colours and a rounded silhouette reminiscent of a highlighter define the fresh aesthetic of the Vuse Go Reload Pen. This compact vaporiser heats e-liquids to release flavour and nicotine. With a robust build, carefully chosen materials and a replaceable pod system, it was designed as a sustainable alternative to disposable devices. Integrated ceramic heating technology ensures consistent flavour, and the device can be conveniently recharged via a universal USB-C port.

The Alina collection combines a linear and subtle stylistic language with functional properties that make it ideal for commercial use. Centrally placed embossment structures the surface and creates a focal point in the middle for the presentation of food. All the individual pieces of the tableware set are made from highly resilient hard porcelain and are not only stackable, but also dishwasher, oven and microwave safe, as well as thermal shock and edge chip-resistant for the intense rigours of the hospitality sector.

The Ohtake Basin and Bathtub range comprises a countertop washbasin and a freestanding soaking tub that are inspired by motifs from nature and Japanese culture. The flowing lines and delicate edges of the fine ceramic washbasin bear a resemblance to the elegant shape of the calla lily. The Stonex tub, with its gentle forms and curved contours, is reminiscent of a Japanese Ofuro. Accordingly, this soaking tub is primarily intended for relaxation rather than cleaning.

The floor-standing Bella Smart toilet is characterised by flowing lines that are gently contrasted by the precise lid edge. The Magic Bubble technology creates a dense layer of foam to reduce odours and splashing water, while the dual-clean flush requires less water and efficiently clears the entire bowl, even at low water pressure. Thanks to a ceramic heating tube, the water is instantly heated to a pre-set temperature as soon as the shower function is activated.

Panio features all the characteristics of a porcelain tableware set specifically designed for use in the hospitality industry. It is distinguished by a radial relief based on parametric, fractal geometric patterns. Its tactile, visually appealing surface discreetly highlights the food presented without eclipsing it. With its versatile range, the collection meets all typical gastronomy requirements. All the pieces are dishwasher safe, impact resistant and the thickness of the material ensures that they can withstand intense use.

Tone is an organically shaped, glazed collection of ceramics created for professional use. The gently curved form was inspired by the appearance of scallops, the sea and the structure of textiles. The collection features three harmonising reactive glazes: Sahara, Blush and Adelfa. Made from a once-fired, virtually pore-free premium vitrified material, Tone is durable and energy efficient in manufacture. All the pieces are nestable, functional in their dimensions and crafted for fine dining.

This cookware set performs several functions with just three items. The Glasslock Chef Topf consists of a pot, a lid and a small stove, and can be used to prepare meals as well as serve them at the table. The lid also functions as a frying pan or can be used as a plate. A small air hole allows steam to escape during cooking, thus preventing contents from boiling over. Made from aluminium with a ceramic coating, the set can be used with a range of different heat sources, from electric hobs to air fryers.

The Unwasted tile collection consists of repurposed waste materials such as eggshells, straw residues, reclaimed glass and ceramic waste, thus creating a closed resource cycle. This blend of different materials also creates variously textured surfaces and unique patterns during production, giving the tiles a natural look and feel. At the same time, the waste-based mixture reduces energy consumption as the tiles can be fired at a lower temperature.

As far back as 2000 BC, tiles were being used throughout the Orient. Ornamental motifs decorated the walls and floors of buildings. Mostly the motifs were similar to those seen on oriental carpets. Even today, in some parts of the world, tiles are still baked in the same way that they have been for thousands of years. KuQua ceramic tiles build on the traditional significance of tiles and in doing so represent a symbiosis of ancient workmanship and contemporary design. One is struck above all by the three-dimensional impression of these tiles. This is mainly due to the meeting of two opposites. The ornaments shown on the tiles were developed on a computer and are infinitely repeatable thus leaving nothing to chance. The KuQua series, which comes in three options, is in fact the result of blending spherical and cubic forms and follows a strict geometrical concept. The flower-like ornament, together with the high-gloss coloured glaze, creates a noticeable contrast to the matt, smoke-black appearance of the surface of the ceramic tiles. KuQua tiles are handmade and fired at 1,000°C in an electric kiln. After screen printing, they are fired a second time then immersed in sawdust. Low fired ceramic tiles are very good at storing and regulating warmth and moisture, then releasing both. As a result, they have a positive effect on a room’s environment.

The LG Room & Style monitor was designed for home office use and entertainment. It supports streaming apps and can be used for work, with or without a PC. The device uses a tray as a stand, which also serves to store items, such as the remote control. Also suitable for mounting on a wall or in a caravan, this user-friendly monitor is easy to assemble and disassemble.

The Restroom Dresser Premium Series was developed to transform the home bathroom into an oasis of well-being. Soft lighting, which switches on automatically using a motion sensor, and flowing shapes create a harmonious ambience. Touchless faucet with automatic on/off functions (wall mounted type) and ceramic-glaze basins increase user comfort. The marbled wall panel not only serves as splash protection, but also lends elegance to the ensemble.

The design of the Portico urinal is inspired by decorative elements of traditional Italian courtyard facades. The urinal is made of a rectangular ceramic block with a stylised, gently curved bowl with raised edges at its centre. The geometry of the bowl has been carefully optimised to prevent urine splashes. The battery of the sensor-controlled flush can be replaced in a few simple steps, making maintenance easier. Portico is available in classic white as well as in an anthracite-coloured version.

The VGR-001 electric hair clipper is characterised by a stepless speed control system with an eye-catching digital speed display. With up to 9,000 rpm, it offers powerful performance for various requirements. Fixed DLC blades with ceramic moving blades ensure strength and durability. The device has a Type-C charging port and a docking station with up to 300 minutes of battery life. Other features include an LED light and ten different comb sizes.

The design of the ceramic basin Cobble is inspired by natural lines, expressed in a gentle shaping that is reminiscent of the appearance of a leaf. The 700 mm wide basin is available in various subtle colours and coated with a skin-friendly and at the same time resistant pearl glaze. Thanks to the smooth surface, it is resistant to water stains, limescale deposits and bacteria. This facilitates cleaning and reduces the consumption of environmentally harmful cleaning agents.

PURE VORTEX is based on an innovative vortex flushing system that opens up new possibilities in the design of sanitary ceramics. The water outlet at the front of the toilet, which is not visible at first glance, allows for a smooth surface without the traditional flushing rim. This makes the interior particularly easy to clean. Thanks to the newly developed technology, the flushing process is not only exceptionally quiet but also environmentally friendly, as only 4.5 litres of water are required for a complete flush.

materials.name: 钛合金
materials.description: 钛合金是以钛为基体并加入铝、钒、钼等元素形成的合金体系，常用名称即钛合金。它兼具较低密度、较高比强度、耐腐蚀和生物相容性，α型、β型及α+β型合金的组织和性能不同。常用于航空结构、发动机部件、医疗植入物、化工设备、运动器材和高端消费品。
materials.cognitiveText: 钛合金在“导热系数”尺度中的参数区间为 6.6–6.7 W/(m·K)。

cases.description: The sophisticated design of the VistaPosition PSP imaging plate holder system enables accurate X-rays in dentistry. Thanks to the colour coding, the components can be assembled quickly and intuitively. Clear, easily visible markings ensure exact positioning of the imaging plate, while the anatomically shaped holder ensures comfortable use. The lightweight titanium guide rod also increases patient comfort.

The Amphibio WaveFlex 82XTi is conceived as an all-rounder and provides superior performance for advanced skiers powered by the new Amphibio technology, a perfect combination of rocker and camber. A slightly wider geometry of the ski allows off-piste rides and skiing in deep snow. Due to a laminated wood core, the ski is very robust and responsive, ensuring an efficient transmission of power. Its responsiveness is underlined by the DualTi technology which guarantees aggressive edge control in all snow conditions.

The secret of SPHERE lies in its minimalistic design. Thanks to the use of a simplified but highly functional joint technology, the glasses do not require screws or soldered joints. The hinges each consist of a small steel ball that is precisely connected to the titanium temples with a milled ring. At an average of 13 grams, as a result SPHERE is a highly comfortable everyday accessory. The simplified design and production process lead to less material, less energy and less waste, protecting the environment.

In cycling sports shifting gears quickly is of utmost importance. Even the slightest irregularity can affect the riding flow and translate into a delay in time. The Super Record EPS 2015 is a groupset for road bikes that delivers a drivetrain for highly effective gear shifting performance. A central aspect of its design is that it merges the know-how of a long-established company with highly advanced technology. Specifically, the rear and front derailleurs are equipped with electric motors that allow the rider to shift gears in  a quick and highly precise manner. A single action via the shift control makes it possible to intuitively and seamlessly shift up or down for a multiple number of sprockets (multi-shifting). The shifting itself offers  a high degree of quality and comfort, since the “click feel” and position of the controls have been optimised in order to prevent any risk of unintentional shifting. Another innovation in the field of gear shifts that further enhances the safety of the rider has been realised with the possibility of releasing the rear derailleur from the motor manually for emergency functionality in the event of a fault. Carbon fibre and titanium have been brought together to make the groupset very light and durable. The seamless merging of tradition with modern technology has thus led to an innovative product of elegant appearance that signifies high  efficiency and safety for the rider.

The Smart wrench is made from a special titanium alloy, which provides an excellent combination of corrosion resistance and strength. Furthermore, the material is particularly lightweight and biocompatible. The tool features ergonomic grooves, making it pleasant and easy to use. The housing can be opened and serves as a storage space for various hex socket bits.

The particular form of the Akrapovič Slip-On Line (Titanium) for the Ducati Multistrada 1200 Enduro and Multistrada 950 is characterised by two symmetrical mufflers representing a two-cylinder engine. The use of titanium alloys has reduced the weight by 43 per cent for enhanced handling. The innovative design of the collector ensures an equal flow of exhaust gasses for a deep sound. Details like the handcrafted carbon-fibre heat shield, the laser-engraved logo, the perfect welds, and the sandblasted finish are indicators of precision engineering.

Mi Mix Alpha is an innovative smartphone which instantly catches the eye, especially with its high-resolution display. It wraps almost completely around the device, extending across not just the front of the casing, but also most of the rear, thus giving it a dramatic appearance. With an astounding 108 MP, the camera is unusually powerful. The smartphone is surrounded by a titanium alloy and fitted with a high-speed Snapdragon 855 Plus 5G chip, offering outstanding graphic performance.

The design of the rack makes it possible to find the required bone screws of the right length and thickness immediately as each screw only fits in its intended place. A nitinol flat spring holds the screws made of a titanium alloy at their tip in a special rack. Inside the screwdriver recess, they are held by a pointed protrusion that arises from the body of the rack. The retaining force allows for machine or ultrasonic washing, high-pressure steam cleaning and autoclaving.

This bike joins the usability and benefits of two worlds, the road racing world and the off-road Gravel world. With its 28 mm tyres it is particularly fast on path, but also on light off-road terrain. The frame offers a certain flexibility typical to titanium where needed, as for example in the seat stays, and boasts high rigidity in the bottom bracket. This creates a balance between a low total weight and the ability to absorb bumps, while being particularly powerful.

This intramedullary nail navigation system detects the accurate position of intramedullary nails using near-field electromagnetic positioning technology. It displays the 3D position of the intramedullary nail and sighting device on the screen and thus enables the surgeon to work precisely and fast, which shortens surgery time. Intramedullary nails are made of a titanium alloy, which is light and robust at the same time, protecting the human body from allergy and immune reactions.

Inspired by the form and gravity of black holes, this timepiece is equipped with independently developed central tourbillon, the first to break through five days of power reserve, using an ultra-light titanium alloy balance wheel for efficient and precise timekeeping. The black hole-shaped hands over the recessed dial plate showcase the convergence of black holes and space-time. Designed by Ziyao Xu.

The Super Sense Sonic Vibration Toothbrush features a titanium alloy unibody design, combined with the industry’s first 3D sonic vibration technology, delivering exceptional cleaning performance. The glossy and colored matte versions highlight the elegant texture of titanium alloy through unique magnetic fluid polishing and electrolytic coloring processes. The enlarged 20% larger screen allows users to intuitively select cleaning modes and durations, greatly enhancing the overall user experience.

Titan Edge ‘Uno’ fuses engineering and minimalist aesthetics into a watch form. 
In a world where every second counts, this is a refreshingly bold take on pausing and experiencing time at a slower pace. This watch has only a single hand, which glides over the dial, making the hand pinions invisible.

The pursuit of lighter fishing rods often requires higher-modulus carbon material, which suffers from reduced elasticity, durability and usability. Additionally, increased brittleness can result in significant material degradation over time as rods are subjected to repeated load. The EVOLUZION’s Titanium Hybrid Shaft structure addresses these concerns through materials innovation, providing the lightweight, high-tension characteristics of higher modulus material without sacrificing durability and lifetime performance.

The nexTouch Panel is a revolutionary product  that offers unprecedented customization, functionality, and safety in  home automation. Customers can customize the touch panel based on the titanium alloy middle frame according to their own needs.With a sleek, modern design crafted from premium  materials like AG glass, marble, and Nappa leather, it  elevates the traditional switch to a work of art. Its intelligent  features, including voice and app control, make it a powerful hub for  smart home devices.

MR-G timepieces, the flagship G-SHOCK line, are designed to showcase master craftsmanship. Following the MRG-B5000, a highly refined re-creation of the very first G-SHOCK, the MRG-B2100 is a sophisticated analog watch that exudes the aesthetic of practical elegance. The stately timepiece features a multi-component structure and impeccable finish, with 27 separate, individually polished bezel parts, and a dial pattern inspired by traditional Japanese kigumi wooden latticework. As with kigumi, the intricate design plays with light and shadow to achieve a bold, yet refined look that aligns perfectly with the prestige of the MR-G line.

THINKTOOL 399 is an efficient and practical tablet for vehicle diagnostics. Thanks to AI-based diagnostic functions, it can quickly record and analyse vehicle fault information. The casing is made of anodised titanium alloy, which ensures robustness, lightness and an industrial look. THINKTOOL 399 supports the intelligent connection of multiple devices and, thanks to functions such as RTC dual diagnostics and VCI screen sharing, enables the parallel diagnostics of two vehicles, which increases efficiency.

The Titanflex 824099 is made of an innovative material combination of HD acetate and a flexible and sturdy, patented nickel-titanium alloy. The design of the glasses is emphasaised by interruption of the classical form of the bridge, imparting a futuristic impression. The particularly flat and treated Base-2 plastic lenses with anti-reflex coating complete the overall homogenous impression.
