Split into four groups – Home, Browser, Conferencing and Function – the keys are then automatically launched by certain applications. This innovative technology offers more control keys to support new functions while simplifying the user interface by presenting controls dynamically as the user needs them. Thanks to a successful rethinking of the design, younger target groups in particular have the opportunity to work with intuitive interaction. The ThinkPad X1 will arrange the surface to match their individual user behaviour.

The models of this notebook series unite lightness and high performance with a slim design. In the interior of the sturdy magnesium-alloy body, honeycomb structures provide enhanced stability. A high-performance rechargeable battery enables extended operating time. HDMI and VGA interfaces allow both a monitor and a projector to be connected. Another user-friendly detail is the keyboard with a convenient pointing stick and 1.5 mm keystroke.

The Elitebook Revolve is a business notebook with touchscreen and Windows 8. Its cover, which includes the screen, can be rotated and inclined downward so that it rests on the keyboard, turning the notebook into a tablet PC. The 11.6” display is made of scratch-resistant Gorilla Glass and a durable magnesium frame. The notebook weighs 1.4 kg and includes two USB 3.0 connections and a DisplayPort. In addition, it features Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and NFC wireless technologies.

The Alienware Area-51m gaming laptop is characterised by an iconic design giving it a self-contained character. The futuristic design combines performance-oriented components with crisp lines, angled sections, abundant lighting and sophisticated cooling. Playing a role in the thermal regulation are hexagonal vents for improved airflow. The magnesium casing provides space for high-performance components, is torsion-resistant and reduces the overall weight of the laptop.

This top-class telephoto lens, which is resistant to spray and dust, is made of a magnesium alloy and is thus both robust and relatively lightweight. It can be used without problems in bad weather or under difficult climate conditions. The premium technical equipment minimises aberration and ensures a high resolution and sharp focus with beautiful bokeh. The image stabilisation system allows for taking shots without a tripod. With this potential, the lens is well suited to sports and nature photography.

The ball heads of the 050 series are the perfect match for carbon fibre tripods. They incorporate a robust magnesium body to achieve a lower weight. The ergonomic levers allow for quick and comfortable handling, while the heads are equipped with a self-lubricant ring guaranteeing particularly smooth movements. The angle selector for portraits provides a high degree of versatility for vertical shooting, both indoors and outdoors.

The innovative SL-1200G turntable is characterised by a newly designed coreless direct-drive motor guaranteeing a constant, even speed and minimal vibration. In connection with the precise motor control, the result is an excellent synchronised operation. The turntable platter is also geared for perfect rotation: it consists of three layers, giving it a high degree of rigidity and enabling vibration-free rotation. The tone arm also consists of premium materials, utilising a magnesium alloy with a high damping effect.

The tablet has been designed for use in rugged environments, where drops, vibration, rain, dust, heat, humidity and other threats are to be expected. Ultra-polymers with high compression strength protect against impacts. Magnesium alloy assures a stable basic structure. The 11.6” multi-touch display with Gorilla Glass can be operated while wearing gloves and provides full HD resolution. The integrated 4G LTE and a dedicated GPS enable the user to work independently of the location.

The children's bicycle COOGHI Smile is characterised by its "Smile Expression" frame, which not only gives it visual lightness, but also communicates the joy of riding as a theme. This idea is underlined by the vibrant colours. Children can assemble and disassemble the bike themselves thanks to simple click mechanisms, which also promotes their manual dexterity. The extremely robust monocoque frame is made of a magnesium alloy.

materials.name: 铜
materials.description: 铜常用名称为铜，较高纯度的工业铜常称紫铜或纯铜。它具有优良的导电、导热、延展和耐腐蚀性能，表面会随环境形成由红褐到绿色的氧化或碱式碳酸盐层。铜常用于电线、电路、换热器、管材、厨具、建筑饰面和工艺品，也是黄铜、青铜等合金的主要基体。
materials.cognitiveText: 铜在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 220–410 MPa。

cases.description: The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

The design concept for the Polar basin mixer series is based on classic aesthetics integrating rectangles and circles as the basic elements. Slim, cylindrical bodies are complemented by clearly contoured spouts and dials. The coherent fusion of these elements results in a minimalist design language that radiates independence and elegance. Various models allow for surface or wall mounting. Manufactured from fully recyclable copper casting, Polar basin mixers make an important contribution to resource conservation.

The basin mixers in the GRACE Series combine oval and rectangular contours with softly rounded edges and transitions. The slim, cylindrical body and elliptical spout merge to form a harmonious unit. Single-lever and two-handle models are available in three heights and four colours. Made of lead-free copper, the faucets are particularly corrosion-resistant thanks to a four-layer coating. The quiet aerator with an adjustable spray angle, in combination with a cold start valve core, reduces water and energy consumption.

The Thermal Mug is a versatile container for hot and cold beverages that combines functionality with a stylish exterior. Made from high-quality stainless steel complemented by copper insulation and vacuum sealing, it maintains drinks at the desired temperature for a long time. The durable, dishwasher-proof powder coating, which is available in five colours, gives the mug a modern appearance. An anti-slip silicone base ensures stability and protects surfaces when the mug is set down.

The effective fin structure of the Mythril Radiators increases their contact surface with the air by 15 per cent, thereby improving heat exchange efficiency. To optimise the heat conduction further, the body is made entirely of copper. These two-tone accessories thus ensure high performance and powerful cooling temperatures, even at full utilisation of the latest GPUs and CPUs. Depending on its positioning, the device appears black or silver.

The Infinity New Reference Subwoofers, available in 10" and 12" versions, offer configuration flexibility through SSI and allow selection of impedance, thus ensuring compatibility with almost any audio system. These subwoofers generate the characteristic deep Infinity bass in closed or vented enclosures. Design features include a radially textured membrane, a centrally placed, copper-coloured Infinity Mobius logo and a high-gloss trim ring that conceals the mounting elements, characterising their elegant appearance.

The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

The One HomeCafe is designed to use capsules to prepare individual cups of coffee and tea. The slim appliance has a streamlined design; copper-coloured elements ensure its high-quality appearance. The slight tilt of the body also gives the appliance an interesting look. For improved handling, the coffee and tea maker does not have its own tank but can be connected directly to a water conditioner.

With its latest streaming multiprocessors and its fast GDDR6X memory, this graphics card is designed for maximum performance. It is already overclocked at the factory but offers additional headroom for overclocking, thanks to advanced cooling with an 11-blade fan, aluminium fin heat sinks and eight copper heat pipes. A special feature is the holographic finish inspired by aurora borealis. Additional RGB lighting, which can be synchronised, is situated at the top and back.

The K-fee One capsule coffee machine is characterised by an elegant design. High-gloss and matt black are paired with copper, while a wave design in the upper area sets further visual accents. Illuminated buttons allow easy operation and programmable cup fill volumes ensure convenience in use. The water tank holds 0.8 litres and can be removed for filling. The capsule machine is particularly compact with a width of just 11.3 cm.

The built-in oven EEB 6550.8JX combines a black glass front with a brilliant copper handle bar, which gives the oven a stylish impression. By electronic operation via sensors behind glass, baking and roasting programmes can be easily selected. Ökotherm catalytic technology and the triple-glazed door contribute to the contemporary and energy-saving functionality of the oven.

The ROG Maximus V Formula (M5F) motherboard is equipped with both air and water cooling. The cooling parts have been enhanced with additional heat-dissipating layers, and the radial groove design is capable of efficiently diverting heat under full load as well. Heat dissipation technology components are special water channels and heat pipes made of 100 per cent copper. Gaming PCs are thus provided with optimal cooling and also extensive overclocking options.

The heat pump outdoor unit combines its very high efficiency with a silent ­operation. The wide slats on the front ensure effective aerodynamics and low energy consumption. Their dark colour makes the fan nearly invisible in the background, lending the device a modern, non-technical appearance. The materials used: steel, copper, aluminium and ­unpainted plastics, are all recyclable.

The lever and outlet of this washbasin mixer are dominated by hollow oval shapes that lend the Ma ya its characteristic appearance. Its surface showcases two colours to underline its sophisticated appearance: The high-contrast combination of matte black and glossy copper gives the mixer an elegant, yet simultaneously modern appeal. Thanks to the distinctive opening, the lever can be easily grasped, enabling comfortable water and temperature adjustments.

Optimal temperature, ideal humidity levels and attention to details are key traits of the Smeg wine coolers for domestic wine storage. They were developed in co-operation with sommeliers and manufactured entirely in Italy. The cooling cabinets are available with stainless steel surfaces as well as in a variant with glass combined with stainless steel or copper elements. They feature a user-friendly touch display on the glass door, whereby temperature, humidity and lighting can be adjusted without the need to open the door.

With its asymmetrical contours, this LED pendant luminaire, which creates a dynamic lighting situation, looks different depending on the viewing angle. The lamp shade is available in any of the monochrome RAL colours or as a two-tone version with different inner and outer colours. It can also be manufactured with a gold, silver or bronze edging. Krivda furthermore provides good illumination at low energy consumption levels.

In order to demonstrate the high standards of craftsmanship of the manufacturer, which has existed since 1917, this copper edition was developed for the 100th anniversary. Copper enables a particularly fast and thus energy-efficient heating. The PFOA-free stainless steel coating increases both durability and food safety while a precisely milled pattern in the bottom of the cookware lets the copper shine through in a decorative way.

This cheese fondue set takes up the current copper trend but also uses the functional properties of the heat conducting material. The fondue pan, which comes in a retro-look, distributes heat evenly so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. Thanks to this configuration, the heat is effectively directed upwards, so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. In combination with the traditional look of the copper, the high-gloss polished stainless steel handle forms a strong contrast. Moreover, the base, which is made of concrete and stainless steel, lends the set both a stable and decorative appearance.

The Suit mixer tap collection is characterised by the combination of soft lines with strikingly angular components, which creates an exciting contrast of form. The control levers for washbasin, shower and bathtub are ergonomically shaped and, thanks to the different heights, the mixer taps can be easily matched to the respective ceramic products. There is a choice of tarnish- and corrosion-resistant coatings in chrome, black, copper or gold for customised bathroom design.

With their carbon fibre fabric on the face of each ear cup – enclosed in a glossy housing with a copper ring – the 900 Legacy look high-quality and original in design. The ear cushions are made of memory foam. They reliably keep ambient noise away from the user through digital hybrid technology, with touch controls ensuring intuitive operation. The headphones are foldable and come with a shockproof, waterproof case.

materials.name: 蓝宝石玻璃
materials.description: 蓝宝石玻璃常用名称为蓝宝石玻璃或蓝宝石晶体，本质上通常是人工生长的单晶氧化铝，并非普通硅酸盐玻璃。它透明、硬度高、耐磨且耐高温，可制成薄片和光学窗口，但加工成本较高且仍具有脆性。常用于手表镜面、手机镜头保护、传感器窗口、LED衬底和精密光学器件。
materials.cognitiveText: 蓝宝石玻璃在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 300–400 MPa。

cases.description: The Extend ring was inspired by the idea to create a piece of jewellery that would be as flexible as it is versatile and that would fit every finger. It was modelled on the pantograph of astronomer and inventor Christoph Scheiner. Just like the technical instrument, the ring is composed of separate elements that flexibly interlock. It is made of 18-carat white or yellow gold and ornamented with precious stones.

The GEMO Luxury Beauty Instrument G10 uses a sapphire flat flash port with RF-ICE anti-aging technology to make the entire process cool and comfortable. The design solves a series of problems, such as excessive temperature, unbearable pain, and redness and sensitivity of the skin, bringing users an unparalleled beauty experience with a high standard of care and service.

The Fenix 7 series is a collection of rugged outdoor smartwatches that help people navigate the outdoors with confidence. The watches are designed to withstand extreme environments and are built with titanium and sapphire to survive any adventure. They incorporate a transparent solar cell that sits above the display collecting sunlight that can extend battery life by over a week. The series comes in three sizes and a variety of finishes to suit a wide range of people and activities. Built-in worldwide topo maps make navigation simple and reliable when in unfamiliar terrain.

materials.name: 钛金属（纯钛）
materials.description: 钛金属（纯钛）常用名称为纯钛或钛金属，通常指工业纯钛而非加入大量合金元素的钛合金。它呈银灰色，密度低于钢，具有良好耐腐蚀性、生物相容性和一定成形焊接能力；不同纯钛等级的强度差异明显。常用于化工设备、医疗器械、换热器、建筑饰面和轻量化产品。
materials.cognitiveText: 钛金属（纯钛）在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 240–550 MPa。

cases.description: Heirloom Vacuum Flask-Mini is a stewed teapot that doesn’t produce odor. The mouth and body are inspired by Oriental aesthetics. In order not to produce odor at high temperature and store water more hygienically, its inner liner is made of pure titanium and the spout is made of stainless steel. To reduce heat loss, the inner liner thickness is only 0.2 mm with a processed mirror surface. Designed by Dong Wu of Shenzhen Yiyuan Technology Co., Ltd.

materials.name: 铸铁
materials.description: 铸铁是含碳量较高、主要通过铸造成形的铁碳合金，常用名称即铸铁。灰铸铁、球墨铸铁、白口铸铁等类型因石墨形态和组织不同，在减振、强度、耐磨和韧性上差异明显。铸铁流动性好、成本相对低，常用于机床底座、发动机部件、管件、炉具、锅具和厚壁结构件。
materials.cognitiveText: 铸铁在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 118–689 MPa。

cases.description: Thanks to precise computer-controlled machining, the STUR Cast-Iron Pan 32 cm is lighter than traditional cast-iron skillets without compromising on even heat distribution or durability. The large frying surface, high walls and ergonomic handles ensure it is convenient to use. The frying pan features no artificial, environmentally harmful coatings but has natural non-stick properties and is suited to all stove tops as well as ovens and grills.

The Electric Fondue Set Pro combines traditional fondue culture with the functionality and simplicity of an electric set. A heating element with a safety thermostat maintains temperatures in the range of 50 to 190 degrees Celsius to suit cheese, meat, chocolate and bouillon fondues alike. The device, made of cast iron and oak, has a splash guard with notches for the fondue forks and is largely free of plastics. Thanks to its long mains cable, it can be used flexibly.

AGA ERA 110i is a premium-class multifunctional cooker. Black glass and high-quality chrome elements give it a minimalist aesthetic, which is reflected in the geometric design. The equipment includes an induction hob and a large hotplate on the top, as well as a convection oven and two cast-iron radiant ovens, each concealed behind a separate door. Operation is via a generously dimensioned touch control surface with integrated LED displays and a character display.

The IoT-ready appliances of the oven range are operated with gas and equipped with a cooktop made of cast iron. The optimised layout has five burners including a grill plate placed in the centre. Convenient use is, among other things, achieved by the wide window and the inclined control panel, which also make for a high-quality appearance. Further details are the LG InstaView technology and the interior illuminated in blue, which allows the user to keep an eye on the food without opening the oven door.

Three gas burners upraising from the smooth, black vitroceramic surface and the cast iron, ring-shaped pan holders characterise the distinctive appearance of this one metre wide hob. The high efficiency of the three burners (2 x 5 kW, 1 x 4.3 kW) allows for professional use. It is operated by a touch control panel. The hob is easy to clean due to the smooth surface and the upraised burners.

Precisely formed design details, such as the metallic control knobs and the cast iron fixings, visualise a high excellence standard and a quality that can be sensuously perceived. The burner arrangement ensures that large cookware can be used. There is a 4 kW dual-circuit wok burner in the centre.

The Peloton Bootcamp Weights are an ergonomically shaped pair of cast iron dumbbells with polyurethane coated ends. They are characterised by a clear, reduced design and stand out due to their striking transition from square weight plates to circular handle. Whenever and wherever you are, they offer the opportunity for strength and ­endurance training.

This gas hob visualises a high quality standard: metallic control knobs and cast iron fixings demonstrate a quality that is sensuously tangible. The energy efficient burners and the dishwasher safe pan supports complement the hob panel, which can either be mounted flush or integrated into the work surface in a classical, additive fashion.

The Stiga Villa 520 compact ride-on lawn mower combines sophisticated mowing technology with a pleasant driving experience. Its cast-iron frame and housing are made in one piece, assuring its stability. The front-mounted mowing head allows a comprehensive view of the working area while simultaneously providing good cutting results, even under bushes and benches. Cutting height adjustment can be easily set from the driver’s seat. Additional accessories for autumn and winter operation allow the machine to be converted for sweeping and snow-clearing functions.

The generous burner arrangement and the clear division into different cooking zones allow professional cooking with large cookware. The stainless steel, which is used for the hob, and the cast iron pan supports along with the energy efficient burners underline the high quality of the hob.

The elegant appearance of this gas hob is due to a flat, stainless steel surface of minimalist design. The cooking zone is divided into two sections: four gas burners are located equally spaced on the right side, while the particularly powerful, triple-flame burner on the left provides room for very big cooking utensils. The cast iron trivets are sturdy and form a contrast to the smooth, stainless steel surface.

This gas hob with a large cooktop has a flat, enamelled surface which is durable and easy to clean. The cast iron, asymmetrically designed pot supports are so designed that they form together one large cooking surface, which extends over the whole cooktop, allowing the pots to be easily shifted. A powerful wok burner is located at the front, thus easing the use of heavy pots. Thanks to ergonomic pot supports and self-ignition, one-handed operation is possible.

The multifunctional kitchen machine Kenwood Cooking Chef is made of anthracite-coloured cast aluminium. This not only ensures durability and stability, but also gives the device a high-quality look and feel. Black high-gloss components replace the familiar chrome applications. The features include an adjustable touch display, numerous presets and recipes, an integrated set of scales and a precise induction cooking system. Cloud connectivity and an app ensure seamless ease of use.

The cast-iron wood-burning stoves of the Jøtul F 170 series have a roughly cylindrical shape that widens gently towards the centre. Integrated into the elegantly rounded front is a large glass door that provides a 156-degree view of the fire. A portion of the stoves’ surface texture is reminiscent of woodchip wallpaper, creating a link to the traditional craftsmanship of cast iron. The Jøtul F 170 series uses intelligent Zensoric technology to optimise firewood consumption and increase energy efficiency.

The Casarte C7 Smart Gas Stove combines the colour piano black with decorative stripes in champagne gold on the main surface, giving rise to a fascinating appearance. This impression is enhanced by the differentiated design of the cast-iron support frames, which also enable energy-efficient use. Discreet control elements and simplified cleaning options were included in the design and emphasise strong practical value.

This large gas hob fascinates with a functional concept defined by distinctive lines and the use of selected materials. For example, a shiny glass surface with cohesive control elements is combined with pot rests made of durable cast iron. In addition to white, shiny numerals on the glass surface, the rotary knobs with a luminous ring are a special feature. It appears when the cooktop is turned on, thus facilitating safe use.

The hob series of the Rinnai G line consists of three modules that can be arranged freely: a glass ceramic hob and two hobs with pan supports made of high-quality cast iron. Digital function displays ensure user-friendly operation. Thanks to the flat installation height and elegant appearance of the individual elements, the series is also suitable for small worktops and open kitchens.

This gas hob combines an elegant and puristic design with state-of-the-art technology. The appearance is characterised by the cast-iron gas grids and black burners on the dark-enamelled stainless-steel hob. In terms of functionality, the hob integrates a very powerful 5 kW double-crown burner and also innovative Preci-Flame technology. This technology allows a selection of nine preprogrammed heat levels, each of which ensures a precise and constant temperature setting.

The Voronoi cast iron grating is suitable for use with the manufacturer’s drainage systems in both horticulture and landscape gardening. The seemingly random arrangement of geometric shapes recalls the markings of a giraffe or cracks in dry soil. With this organic motif, the grating easily blends into mineral and planted settings. It is made of a robust iron-carbon alloy and thus offers good corrosion resistance. A special coating offers protection against the weather.

This cast-iron cookware series was especially designed for outdoor use and is particularly suitable for outdoor gas stoves and fireplaces. The robust pots, lids and pans are each cast in one piece without the need for welding. Thanks to their bulbous contours, the pots feature a large base for effective heat conduction. The wide handle openings facilitate easy handling, while the different lids fit flexibly on all pots.

materials.name: 竹材
materials.description: 竹材常用名称为竹材或竹木，来源于竹秆，经干燥、防护、剖分、层压或重组后可形成板材和构件。其纤维沿生长方向排列，具有较高比强度和鲜明纹理，但性能受竹种、部位、含水率及胶合方式影响。常用于家具、餐具、地板、包装、建筑构件和可持续产品设计。
materials.cognitiveText: 竹材在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 100–800 MPa。

cases.description: The continuation of the work-at-home trend is associated with challenges to remote workers. Their homes do not always have enough space for the integration of an attractive and ergonomic workstation that leaves the look and feel of the room fundamentally intact. Float Mini offers the perfect solution with its compact design and cosy aesthetics. The rounded corners, slim profile and matt textures help it blend harmoniously into a home environment without sacrificing functionality – a feature that only becomes obvious during use. An off-centre base ensures that no table legs get in the way when the users change their sitting position, and the infinitely variable height adjustment feature permits ergonomic working while standing. Humanscale is both the name and the mission of the manufacturer, whose products are consistently designed for user-centric functionality. Float Mini can also be fitted with castors for mobility, and the desktop options of bamboo, MDF or linoleum in a warm colour palette cater to personal preferences. “Float Mini is reminiscent of the wabi-sabi aesthetic,” commented the Red Dot jurors. “The asymmetrical design ensures that it can perfectly fulfil its function. It offers a remarkable level of quality and user convenience, and the desk is adaptable to a variety of settings beyond the home office, such as hotels or living spaces.” The product designers spent a long time fine-tuning Float Mini to achieve its intuitive functionality and unique character. Every detail, from the geometry of the base to the mechanical feel of the height adjustment, was worked on until perfection was achieved. The materials were intentionally chosen to balance aesthetic appeal, eco-friendliness and longevity. Last but not least, the minimalist design reflects the modern-day consumer demand for products that are repairable and made of just a few components. “Fewer parts mean fewer potential points of failure, easier disassembly and better recyclability,” said the product designers. All variants of Float Mini prove that this approach produces beautiful results.

The Float Mini table seamlessly blends classic residential aesthetics with Humanscale’s renowned ergonomic design, offering a compact, versatile solution for both home and workspaces. Designed to promote natural movement, Float Mini effortlessly adjusts to various heights, providing an essential component for an ergonomic setup that enhances user well-being. Available in a refined palette of colors, Float Mini complements any environment, with surface options that include sustainable bamboo and a new natural linoleum material. This eco-friendly linoleum is wear-resistant, anti-static, and fingerprint-proof, featuring a soft matte finish.

Bathtubs, in particular stand-alone ones, offer little to no space to store items like towels, shampoo, books, glasses, and tablets. TUBLER, the bathroom butler, is a flexible piece of furniture for stand-alone bathtubs that can also be used with built-in bathtubs. TUBLER is manufactured mainly from eco-friendly bamboo, cotton, and stainless steel, withstands the bathroom environment, and is fully recyclable. TUBLER is a space-saving, highly practical combination of shelf and table for almost all bathtubs on the market.

materials.name: 棉纤维
materials.description: 棉纤维常用名称为棉或棉花纤维，是包覆棉籽表面的天然纤维，主要成分为纤维素。它吸湿、透气、触感柔和，并能进行纺纱、织造、染整和复合加工。棉纤维常用于服装、家纺、医疗敷料、过滤材料和纤维增强生物复合材料，其性能会受纤维长度、含水率和织物结构影响。
materials.cognitiveText: 棉纤维在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 287–800 MPa。

cases.description: The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

Biatain Fiber is a gel-forming fibre dressing used for deeper wounds and wound cavities that present a moderate to high degree of exudation. The new HexaLock technology integrates the gelling fibres into reinforced hexagonal netting and traps exudate and bacteria. It minimises shrinkage of the dressing and forms a dimensionally stable gel for easy removal in one piece. The hexagonal embossing pattern is inspired by nature.

materials.name: 黄铜
materials.description: 黄铜是以铜和锌为主要成分的铜合金，常用名称即黄铜。它呈黄至金色金属光泽，具有良好成形、切削、耐腐蚀和装饰性能；加入铅、锡、铝等元素可形成不同用途的特殊黄铜。常用于阀门、管件、紧固件、乐器、灯具、家具五金、饰品和需要金色外观的产品部件。
materials.cognitiveText: 黄铜在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 300–890 MPa。

cases.description: The Figura Sink Set is a kitchen tap made of environmentally friendly, lead-reduced brass. Available in 20 different finishes, it offers the perfect quality and texture for any kitchen. The tap features separate hot and cold water handles, while the spout can swivel 360 degrees and is able to take an optional extendable hose. It is manufactured using a drawing technique, with a special profile that has two flat sides and two semi-circle segments.

The core components of the SmallRig Follow Focus F60 are made of brass and new composite materials that enable precise fine adjustment of the lens focus during video recordings. The product has a modular design and is equipped with a removable palm rest that provides stability for hand-held shooting. The adjustment wheel is made of solid mahogany and features a ribbed surface to improve grip. With its dynamic damping system, the SmallRig Follow Focus F60 is suitable for lenses with different diameters.

The washbasins in the Liquid collection are characterised by their minimalist design and soft, curved shapes. They are suitable for the private sphere, but also for the hospitality industry or public spaces. The round basins made of white porcelain harmonise with robust brass fittings that have been reduced to the essentials, have a high-quality feel and are intuitive to use. The smooth surfaces and the absence of sharp edges also make the products easier to clean. “The reduced design language ensures a high recognition value, and the choice of durable material is also convincing,” was the jury’s verdict.

In keeping with classical design vocabulary, the rounded contours and brass detailing of this pendant luminaire create an elegant look that harmonises with the ambience of the dining table. The light beam is reflected onto the opalised top shade by the lower shade, thus producing glare-free lighting. The distance between the lampshades is adjustable. If they are closer together, the luminaire creates downward light while a greater distance produces more diffused light.

These bathroom fittings are part of a series that harmoniously combines bold architectural forms and pleasant to the touch, tactile textures. To ensure functionality and ergonomics, minimalist cylindrical elements have been embellished with impressively diamond-cut milling for a good grip. A carefully considered labelling makes it intuitive to find the direction of rotation for hot or cold water. The scratch-resistant fittings are made of high-quality brass, either hand-polished or brushed.

This gas hob was developed specially for the Asian market, with the focus placed on a clear, streamlined design idiom. A compact surface made of a glass-ceramic material is combined with high-end brass burners, which create an interesting visual accent against the otherwise dark colour scheme. The pan supports and the black rotary knob blend beautifully into the overall design concept. The knob can be operated safely and conveniently with just one hand.

Mahjong Tea combines two Chinese traditions in its design concept: loose tea is pressed into pre-measured mahjong tiles that are stored in characteristic wooden tea boxes. The stackable boxes are decorated with crafted elements and brass inlays; a band with illustrations protects their untreated surface. Organic materials emphasise the product’s character. Together, product and packaging form an aesthetic design object.

Made famous by jazz musicians like Charlie Parker and Stan Getz, the saxophone is one of the most multifaceted musical instruments. The design of the YDS-150 digital saxophone is modelled closely on the familiar shape and playing style of an acoustic soprano saxophone. It showcases the same length and also utilises the same key layout. Musicians can therefore start playing it immediately without having to get used to it first. The digital saxophone features a brass bell typical of familiar saxophones and inspires with an elegantly rounded shape that leads from the mouthpiece to the flared bell. With only two-thirds of the weight of a conventional saxophone, it rests well-balanced in the hands. At the very heart of this saxophone is a sophisticated digital concept. The YDS-150 enables perfect control of the volume ratios over 15 levels for daily practice. The loudspeaker unit and the brass bell are linked by an acoustic tube that features the Integrated Bell Acoustic System. This tube senses the player’s breath passing through the body and makes the instrument vibrate in response. The result is a natural instrument body resonance that feels just like playing an acoustic saxophone. Featuring saxophone voices such as the soprano, alto, tenor and baritone, as well as synthesiser voices, it allows players to perform a broad repertoire.

With its logo lettering, flashing brass accents and black faux leather throughout, the Marshall Monitor II A.N.C. takes its cue from the brand’s classic design. The battery life is up to 45 hours, and thick ear and head pads ensure good wearing comfort. Ambient noise is continuously localised, measured and eliminated via active noise cancellation, while 40-mm dynamic drivers deliver excellent sound.

The Solaris Collection is made from solid brass, and thanks to its soft contours is characterised by a comfortable handhold. Alongside the finely rounded edges of the narrow, flat switches, there are push switches harmoniously embedded in the switch plate, offering the user convenience and a particular tactile experience when activating the switch. The contrast between the colour of the brushed brass plate and the circular black buttons beautifully emphasises the contours of the switch. The collection is available in numerous designs; the plate can be individually engraved with words, symbols or pictograms.

The Marshall Emberton is an extremely compact Bluetooth speaker that fits in almost any pocket. The device, reminiscent of a guitar amplifier, is covered with a metal grille at the front and back and bears the brand’s lettering. A brass knob on the top adds another accent and underlines the value of the product. The minimalist design language is supported by the simple handling, which requires only a few operating elements.

The Full Moon tableware set comprises two bowls and three plates of different sizes, as well as a cup. Each individually handcrafted piece showcases its own distinctive appearance. The design combines the traditional Korean materials of Yuhgee (brassware) and Ott-chil (lacquer) in a creative manner. Both materials possess sterilizing effects so that they can maintain the freshness of food for longer. Moreover, they preserve the temperature and thus the flavour of food with long cooking times.

This three-piece table light consists of two inversely oriented, truncated cones which are pierced by a round rod, made of either brass or stainless steel. The rod is tiltable by 24 and the lampshade pivotable by 120 degrees, both individually adjustable. An energy-efficient LED provides glare-free illumination with 11 watts, a colour temperature of 2,700 kelvins and a luminous flux of 1,400 lumens. Switching and dimming is controlled by a flush-integrated metal switch in the base of the lamp. A memory function serves to save the last selected brightness setting.

The architectural design of the Bridge Collection switches is minimalist and pure. Their appearance is defined by the geometric proportions of their commutators whose shape resemble a seesaw or bridge. They unite design, ergonomics, simplicity and tradition. The switches are available in various high-quality material finishes. The base plate, for instance, comes in stainless steel, aluminium, Corian or brass. As the aluminium commutator is also available in different colours, this provides a wide range of combination options.

The cold water high-pressure cleaner HD 8 / 18-4 M is available in two versions: mobile with large wheels and as a stationary model for wall mounting. The machine is built to last and is thus designed for economical operation. This  is evidenced by the automatic pressure relief, the brass cylinder head, a four-pole, predominantly maintenance-free motor and an efficient filter at the  water inlet. The large control switch at the front is easy to reach, even during operation.

Storm System brings together various ceiling elements mounted in an installation ring, which is flush with the ceiling. Using the innovative “snap lock” technique, various fixtures are easily mounted into the ring. Users have a choice of 17 elements such as lighting, speakers, cameras, smoke detectors, ventilation systems, motion detectors and cable outputs. The entire range of fixtures has the same streamlined design and all elements are made of high-quality materials such as aluminium, brass, wood, glass, concrete or leather.

cases.productName: Kitchen Knives and Wooden Knife Block
cases.description: The W1 series comprises five versatile kitchen knives, housed in a robust wood knife block. The handles, manufactured from Acacia wood, and the asymmetric knife block express visual harmony and unity. Their softly rounded contours facilitate handling and highlight the high-alloy metal blade. Another unique and distinct feature is the brass rivets around three holes in the handle. The stainless knives are easy to clean and fully suitable for the use in commercial kitchen environments.

The L’OR Barista by JDE Peet’s allows espresso to be prepared easily and is designed to be used with two capsule sizes. In addition to single servings, two cups of espresso or a double espresso can also be brewed at the same time. The automatic capsule recognition system measures out the correct amount of water. The high-gloss black housing accentuates both the matt black dispensing area and the double nozzle with brass-finished accents. This interplay gives the espresso machine an elegant look.

The WA is a door handle with grips made of anodised aluminium and a body of refined brass. The extruded elements are characterised by precise lines, giving them a clear geometric appearance. Both the handle and the fittings can be selected in different finishes to permit individual combinations. The contrasts between the different materials, textures and colours adds excitement to the series, making it suitable for many interior styles.

The new Jägermeister Tap Machine – Mysterious Core has been designed to communicate the DNA of the premium liquor in the hospitality industry. The IoT-ready, compact appliance has a functionally designed body with a striking cooling rib structure. The tap made of solid brass is emphasised with green light below the spout, which also highlights the displayed drinking temperature of -18 degrees centigrade. A slim handle ensures comfortable handling.

materials.name: 不锈钢
materials.description: 不锈钢常用名称为不锈钢或耐蚀钢，是以铁为基体、含有足够铬并可加入镍、钼等元素的合金体系。铬在表面形成钝化膜，使其具有较好的耐腐蚀和清洁维护性能。奥氏体、铁素体、马氏体等类别在强度、磁性和加工性上不同，常用于厨具、建筑、医疗、交通及产品外壳。
materials.cognitiveText: 不锈钢在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 500–750 MPa。

cases.description: Singly ONE is a robust charging station designed for both private and commercial use. Its elegant, timeless stainless steel case blends seamlessly into any environment. An integrated display presents all key information at a glance – from charging power to status notifications. Maximum safety is ensured by the built-in residual current circuit breaker, which reliably protects both user and vehicle in the event of a fault. Replaceable components simplify maintenance and help extend the unit’s service life.

The Harman Kardon sound system in the Volvo XC90 combines high-quality audio technology with a sophisticated design. The front door grilles are made of etched stainless steel, coated in matt-black and have a laser-engraved logo. Seamlessly integrated into the interior, the grilles also house the seat adjustment controls, thus combining functionality and aesthetics. The central speaker cover runs behind the dashboard, with precisely positioned hole patterns ensuring a harmonious appearance.

NWP500 is a heating pump water heater for the centralised supply of residential buildings. By utilising ambient air, the system works much more energy-efficiently than conventional electric water heaters and also reduces CO₂ emissions. The well-thought-out arrangement of the connections enables space-saving and simple installation. It is operated via an ergonomically positioned touchscreen display or a clearly organised app. The inner container is made of corrosion-resistant stainless steel and the thermal insulation is made of climate-friendly HFO foam.

The RICHARTZ KEY TOOLS compact series is the particularly handy version of the original RICHARTZ KEY TOOLS and combine up to 17 functions in a minimal space. Made from matt-finished stainless steel, these multi-tools impress with their precise finish and clearly recognisable, embossed functional surfaces. Whether as a shopping aid (shop), DIY tool (work) or versatile all-rounder (13+), each version offers well-thought-out solutions for everyday life, the household and hobbies. It is compact, robust and always ready for use.

The timeless design of Tangente 2date is offset by a contemporary dual date display. A ring date around the edge of the dial keeps the entire month in view, while a small window highlights the current date in red. A finely balanced contrast between the polished stainless steel case and black leather strap adds to the visual appeal of this handcrafted timepiece. The manually wound movement evokes a sense of nostalgia, while the sapphire crystal glass back offers a view of the mechanical calibre inside.

The SmartAppGuided Spiral Epilation Tweezer Pen 5-in-1 uses a precision stainless steel coil to safely remove hair at the root for long-lastingly smooth skin. It is designed to minimise skin irritation and can be used on both small and large facial areas such as the chin, upper lip, cheeks, forehead and eyebrows. Thanks to its compact, slightly tapered shape, the pen is suitable for easy, intuitive and precise operation. An app is also available to guide the user through the application.

The EDC29 is a thin tactical torch with a run time of over 60 hours that combines outstanding light output, intelligent functions and a robust design. It has a light output of 6,500 lumens, a range of up to 400 metres and a dual LED system with 18 cores for different types of light, such as spotlighting or floodlighting. A light shield mode provides protection, while randomly changing light frequencies can create a dizzying effect. The robust construction of stainless steel and carbon fibre weighs just 160 grams and fits securely in the hand.

The Perun 3 Mini is a 63 mm short, 85-gram torch for a wide range of applications, such as outdoor use, signalling and emergencies. It delivers white and red light with an output of up to 1,300 lumens. The magnetic tailcap allows hands-free use, while the stainless steel knob and a removable clip ensure easy operation and effortless portability. With the included headband, the Perun 3 Mini becomes a headlamp. The stepless brightness control and the long standby time increase safety.

The Thermal Mug is a versatile container for hot and cold beverages that combines functionality with a stylish exterior. Made from high-quality stainless steel complemented by copper insulation and vacuum sealing, it maintains drinks at the desired temperature for a long time. The durable, dishwasher-proof powder coating, which is available in five colours, gives the mug a modern appearance. An anti-slip silicone base ensures stability and protects surfaces when the mug is set down.

The Gibraltar lounge furniture creates a cosy, welcoming ambience. The aesthetics of the lines are characterised by the delicate lightness of the thin, round tube profiles made of stainless steel, which in their double execution ensure robust stability. The opulent design of the high-quality seat and back cushions creates an appealing contrast. The open strapping on the backrest guarantees a high level of seating comfort, while the modular design offers great flexibility with many combination options for the individual elements.

The Elegant Scenery bathroom cabinet set includes two washbasins with a separate cover, as well as a mirror with touch-sensitive lighting. The stacked and seemingly interlocking ensemble of individual elements gives the arrangement an architectural aesthetic that is visually accentuated by the combination of multilayer solid wood, natural stone, stainless steel and Corian, each with its own colour scheme. A drawer with a clearly structured interior allows for the organised storage of cosmetics and care utensils.

WMF Element One, a sparkling water maker made of high-quality stainless steel, is characterised by its ease of use: the knurled control knob on the top precisely regulates the degree of carbonation, adapting it to the user’s taste preferences. Preparation is as easy as pressing a button. An elegant water cylinder and soft curves characterise the design of the compact device, which, thanks to its slim silhouette, requires little space on the work surface.

The development of this tableware concept for the Economy Class of Etihad Airways was focused on sustainability and an enhanced passenger experience. The reusable tableware is made entirely from recycled plastic and is part of a closed-loop recycling system. At the end of their life cycle, the parts are collected, washed, ground and reused to create new products. Complementing the system is cutlery made from stainless steel and pressed paper, as well as paper cups and bamboo stirrers.

Conum for One is a mug with a filter that enables effortless preparation of loose-leaf tea directly in the mug. The fine-mesh stainless steel filter allows the flavours to unfold fully. Afterwards, the lid doubles as a convenient holder for the filter. Made from heat-resistant borosilicate glass, the mug is neutral in odour and taste as well as dishwasher-proof. The mug’s exceptional resistance to temperature fluctuations makes it extremely durable – ideal for daily use, whether in the home or in the office.

With its elegant stainless steel finish and integrated MoodLight, the Liebherr French Door fridge-freezer is a high-quality addition to any modern kitchen. The compact design is characterised by flush-fitting doors and distinctive handle recesses. The flexible interior offers various temperature zones, including a VarioTempZone that can be used as a refrigeration or freezer compartment. The innovative sealing system of the appliance doors, which can be opened independently of each other, ensures good energy efficiency.

The TANGO XP bean-to-cup coffee machine is designed for professional use and is characterised by its robust construction. Three bean containers, a double brewing group and a manual steam element offer a wide range of preparation options. Stainless steel surfaces in a matt and glossy finish complement the black control panel with full-touch display, which allows the selection of recipes and the control of the grind setting as well as the brewing temperature. Flowing transitions and the slightly inclined front ensure a bold appearance.

Improvisational cooking can produce excellent cuisine, but compromises should never be made when it comes to choice of knife. Blunt blades have driven many an amateur cook crazy, and professional chefs won’t even put on their aprons unless their knives are precision-sharpened. That’s why the Kuhn Rikon Black Coated Knives Series is such an exciting proposition. The elegant black blades are seamlessly connected to the handle, creating a harmonious, aesthetic overall appearance. It also features perfectly balanced weight and an ergonomic shape for a positive tactile experience. Six knives ensure that the right blade for different food items is always to hand, and a pair of household scissors completes the functional set. A matching magnetic knife block reflects the designers’ intent to create a product that looks good in the kitchen setting. The knives nestle almost flush against the block, where they are transformed into a stylish eye-catcher. A non-slip chopping board with a juice groove completes the convenient and consistently designed set. The purist appearance of the knives is the ultimate outcome of a lengthy test phase. Finding the perfect shape for the handle and the exact blade angle for precise cutting results are also aspects that the designers intensively considered. “Achieving the perfect balance between the blade and handle was crucial. We spent a great deal of time refining the length and weight of each aspect to maintain an elegant, streamlined design while optimising function,” they commented. Choice of materials was also decisive to functional excellence. The knives are made from Japanese stainless steel, which is renowned for its hardness, sharpness and durability. A non-stick coating on the blades further enhances cutting performance and the cooking experience. “The Kuhn Rikon Black Coated Knives Series stands out for its exceptional quality and captivating aesthetics,” was the jury’s verdict. “Every detail is precision manufactured and ergonomically designed. In combination, the colours and design make an elegant and sophisticated statement that reflects the first-class choice of materials.”

Luxe Café Premier is a 3-in-1 coffee machine for preparing espresso, cold brew drinks and filter coffee. It features a conical grinder with 25 grind settings and integrated scales. It is operated via precise buttons, control dials and an easy-to-read, clearly structured display. The housing, made of stainless steel and matt black plastic, is functionally designed and characterised by the harmonious combination of flat surfaces, clear lines and rounded edges.

The Liebherr Side-by-Side is a fridge-freezer combination with a wine temperature control compartment. This offers separate temperature zones for white and red wine, humidity control and adjustable wooden shelves. The wine is also protected from vibrations and UV rays. The appearance is characterised by BlackSteel or SmartSteel – a specially polished and sealed stainless steel. This material is also used on the inner door, inner rear wall and decorative strips. The refrigerator door closes softly and quietly.

The combi-steamer Convotherm mini pro was developed for small professional kitchens with high capacity utilisation. AI-supported functions such as optical food recognition, sensor-based cooking processes and a self-dosing cleaning system minimise the operating effort. The stainless steel and glass housing is hygienic and robust. The operating elements are clearly structured; only the antibacterial handle needs to be fully grasped by hand. The unobtrusive form, with its flush installation option, fits well into various room concepts.

materials.name: PET聚酯纤维
materials.description: PET聚酯纤维常用名称为涤纶或聚酯纤维，是以聚对苯二甲酸乙二酯为主要成分制成的合成纤维。它具有强度较高、耐磨、易洗快干和尺寸稳定等特点，可制成长丝、短纤、织物或非织造材料。常用于服装、箱包、家具面料、绳带、过滤材料及纤维增强复合材料。
materials.cognitiveText: PET聚酯纤维在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 400–900 MPa。

cases.description: The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

Sustainability was prioritised in the development of the IN/OUT collection. The minimalist design boasts a timeless sophistication with handcrafted details. All materials are sourced from local suppliers in order to reduce the products’ carbon footprint. Made from durable stainless steel, the chairs are easily stackable. Their comfortable seat cushions feature a quick-drying surface, and their attractive backrests are made from weather-resistant polyester ropes.

To conserve resources and minimise waste, this sporty safety shoe is made from environmentally friendly and recycled materials. For example, recycled foam and polyester fibres were used for the footbed. The properties of the breathable, cushioning material ensure a pleasant foot climate, offer comfort and support the foot in its natural rolling movement. The sustainable profile is rounded off by the tear-resistant textile fibres made from PET bottles for penetration protection.

The HP OMEN bags allow gamers to carry large amounts of computing equipment in a compact way. The bags are the size of a backpack or duffel bag and offer large openings so that the contents can be accessed from several sides. They are made of waterproof, coated polyester with cleverly arranged zippers. The series follows a uniform design concept and includes bags of various sizes, including a travelling bag with a separate shoe compartment.

This hammock is reminiscent of a Venetian gondola which floats gently over the water. The height-adjustable lying surface is made from recycled plastic bottles and adapts itself to the user’s requirements. The reinforced frame, along with well-considered connecting elements and fourfold tilt protection, assures the necessary safety. The hammock may also be equipped with an awning.

This tyre for utility terrain vehicles (UTV), with its innovative design using a nylon material, conforms to the current trend of making UTV tyres, like sedan tyres, out of polyester and with a steel belt. The result is a reinforced radial tyre which is also given a newly developed, concave profile. This means that the tyre is not only flatter than usual but above all offers better and more stable driving on rough terrain.

The BULLET is a robust polycarbonate piece of luggage with a rugged look and feel, inspired by off-road SUVs. It is made from RCS-certified, recycled PET bottles. The two handles on the top combine comfort and functionality and make it easier to lift the suitcase when it is heavy. Shock-absorbing edges, inner padding and anti-theft zips offer optimum protection. Functions such as an integrated laundry compartment for separating worn and clean clothes make it easier to keep things tidy when travelling.

The aim of the Filo messenger bag, made  of water-repellent polyester, was to  enhance safety for the cyclist. The cover flap features a reflective fabric that makes the cyclist more visible in the dark. The spacious interior can even be increased when pulling the two zippers  on the sides. The bag can be worn diagonally across only one shoulder or – for better weight distribution – like a rucksack on both shoulders.

This heat-repellent film for car windows is an efficient thermal insulator. It uses XIR PRO technology which reflects infrared waves with a wavelength greater than 1,350 mm, thus preventing a rise in temperature in the car interior. The film, in addition, affords further safety protection. The use of an environmentally friendly PET substrate not only reduces glare and improves visibility but furthermore limits the shattering of glass in case of an accident.

The WNC LAXY 5G CPE + Wi-Fi 7 Extender consists of networked 5G end devices for home use that combine high connection speed with a resource-saving design. They support the Matter smart home standard and Wi-Fi 7 and are manufactured using recycled materials, including PCR plastics, PET fibres and oyster shells. The devices are based on a symmetrical three-component structure that is manufactured using two injection moulds, thus reducing production waste.

The colourful woven rugs in the Strata collection were created as part of a fruitful collaboration between the traditional carpet manufacturer Rols and the textile design studio Wallace#Sewell. Both are united not only by high-quality standards, but also by an appreciation of traditional craftsmanship, innovative thinking and, not least, a sustainable philosophy. Designed according to the motto “Archive of Earth Memories” by Wallace#Sewell and produced at the Rols weaving mills, these rugs pay homage to our planet’s diverse landscapes and colours. Rols has been using the traditional Wilton knotting technique for more than a century and, over the years, has passed the necessary skills down from one generation to the next. The partners have endeavoured to preserve this special rug-making expertise, while at the same time creating an aesthetic, contemporary look. Vibrant patterns and colours as well as precise workmanship are key building blocks in this process. Rols has a strong commitment to sustainability, which is why energy-efficient production, the use of local yarn processing partners and a considered choice of materials are important priorities. Recycled post-consumer PET bottles are used to create the yarn for eight differently patterned Strata rugs. As a material it is remarkably well-suited for making rugs, even ones with complex patterns, and it offers decisive functional advantages. Thanks to the extreme durability of the innovative yarn and UV treatment, the rugs are perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. “The surface of the Strata rugs feels absolutely natural and soft. They are a pleasure to walk on and meticulously executed. Craftsmanship and functionality have come together here to make a great product,” said the impressed jury. “We were also captivated by the brilliant colours.” This luminosity is typical of designs by Wallace#Sewell, and they add a vibrancy and energy to living spaces. Strata literally weaves together a poetic idea, a dramatic look, an innovative material and meticulous craftsmanship – these rugs represent originality that is both beautiful and functional.

Securipak2.0 is an improved anti-theft backpack in which the main compartment and all pockets are only accessible from the back. A cut-resistant fabric provides additional protection against theft. The backpack has been ergonomically designed for greater carrying comfort and, despite its minimalist aesthetics, it has numerous functions, including an RFID-protected compartment, zip pockets and two open pockets for quick access. For the sake of the environment, the outer material is made from recycled PET bottles using a dope-dyeing process.

The design of the Orbis Circular Collection bags is focused on the complete recyclability of the material used. In order to guarantee a closed material cycle in the production of the luggage and not produce any new waste, all elements – from the upper material to the zips and lining – are made from one and the same material: PET/polyester. “The consistent recycling of existing materials conserves valuable resources,” said the jury, highlighting the special sustainability aspect of the modern bag series. The collection consists of two rucksacks with practical, minimalistic designs, a laptop bag with a handle and a travel or sports bag with several compartments.

With its compact design, the RASPAIL Soft Trunk – a combination of trolley suitcase and duffle bag – is exceptionally versatile. It can be carried, lifted and tucked away using the handle on the front, and pulled over longer distances thanks to integrated wheels and a retractable telescopic tube. The trolley features a separate shoe compartment and is closed with a security zipper. The product was also designed with sustainability in mind as the water-repellent outer material is made from recycled water bottles.

Carrying babies close to the body is both practical and strengthens the bond between parents and child. The design of the Konny Baby Carrier set out in 2017 to develop a new baby carrier from scratch. One of the main differences to competing products is that this carrier can be easily slipped on like a T-shirt. The SUMMER version differs from the original product in that it is specifically optimised for use in warm weather. The biggest challenge in the development process was to find a fabric that is as comfortable and resilient as the originally chosen fabric, but at the same time introduces additional properties such as breathability and UV protection. Since such a fabric did not yet exist, it was newly created in a months-long research and development process. The result is an innovative soft air mesh fabric made of a polyester/elastane blend with four-way stretch that is ultra-lightweight, breathable and has moisture-wicking properties. In addition, this fabric also offers 85 per cent UV protection and is antibacterial. The Konny Baby Carrier SUMMER is made entirely from this new type of mesh fabric. The breathable and cooling material absorbs sweat and discharges it towards the outside. The baby carrier is easy to slip on and features an ergonomic design that evenly distributes the baby’s weight and supports a healthy hip development.

The containers of the modular Jive Recycling Bin system are used for space-saving waste separation. A wide front flap is easy to open and facilitates the disposal of glass, paper, PET, can, cardboard and plastic waste. The two large handles are connected to the securely closing lid and ensure comfortable transport. With enclosed, graphically reduced stickers, the containers can be marked for different types of waste.

This highly elastic, hardwearing pillow helps the user to adopt a comfortable, natural posture when sleeping. It adapts to the body from the head down along the cervical spine, relieving pressure and stimulating blood flow. The innovative, breathable pillow is made of polyester and thermoplastic elastomer that is also found in medical devices, kitchen utensils and baby bottles. The triangular mesh surface is exceptionally soft.

Biatain Fiber is a gel-forming fibre dressing used for deeper wounds and wound cavities that present a moderate to high degree of exudation. The new HexaLock technology integrates the gelling fibres into reinforced hexagonal netting and traps exudate and bacteria. It minimises shrinkage of the dressing and forms a dimensionally stable gel for easy removal in one piece. The hexagonal embossing pattern is inspired by nature.

The main compartment of this backpack is only accessible from the back. This feature protects against theft, as do the hidden side pockets, of which one is RFID-protected. Behind the body fabric, there is a cut-resistant layer. The bag is equipped with an integrated and hidden USB port to connect easily with electronic devices carried inside. The outer material is a special fabric created by using 100 per cent recycled PET bottles. The backpack comes in eleven colours and two different dimensions.

Curio-city is a wall-mounted playground for cats. The material made from PET (polyethylene terephthalate) is not only environmentally friendly, sound-absorbing and fireproof, but, thanks to its soft texture, also represents an ideal wall panelling cats like to scratch and rub against. An L-shaped metal bracket provides a simple stand construction whose fittings hide expertly in the flexibly placeable elements that are different in size. They consist of laterally stacked panels and offer superb playing possibilities.

materials.name: 钛合金
materials.description: 钛合金是以钛为基体并加入铝、钒、钼等元素形成的合金体系，常用名称即钛合金。它兼具较低密度、较高比强度、耐腐蚀和生物相容性，α型、β型及α+β型合金的组织和性能不同。常用于航空结构、发动机部件、医疗植入物、化工设备、运动器材和高端消费品。
materials.cognitiveText: 钛合金在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 860–950 MPa。

cases.description: The sophisticated design of the VistaPosition PSP imaging plate holder system enables accurate X-rays in dentistry. Thanks to the colour coding, the components can be assembled quickly and intuitively. Clear, easily visible markings ensure exact positioning of the imaging plate, while the anatomically shaped holder ensures comfortable use. The lightweight titanium guide rod also increases patient comfort.

The Amphibio WaveFlex 82XTi is conceived as an all-rounder and provides superior performance for advanced skiers powered by the new Amphibio technology, a perfect combination of rocker and camber. A slightly wider geometry of the ski allows off-piste rides and skiing in deep snow. Due to a laminated wood core, the ski is very robust and responsive, ensuring an efficient transmission of power. Its responsiveness is underlined by the DualTi technology which guarantees aggressive edge control in all snow conditions.

The secret of SPHERE lies in its minimalistic design. Thanks to the use of a simplified but highly functional joint technology, the glasses do not require screws or soldered joints. The hinges each consist of a small steel ball that is precisely connected to the titanium temples with a milled ring. At an average of 13 grams, as a result SPHERE is a highly comfortable everyday accessory. The simplified design and production process lead to less material, less energy and less waste, protecting the environment.

In cycling sports shifting gears quickly is of utmost importance. Even the slightest irregularity can affect the riding flow and translate into a delay in time. The Super Record EPS 2015 is a groupset for road bikes that delivers a drivetrain for highly effective gear shifting performance. A central aspect of its design is that it merges the know-how of a long-established company with highly advanced technology. Specifically, the rear and front derailleurs are equipped with electric motors that allow the rider to shift gears in  a quick and highly precise manner. A single action via the shift control makes it possible to intuitively and seamlessly shift up or down for a multiple number of sprockets (multi-shifting). The shifting itself offers  a high degree of quality and comfort, since the “click feel” and position of the controls have been optimised in order to prevent any risk of unintentional shifting. Another innovation in the field of gear shifts that further enhances the safety of the rider has been realised with the possibility of releasing the rear derailleur from the motor manually for emergency functionality in the event of a fault. Carbon fibre and titanium have been brought together to make the groupset very light and durable. The seamless merging of tradition with modern technology has thus led to an innovative product of elegant appearance that signifies high  efficiency and safety for the rider.

The Smart wrench is made from a special titanium alloy, which provides an excellent combination of corrosion resistance and strength. Furthermore, the material is particularly lightweight and biocompatible. The tool features ergonomic grooves, making it pleasant and easy to use. The housing can be opened and serves as a storage space for various hex socket bits.

The particular form of the Akrapovič Slip-On Line (Titanium) for the Ducati Multistrada 1200 Enduro and Multistrada 950 is characterised by two symmetrical mufflers representing a two-cylinder engine. The use of titanium alloys has reduced the weight by 43 per cent for enhanced handling. The innovative design of the collector ensures an equal flow of exhaust gasses for a deep sound. Details like the handcrafted carbon-fibre heat shield, the laser-engraved logo, the perfect welds, and the sandblasted finish are indicators of precision engineering.

Mi Mix Alpha is an innovative smartphone which instantly catches the eye, especially with its high-resolution display. It wraps almost completely around the device, extending across not just the front of the casing, but also most of the rear, thus giving it a dramatic appearance. With an astounding 108 MP, the camera is unusually powerful. The smartphone is surrounded by a titanium alloy and fitted with a high-speed Snapdragon 855 Plus 5G chip, offering outstanding graphic performance.

The design of the rack makes it possible to find the required bone screws of the right length and thickness immediately as each screw only fits in its intended place. A nitinol flat spring holds the screws made of a titanium alloy at their tip in a special rack. Inside the screwdriver recess, they are held by a pointed protrusion that arises from the body of the rack. The retaining force allows for machine or ultrasonic washing, high-pressure steam cleaning and autoclaving.

This bike joins the usability and benefits of two worlds, the road racing world and the off-road Gravel world. With its 28 mm tyres it is particularly fast on path, but also on light off-road terrain. The frame offers a certain flexibility typical to titanium where needed, as for example in the seat stays, and boasts high rigidity in the bottom bracket. This creates a balance between a low total weight and the ability to absorb bumps, while being particularly powerful.

This intramedullary nail navigation system detects the accurate position of intramedullary nails using near-field electromagnetic positioning technology. It displays the 3D position of the intramedullary nail and sighting device on the screen and thus enables the surgeon to work precisely and fast, which shortens surgery time. Intramedullary nails are made of a titanium alloy, which is light and robust at the same time, protecting the human body from allergy and immune reactions.

Inspired by the form and gravity of black holes, this timepiece is equipped with independently developed central tourbillon, the first to break through five days of power reserve, using an ultra-light titanium alloy balance wheel for efficient and precise timekeeping. The black hole-shaped hands over the recessed dial plate showcase the convergence of black holes and space-time. Designed by Ziyao Xu.

The Super Sense Sonic Vibration Toothbrush features a titanium alloy unibody design, combined with the industry’s first 3D sonic vibration technology, delivering exceptional cleaning performance. The glossy and colored matte versions highlight the elegant texture of titanium alloy through unique magnetic fluid polishing and electrolytic coloring processes. The enlarged 20% larger screen allows users to intuitively select cleaning modes and durations, greatly enhancing the overall user experience.

Titan Edge ‘Uno’ fuses engineering and minimalist aesthetics into a watch form. 
In a world where every second counts, this is a refreshingly bold take on pausing and experiencing time at a slower pace. This watch has only a single hand, which glides over the dial, making the hand pinions invisible.

The pursuit of lighter fishing rods often requires higher-modulus carbon material, which suffers from reduced elasticity, durability and usability. Additionally, increased brittleness can result in significant material degradation over time as rods are subjected to repeated load. The EVOLUZION’s Titanium Hybrid Shaft structure addresses these concerns through materials innovation, providing the lightweight, high-tension characteristics of higher modulus material without sacrificing durability and lifetime performance.

The nexTouch Panel is a revolutionary product  that offers unprecedented customization, functionality, and safety in  home automation. Customers can customize the touch panel based on the titanium alloy middle frame according to their own needs.With a sleek, modern design crafted from premium  materials like AG glass, marble, and Nappa leather, it  elevates the traditional switch to a work of art. Its intelligent  features, including voice and app control, make it a powerful hub for  smart home devices.

MR-G timepieces, the flagship G-SHOCK line, are designed to showcase master craftsmanship. Following the MRG-B5000, a highly refined re-creation of the very first G-SHOCK, the MRG-B2100 is a sophisticated analog watch that exudes the aesthetic of practical elegance. The stately timepiece features a multi-component structure and impeccable finish, with 27 separate, individually polished bezel parts, and a dial pattern inspired by traditional Japanese kigumi wooden latticework. As with kigumi, the intricate design plays with light and shadow to achieve a bold, yet refined look that aligns perfectly with the prestige of the MR-G line.

THINKTOOL 399 is an efficient and practical tablet for vehicle diagnostics. Thanks to AI-based diagnostic functions, it can quickly record and analyse vehicle fault information. The casing is made of anodised titanium alloy, which ensures robustness, lightness and an industrial look. THINKTOOL 399 supports the intelligent connection of multiple devices and, thanks to functions such as RTC dual diagnostics and VCI screen sharing, enables the parallel diagnostics of two vehicles, which increases efficiency.

The Titanflex 824099 is made of an innovative material combination of HD acetate and a flexible and sturdy, patented nickel-titanium alloy. The design of the glasses is emphasaised by interruption of the classical form of the bridge, imparting a futuristic impression. The particularly flat and treated Base-2 plastic lenses with anti-reflex coating complete the overall homogenous impression.

The Camp Chair sets a new standard in terms of its functionality and use of sophisticated materials. It is not only compact, robust and very light, weighing just 1,188 grams, but it also offers a compact storage size and ensures high seating comfort. Features such as the optimised DAC frame tubing made from special alloy, the tailor-made seat and the seat top spacer pole are seamlessly integrated to form a product of high functionality.

cases.productName: Stop and Clamping Square 800 GK aluminium-titanium
cases.description: The Stop and Clamping Square 800 GK is an aluminium-titanium square designed for accurate positioning and fixing of working parts in welding and clamping materials. It is lightweight (22.9 pounds) and solid with a height of 800 millimeters. It is available in different sizes ranging from a square height of 300 millimeters to 1200 millimeters.

materials.name: NiTi形状记忆合金
materials.description: 材料简介
materials.cognitiveText: NiTi形状记忆合金在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 895–1900 MPa。

cases.description: The design of this wireless-charging neck light set is based on a concept that meets the needs of different work environments. Featuring shape-memory alloy, the flexible metal neck frame allows for hands-free use and ensures good wearing comfort. The dimmable, waterproof and dustproof LED lamps are equipped with a magnetic base that makes it possible to remove them from the frame and either attach them to metal surfaces or use them as torches.

The HBS750 headset is characterised by a bicolour design: the around-the-neck section consists of a shape memory alloy which can be folded as required. The embossed colour at the front contributes to the slim and compact appearance of the headset. With ergonomic curves that perfectly fit to bodily contours, the headset is comfortable to wear.

The Camp Chair sets a new standard in terms of its functionality and use of sophisticated materials. It is not only compact, robust and very light, weighing just 1,188 grams, but it also offers a compact storage size and ensures high seating comfort. Features such as the optimised DAC frame tubing made from special alloy, the tailor-made seat and the seat top spacer pole are seamlessly integrated to form a product of high functionality.

The yoose TRIPLE alloy reciprocating Shaver was designed for travel and other on-the-go scenarios. The compact form makes it easy to toss in your suitcase or use in the car. It also features more selling points than traditional shavers, especially function and cost. Its unique appearance and the multiple color choices make it a more fashionable choice. The integrated T-shaped structure design, streamlined all-alloy body, and triple ultra-thin blade reciprocating head enhance the speed and accuracy of shaving.
A complete range designed for men's shaving scenarios. Highly integrated all-alloy razors are compact, portable and powerful for everyday and traveling shaving.

This product is a rechargeable arc lighter to realize a safe, stable and efficient ignition experience. Suitable for a variety of environments, allowing users to realize their ignition needs indoors, in the car, and even in harsh environments such as low temperatures, high altitudes, high winds, and humidity. Can be used repeatedly by just charging, reducing the cost of use. Does not produce harmful gases, very friendly to the environment. 
The product body is round and compact, easy to carry, handheld feeling warm, one-handed use. Integrated all-alloy body and mirror texture, more like a portable exquisite artwork.

materials.name: 碳纤维
materials.description: 碳纤维常用简称为碳纤，是含碳量很高的细丝状材料，通常由聚丙烯腈等前驱体经稳定化和碳化制成。它具有低密度、高比强度、高比模量和明显方向性，多与环氧等树脂组合成复合材料。常用于航空航天、运动器材、自行车、汽车部件、机器人和高端产品外壳。
materials.cognitiveText: 碳纤维在“拉伸强度”尺度中的参数区间为 1800–3700 MPa。

cases.description: The A80 keyboard was created for high-end gamers and tech enthusiasts, delivering mechanical precision in combination with a dynamic appearance. The CNC-machined metal case references sports car aesthetics while the LED light strip creates customisable, futuristic lighting effects. A palm rest is set at an ergonomic angle to support the hand and lower arm during extended gaming sessions. This greater angle also results in faster keyboard reaction times. The forged carbon surface of the case is resistant to dirt and extremely durable.

The lightweight TravelMate P6 14 AI laptop is designed as a companion for mobile working. It combines a powerful NPU with over 45 TOPS for local AI applications with a robust casing made of carbon fibre and magnesium alloy. The device is optimised for hybrid working environments and features a triple microphone and numerous functions that simplify the workflow. PCR materials and an energy-efficient construction ensure sustainability.
