The Mountaineering Exoskeleton combines electric assistance technology with intelligent kinematics to reduce the physical strain of climbing. The adaptive construction with an anti-slip system ensures stability on rough terrain. Flexible sizing and quick donning and removal make it suitable for a range of users. Lightweight carbon fibre and efficient energy management optimise wearability and duration of use. Intelligent human-machine interaction synchronises movements and supports the natural gait.

The EDC29 is a thin tactical torch with a run time of over 60 hours that combines outstanding light output, intelligent functions and a robust design. It has a light output of 6,500 lumens, a range of up to 400 metres and a dual LED system with 18 cores for different types of light, such as spotlighting or floodlighting. A light shield mode provides protection, while randomly changing light frequencies can create a dizzying effect. The robust construction of stainless steel and carbon fibre weighs just 160 grams and fits securely in the hand.

The Amflow PL is an ultra-light electric mountain bike. Weighing just over 2 kg, its carbon frame ensures agility and an effortless riding experience. The bike features internal cable routing, a short front fork for more stability when cornering and a four-link structure for improved pedalling feedback. The DJI Avinox drive offers high performance with a compact design and is integrated inconspicuously into the frame. Despite the electric components, the Amflow PL resembles a classic mountain bike.

TreeRoot Quick Lock Travel Tripod (R141K-320P) is a versatile travel tripod that offers excellent stability. Made from an aluminium alloy and high-modulus carbon fibre, it combines strength with lightweight construction. The Reuleaux hybrid-shaped leg tube enhances torsional rigidity and handling. A user-friendly locking mechanism allows for set-up within seconds, while the quick-release centre column enables tool-free removal for instant transitioning to low-angle shooting.

As a modern redesign of the iconic boom box of the 1980s, the iP4 audio system combines yesterday’s look with today’s technology. Beneath the rubberised surface, the device features specially designed carbon fibre woofers, a highly efficient class-D amplifier, and digital sound processing developed and licensed by SRS Labs. Additional features include a magnetically attached remote control, a five-band graphic equaliser, and an output-level indicator.

The LED panels of the AOTO SW Series combine a modern look with advanced technology for large stages. The panels feature a robust, high-strength framework made of carbon fibre and an aluminium alloy, making them weigh less than 19 kg/m². A pronounced curvature and precise 90-degree angles allow for visually creative presentations. Thanks to practical mechanical features such as magnetic modules, quick-release fasteners, ejection systems and ergonomic handles, efficient installation and easy maintenance are achieved.

Matching the ambience of a loft living space, this kitchen provides cabinet modules that are particularly suited for the presentation of decorative items. The Loft kitchen is based on a stringent design concept favouring the use of high quality materials such as carbon, stainless steel, veneer and glass. Its striking contour is determined by a segment-shaped structure. The geometric proportions emphasise the appeal of the cabinet elements. The kitchen island includes a hidden cupboard, which can be accessed from two sides. It features an electromechanical drive for automatic opening.

Thanks to its innovative construction with four joints, the Orca garden shears optimise power transmission compared to conventional shears by approximately 50 per cent. The four main components, made of high-quality, carbon fibre-reinforced polyamide, minimise weight and springiness. Despite their slim design, the shears achieve a stability and rigidity that matches that of professional aluminium shears. Both blades can be removed for sharpening or replacement. Orca includes a hand guard and is available in two sizes.

The PurMop BLACK C1 carbon fibre mop system was developed for cleaning cleanrooms. It fulfils the strictest hygiene requirements and impresses with its user-friendliness, ergonomics and efficiency. The system has a non-contact mechanism for picking up and dropping the mops. Its low weight of just 650 grams and flexibly adjustable length facilitate ergonomic use - even overhead. The matt black colour and the strikingly patterned handle give PurMop BLACK C1 a slightly futuristic look. The matching mops are made entirely from recycled material.

The Ultra High Resolution Spectral 3D Microscopy Scanning Measurement System is characterised by high precision, resolution and scanning speed. It represents an efficient quality inspection solution for high-tech industries. The device has an ultra-fine light point that captures the smallest details while simultaneously offering a wide range with ultra-high resolution. It achieves an image processing speed of up to 15.4 billion pixels per second and scans 3D contours at a sampling rate of 7 kHz in full-screen mode.

The Vision-1 is a versatile pair of sunglasses that offers seamless tint adjustment and optimal eye protection. The glasses utilise innovative IRID X-10 lenses, which combine a small solar cell with a special liquid crystal film to provide battery-free autonomous tint adaptation in less than a second, depending on the ambient light. The lenses can cover any tint from 60 to 6 per cent of light transmittance. The frame, made of carbon fibre-reinforced Grilamid, is both durable and lightweight, while its adjustable temples enhance comfort.

The carbon e-bike i:SY Skyfly is characterised by its light weight of 18.2 kg and the minimalist appearance with striking frame openings and nearly identical frame angles. Components such as the Bosch SX drive unit, the battery and the system control are form-fittingly integrated. Despite its compact dimensions, the e-bike offers riders from 165 cm to 195 cm the opportunity to adjust the ergonomic sitting position that suits them. Mounting points on the frame allow for the installation of a luggage rack on both the front and rear wheel.

The Enya NEXG 2 Carbon Fiber Smart Guitar combines traditional guitar craftsmanship with the essence of new technologies. The use of third-generation acoustic carbon fibre makes the guitar lighter and more robust and promotes a powerful acoustic performance. Thanks to its handcrafted production in combination with high-quality materials, the guitar impresses with its quality and elegant appearance. Technical features such as AR speakers, a new DSP chip and AI tone cloning technology offer ambitious music lovers plenty of scope.

“Designing Dreams” was the title of the exhibition with which Flavio Manzoni and the Ferrari Design Team presented themselves as Red Dot: Design Team of the Year 2019 at the Red Dot Design Museum and provided an insight into their work. To mark the brand’s 75th anniversary, the Ferrari Design Team created another dream for the Gran Turismo video game: the Ferrari of the future in the form of the Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo concept car. Even though the study will only be on the road on virtual racetracks for the time being, its design already defines what Ferrari calls a “speed form” and thus gives insight into the future vocabulary of form. At the same time, the Ferrari Vision GT builds a bridge to the history of the brand, as its aggressive design is directly inspired by the legendary Ferrari sports prototypes of the 1960s and 1970s. The new design language is characterised by very sharp and angular lines, which are, however, at the same time based on a very organic design. This strong contrast, based on the plasticity of the surfaces in interaction with the geometric precision of the lines, has a disruptive effect that shapes the highly independent, futuristic character of the single-seater. At the heart of the Ferrari Vision GT’s architecture is a progressive aerodynamic concept based on two imposing side channels. This patented solution directs the airflow from the front underbody, around the cockpit and over the striking side pods. The sleek, aerodynamic body appears to float above the flat carbon-fibre underbody that houses all the car’s technical components. The interior design continues the design language of the exterior and offers optimal functionality and driver ergonomics. The jury was enthusiastic about the concept: “The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo embodies the Ferrari heritage and manifests a vision for the future of the brand. The entire appearance of this concept study, designed for the greatest possible aerodynamics, conveys dynamism, speed and uncompromising determination. The fascination of the play of contrasts celebrated here, this retro-futuristic design language, is hard to resist.”

Scotsman is a fully connected carbon fibre e-scooter characterised by its streamlined design with organic curves. The frame is 3D-printed in a single pass from patented thermoplastic carbon fibre composite, resulting in a strong yet lightweight structure free of joints or screws that is recyclable and more durable than steel or aluminium. Smart features such as GPS, auto-lock, a mobile app and dashcam allow the user to make informed decisions on the ride.

The Canyon Spectral:ON CFR mountain bike combines a full carbon frame with a high-torque motor and offers significantly more range than the previous model thanks to the discreetly integrated battery with up to 900 Wh capacity. Flowing transitions between stem, cockpit and front triangle underline the claim in terms of performance, lightness and dynamics. A light, manoeuvrable piece of sports equipment, it offers a natural riding feel with reliable resistance.

The frame of the Superstrata bicycle consists of a single piece of carbon fibre composite formed using a 3D printing process – without joints, screws or adhesives – which means a gain for both the strength and the aesthetics of the bike. Each model is unique, as the frame is made specifically for the body measurements of the buyer. The durable structure made of the composite material is fully recyclable at the end of the bicycle’s life cycle.

The Zero Y Carbon Fiber travel tripod is suitable for both photographers and videographers. After flipping an ergonomically designed release lever, the user can remove the centre column and use it as a selfie stick. In addition, the centre column can be shortened for a low camera position or inverted so that the camera hangs below the tripod legs. An integrated bubble level can be used for checking the alignment. The ball head is equipped with an Arca-Swiss-compatible quick-release plate. The jury praised the fact that, despite its light weight, the tripod boasts a wide range of possible uses.

parameters.name: 线膨胀系数
parameters.definition: 线膨胀系数表示材料受温度变化时尺寸变化的程度。数值越高，热胀冷缩越明显。
parameters.designMeaning: 帮助设计师理解温度变化对材料尺寸稳定性的影响。

materials.name: 金刚石
materials.description: 金刚石常用名称为金刚石，达到宝石品质并经切磨后通常称为钻石，是碳元素形成的晶体材料。它具有极高硬度、耐磨性和很高导热能力，但不同晶向和缺陷会影响性能。除珠宝外，工业金刚石广泛用于切削、磨削、钻探、散热片、光学窗口和高压实验装置。
materials.cognitiveText: 金刚石在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 0.8–1.2 10^-6/K。

cases.description: A sustainable approach to resources clearly reflects in the use of durable products. This is no different when it comes to cooking. For example, a high-quality kitchen knife can accompany its user for decades if it is sharpened regularly. With this in mind, the KLENG Chef’s Knife in combination with a self-sharpening knife block offers the best conditions for a long product life. Without any additional effort on the part of the user, the steel blade is re-sharpened every time it is pulled out of the knife block. A diamond-like carbon coating inspired by space technology reduces cutting friction and improves the scratch resistance as well as acid and alkali resistance of the blade. Both the knife handle and the knife block are made of renewable, fast-growing bamboo. Due to the high density of the bamboo fibres, the surface feels pleasantly supple. The kitchen knife, handmade in Germany, is available with either a black diamond-coated blade and dark brown handle or a matt silver blade and light brown bamboo handle, with the logo on the blade prominently highlighted. The knife with its gently curved edge follows a minimal design language. In the set with the colour-matching knife block, it is visually and haptically highly appealing.

The Crescent Lufkin Shockforce has been developed for experts, in particular for professionals in the building trade. In this context, impact protection, durability and tape stand out are the main criteria for a good tape measure. This is taken into account by the choice of materials, a reduction in weight and sophisticated details such as the blade geometry. Further features are the good legibility and the durable nylon coating of the tape, which is printed on both sides. The tape hook has a diamond-coated finish that grips almost any surface. The tether point likewise serves as a pivot point for marking arches.

This cookware series shows an exceptionally robust sealing with a rough surface. All pots and pans are made by hand and feature three layers: a plasma-hardened base as well as a PEEK intermediate layer and a diamond-reinforced finish with an abrasion-resistant non-stick coating. The cookware is optionally available with phenolic or stainless steel handles which are either fixed or detachable. It also includes matching lids for all sizes. They are made of safety glass or stainless steel and equipped with a vent.

With this manually adjustable knife sharpener it is possible to adjust the grinding surface quite simply so that every knife can be sharpened in the grinding angle originally set by the manufacturer. This way there is less metal abrasion. The knife sharpener has three grinding slots: one with ceramic rods for light re-sharpening, one with diamond for sharpening blunt or damaged knives as well as one with serrations for a serrated blade.

The DSW 1510-CA diamond wire saw represents a new design approach that focuses on the aspects of safety and simplicity. Instead of multiple components that all have to be connected via cables on site, the DSW 1510-CA is a compact all-in-one unit that is controlled via a wireless remote control. This allows the user to start work faster and stand at a safer distance while the saw is in operation. Large wheels make it easier to transport the device on construction sites.

Diamond-like carbon (DLC) is used as a high-performance material in the racing and aviation industry. Since the surgical steel and titanium composite frames of this collection are coated with an amorphous film of DLC, they are particularly durable and scratch-resistant. The frames weigh barely 17 grams and utilise a patented screwless hinge technology, which has been thoroughly tested to withstand high physical strain without failing.

The rugged and capable Apple Watch Ultra 2 features the most accurate GPS in a sports watch, the brightest display of any Apple product, and up to 36 hours of battery life with regular use or up to 72 hours in Low Power Mode. watchOS 11 brings powerful new features including insights from training load and the Vitals app; sleep apnea notifications; the Tides app; new customization options for the Action button; and more. The new black titanium finish for Apple Watch Ultra 2 is achieved with a custom blasting process, and the diamond-like carbon physical vapor deposition coating over the grade 5 titanium makes it scratch-resistant and durable.

materials.name: 橡木
materials.description: 橡木常用名称为橡木或栎木，来自栎属多种树木，是家具和室内产品中常见的阔叶木材。其纹理明显，通常具有较好的强度、耐磨性和表面涂饰效果，白橡与红橡在导管结构、色泽和耐久性方面存在差异。常用于家具、地板、酒桶、饰面板和结构木制品，性能受含水率影响明显。
materials.cognitiveText: 橡木在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 3.1–4.5 10^-6/K。

cases.description: Design innovations are often the product of technology transfer. In the case of Furniture Linoleum, the innovative aspect is first and foremost a carefully considered material transfer that has led to a sustainable product with aesthetic appeal. Forbo Flooring had previously focused on the production of high-quality flooring materials before deciding to diversify its portfolio and expertise in the furniture sector with Furniture Linoleum. Now the time-tested material of linoleum is captivating a new audience with its natural, warm feel and excellent durability as a contemporary surface finish for home and kitchen furniture, doors, and much more. “This product embodies our vision of creating functional, durable and environmentally conscious finishes for both flooring and furniture,” says the manufacturer. Linoleum’s climate-positive aspects also contribute to user convenience. Made from renewable and natural raw materials such as linseed oil, wood flour, pine resin and limestone, it has a naturally elegant, matt surface that is resistant to fingerprints. Being easy to clean, Furniture Linoleum is also an interesting option for the customised furnishing of public spaces. Forbo Flooring complements all of these positive properties with an attractive range of 24 colours that blend seamlessly with natural woods and stones, such as oak, walnut and maple, or marble, concrete and terrazzo. A special aesthetic has been achieved with the “Pure Linoleum” decor, which completely dispenses with colour pigments to showcase the natural shade of linseed oil. Like leather and wood, each piece is unique and alters in appearance over time. The Red Dot jurors were fascinated by the natural look and feel: “What really impressed us about Furniture Linoleum is this focus on material purity. The special yet subtle tactile warmth of the surfaces makes them feel comforting to the touch. Another remarkable aspect is the unique natural aroma of linoleum that is pleasant to perceive. This material represents tangible quality. It is honest, thoughtfully designed and delivers genuine added value for healthy interior spaces.”

The LIND Canvas electric jetboard combines the look, handling and feel of a classic surfboard with modern drive technology. Made of EPS foam and epoxy resin with oak wood details, the board weighs just 7 kg and can be set up in less than a minute without tools. The jet and battery modules fit in a backpack. With 20 kW of power, a speed of up to 60 km/h and 45 minutes of riding time, it offers powerful performance and timeless aesthetics. Unique Art Boards made in collaboration with artists are available as collectables.

The Electric Fondue Set Pro combines traditional fondue culture with the functionality and simplicity of an electric set. A heating element with a safety thermostat maintains temperatures in the range of 50 to 190 degrees Celsius to suit cheese, meat, chocolate and bouillon fondues alike. The device, made of cast iron and oak, has a splash guard with notches for the fondue forks and is largely free of plastics. Thanks to its long mains cable, it can be used flexibly.

The Loop furniture collection is characterised by an attractive interplay of contrasts. It combines a sculptural base made of solid oak wood with the softness of organically moulded textile upholstery. In addition to artfully curved armrests, which inspired the name, the aesthetics are characterised by balanced proportions that also ensure pleasant comfort. The flexible collection includes armchairs, chairs, chaise longues and footstools that bring cosiness and elegance to a variety of room layouts.

Where people move frequently for work reasons, the traditional fitted kitchen becomes a problem due to a lack of flexibility. TERMINO’s modular kitchen system addresses this problem by being modular in design and made from lightweight yet durable materials such as recycled aluminium, 316L stainless steel and European oak. With 14 highly configurable, stackable modules, it adapts to a wide variety of layouts, as well as to changes in household size, needs or preferences.

The slimline oak Heart'n'Soul dining table, with its integrated, hidden extension leaves, can seat up to twelve people. At both ends of the table there is a fabric-lined drawer for storing important items, like cutlery, within easy reach. The Heart'n'Soul dining tables are available in dark oak and black oak versions, as well as oak versions with a highly scratch resistant nanolaminate finish in various colours. The rounded corners and smooth transitions from tabletop to table legs create a high-quality aesthetic.

The Diabolo Dumbbells were developed with a special focus on exclusivity and sustainability. When customising these free weights to their personal preferences, users can choose between different FSC-certified hardwoods for the handles, including reclaimed oak, and even order a personal engraving on the slightly concave-shaped end plate. Each dumbbell set is made to order with the aim of preventing material waste and the production of superfluous equipment. The lifetime guarantee also ensures that the stylish training equipment can be repaired rather than replaced. The jury praised the Diabolo Dumbbells as “an excellent example of how elegance and sustainability can be successfully combined”.

IKA innovatively advances the design of folding chairs. The seat and legs are made of high-quality oak and are combined with a sturdy leather strap, which has two functions: it serves as a convenient backrest, but also as a carrying strap. This facilitates the transport of IKA when folded. The iron fittings are deliberately used as a striking design feature.

Distinctive visual accents with a contrast between gloss and matt surfaces, along with a combination of oak and aluminium, characterise this compact wine cooler. The frameless door with its tinted, UV-absorbent glass, together with the appealing interior lighting, presents the contents in an attractive light. The wine cooler offers a satisfying user experience with a pull-out shelf and two temperature zones that can be controlled individually.

The handle-free built-under Siemens Freestanding Wine Cooler cools and elegantly showcases fine wines. Its dark metal body, which tastefully complements the graphite-grey interior, creates an effective display for white and red wines. From the solid oak shelves to the door with UV filter, the materials and overall design exude strong value.

Inspired by a kinetic sculpture, this table lamp consists of five wooden rods of different lengths equipped with discreet adjustable metal connections. These allow both the lamp base and the illuminated area to be aligned according to individual needs. As a battery-powered device, the lamp achieves a running time of approximately eight hours at full power and a running time of up to twelve hours at medium power. The portable table lamp is optionally available in oak, ash wood or walnut.

The Siemens Freestanding Wine Cooler provides plenty of room for fine wines that are showcased in an appealing manner. Dark grey tones in the interior frame the stored bottles, while the metallic-grey tinted glass door protects the bottles from harmful UV light. The exclusive overall appearance is enhanced by solid aluminium profiles on the front of the real oak shelves. The presenter shelf that can be set at an angle allows special treasures to be beautifully arranged.

This robust pizza peel was designed in the style of a garden shovel and equipped with a handle made of solid oak wood. This patented handle enables one-handed use, as its smoothly sanded wooden surface rests firmly against the forearm during use. The blade made of high-quality aluminium boasts an only 2 mm thick edge that easily slides under the pizza base. The pizza peel is suitable for pizzas with a diameter of up to 30 cm.

The Siemens BU30 wine cooler is characterised by high-quality features and a modern functionality and was designed for fitted kitchens. The slender appliance with 30 cm width has a dark surface with a milled, black anodised bar handle made of genuine metal. The graphite grey interior is combined with oak wood shelves, which have solid aluminium profiles on the front. A tinted UV protection of the door as well as innovative temperature regulation and control by touch operation ensure optimised storage conditions.

The characteristic style element of this bathroom furniture series is the shape it is named after – oval. The collection is furthermore defined by a high-contrast material combination that blends warm oak or ash wood with dark grey powder-coated metal elements. The versatile and functionally sophisticated components merge into a homogeneous entity. With its highly distinctive design, the collection lends bathrooms a unique and exclusive style.

Reverse Conference is a series of conference tables, available with one or multiple bases and variable tabletops in 14 sizes. The table displays an elegant look with its 30 mm laminated wood plate in oak veneer or lacquered style, and the contrasting thick bases tapering upward. The base frames are made of 100 per cent recyclable polyethylene and come in matt or glossy versions.

These open shelving elements in light design, used as end shelving in the cabinet area, take the interior of the kitchen to the outside and facilitate opening of the kitchen into the living and dining area. The shelves are flexible to use. In the rear panel, system rails are located which can accommodate, apart from shelves of glass or oak, also drawers or storage boxes and utensil holders.

With its delicate lines, the bed Light manages elegantly to tame the natural characteristics of wood. Graceful, slanted legs conform to the manufacturer’s trademark style while the two broad bars of the bed head add a refined touch. The precise construction of the bed is reflected by the details: only the head of the wooden peg, for example, hints at the point where the sides of the bed are connected to each other. Light is available in walnut or oak.

This entrance door is 220 mm thick and its exterior is completely covered with glass, thus allowing it to blend in harmoniously with the house entrance. On the side is a functional channel in black anodised aluminium which contains the bell and a door-opening module together with the letterbox. The inside of the door is made of fine woods, such as varnished German wild oak, a feature which underlines its exclusive character.

The AUGLETICS Eight Style ergometer is clad in a chic oak wall and can be optimally connected. It is almost noiseless as the resistance is generated by an eddy current brake. With a Virtual Coach, every stroke can be analysed in real time and the user’s technique can be continuously improved. The integrated touch display ensures simple operation. The ergometer can be stowed away in two easy steps and, folded up, fits in any corner.

materials.name: 瓷
materials.description: 瓷常用名称为瓷器或瓷质陶瓷，是以高岭土、长石、石英等原料成形并经高温烧结得到的致密陶瓷。它通常质地坚硬、耐磨、耐化学腐蚀并具有良好电绝缘性，但脆性较高。日用瓷、建筑瓷和工程瓷在配方与烧成制度上差异明显，常用于餐具、卫浴、绝缘件、饰面和精密陶瓷部件。
materials.cognitiveText: 瓷在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 2–6.6 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The particularly lightweight Zenbook A14 laptop supports mobile users in urban environments. The rounded shape of the casing and the grey and beige colour scheme, which is inspired by pebbles, ensure pleasant handling and a natural look. Made from a magnesium-aluminium alloy with a ceramic finish, the surface is resistant to scratches and dirt. The device combines high battery performance with robust suitability for everyday use.

The ultra-slim, foldable casing of the Xiaomi Mix Fold 4 is both lightweight and robust. Its seamless design with glass, metal and fibreglass creates a pleasant feel and an elegant look. The quad-curved glass of the display blends harmoniously into the metal casing, while the back is made of Dragon Scale Fibre, a material composed of ceramic and aramid. Combined with sophisticated hinge technology, it increases shock resistance.

The expressive Metalcraft tile range provides scope for creating bathrooms and living spaces in a very individual style. The colour concept encompasses silver and steel tones as well as shades of brown and black with copper, brass and petrol-coloured highlights. Finished with the easy-to-clean CeramicPlus surface, the floor tiles are slip-resistant (R10) and available in four colours and three sizes. They can be combined with large-format wall tiles (40 × 120 cm) from the same range and matching skirting to create either harmony or contrast.

Inspired by the rawness of urban landscapes, the CementEra tiles, with their eye-catching cement aesthetic, embody minimalist elegance. Combining the characteristic texture of concrete with a handmade look, the tiles offer visual depth and sensory appeal. Available in four harmonious colours, they feature traditional marbling patterns and digital marble effects that give floors, work surfaces, walls and facades a calm and modern appearance. The large-format sizes of the tiles ensure a seamless design appearance.

The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

Six bold colours and a rounded silhouette reminiscent of a highlighter define the fresh aesthetic of the Vuse Go Reload Pen. This compact vaporiser heats e-liquids to release flavour and nicotine. With a robust build, carefully chosen materials and a replaceable pod system, it was designed as a sustainable alternative to disposable devices. Integrated ceramic heating technology ensures consistent flavour, and the device can be conveniently recharged via a universal USB-C port.

The Alina collection combines a linear and subtle stylistic language with functional properties that make it ideal for commercial use. Centrally placed embossment structures the surface and creates a focal point in the middle for the presentation of food. All the individual pieces of the tableware set are made from highly resilient hard porcelain and are not only stackable, but also dishwasher, oven and microwave safe, as well as thermal shock and edge chip-resistant for the intense rigours of the hospitality sector.

The Ohtake Basin and Bathtub range comprises a countertop washbasin and a freestanding soaking tub that are inspired by motifs from nature and Japanese culture. The flowing lines and delicate edges of the fine ceramic washbasin bear a resemblance to the elegant shape of the calla lily. The Stonex tub, with its gentle forms and curved contours, is reminiscent of a Japanese Ofuro. Accordingly, this soaking tub is primarily intended for relaxation rather than cleaning.

The floor-standing Bella Smart toilet is characterised by flowing lines that are gently contrasted by the precise lid edge. The Magic Bubble technology creates a dense layer of foam to reduce odours and splashing water, while the dual-clean flush requires less water and efficiently clears the entire bowl, even at low water pressure. Thanks to a ceramic heating tube, the water is instantly heated to a pre-set temperature as soon as the shower function is activated.

Panio features all the characteristics of a porcelain tableware set specifically designed for use in the hospitality industry. It is distinguished by a radial relief based on parametric, fractal geometric patterns. Its tactile, visually appealing surface discreetly highlights the food presented without eclipsing it. With its versatile range, the collection meets all typical gastronomy requirements. All the pieces are dishwasher safe, impact resistant and the thickness of the material ensures that they can withstand intense use.

Tone is an organically shaped, glazed collection of ceramics created for professional use. The gently curved form was inspired by the appearance of scallops, the sea and the structure of textiles. The collection features three harmonising reactive glazes: Sahara, Blush and Adelfa. Made from a once-fired, virtually pore-free premium vitrified material, Tone is durable and energy efficient in manufacture. All the pieces are nestable, functional in their dimensions and crafted for fine dining.

This cookware set performs several functions with just three items. The Glasslock Chef Topf consists of a pot, a lid and a small stove, and can be used to prepare meals as well as serve them at the table. The lid also functions as a frying pan or can be used as a plate. A small air hole allows steam to escape during cooking, thus preventing contents from boiling over. Made from aluminium with a ceramic coating, the set can be used with a range of different heat sources, from electric hobs to air fryers.

The Unwasted tile collection consists of repurposed waste materials such as eggshells, straw residues, reclaimed glass and ceramic waste, thus creating a closed resource cycle. This blend of different materials also creates variously textured surfaces and unique patterns during production, giving the tiles a natural look and feel. At the same time, the waste-based mixture reduces energy consumption as the tiles can be fired at a lower temperature.

As far back as 2000 BC, tiles were being used throughout the Orient. Ornamental motifs decorated the walls and floors of buildings. Mostly the motifs were similar to those seen on oriental carpets. Even today, in some parts of the world, tiles are still baked in the same way that they have been for thousands of years. KuQua ceramic tiles build on the traditional significance of tiles and in doing so represent a symbiosis of ancient workmanship and contemporary design. One is struck above all by the three-dimensional impression of these tiles. This is mainly due to the meeting of two opposites. The ornaments shown on the tiles were developed on a computer and are infinitely repeatable thus leaving nothing to chance. The KuQua series, which comes in three options, is in fact the result of blending spherical and cubic forms and follows a strict geometrical concept. The flower-like ornament, together with the high-gloss coloured glaze, creates a noticeable contrast to the matt, smoke-black appearance of the surface of the ceramic tiles. KuQua tiles are handmade and fired at 1,000°C in an electric kiln. After screen printing, they are fired a second time then immersed in sawdust. Low fired ceramic tiles are very good at storing and regulating warmth and moisture, then releasing both. As a result, they have a positive effect on a room’s environment.

The LG Room & Style monitor was designed for home office use and entertainment. It supports streaming apps and can be used for work, with or without a PC. The device uses a tray as a stand, which also serves to store items, such as the remote control. Also suitable for mounting on a wall or in a caravan, this user-friendly monitor is easy to assemble and disassemble.

The Restroom Dresser Premium Series was developed to transform the home bathroom into an oasis of well-being. Soft lighting, which switches on automatically using a motion sensor, and flowing shapes create a harmonious ambience. Touchless faucet with automatic on/off functions (wall mounted type) and ceramic-glaze basins increase user comfort. The marbled wall panel not only serves as splash protection, but also lends elegance to the ensemble.

The design of the Portico urinal is inspired by decorative elements of traditional Italian courtyard facades. The urinal is made of a rectangular ceramic block with a stylised, gently curved bowl with raised edges at its centre. The geometry of the bowl has been carefully optimised to prevent urine splashes. The battery of the sensor-controlled flush can be replaced in a few simple steps, making maintenance easier. Portico is available in classic white as well as in an anthracite-coloured version.

The VGR-001 electric hair clipper is characterised by a stepless speed control system with an eye-catching digital speed display. With up to 9,000 rpm, it offers powerful performance for various requirements. Fixed DLC blades with ceramic moving blades ensure strength and durability. The device has a Type-C charging port and a docking station with up to 300 minutes of battery life. Other features include an LED light and ten different comb sizes.

The design of the ceramic basin Cobble is inspired by natural lines, expressed in a gentle shaping that is reminiscent of the appearance of a leaf. The 700 mm wide basin is available in various subtle colours and coated with a skin-friendly and at the same time resistant pearl glaze. Thanks to the smooth surface, it is resistant to water stains, limescale deposits and bacteria. This facilitates cleaning and reduces the consumption of environmentally harmful cleaning agents.

PURE VORTEX is based on an innovative vortex flushing system that opens up new possibilities in the design of sanitary ceramics. The water outlet at the front of the toilet, which is not visible at first glance, allows for a smooth surface without the traditional flushing rim. This makes the interior particularly easy to clean. Thanks to the newly developed technology, the flushing process is not only exceptionally quiet but also environmentally friendly, as only 4.5 litres of water are required for a complete flush.

materials.name: 蓝宝石玻璃
materials.description: 蓝宝石玻璃常用名称为蓝宝石玻璃或蓝宝石晶体，本质上通常是人工生长的单晶氧化铝，并非普通硅酸盐玻璃。它透明、硬度高、耐磨且耐高温，可制成薄片和光学窗口，但加工成本较高且仍具有脆性。常用于手表镜面、手机镜头保护、传感器窗口、LED衬底和精密光学器件。
materials.cognitiveText: 蓝宝石玻璃在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 4.3–5.4 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The Extend ring was inspired by the idea to create a piece of jewellery that would be as flexible as it is versatile and that would fit every finger. It was modelled on the pantograph of astronomer and inventor Christoph Scheiner. Just like the technical instrument, the ring is composed of separate elements that flexibly interlock. It is made of 18-carat white or yellow gold and ornamented with precious stones.

The GEMO Luxury Beauty Instrument G10 uses a sapphire flat flash port with RF-ICE anti-aging technology to make the entire process cool and comfortable. The design solves a series of problems, such as excessive temperature, unbearable pain, and redness and sensitivity of the skin, bringing users an unparalleled beauty experience with a high standard of care and service.

The Fenix 7 series is a collection of rugged outdoor smartwatches that help people navigate the outdoors with confidence. The watches are designed to withstand extreme environments and are built with titanium and sapphire to survive any adventure. They incorporate a transparent solar cell that sits above the display collecting sunlight that can extend battery life by over a week. The series comes in three sizes and a variety of finishes to suit a wide range of people and activities. Built-in worldwide topo maps make navigation simple and reliable when in unfamiliar terrain.

materials.name: 钛金属（纯钛）
materials.description: 钛金属（纯钛）常用名称为纯钛或钛金属，通常指工业纯钛而非加入大量合金元素的钛合金。它呈银灰色，密度低于钢，具有良好耐腐蚀性、生物相容性和一定成形焊接能力；不同纯钛等级的强度差异明显。常用于化工设备、医疗器械、换热器、建筑饰面和轻量化产品。
materials.cognitiveText: 钛金属（纯钛）在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 8.4–9 10^-6/K。

cases.description: Heirloom Vacuum Flask-Mini is a stewed teapot that doesn’t produce odor. The mouth and body are inspired by Oriental aesthetics. In order not to produce odor at high temperature and store water more hygienically, its inner liner is made of pure titanium and the spout is made of stainless steel. To reduce heat loss, the inner liner thickness is only 0.2 mm with a processed mirror surface. Designed by Dong Wu of Shenzhen Yiyuan Technology Co., Ltd.

materials.name: 钢化玻璃
materials.description: 钢化玻璃常用名称为钢化玻璃或强化玻璃，是普通玻璃经热处理或化学强化形成表面压应力的安全玻璃。它的抗弯和抗热冲击能力通常高于未强化玻璃，破碎时热钢化玻璃会形成较小颗粒。常用于建筑门窗、家具、家电面板、汽车侧窗、手机保护盖板和展示装置。
materials.cognitiveText: 钢化玻璃在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 8.5–9.5 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The ARTEVO TERRA window system guarantees sustainability throughout its entire life cycle. The profiles are made of bio-attributed PVC on the outside and up to 78 per cent recycled PVC in the core. The glazing beads contain up to 80 per cent recycled material. The fibre composite material makes steel superfluous in 80 per cent of applications, thus reducing CO₂ emissions. The LowE profile technology optimises thermal insulation and meets passive house standards. The system is fully recyclable; digital labelling facilitates end-of-life recycling.

The Sonnenglas Light Carafe is a hand-blown glass carafe that transforms into an atmospheric table lamp with the manufacturer’s SOMO solar light. Only recycled bottle glass collected by locals in Eswatini (Africa) is used in the production process. This work is the sole source of income for many, and it also contributes to a cleaner environment. Manufactured in a solar-powered factory, the Light Carafe is highly functional and has a timeless aesthetic.

The Wuliangye Project Vision combines the aesthetics of industrial mechanics with the Fibonacci spiral to symbolise the connection between nature, time and innovation. The outer packaging of the fine, traditional spirit hints at the precise curves and structural shape of the bottle inside. A glass window provides a glimpse of the interior. The proportions of the high-end metal bottle adhere to the golden ratio, and its spiral shape invites playful interaction.

VB600 Dual Eyes Video Bar is a video conferencing system with dual-lens technology for medium and large meeting rooms. It combines high audio and video quality with intelligent functions such as auto-framing and speaker tracking. A one-touch privacy function increases security. Thanks to its user-friendliness and flexibility, the system is suitable for various application areas, including financial consulting and medical technology, and thus meets the increasing demand for remote solutions.

The ultra-slim, foldable casing of the Xiaomi Mix Fold 4 is both lightweight and robust. Its seamless design with glass, metal and fibreglass creates a pleasant feel and an elegant look. The quad-curved glass of the display blends harmoniously into the metal casing, while the back is made of Dragon Scale Fibre, a material composed of ceramic and aramid. Combined with sophisticated hinge technology, it increases shock resistance.

The design of the Xiaomi 14 Ultra is defined by its prominently placed camera, emphasising the device's advanced photo and video capabilities. Its metal casing ensures high stability and pressure resistance, while the quad-curved screen enhances both the visual and tactile user experience. The device is complemented by accessories, such as a photo grip with a shutter button and zoom function, a 1,500 mAh battery for extended use and an adapter ring for filters.

The iPad Pro M4 is the thinnest Apple product to date. It combines high computing power with an extremely flat design. The 11" model measures 5.3 mm, the 13" model only 5.1 mm. Both versions are made from recycled aluminium and are available in silver or black. A tandem OLED display ensures precise image reproduction. An anti-reflective nano-glass surface is available as an option. Despite the reduced weight, stability is maintained, facilitating mobile work processes considerably.

The TCL 50 PRO NXTPAPER 5G is a smartphone with a focus on visual comfort and material-conscious design. Its battery cover is just 0.34 mm thin and is paired with a newly developed frame that enhances the visual experience by remaining nearly invisible. The matt screen surface features a nano-etched microstructure to reduce eye strain. This device is aimed at users who prioritise an ergonomic design language and thoughtful functionality.

The Xiaomi Civi4 Pro is a particularly slim smartphone designed for young, fashion-conscious users. Thanks to its low weight, it sits comfortably in the hand. The back combines two colours with a mother-of-pearl-like sheen, while the camera ring with its finely polished structure is reminiscent of luxury watches. A Snapdragon chip and Leica image processing ensure high image quality and smooth performance with continuous use.

The ROG Phone 9 is a gaming smartphone with features suitable for everyday use. Its integrated hybrid camera allows for precise recording, while AI-powered translation and transcription for calls provide additional convenience. A 5,800 mAh battery ensures a long runtime, while the five-part cooling system keeps performance stable. The 185 hertz AMOLED display, a lateral charging port and a headphone connector enhance the gaming experience. The device is IP68-rated and made of recycled aluminium.

The Zenfone 12 Ultra combines rugged outdoor capability with a sustainable design concept. The back is made from etched glass without additional coatings, the frame uses recycled aluminium, and the display glass contains 22 per cent recycled materials. The camera features a 6-axis gimbal with AI optimisation and an algorithm for stable 4K videos. A 6.78" display with 144 Hz, IP68 certification and a 5,500 mAh battery complete the smartphone’s high-performance profile.

With a 40.2 MP sensor and in-body image stabilisation, the FUJIFILM X100VI delivers high image quality even in low light conditions. The camera’s retro aesthetic is achieved through a tactile, analogue feel reminiscent of classic film cameras. The machined dial, non-slip exterior and aluminium top plate reinforce this impression. And advanced hybrid viewfinder and a flat, fold-out LCD display ensure flexibility. The compact and lightweight camera is available in both silver and black versions.

The Strato V enables 4K playback with Dolby Vision and lossless audio. It can be used independently or in conjunction with Terra servers. An Strato V 960GB SSD can store around ten 4K films, while the newly developed user interface makes it easy to navigate smaller film archives. Movies can be downloaded in around 10 minutes via Gigabit Ethernet during playback without compromising performance. The device is housed in a sleek, high-quality black anodised aluminium and glass case.

Flat proportions, frameless windows, flush door handles and a precisely shaped front with a shark nose characterise the appearance of the all-electric NIO ET5 Touring. A continuous glass roof visually opens up the interior, and LiDAR technology for autonomous driving functions is seamlessly integrated. Digital user interfaces, ambient lighting and an innovative battery changing system complement the vehicle’s design, which is characterised by understated elegance and user-friendliness.

The SV-M4K200 Series Medical Endoscopic Camera System is an integrated platform for endoscopic imaging using a crane and trolley. It supports various light sources, control devices and 2D/3D controllers for different needs. A washable 8″ glass panel and an IPX7-certified ergonomic handle meet high hygiene standards and prevent fatigue. The integrated electronic 3D optics enable automatic image correction and switching between 2D and 3D. High-resolution images facilitate the identification of difficult-to-observe lesions.

The intelligent N5 POS system integrates QR code scanning, NFC, chip and magnetic stripe payment options into one compact device. Voice guidance, backlit buttons and an illuminated scan area with colour gradient enhance usability and ensure an intuitive payment experience. A combination of glass surfaces, aluminium and floating design elements creates a modern, technical appearance. The terminal’s elongated shape optimises its functionality on narrow counters, making it ideal for retail, banking and the service sector.

The SANTAK Micro Data Center is a compact, integrated IT infrastructure solution. It consolidates essential IT components into pre-fabricated, self-contained modules and was designed to offer rapid deployment, flexible expansion and easy maintenance. Asymmetrical shapes, smooth surfaces and a full-glass screen characterise its visual appearance. The operation units are integrated onto the back side of the screen, which simplifies the overall design and also allows for effortless operation.

NWP500 is a heating pump water heater for the centralised supply of residential buildings. By utilising ambient air, the system works much more energy-efficiently than conventional electric water heaters and also reduces CO₂ emissions. The well-thought-out arrangement of the connections enables space-saving and simple installation. It is operated via an ergonomically positioned touchscreen display or a clearly organised app. The inner container is made of corrosion-resistant stainless steel and the thermal insulation is made of climate-friendly HFO foam.

HYSTYLE WOOD is a versatile glazing system that combines high energy efficiency with architectural restraint. The large glazing areas create open spaces. The system is available with single, double or triple glazing and is suitable for classic inswing opening mechanisms as well as top hung or side hung outswing openings. HYSTYLE WOOD is available in two wood finishes: with pressure-glued natural wood profiles or as a hybrid combination of recycled wood and recycled aluminium.

The COLMO Whole-House Smart Series integrates lighting, climate, security and appliance functions via a central control unit with a 12.3" display. It enables a natural interaction through face, voiceprint and fingerprint recognition. The system supports five communication protocols, connects up to 128 devices and responds in less than 0.1 seconds. Dark colours and coated glass surfaces blend unobtrusively into modern living spaces, while uniform dimensions and shapes allow for flexible, harmonious interior design.

materials.name: 混凝土
materials.description: 混凝土常用名称为混凝土，工程中也简称“砼”，由水泥、骨料、水及必要外加剂拌合并硬化形成。它抗压能力较强、可浇筑成复杂形状且成本相对可控，但抗拉性能较弱，常与钢筋组合使用。除建筑结构外，也用于家具、灯具、花器和公共设施等产品，表观性能受配比、养护和孔隙影响。
materials.cognitiveText: 混凝土在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 9–12 10^-6/K。

cases.description: Design innovations are often the product of technology transfer. In the case of Furniture Linoleum, the innovative aspect is first and foremost a carefully considered material transfer that has led to a sustainable product with aesthetic appeal. Forbo Flooring had previously focused on the production of high-quality flooring materials before deciding to diversify its portfolio and expertise in the furniture sector with Furniture Linoleum. Now the time-tested material of linoleum is captivating a new audience with its natural, warm feel and excellent durability as a contemporary surface finish for home and kitchen furniture, doors, and much more. “This product embodies our vision of creating functional, durable and environmentally conscious finishes for both flooring and furniture,” says the manufacturer. Linoleum’s climate-positive aspects also contribute to user convenience. Made from renewable and natural raw materials such as linseed oil, wood flour, pine resin and limestone, it has a naturally elegant, matt surface that is resistant to fingerprints. Being easy to clean, Furniture Linoleum is also an interesting option for the customised furnishing of public spaces. Forbo Flooring complements all of these positive properties with an attractive range of 24 colours that blend seamlessly with natural woods and stones, such as oak, walnut and maple, or marble, concrete and terrazzo. A special aesthetic has been achieved with the “Pure Linoleum” decor, which completely dispenses with colour pigments to showcase the natural shade of linseed oil. Like leather and wood, each piece is unique and alters in appearance over time. The Red Dot jurors were fascinated by the natural look and feel: “What really impressed us about Furniture Linoleum is this focus on material purity. The special yet subtle tactile warmth of the surfaces makes them feel comforting to the touch. Another remarkable aspect is the unique natural aroma of linoleum that is pleasant to perceive. This material represents tangible quality. It is honest, thoughtfully designed and delivers genuine added value for healthy interior spaces.”

The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

The planning concept for the SHIROYAMA commercial space combines concrete walls and brickwork with new furnishings and modern fittings. Open ceilings create visual interaction between the different levels. The multifunctional zones for dining, exhibitions and product displays are based on principles of the experience economy. Inspired by the theme “Immersed in a Dialogue with the Mountains”, the interior design unites nature, culture and people, fostering a space for contemplation and social interaction that goes beyond conventional usage concepts.

The litter bin Bien was designed for public spaces and is available in different sizes and designs depending on the city's needs – optionally with a practical sorting function. It impresses with its timeless shape and high-quality design. A key feature of Bien is the material harmony between concrete and steel, which ensures high processing quality and great resistance to natural elements. The successful contrast between the opening and the container underlines the function and use of the litter bin.

The soap dispenser, toothbrush tumbler and toilet brush of the TIME bathroom series are made of concrete. The matching pedal bin of the series is made of ABS plastic. The equally stable and soft material concrete can be fired at low temperatures. This saves energy during production and is easily recyclable. A silicone layer under the bottom of the products prevents possible surface scratches. “The timeless and simple material sets aesthetic accents in the bathroom and is also a convincing choice from a sustainability point of view,” was the jury’s verdict. The bathroom accessories are available in concrete, black and soft grey.

The Line is a range of timelessly elegant street lighting. The noticeable micro-faceted optic modules integrated into the vertical slim pole deliver a high light output with standard-compliant glare control. As the main body can be given a steel, concrete or bronze surface, it is possible visually to match the luminaire to its surroundings. The range comprises stacks, bollards, pole or wall lights, thereby guaranteeing a wide range of uses in the urban context.

Inspired by architect Antoni Gaudí’s mosaic tile from the year 1906, this minimalist concrete paving slab is also innovative and hexagonal in shape. Two optical dummy joints divide the tile into three sections, one of which is characterised by a precise groove structure. This produces a noticeable, dark shadow effect. The main slab, with its symmetrical design, is complemented by two additional slab formats. Together, the slabs can be used to compose a large variety of different effects by orienting them in different ways.

The Staircase Object 004 is the central element of a comprehensive interior design for the editorial department floor of the fischerAppelt PR- and Marketing agency. It comprises a bar/kitchen, terraced seating, cupboards and display cases and a staircase in a range of materials consisting of concrete, larch and raw steel. At the heart of the complex is the staircase which seems to tower down from the roof garden above and is made of ten “Us” of suitably bent, 15 mm thick, slightly corroded, untreated steel panels that are simply bolted onto the supporting structure. These components vary only in height.

Greenpad is an environmentally friendly concrete system for car parks, roads and walkways as well as landscaping. It has a high capacity for absorbing rain water, because the concrete surface is interrupted by grass areas. In addition, it minimises heat reflection off the surface. The method applied here combines four different modules to create a wide range of patterns. The grass has already been planted in the modules, which are firmly fixed in place using a load bearing structure made of iron rods and concrete.

A newly developed technique has made it possible to create urban concrete benches with flexible shapes. This technique has led to immaculate surfaces and flowing lines that leave traditional, rigid forms far behind. An ordinary material such as concrete has been transformed into a high-quality piece of work. The solid bench looks like an upholstered one. The buttons in the upholstery here serve as drainage holes for rainwater. Structure and surface remain unchanged over time.

In order to make the Monka Hotel blend into its surroundings, its design is deliberately ambiguous, on the border between traditional architecture and more modern styles. The facade features grey concrete, the large windows of different sizes have black frames to give the building a calm exterior. The lobby is fitted with unadulterated materials. A wall clad with original ancient cave stones goes with the concrete floor and the wooden partition. The stairs have an open construction which allows them to reflect the light from outside.

The Shihlien Chemical Biotech Salt Plant Laboratory is a 900-sqm building located in the Chinese city of Huai’an. The laboratory, which is part of a new world-class medical-grade salt production plant, is used by technicians to carry out extensive quality controls and testing procedures. Reflecting this function, the architectural plan is inspired by the form of salt crystals. As an essential focus of the salt production process, the notion of “purity” has also become a motif and the driving concept of visualising the spatial design. Accordingly, the floor plan of the building is conceived as a regular array of salt crystals, featuring a series of offset cubic protrusions to accommodate each of the key functions. While the main building geometries are rectilinear, entrances and key elevations are highlighted by contrasting fluid curvatures to create welcoming gestures to users. Meanwhile, the building interior showcases a crisp and restrained design: white walls, linear strip lighting, as well as light-coloured tiles that lend the ambience a fresh and clear appeal. In key rooms, a warmer atmosphere is conjured by combining wood and exposed concrete. Full-height low-emissivity glazing provides ample daylighting and allows people working inside pleasant views of the surrounding picturesque Jiangsu countryside from their workspaces.

Storm System brings together various ceiling elements mounted in an installation ring, which is flush with the ceiling. Using the innovative “snap lock” technique, various fixtures are easily mounted into the ring. Users have a choice of 17 elements such as lighting, speakers, cameras, smoke detectors, ventilation systems, motion detectors and cable outputs. The entire range of fixtures has the same streamlined design and all elements are made of high-quality materials such as aluminium, brass, wood, glass, concrete or leather.

This cheese fondue set takes up the current copper trend but also uses the functional properties of the heat conducting material. The fondue pan, which comes in a retro-look, distributes heat evenly so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. Thanks to this configuration, the heat is effectively directed upwards, so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. In combination with the traditional look of the copper, the high-gloss polished stainless steel handle forms a strong contrast. Moreover, the base, which is made of concrete and stainless steel, lends the set both a stable and decorative appearance.

Inspired by raw industrial aesthetics, the surfaces of RAUVISIO cube feature the cool visual appeal and irregular texture of concrete. With their natural air pores and individually unique surface structure, the panels make a bold statement in any room. A matching edgeband is incorporated to create the appearance of a solid concrete slab. The matt finish obscures fingerprints and smudges so that nothing diminishes the elegant overall impression. The sturdy material can also be processed with standard woodworking tools.

Boost Expression is a collection of porcelain and wall tiles characterised by their textured, three-dimensional concrete effect. Inspired by iconic forms such as circles, lines and ellipses, the tiles provide plenty of scope for indoor and outdoor applications. Natural textures are paired with a pastel colour palette, giving the tiles considerable depth and a distinctive look. The cutting-edge Sensitech surfaces ensure a soft touch, excellent anti-slip properties and outstanding durability.

The TRAX TRUNK Bench aims to enhance public spaces as an emotionally appealing and functional seating option. Inspired by traditional Japanese gardens, the bench is characterised by an innovative design where three laminated pieces of lumber sit atop concrete pillars reinforced with steel plates for stability. The TRAX TRUNK Bench allows for various configurations according to the modular principle. It offers an affordable and sustainable option for municipalities and promotes vibrant community spaces for people of all ages.

Ideally, the interior design of shops and flagship stores creates a parallel world that immediately attracts visitors and in which products can be staged effectively. The aim in designing the JINS Shop in the Shanghai World Financial Center (SWFC) was to create an appealing effect of huge emptiness within a shopping mall which is usually crowded with goods and people. The interior space was to be presented and perceived in the sense of a sculptural architecture. The result has emerged as an impressive solution that stands out for its puristic effect. The interior space of the sales room is composed of five cantilever tables, each made of concrete and with a maximum length of up to 12 metres. The overall concept combines extreme dimensions, a maximum length and a minimum width and depth, in such a manner that it ensures a maximum linear display and freedom of movement for customers. The void space of the shop is divided into six different parts that can contain a large amount of stocks or fulfil other functions such as offering a workshop of glasses fabrication between tables no. 4 and 5. In this shop, the steel structure encased in concrete makes the interior work in an architectural manner. Even the furniture serves as a piece of the structure. Inviting visitors to experience the interior space like a low extending landscape, all tables are arranged horizontally and at a just level, 80 cm high from ground.

The premium X2 Pro Master Edition features a surprisingly artistic approach towards the product. The aim is to pay homage to two of the most common construction materials – concrete and brick – and to convey a sense of solidity and stability, so as to highlight the connection between the real world and the world of technology. The design of this smartphone, with an appealing look and feel, attempts to bridge this gap. It lends new vitality to an industrial product in an imposing combination of art and industrialism, sensitivity and rationality.

This private museum houses a collection of dried fish maws, also known as swim bladders. One of its striking design features is a visible concrete joist pierced by a wooden beam. The entrance hall is fitted out with oak furniture which, together with the oak staircase, gives the space a sober aesthetics. A painting on the subject of man and fish tempts visitors into the exhibition space which is equipped with museum display cases and a strict lighting design so that the shape and texture of the concave exhibits are accentuated to their advantage.

materials.name: 不锈钢
materials.description: 不锈钢常用名称为不锈钢或耐蚀钢，是以铁为基体、含有足够铬并可加入镍、钼等元素的合金体系。铬在表面形成钝化膜，使其具有较好的耐腐蚀和清洁维护性能。奥氏体、铁素体、马氏体等类别在强度、磁性和加工性上不同，常用于厨具、建筑、医疗、交通及产品外壳。
materials.cognitiveText: 不锈钢在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 10–16 10^-6/K。

cases.description: Singly ONE is a robust charging station designed for both private and commercial use. Its elegant, timeless stainless steel case blends seamlessly into any environment. An integrated display presents all key information at a glance – from charging power to status notifications. Maximum safety is ensured by the built-in residual current circuit breaker, which reliably protects both user and vehicle in the event of a fault. Replaceable components simplify maintenance and help extend the unit’s service life.

The Harman Kardon sound system in the Volvo XC90 combines high-quality audio technology with a sophisticated design. The front door grilles are made of etched stainless steel, coated in matt-black and have a laser-engraved logo. Seamlessly integrated into the interior, the grilles also house the seat adjustment controls, thus combining functionality and aesthetics. The central speaker cover runs behind the dashboard, with precisely positioned hole patterns ensuring a harmonious appearance.

NWP500 is a heating pump water heater for the centralised supply of residential buildings. By utilising ambient air, the system works much more energy-efficiently than conventional electric water heaters and also reduces CO₂ emissions. The well-thought-out arrangement of the connections enables space-saving and simple installation. It is operated via an ergonomically positioned touchscreen display or a clearly organised app. The inner container is made of corrosion-resistant stainless steel and the thermal insulation is made of climate-friendly HFO foam.

The RICHARTZ KEY TOOLS compact series is the particularly handy version of the original RICHARTZ KEY TOOLS and combine up to 17 functions in a minimal space. Made from matt-finished stainless steel, these multi-tools impress with their precise finish and clearly recognisable, embossed functional surfaces. Whether as a shopping aid (shop), DIY tool (work) or versatile all-rounder (13+), each version offers well-thought-out solutions for everyday life, the household and hobbies. It is compact, robust and always ready for use.

The timeless design of Tangente 2date is offset by a contemporary dual date display. A ring date around the edge of the dial keeps the entire month in view, while a small window highlights the current date in red. A finely balanced contrast between the polished stainless steel case and black leather strap adds to the visual appeal of this handcrafted timepiece. The manually wound movement evokes a sense of nostalgia, while the sapphire crystal glass back offers a view of the mechanical calibre inside.

The SmartAppGuided Spiral Epilation Tweezer Pen 5-in-1 uses a precision stainless steel coil to safely remove hair at the root for long-lastingly smooth skin. It is designed to minimise skin irritation and can be used on both small and large facial areas such as the chin, upper lip, cheeks, forehead and eyebrows. Thanks to its compact, slightly tapered shape, the pen is suitable for easy, intuitive and precise operation. An app is also available to guide the user through the application.

The EDC29 is a thin tactical torch with a run time of over 60 hours that combines outstanding light output, intelligent functions and a robust design. It has a light output of 6,500 lumens, a range of up to 400 metres and a dual LED system with 18 cores for different types of light, such as spotlighting or floodlighting. A light shield mode provides protection, while randomly changing light frequencies can create a dizzying effect. The robust construction of stainless steel and carbon fibre weighs just 160 grams and fits securely in the hand.

The Perun 3 Mini is a 63 mm short, 85-gram torch for a wide range of applications, such as outdoor use, signalling and emergencies. It delivers white and red light with an output of up to 1,300 lumens. The magnetic tailcap allows hands-free use, while the stainless steel knob and a removable clip ensure easy operation and effortless portability. With the included headband, the Perun 3 Mini becomes a headlamp. The stepless brightness control and the long standby time increase safety.

The Thermal Mug is a versatile container for hot and cold beverages that combines functionality with a stylish exterior. Made from high-quality stainless steel complemented by copper insulation and vacuum sealing, it maintains drinks at the desired temperature for a long time. The durable, dishwasher-proof powder coating, which is available in five colours, gives the mug a modern appearance. An anti-slip silicone base ensures stability and protects surfaces when the mug is set down.

The Gibraltar lounge furniture creates a cosy, welcoming ambience. The aesthetics of the lines are characterised by the delicate lightness of the thin, round tube profiles made of stainless steel, which in their double execution ensure robust stability. The opulent design of the high-quality seat and back cushions creates an appealing contrast. The open strapping on the backrest guarantees a high level of seating comfort, while the modular design offers great flexibility with many combination options for the individual elements.

The Elegant Scenery bathroom cabinet set includes two washbasins with a separate cover, as well as a mirror with touch-sensitive lighting. The stacked and seemingly interlocking ensemble of individual elements gives the arrangement an architectural aesthetic that is visually accentuated by the combination of multilayer solid wood, natural stone, stainless steel and Corian, each with its own colour scheme. A drawer with a clearly structured interior allows for the organised storage of cosmetics and care utensils.

WMF Element One, a sparkling water maker made of high-quality stainless steel, is characterised by its ease of use: the knurled control knob on the top precisely regulates the degree of carbonation, adapting it to the user’s taste preferences. Preparation is as easy as pressing a button. An elegant water cylinder and soft curves characterise the design of the compact device, which, thanks to its slim silhouette, requires little space on the work surface.

The development of this tableware concept for the Economy Class of Etihad Airways was focused on sustainability and an enhanced passenger experience. The reusable tableware is made entirely from recycled plastic and is part of a closed-loop recycling system. At the end of their life cycle, the parts are collected, washed, ground and reused to create new products. Complementing the system is cutlery made from stainless steel and pressed paper, as well as paper cups and bamboo stirrers.

Conum for One is a mug with a filter that enables effortless preparation of loose-leaf tea directly in the mug. The fine-mesh stainless steel filter allows the flavours to unfold fully. Afterwards, the lid doubles as a convenient holder for the filter. Made from heat-resistant borosilicate glass, the mug is neutral in odour and taste as well as dishwasher-proof. The mug’s exceptional resistance to temperature fluctuations makes it extremely durable – ideal for daily use, whether in the home or in the office.

With its elegant stainless steel finish and integrated MoodLight, the Liebherr French Door fridge-freezer is a high-quality addition to any modern kitchen. The compact design is characterised by flush-fitting doors and distinctive handle recesses. The flexible interior offers various temperature zones, including a VarioTempZone that can be used as a refrigeration or freezer compartment. The innovative sealing system of the appliance doors, which can be opened independently of each other, ensures good energy efficiency.

The TANGO XP bean-to-cup coffee machine is designed for professional use and is characterised by its robust construction. Three bean containers, a double brewing group and a manual steam element offer a wide range of preparation options. Stainless steel surfaces in a matt and glossy finish complement the black control panel with full-touch display, which allows the selection of recipes and the control of the grind setting as well as the brewing temperature. Flowing transitions and the slightly inclined front ensure a bold appearance.

Improvisational cooking can produce excellent cuisine, but compromises should never be made when it comes to choice of knife. Blunt blades have driven many an amateur cook crazy, and professional chefs won’t even put on their aprons unless their knives are precision-sharpened. That’s why the Kuhn Rikon Black Coated Knives Series is such an exciting proposition. The elegant black blades are seamlessly connected to the handle, creating a harmonious, aesthetic overall appearance. It also features perfectly balanced weight and an ergonomic shape for a positive tactile experience. Six knives ensure that the right blade for different food items is always to hand, and a pair of household scissors completes the functional set. A matching magnetic knife block reflects the designers’ intent to create a product that looks good in the kitchen setting. The knives nestle almost flush against the block, where they are transformed into a stylish eye-catcher. A non-slip chopping board with a juice groove completes the convenient and consistently designed set. The purist appearance of the knives is the ultimate outcome of a lengthy test phase. Finding the perfect shape for the handle and the exact blade angle for precise cutting results are also aspects that the designers intensively considered. “Achieving the perfect balance between the blade and handle was crucial. We spent a great deal of time refining the length and weight of each aspect to maintain an elegant, streamlined design while optimising function,” they commented. Choice of materials was also decisive to functional excellence. The knives are made from Japanese stainless steel, which is renowned for its hardness, sharpness and durability. A non-stick coating on the blades further enhances cutting performance and the cooking experience. “The Kuhn Rikon Black Coated Knives Series stands out for its exceptional quality and captivating aesthetics,” was the jury’s verdict. “Every detail is precision manufactured and ergonomically designed. In combination, the colours and design make an elegant and sophisticated statement that reflects the first-class choice of materials.”

Luxe Café Premier is a 3-in-1 coffee machine for preparing espresso, cold brew drinks and filter coffee. It features a conical grinder with 25 grind settings and integrated scales. It is operated via precise buttons, control dials and an easy-to-read, clearly structured display. The housing, made of stainless steel and matt black plastic, is functionally designed and characterised by the harmonious combination of flat surfaces, clear lines and rounded edges.

The Liebherr Side-by-Side is a fridge-freezer combination with a wine temperature control compartment. This offers separate temperature zones for white and red wine, humidity control and adjustable wooden shelves. The wine is also protected from vibrations and UV rays. The appearance is characterised by BlackSteel or SmartSteel – a specially polished and sealed stainless steel. This material is also used on the inner door, inner rear wall and decorative strips. The refrigerator door closes softly and quietly.

The combi-steamer Convotherm mini pro was developed for small professional kitchens with high capacity utilisation. AI-supported functions such as optical food recognition, sensor-based cooking processes and a self-dosing cleaning system minimise the operating effort. The stainless steel and glass housing is hygienic and robust. The operating elements are clearly structured; only the antibacterial handle needs to be fully grasped by hand. The unobtrusive form, with its flush installation option, fits well into various room concepts.

materials.name: 金
materials.description: 金常用名称为黄金，是具有黄色金属光泽的贵金属。它延展性和导电性突出，化学性质稳定，不易氧化，但纯金较软，工程使用中常通过加入银、铜等元素形成不同成色的合金。除珠宝和装饰外，金还用于电子触点、连接器、镀层、牙科和精密器件，其成本与资源属性非常显著。
materials.cognitiveText: 金在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 14–15 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

One of the key challenges of design today seems to be to create innovative products that are tailored to the needs and personalities of consumers and are sustainable at the same time. The Busch-art linear/ALBA switch range by Busch-Jaeger and Niessen, market leader in the field of electrical installation technology and building automation, fulfils this brief exceptionally well. A prominent feature of these switches is the position of the inserts, which float above the frame and are not, as usual, enclosed by them. This gives the product range a unique sense of lightness, heightened by the sharp, slim contours that radiate clarity and elegance across a wide selection of materials and models. The breadth of the Busch-art linear/ALBA switch range is hard to beat, in particular with regard to the frames. Whether it is glass, structured glass, wood, aluminium or plastic, with fine surrounds in chrome, gold or rose gold, and glossy, matt or mirrored surfaces, the rich variety on offer will satisfy personal preferences and suit the widest possible range of interiors. The soft feel of the switches also makes for a pleasurable sensory experience. In this way, the Busch-art linear/ALBA range is not only testimony to in-depth deliberations about form, material and colour but also about the environment, responsibility and the future. The collection is made with recycled and recyclable materials and follows a cradle-to-cradle philosophy for the healthy and regenerative productivity of companies. All plastic parts are produced from at least 92 per cent (white plastic) and up to 98 per cent (black plastic) recycled materials. That translates into a total reduction in CO₂ emissions of 82 per cent and requires a considerable amount of development work as it is difficult to produce such perfect, flat surfaces from recyclate. It is clear that sustainability is not a secondary consideration for Busch-Jaeger and Niessen but a value that is at the very heart of its design and product development work. The jury recognised this. “The Busch-art linear/ALBA switch range is both an object lesson in carefully considered design – from the construction through to the execution of details and surfaces, as well as the impressive haptics – and also a benchmark for sustainable design.”

FILKA is a fully automatic filter coffee maker characterised by a high-quality and space-saving body. The contrasting surface finish made of brushed stainless steel and black plastic defines the innovative approach. The machine supports the users by means of a fully automatic cup control for optimal coffee preparation – whether for a single cup or a whole pot.
