In addition to a removable water tank and bean container, the washable gold-tone filter also offers a high level of user comfort.

The durable Opus lighting system was developed as a part of a product family for both residential and commercial sectors. The heart of the concept is an innovative track system, which unites central functions such as lighting, sound, air conditioning, security and multi-sensor monitoring. A wide range of available colours and surface finishes meet the demands of variability and adaptability to different interiors. In addition to discreet, timeless designs, the system allows the setting of glamorous highlights with gold-plated or chrome finishes.

The invention of pocket watches and later wristwatches gave everybody the possibility to check on the time anywhere and thus plan activities accordingly. The Apple Watch now adds a further interpretation to the measuring of time. Coming with a design language that is inspired by traditional watchmaking, it features an innovative interface that enables users to customise the watch by allowing them to choose between different, more personal watch faces. Users can thus configure the interface in the style of a classic chronograph, for instance, or opt for a more playful display such as a fluttering butterfly. Both  the interface and the housing of the Apple Watch have been created and perfectly matched specifically for such a small device. A digital crown makes navigating the watch highly intuitive and amazes users with its versatility and many possibilities. The innovative Force Touch display is extremely sensitive and recognises even the lightest touch. Another exciting experience is how it senses the difference between  a tap and a press, as the Taptic Engine enables a new vocabulary of both acoustic and sensory notifications and responses. Offering a myriad of new interactive possibilities, the Apple Watch also allows extensive customising such as the material used for the wristband or the enclosure, ranging from stainless steel to a model in gold – for a new way of experiencing time.

The Extend ring was inspired by the idea to create a piece of jewellery that would be as flexible as it is versatile and that would fit every finger. It was modelled on the pantograph of astronomer and inventor Christoph Scheiner. Just like the technical instrument, the ring is composed of separate elements that flexibly interlock. It is made of 18-carat white or yellow gold and ornamented with precious stones.

With its aesthetic design and its components, the Plutus luggage collection satisfies high demands. The robust shells display an elegant prism pattern, logos and zip fasteners are finished in premium gold-metallic materials. In their interior the suitcases offer a good number of separate pockets which help to stow high-quality shoes and clothing safely and make packing in general easy. Furthermore, the collection is equipped with a TSA-conforming lock and high-quality double wheels.

Rings are pieces of jewellery with great symbolic meaning. The ring, made of silver plated with gold, contains the Chinese character for heart, which is the focal point of this design. It can be worn on its own or be complemented by one of the other rings made of silver plated with platinum. These other rings also include characters that can be combined with the root word for heart and so create another meaning. In this way, the delicate items of jewellery are carriers of a message.

The interchangeable hearing clip combines a specially developed hearing aid with a hand-made jewellery cover in a simple, but extremely innovative way. The gold or silver mesh-like surface of this decorative earpiece ensures optimal sound quality. Form rigidly follows function and dimensions of a high-tech hearing aid. The exchangeable hearing clip combines easy handling, light looks and excellent voice quality with appealing design.

With its asymmetrical contours, this LED pendant luminaire, which creates a dynamic lighting situation, looks different depending on the viewing angle. The lamp shade is available in any of the monochrome RAL colours or as a two-tone version with different inner and outer colours. It can also be manufactured with a gold, silver or bronze edging. Krivda furthermore provides good illumination at low energy consumption levels.

The Suit mixer tap collection is characterised by the combination of soft lines with strikingly angular components, which creates an exciting contrast of form. The control levers for washbasin, shower and bathtub are ergonomically shaped and, thanks to the different heights, the mixer taps can be easily matched to the respective ceramic products. There is a choice of tarnish- and corrosion-resistant coatings in chrome, black, copper or gold for customised bathroom design.

The Ringbuds Pro ear-hook earphones are made from titanium, giving them a particularly high-quality feel – especially in combination with their gold-coloured metal accents and the finely crafted surface texture complete with TPU coating. Consideration was also given to environmental compatibility in the choice of materials. The Ringbuds Pro are equipped with a novel technology that ensures a nuanced sound image through increased vibration amplitudes for precise transmission of sound waves into the ear canal.

The SPA 2.0 earthenware tiles are produced in a slim format with a thickness of only 6 mm. The series thus not only stands for special sustainability but also opens up a high degree of creative freedom for the user. The digitally printed basic tiles are designed in black and white, with shaded decors rounding off the concept. Special accents in the kitchen, bathroom and guest WC can also be achieved by using metallic matt-gloss optics in gold, silver and rose gold.

materials.name: 铜
materials.description: 铜常用名称为铜，较高纯度的工业铜常称紫铜或纯铜。它具有优良的导电、导热、延展和耐腐蚀性能，表面会随环境形成由红褐到绿色的氧化或碱式碳酸盐层。铜常用于电线、电路、换热器、管材、厨具、建筑饰面和工艺品，也是黄铜、青铜等合金的主要基体。
materials.cognitiveText: 铜在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 16.5–17 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The modernist designs of the porcelain tiles in the Grotta Collection were inspired by the Brutalist movement of the 1970s. Featuring reduced shapes, neutral tones and decorative textures, they can be used to create abstract wall art. The collection owes its distinctive character to a modern interpretation of established forms as well as to the use of unusual materials such as concrete, brick and copper. The collection consists of four creative motifs, each composed of three decorative tiles.

The design concept for the Polar basin mixer series is based on classic aesthetics integrating rectangles and circles as the basic elements. Slim, cylindrical bodies are complemented by clearly contoured spouts and dials. The coherent fusion of these elements results in a minimalist design language that radiates independence and elegance. Various models allow for surface or wall mounting. Manufactured from fully recyclable copper casting, Polar basin mixers make an important contribution to resource conservation.

The basin mixers in the GRACE Series combine oval and rectangular contours with softly rounded edges and transitions. The slim, cylindrical body and elliptical spout merge to form a harmonious unit. Single-lever and two-handle models are available in three heights and four colours. Made of lead-free copper, the faucets are particularly corrosion-resistant thanks to a four-layer coating. The quiet aerator with an adjustable spray angle, in combination with a cold start valve core, reduces water and energy consumption.

The Thermal Mug is a versatile container for hot and cold beverages that combines functionality with a stylish exterior. Made from high-quality stainless steel complemented by copper insulation and vacuum sealing, it maintains drinks at the desired temperature for a long time. The durable, dishwasher-proof powder coating, which is available in five colours, gives the mug a modern appearance. An anti-slip silicone base ensures stability and protects surfaces when the mug is set down.

The effective fin structure of the Mythril Radiators increases their contact surface with the air by 15 per cent, thereby improving heat exchange efficiency. To optimise the heat conduction further, the body is made entirely of copper. These two-tone accessories thus ensure high performance and powerful cooling temperatures, even at full utilisation of the latest GPUs and CPUs. Depending on its positioning, the device appears black or silver.

The Infinity New Reference Subwoofers, available in 10" and 12" versions, offer configuration flexibility through SSI and allow selection of impedance, thus ensuring compatibility with almost any audio system. These subwoofers generate the characteristic deep Infinity bass in closed or vented enclosures. Design features include a radially textured membrane, a centrally placed, copper-coloured Infinity Mobius logo and a high-gloss trim ring that conceals the mounting elements, characterising their elegant appearance.

The Apple Watch Series 9 is powered by the so-called S9 SiP, which improves performance and supports innovative features. In particular, the new double-tap gesture makes it easier to operate the watch with just one hand. By tapping twice with the index finger and thumb, common actions such as stopping a timer or playing music can be performed. This also makes it easier to answer calls, reply to messages or take photos. A carbon-neutral model is available for environmentally conscious customers.

The One HomeCafe is designed to use capsules to prepare individual cups of coffee and tea. The slim appliance has a streamlined design; copper-coloured elements ensure its high-quality appearance. The slight tilt of the body also gives the appliance an interesting look. For improved handling, the coffee and tea maker does not have its own tank but can be connected directly to a water conditioner.

With its latest streaming multiprocessors and its fast GDDR6X memory, this graphics card is designed for maximum performance. It is already overclocked at the factory but offers additional headroom for overclocking, thanks to advanced cooling with an 11-blade fan, aluminium fin heat sinks and eight copper heat pipes. A special feature is the holographic finish inspired by aurora borealis. Additional RGB lighting, which can be synchronised, is situated at the top and back.

The K-fee One capsule coffee machine is characterised by an elegant design. High-gloss and matt black are paired with copper, while a wave design in the upper area sets further visual accents. Illuminated buttons allow easy operation and programmable cup fill volumes ensure convenience in use. The water tank holds 0.8 litres and can be removed for filling. The capsule machine is particularly compact with a width of just 11.3 cm.

The built-in oven EEB 6550.8JX combines a black glass front with a brilliant copper handle bar, which gives the oven a stylish impression. By electronic operation via sensors behind glass, baking and roasting programmes can be easily selected. Ökotherm catalytic technology and the triple-glazed door contribute to the contemporary and energy-saving functionality of the oven.

The ROG Maximus V Formula (M5F) motherboard is equipped with both air and water cooling. The cooling parts have been enhanced with additional heat-dissipating layers, and the radial groove design is capable of efficiently diverting heat under full load as well. Heat dissipation technology components are special water channels and heat pipes made of 100 per cent copper. Gaming PCs are thus provided with optimal cooling and also extensive overclocking options.

The heat pump outdoor unit combines its very high efficiency with a silent ­operation. The wide slats on the front ensure effective aerodynamics and low energy consumption. Their dark colour makes the fan nearly invisible in the background, lending the device a modern, non-technical appearance. The materials used: steel, copper, aluminium and ­unpainted plastics, are all recyclable.

The lever and outlet of this washbasin mixer are dominated by hollow oval shapes that lend the Ma ya its characteristic appearance. Its surface showcases two colours to underline its sophisticated appearance: The high-contrast combination of matte black and glossy copper gives the mixer an elegant, yet simultaneously modern appeal. Thanks to the distinctive opening, the lever can be easily grasped, enabling comfortable water and temperature adjustments.

Optimal temperature, ideal humidity levels and attention to details are key traits of the Smeg wine coolers for domestic wine storage. They were developed in co-operation with sommeliers and manufactured entirely in Italy. The cooling cabinets are available with stainless steel surfaces as well as in a variant with glass combined with stainless steel or copper elements. They feature a user-friendly touch display on the glass door, whereby temperature, humidity and lighting can be adjusted without the need to open the door.

With its asymmetrical contours, this LED pendant luminaire, which creates a dynamic lighting situation, looks different depending on the viewing angle. The lamp shade is available in any of the monochrome RAL colours or as a two-tone version with different inner and outer colours. It can also be manufactured with a gold, silver or bronze edging. Krivda furthermore provides good illumination at low energy consumption levels.

In order to demonstrate the high standards of craftsmanship of the manufacturer, which has existed since 1917, this copper edition was developed for the 100th anniversary. Copper enables a particularly fast and thus energy-efficient heating. The PFOA-free stainless steel coating increases both durability and food safety while a precisely milled pattern in the bottom of the cookware lets the copper shine through in a decorative way.

This cheese fondue set takes up the current copper trend but also uses the functional properties of the heat conducting material. The fondue pan, which comes in a retro-look, distributes heat evenly so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. Thanks to this configuration, the heat is effectively directed upwards, so that the cheese does not burn in the middle of the pan. In combination with the traditional look of the copper, the high-gloss polished stainless steel handle forms a strong contrast. Moreover, the base, which is made of concrete and stainless steel, lends the set both a stable and decorative appearance.

The Suit mixer tap collection is characterised by the combination of soft lines with strikingly angular components, which creates an exciting contrast of form. The control levers for washbasin, shower and bathtub are ergonomically shaped and, thanks to the different heights, the mixer taps can be easily matched to the respective ceramic products. There is a choice of tarnish- and corrosion-resistant coatings in chrome, black, copper or gold for customised bathroom design.

With their carbon fibre fabric on the face of each ear cup – enclosed in a glossy housing with a copper ring – the 900 Legacy look high-quality and original in design. The ear cushions are made of memory foam. They reliably keep ambient noise away from the user through digital hybrid technology, with touch controls ensuring intuitive operation. The headphones are foldable and come with a shockproof, waterproof case.

materials.name: 铝合金
materials.description: 铝合金是以铝为基体并加入镁、硅、铜、锌等元素形成的轻金属材料，常用名称即铝合金。它具有低密度、较好的比强度、耐腐蚀性和加工性，可进行挤压、压铸、冲压、机加工及阳极氧化。常用于电子产品外壳、交通工具、家具、建筑型材、灯具和包装。
materials.cognitiveText: 铝合金在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 21–21 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The T-CREATE EXPERT P32 Desk External SSD is designed for professional video production, offering up to 16 TB of storage and a write speed of 1,700 MB/s. Capable of storing over 11 hours of 4K footage, it remains impressively compact. Its CNC-machined aluminium construction with integrated cooling fins ensures efficient heat dissipation, supporting both high performance and large storage capacity. Thanks to its minimal footprint, the device fits neatly on any desk.

The high-performance T-FORCE XTREEM ARGB DDR5 Memory combines sophisticated technology with a robust design, delivering impressive efficiency and overclocking capability. A uniform Aurora light effect adds visual accents, while the heat spreader made of forged aluminium alloy with a sandblasted texture effectively dissipates heat and ensures stable high-speed data transmission. The integrated PMIC stabilises the power supply.

With a 40.2 MP sensor and in-body image stabilisation, the FUJIFILM X100VI delivers high image quality even in low light conditions. The camera’s retro aesthetic is achieved through a tactile, analogue feel reminiscent of classic film cameras. The machined dial, non-slip exterior and aluminium top plate reinforce this impression. And advanced hybrid viewfinder and a flat, fold-out LCD display ensure flexibility. The compact and lightweight camera is available in both silver and black versions.

The intelligent N5 POS system integrates QR code scanning, NFC, chip and magnetic stripe payment options into one compact device. Voice guidance, backlit buttons and an illuminated scan area with colour gradient enhance usability and ensure an intuitive payment experience. A combination of glass surfaces, aluminium and floating design elements creates a modern, technical appearance. The terminal’s elongated shape optimises its functionality on narrow counters, making it ideal for retail, banking and the service sector.

Falcon 2 is a modular, expandable business tablet designed for use in industries such as retail, hospitality and public services, offering flexible adaptation to a variety of requirements. Three accessory kits, three docking stations and a secondary display allow for custom configurations, including the integration of payment functions and identity verification. The modules connect easily via pogo pin connections, while aluminium alloys keep the device lightweight and ensure efficient heat dissipation.

The NEX E1 Ultra screwdriver set was developed with accessory storage in mind. The precision electric tool and 50 magnetic drill bits are housed in a cylindrical aluminium box. A pop-up and rotating mechanism allows the drill bits to extend outwards for easy access. Offering multiple torque settings, the tool is equipped with a powerful motor and powered by a rechargeable high-performance lithium battery.

amp is an AI-supported strength-training device that blends seamlessly into the interior thanks to its minimalist design. The compact system made of aluminium alloy and chrome-plated steel is extremely resilient and has precise rope guidance. A central rotary dial allows intuitive height and rotation adjustment, while the locking mechanism ensures safe operation. With flexibly adjustable resistance and smart training modes, it can train any muscle group, while gamification and coaching options increase motivation.

TreeRoot Quick Lock Travel Tripod (R141K-320P) is a versatile travel tripod that offers excellent stability. Made from an aluminium alloy and high-modulus carbon fibre, it combines strength with lightweight construction. The Reuleaux hybrid-shaped leg tube enhances torsional rigidity and handling. A user-friendly locking mechanism allows for set-up within seconds, while the quick-release centre column enables tool-free removal for instant transitioning to low-angle shooting.

The LED panels of the AOTO SW Series combine a modern look with advanced technology for large stages. The panels feature a robust, high-strength framework made of carbon fibre and an aluminium alloy, making them weigh less than 19 kg/m². A pronounced curvature and precise 90-degree angles allow for visually creative presentations. Thanks to practical mechanical features such as magnetic modules, quick-release fasteners, ejection systems and ergonomic handles, efficient installation and easy maintenance are achieved.

Elfin-Pro is a collaborative robot for industrial human-machine collaboration in various work environments, including welding, spraying, polishing, screwing and picking. By integrating cutting-edge technologies such as end force control and artificial intelligence, it ensures stable, reliable performance, quick response and safe collaboration. An aluminium alloy provides high rigidity with reduced weight, while the internal wiring increases interference resistance.

The almost bezel-free AOC 27T4X monitor can be used like a standless picture frame or with an individually height-adjustable stand. This also facilitates transportability. Particularly ingenious is that all interfaces are located on a small bracket at the back of the screen. This also serves for height adjustment, as well as acting as a connector between the display and the stand, which is made of an aluminium alloy.

The CreateMate High-speed Card Reader Case is a lightweight device for outdoor shooting that allows photographers to store and read memory cards with ease. It is compatible with various formats and can accommodate up to four SD cards, four TF cards and two Nano-SIM cards. The data transfer rate of up to 312 MB/s and the plug-and-play function via the Type-C interface are particularly noteworthy. To protect against shocks, dust and water, the casing is made from a single piece of an aluminium alloy and surrounded by a robust silicone cover.

The 3D scanner 3DMakerpro Seal impresses with an exceptional precision of up to 0.01 mm. Thanks to its custom-made micro-optics module, it is compact enough to be connected to smartphones, increasing flexibility and mobility. Supportive accessories such as a handle and a two-axis turntable expand the range of applications and bring playful aspects to 3D scanning. The metallic exterior gives the scanner robustness while also providing an elegant, sporty look.

LEDskin is an LED system for the construction of exhibition booths. It consists of individual modules that can be assembled as required to create large video walls in various shapes. Despite a material thickness of only 62 mm, all cables can be laid invisibly. The rear of such a video wall can be covered either with fabric or panels. The new generation of the 2024 product features improved display specifications, such as a smaller pixel pitch and a more robust LED surface.

The SmallRig Basic Cage Kit for RED KOMODO / KOMODO-X 4110 is made of an aluminium alloy and reliably protects the camera body. It also offers a simple mounting option for accessories. The top handle can be adjusted forwards and backwards and allows full access to the camera’s LCD screen. It can be easily removed, facilitating shots from low angles. The monitor mount can be tilted 180 degree and swivelled 360 degree.

The Anymaka Hammock Stand is a hammock stand made from a robust, oxidised aluminium alloy with a corrosion-resistant black finish. With its convenient snap-fold design, it can be set up for use as a hammock or armchair in just a few seconds. Thanks to good processing and robust material, the maximum load capacity is 225 kg. The padded storage bag offers secure transport with external compartments and shoulder strap.

With their integrated Wi-Fi functionality, the Unity headphones enable lossless, high-resolution audio streaming with a quality of up to 24 bit/192 kHz. This significantly improves the sound, making it clearer and more detailed. The ear cups are CNC-machined from a single block of aluminium alloy and combined with a vibration-reducing, carbon-fibre-infused nylon chassis. This combination of materials reduces outside noise and supports the ANC function. “The Unity headphones demonstrate a high level of innovation,” praised the jury. “Moreover, the materials and workmanship support the sound quality in an exemplary manner.”

The jury was impressed: “The compact CM555 docking station is characterised by a minimalist design that puts functionality in the foreground. It also offers a comprehensive selection of interfaces.” Equipped with DisplayLink technology for up to three displays at up to 8K, 10 Gbps data ports, Gigabit Ethernet, 100 watts of charging power and dual card reading, it provides access to all the peripheral devices needed for programming, editing or designing. The robust aluminium alloy chassis provides effective heat dissipation, while the top power switch directly disconnects all external devices for added security.

The Verkada CB52-E and CB62-E outdoor surveillance cameras are equipped with wide-angle lenses, and the CB52-TE and CB62-TE models with telephoto lenses. As a result, these bullet cameras offer a large field of view and a powerful zoom for magnifying distant objects. All models have an aluminium unibody housing that protects the sensitive electronic components from environmental influences and vandalism. A system-on-a-chip with a coprocessor for video processing makes it possible to read vehicle number plates. The jury was impressed by the fact that the cameras are able to simultaneously monitor up to three lanes of traffic and reliably capture the number plates of vehicles travelling at speeds of 128 km/h.

The A&futura SE180 is an elegant hi-res audio player that follows a modular design as a special feature. The DAC module and the amp module can be entirely exchanged, which allows the realisation of different audio characteristics if desired, whereby the device delivers uncompromised and detailed sound in any configuration. The audio player features an intuitive user interface with a generous display and also a rotary control including LED lighting on the side.

materials.name: 锌合金
materials.description: 锌合金常用名称为锌合金或锌压铸合金，是以锌为基体并加入铝、铜、镁等元素的低熔点合金，常见体系包括Zamak。它具有良好压铸流动性，可成形薄壁、细节丰富的零件，表面适合电镀和涂装。常用于锁具、拉手、电子外壳、汽车小型件、玩具和装饰五金。
materials.cognitiveText: 锌合金在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 27–27.3 10^-6/K。

cases.description: With a clearly structured surface, rounded edges and a sleek design, the intelligent AL501 Video Smart Lock offers a convenient security solution. A combination of zinc alloy material, plastic, glass and black metallic paint ensures durability and a pleasant feel. Windproof, water resistant and equipped with a camera that enables real-time security monitoring, the AL501 opens the front door from the outside using a fingerprint or password.

The ROG Herculx graphics card holder is a stable column made of zinc alloy that supports heavy graphics cards in a PC from below. With a height of 72 to 128 mm, it is suitable for a variety of computer chassis. The bottom platform can be raised easily, and the fine-tuning is done using an adjustable wheel. The embedded magnetic spirit level facilitates alignment of the platform in a horizontal position. The 3D ARGB lighting can be adjusted via software and synchronised with other ASUS components.

Equipped with a fingerprint reader, Ujia is a smart door lock that can be operated via an easy to navigate app or NFC tag. Its construction makes the DIY installation simple and it will fit a wide range of doors.The lock is made of zinc alloy with an inbuilt RGB LED indicator. The design deliberately focuses on giving the lock a harmonious appearance to make it look less like an electronic device and more like a complementary addition to the interior decor.

The design of this zinc alloy door handle was inspired by the famous Ladybower Reservoir. The water running down the plughole is an amazing sight. The dent just above the rose is based on the soft curves of this overflow, so that, symbolically speaking, the handle floats between rest and motion. The concave dent in the handle is distinctly ergonomic and naturally reflects the pressure point of the thumb.

The deliberately reduced appearance of the smart switch Aqara H1 ensures its suitability for a wide range of interiors. By using an electronic microswitch together with a structural design, operation generates crisp, acoustic feedback sound. The bracket is made of a zinc alloy, which ensures durability and protects the switch structure from severe deformation. This furthermore safeguards the uniform appearance of the switch, which can also be mounted on uneven wall finishes.

This bike lock combines fingerprint recognition technology with a U-lock. The finger becomes the key and authorised fingerprints will take only 0.5 seconds to unlock. This saves time for the daily travel since the user no longer needs to look for the keys in pockets or purses. At the same time, fingerprints are unique to a person, which makes the product harder to hack. The design with zinc alloy lock and stainless-steel shackle provides a high degree of protection against theft.

The HISONG AirStudio One revolutionizes audio composition and production for musicians, vloggers, and live streamers, eliminating the common challenges of traditional audio equipment. Featuring a wireless, all-in-one design, the HISONG AirStudio One simplifies traditional setups by combining all essential audio tools in a compact, portable form.This innovation boosts comfort, convenience, and mobility, making it perfect for creators who demand flexibility and efficiency in every project.

Made of zamac, a strong metal alloy, the XtremKey USB key can resist almost everything: extreme temperatures, falls, water immersion and pressure. Memory modules are shielded inside a 2-millimeter casing and sealed with wear-resistant screw threads and a rubber O-ring. With its impenetrable shell, the XtremKey is the perfect USB drive for the most demanding users.

July+ is a new bathroom faucet range that has been designed following the principle of "form follows function". It has been developed to cover all the demands of the market in terms of comfort, performance, water and energy consumption and affordable price, all with a simple & timeless aesthetics that will easily integrate in all types of bathroom designs. July+ its the perfect tool for both small budget projects and households, thanks to its depth of range that provides multiple solutions in terms of installation types, water consumption and specific disable products. Also available in mat black for a more graphic look.

Record audio for your Twitch channel in high quality with the THRONMAX MDrill One Pro, a USB microphone that works with Mac, Windows, Linux, and PS4 platforms. The MDrill One Pro can be used for game streams, podcasts, ASMR recording, YouTube videos, and more. A USB Type-C port on the mic facilitates the connection with your computer or gaming system. You can monitor in real-time through the mic itself using its 3.5mm headphone output. The mic is equipped with controls for mode as well as a headphone volume control. It offers four settings: omnidirectional, cardioid, bidirectional, and stereo. Omnidirectional picks up sound in a 360° pattern.

cases.productName: 8BitDo SN30 Pro Bluetooth Controller for Android
cases.description: 8BitDo SN30 Pro Bluetooth Controller for Android is the first gamepad cooperated with Microsoft which is specifically built to play Xbox cloud games on Android devices. On the basis of being easy to carry, this controller is designed with dual joysticks, mappable buttons, and adjustable trigger keys. The built-in battery can last up to 18 hours. Also, the Bluetooth connection allows this controller to be used for Xbox titled games, and it includes a pro-level mobile gaming clip with adjustable positioning and expandable clip for large smartphones.

The new generation of ZenBook Pro Duo UX582/UX482 features a new hinge design with an ergonomic auto-tilt mechanism that lifts the ScreenPad Plus by 7 to 9.5°, thereby helping to reduce screen reflection and provide a better user experience. In addition, new apps and an in-app toolbar on ScreenPad Plus enable more intuitive interaction between the main display and ScreenPad Plus.

The Camp Chair sets a new standard in terms of its functionality and use of sophisticated materials. It is not only compact, robust and very light, weighing just 1,188 grams, but it also offers a compact storage size and ensures high seating comfort. Features such as the optimised DAC frame tubing made from special alloy, the tailor-made seat and the seat top spacer pole are seamlessly integrated to form a product of high functionality.

With their curved contours, the F1 Series door handles are inspired by the styling of Ferrari sports cars. “Their design conveys a sense of speed, lending them an elegant appearance,” noted the jury. The solid handles are made of a stainless zinc alloy with a silky surface for durability and are optionally available in a glossy, matt-black or brass finish.

The yoose TRIPLE alloy reciprocating Shaver was designed for travel and other on-the-go scenarios. The compact form makes it easy to toss in your suitcase or use in the car. It also features more selling points than traditional shavers, especially function and cost. Its unique appearance and the multiple color choices make it a more fashionable choice. The integrated T-shaped structure design, streamlined all-alloy body, and triple ultra-thin blade reciprocating head enhance the speed and accuracy of shaving.

The Halo h2o soft-water shower offers a brand new showering experience with healthy and pure soft water. It boasts a soft-water purification filter placed in the handle of the shower, which contains a natural lemon-extract filtering material and a high-purity copper zinc alloy.
A complete range designed for men's shaving scenarios. Highly integrated all-alloy razors are compact, portable and powerful for everyday and traveling shaving.

This product is a rechargeable arc lighter to realize a safe, stable and efficient ignition experience. Suitable for a variety of environments, allowing users to realize their ignition needs indoors, in the car, and even in harsh environments such as low temperatures, high altitudes, high winds, and humidity. Can be used repeatedly by just charging, reducing the cost of use. Does not produce harmful gases, very friendly to the environment. 
The product body is round and compact, easy to carry, handheld feeling warm, one-handed use. Integrated all-alloy body and mirror texture, more like a portable exquisite artwork.

materials.name: PET
materials.description: PET常用名称为PET塑料或聚酯，化学名称为聚对苯二甲酸乙二酯。它可制成透明容器、薄膜、片材和纤维，具有较好的强度、气体阻隔性、尺寸稳定性和可回收性。结晶程度与加工状态会改变透明度和耐热性，常用于饮料瓶、食品包装、电子薄膜、纺织纤维及工程塑料。
materials.cognitiveText: PET在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 15–65 10^-6/K。

cases.description: This hammock is reminiscent of a Venetian gondola which floats gently over the water. The height-adjustable lying surface is made from recycled plastic bottles and adapts itself to the user’s requirements. The reinforced frame, along with well-considered connecting elements and fourfold tilt protection, assures the necessary safety. The hammock may also be equipped with an awning.

The BULLET is a robust polycarbonate piece of luggage with a rugged look and feel, inspired by off-road SUVs. It is made from RCS-certified, recycled PET bottles. The two handles on the top combine comfort and functionality and make it easier to lift the suitcase when it is heavy. Shock-absorbing edges, inner padding and anti-theft zips offer optimum protection. Functions such as an integrated laundry compartment for separating worn and clean clothes make it easier to keep things tidy when travelling.

This heat-repellent film for car windows is an efficient thermal insulator. It uses XIR PRO technology which reflects infrared waves with a wavelength greater than 1,350 mm, thus preventing a rise in temperature in the car interior. The film, in addition, affords further safety protection. The use of an environmentally friendly PET substrate not only reduces glare and improves visibility but furthermore limits the shattering of glass in case of an accident.

The WNC LAXY 5G CPE + Wi-Fi 7 Extender consists of networked 5G end devices for home use that combine high connection speed with a resource-saving design. They support the Matter smart home standard and Wi-Fi 7 and are manufactured using recycled materials, including PCR plastics, PET fibres and oyster shells. The devices are based on a symmetrical three-component structure that is manufactured using two injection moulds, thus reducing production waste.

The colourful woven rugs in the Strata collection were created as part of a fruitful collaboration between the traditional carpet manufacturer Rols and the textile design studio Wallace#Sewell. Both are united not only by high-quality standards, but also by an appreciation of traditional craftsmanship, innovative thinking and, not least, a sustainable philosophy. Designed according to the motto “Archive of Earth Memories” by Wallace#Sewell and produced at the Rols weaving mills, these rugs pay homage to our planet’s diverse landscapes and colours. Rols has been using the traditional Wilton knotting technique for more than a century and, over the years, has passed the necessary skills down from one generation to the next. The partners have endeavoured to preserve this special rug-making expertise, while at the same time creating an aesthetic, contemporary look. Vibrant patterns and colours as well as precise workmanship are key building blocks in this process. Rols has a strong commitment to sustainability, which is why energy-efficient production, the use of local yarn processing partners and a considered choice of materials are important priorities. Recycled post-consumer PET bottles are used to create the yarn for eight differently patterned Strata rugs. As a material it is remarkably well-suited for making rugs, even ones with complex patterns, and it offers decisive functional advantages. Thanks to the extreme durability of the innovative yarn and UV treatment, the rugs are perfect for both indoor and outdoor use. “The surface of the Strata rugs feels absolutely natural and soft. They are a pleasure to walk on and meticulously executed. Craftsmanship and functionality have come together here to make a great product,” said the impressed jury. “We were also captivated by the brilliant colours.” This luminosity is typical of designs by Wallace#Sewell, and they add a vibrancy and energy to living spaces. Strata literally weaves together a poetic idea, a dramatic look, an innovative material and meticulous craftsmanship – these rugs represent originality that is both beautiful and functional.

Securipak2.0 is an improved anti-theft backpack in which the main compartment and all pockets are only accessible from the back. A cut-resistant fabric provides additional protection against theft. The backpack has been ergonomically designed for greater carrying comfort and, despite its minimalist aesthetics, it has numerous functions, including an RFID-protected compartment, zip pockets and two open pockets for quick access. For the sake of the environment, the outer material is made from recycled PET bottles using a dope-dyeing process.

The design of the Orbis Circular Collection bags is focused on the complete recyclability of the material used. In order to guarantee a closed material cycle in the production of the luggage and not produce any new waste, all elements – from the upper material to the zips and lining – are made from one and the same material: PET/polyester. “The consistent recycling of existing materials conserves valuable resources,” said the jury, highlighting the special sustainability aspect of the modern bag series. The collection consists of two rucksacks with practical, minimalistic designs, a laptop bag with a handle and a travel or sports bag with several compartments.

With its compact design, the RASPAIL Soft Trunk – a combination of trolley suitcase and duffle bag – is exceptionally versatile. It can be carried, lifted and tucked away using the handle on the front, and pulled over longer distances thanks to integrated wheels and a retractable telescopic tube. The trolley features a separate shoe compartment and is closed with a security zipper. The product was also designed with sustainability in mind as the water-repellent outer material is made from recycled water bottles.

The containers of the modular Jive Recycling Bin system are used for space-saving waste separation. A wide front flap is easy to open and facilitates the disposal of glass, paper, PET, can, cardboard and plastic waste. The two large handles are connected to the securely closing lid and ensure comfortable transport. With enclosed, graphically reduced stickers, the containers can be marked for different types of waste.

The main compartment of this backpack is only accessible from the back. This feature protects against theft, as do the hidden side pockets, of which one is RFID-protected. Behind the body fabric, there is a cut-resistant layer. The bag is equipped with an integrated and hidden USB port to connect easily with electronic devices carried inside. The outer material is a special fabric created by using 100 per cent recycled PET bottles. The backpack comes in eleven colours and two different dimensions.

Curio-city is a wall-mounted playground for cats. The material made from PET (polyethylene terephthalate) is not only environmentally friendly, sound-absorbing and fireproof, but, thanks to its soft texture, also represents an ideal wall panelling cats like to scratch and rub against. An L-shaped metal bracket provides a simple stand construction whose fittings hide expertly in the flexibly placeable elements that are different in size. They consist of laterally stacked panels and offer superb playing possibilities.

EcoFusionAI is a next-generation recycling and 3D printing system that transforms discarded PET bottles directly into filament using AI-driven automation. By eliminating traditional grinding steps, it lowers energy consumption and costs, making it accessible for schools, makerspaces, and small businesses. Its cutting bar precisely slices bottles for direct heating and extrusion, while a robotic arm autonomously loads new material. Semi-transparent panels foster user engagement, and intelligent dashboards provide real-time progress and environmental insights. This streamlined process not only reduces plastic waste but also promotes hands-on sustainability education. Through advanced simulation, development costs were minimized, ensuring a polished, user-friendly product. As a result, EcoFusionAI stands out as a unique, practical solution in the sustainable manufacturing sector, bridging creativity, efficiency, and environmental responsibility.

The IONIQ 5 N, the N series’ first high-performance EV, represents Hyundai’s long-standing legacy of offering high-quality mobility alongside driver-focused N models. Sustainable materials are applied throughout IONIQ 5 N, including recyclable paperette door decorative garnish, BIO PET yarn from sugarcane, recycled PET yarn from recycled PET bottles, BIO TPO from sugarcane, and eco-processed leather. IONIQ 5 N also adds recycled tire pigment paint and recycled poly Alcantara seat cover cloth. Under the hood, it combines the standard model’s Electrified-Global Modular Platform (E-GMP) with N’s motorsport-bred technologies and leverages N’s expertise from electrified Rolling Labs to maximize the EV’s high-performance capabilities.

cases.productName: Circular Plastics – Returning Waste to Use in Africa
cases.description: Circular Plastics is a collaboration between three universities and one NGO in the UK with project partners in Kenya, Rwanda, and Nigeria. Together they developed a technology-led strategy to reduce waste by transforming used plastic water bottles into products that support entrepreneurship in low-to-middle-income countries. The team devised an extruding process that converts polyethylene terephthalate (PET) from plastic bottles into 3D printer filament. To date, six innovative products have been launched that support self-sufficiency and economic development in the agriculture, mineral extraction, fishing, and mobility sectors in LMIC areas.

This design challenge involved creating a design to take the Ramlösa brand of mineral water from glass to plastic PET without reducing the premium impression and positioning of Ramlösa in restaurants. In addition to the bottle’s sculpted design, the label and the graphics enhance the high-end feeling by creating an unbroken seal that assures quality.

Attaching to ubiquitous drop-ceiling T-grids, the three-dimensional magnetic TURF Acoustic Ceiling Tiles, made from recycled PET, allows for endless customization. Acoustic levels and noise within modern open spaces and hard-surface environments are a constant distraction that impact productivity and focus. Solutions are limited, very expensive and many times require specialized installation. The TURF Acoustic Ceiling Tile System is an intelligent solution to environmental noise that leverages inspiring aesthetics, customer expression and customization, functional design and engineering, low-cost manufacturing, recycled materials, and magnetic plug-n-play contractor-friendly installation onto drop ceiling grids. TURF’s ability to offer functional performance and transformative aesthetics without compromise while complementing existing construction workflows and budgets sets this product apart in the market. Any trade can install TURF: ceiling contractors, painters, electricians, facilities management—virtually anyone.

The ECO 6L Refillable Filtered Water Bottle was designed to be refilled in any ECO Filtration Fountain, allowing the whole family to opt for more conscious, sustainable water consumption. It is made of recyclable PET (BPA free), with a UV filter that protects water from sunlight. Offering two positions of use, vertical and horizontal, the bottle is easy to transport and store in the refrigerator on its side. The drop present in the brand logo defines the shape of the bottle, and the shape of the bottle allows it to be stored horizontally—a synergy of form, function, and branding.

This provides a new twist on the traditional recycling container. Made entirely from post-consumer recycled PET soda and water bottles, the bin encourages people to recycle at the same time as it showcases the design potential of recycled plastic. It ships flat for maximum transport and deployment efficiency.

The ADITUSEcoLanyard is an innovative holder for wearing badges, specifically designed for sustainable event management. It is only made from 100% recycled and recyclable PET (rPET), making it ideal for trade shows and conferences. Badges, which are central to networking, can be worn optimally. Unlike conventional lanyards that are difficult to recycle and often end up in the trash, the ADITUSEcoLanyard does not require metal clips or carabiners. Its unique design features notches that securely hold the badge and allows for easy local recycling after the event, similar to PET bottles. It is stable, safe, and environmentally friendly.

The robust Armox travel bag is built for outdoor adventures thanks to a hybrid construction that combines a flexible front panel made of tear-resistant, coated ripstop fabric with a sturdy ABS hard shell back panel laminated with fabric to achieve seamless surface integration. The travel bag offers an enhanced user experience thanks to its suspension wheels which absorb shocks and noise. It also features two practical front pockets and has an exterior fabric and lining made entirely of recycled PET plastic.

materials.name: PA
materials.description: PA常用名称为尼龙或PA塑料，材料学名称为聚酰胺。其分子链含有酰胺基团，通常具有较高强度、耐磨性、耐疲劳性和良好的自润滑特征。不同尼龙牌号及含水状态会显著影响尺寸和力学性能。常用于齿轮、轴承、扣件、织物纤维、工具零件及结构性注塑件。
materials.cognitiveText: PA在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 40–45 10^-6/K。

cases.description: JBL Wind 3 delivers sound via Bluetooth and is equipped with an AUX input and FM radio. Its compact design also features an LED-backlit LCD. The device is IPX7 certified and can be installed on old and new handlebars by using the supplied nylon handlebar mount. Undocked, JBL Wind 3 can be clipped onto a backpack’s shoulder strap or attached to a lanyard, for example. Thus, the speaker can easily be used on the street or cycle path.

Less is More is a flush plate for toilets, which is available in black, white, brushed or polished. Its designer, Alessio Pinto, was inspired by Ludwig Mies van der Rohe and his design principle “less is more”, as well as by the history of the mechanism, and wanted to give it an innovative and sustainable form. “Plus and minus, not more and not less” is his motto. The plate therefore displays neither signs nor symbols, but simply offers two grey nylon cords as the control options.

The Crescent Lufkin Shockforce has been developed for experts, in particular for professionals in the building trade. In this context, impact protection, durability and tape stand out are the main criteria for a good tape measure. This is taken into account by the choice of materials, a reduction in weight and sophisticated details such as the blade geometry. Further features are the good legibility and the durable nylon coating of the tape, which is printed on both sides. The tape hook has a diamond-coated finish that grips almost any surface. The tether point likewise serves as a pivot point for marking arches.

Laughing Owl is a very light and roomy three-pole tunnel tent for four people. The fly sheet is made of Gorlyn 30 nylon ripstop fabric, which is a 6.6 nylon that has a higher tensile strength than most tent constructions. The spacious living area has three large windows made of FabVue material, which has the look and feel of a mesh but is actually a woven fabric and thus lighter and more durable. The light and strong 13.55 mm DAC-PL aluminium poles are characterised by a high degree of elasticity.

Mobility by bicycle is part of a modern urban lifestyle. This handlebar bag combines an elegant appearance with sophisticated functionality and a design that is oriented to the flowing use between the office, daily routines and leisure time. The robust and water-resistant nylon material with a textile look ensures a long life and high functionality. By means of the self-explanatory Klickfix adapters, the bag attaches to all standard handlebars.

Snowflake is a pendant luminaire made of FSC-certified bamboo plywood. It is sold as a kit, which reduces the volume for shipping to a minimum. Furthermore, this gives users the fun and satisfaction of having easily assembled their own lighting system. Push-in nylon clips keep the pieces together and ensure that the lamp automatically takes up its shape during assembly. The design of the luminaire, which is available in three different sizes, was inspired by a trip to the Antarctic.

The Nikau pendant luminaire is made of FSC-certified bamboo plywood and sold as a kit of single parts. It can easily be assembled on site via push-in nylon clips. The lamp comes in two versions: the long version works best in the corner of a room and several of them serve as a room divider, whereas the short version shown here is suited for direct illumination, for example of tables. The shadow play of the luminaire yields a dynamic effect. The name Nikau refers to the name of the only indigenous palm tree in New Zealand.

Wind was developed with the objective of designing a new archetype of a bookcase. The modular aluminium bookcase system features extruded shelves and die-cast uprights. The aesthetics of the system are defined both horizontally and vertically by the filigree aluminium uprights, while the nylon fibre joints ensure a high degree of stability. Closing element of each composition is an aluminium laminated, lacquered MDF panel.

This patented suitcase system features a hard top and bottom crafted from ABS with 600D polyester lamination. The rest of the suitcase is made of a robust nylon fabric, which is otherwise commonly used in hiking boots. Fibreglass connecting rods reinforce the construction and reduce its overall weight. Apart from the trolley rods, the suitcase offers an integrated handle and allows quick access to selected items thanks to pockets on the front panel.

The main idea behind the DAYFARER is to offer a backpack that allows a smooth transition from the world of work to sports activities. Accordingly, a ventilated shoe compartment at the bottom of the bag keeps trainers away from other belongings, while an upholstered laptop pocket ensures the transport of the work equipment. The spacious main compartment opens flat like a suitcase, shoulder straps and back are well cushioned. The backpack is made of ballistic nylon fabric with water-repelling external coating.

The Portree backpack bag combines an elegant design with sophisticated functionality. Made of robust, water-repellent nylon material, it has been tailored to the flowing use between the office, everyday life and leisure. It can be attached to standard bicycle racks by means of Vario hooks and, thanks to an integrated strap, serve as a practical backpack. A padded notebook compartment is included for professional use.

Norco Lifestyle is a bag made of nylon fabric with an inherently stable top cover and a magnetic rotary fastener fashioned from aluminium. The fastener closes automatically and opens with a half turn. The bag is available in two sizes and features backside hooks, which allow it to be securely fixed and quickly removed from conventional bicycle racks. It contains a cushioned notebook or iPad compartment and various organiser pockets.

The bicycle fork mount was developed for the professional and secure transport of road and mountain bikes. The major component parts of the product are made of aluminium and nylon. It is based on a quick-exchange system for mounting a conventional 9-mm fork or a 15-mm through-axle fork using a quick-release mechanism. The configuration does not necessitate the use of tools. A central locking system secures the bicycle to the carrier.

The multifunctional CBS chair programme embodies a modern vision of a chair series conceived to satisfy the expectations of a broad target group. The elegant design underscores the chair’s comfort with a wide, enveloping back, which is based on an extremely thin one-piece nylon shell. Finely cut in the lumbar area, the back provides enhanced freedom of movement during sitting. The CBS chair is available with a black or white shell, each with or without coloured pads. There is also an optional metal frame, allowing for several different configurations.

This eyewear collection features a special coating, which creates a glossy look and striking patterns on very light polymer frames. Hand-stitched elastic nylon strings connected to the joints put less stress on the material and enhance flexibility of the temple movement. With the aid of metal components, the titanium temples can function with spring effect during folding and unfolding.

The Freeride Pro 20L daypack was developed for freeriders and freeskiers, featuring a variety of storage compartments, attachment possibilities, as well as an integrated back protector that can also be detached and used separately. The design concept focuses on important functions required for use on mountains: ergonomic neoprene shoulder straps and a wide hip-belt with Velcro and buckle fastenings ensure high wearing comfort, while a signalling whistle and a quickly accessible avalanche compartment allow users to react expeditiously in case of emergency.

This tyre for utility terrain vehicles (UTV), with its innovative design using a nylon material, conforms to the current trend of making UTV tyres, like sedan tyres, out of polyester and with a steel belt. The result is a reinforced radial tyre which is also given a newly developed, concave profile. This means that the tyre is not only flatter than usual but above all offers better and more stable driving on rough terrain.

The Tapole Series T is manufactured in an innovative process which enables production of the frame of nylon and titanium without the use of screws or adhesives. Based on the properties of titanium alloy, by laser cutting and bending the sheet of titanium, a consistent hinge structure is created. The temples of the frame, which weighs less than 6.5 grams, are very flexible and easily adjustable.

With only 11 x 22 cm the Lofoten 1 ULW exhibits an exceptionally small pack size, and with 490 grams an extremely low weight for a double-walled one person tent. Stable aluminium poles with particularly short segments enable the reduced pack size, and the seven denier nylon of 26g/sqm with a thread count of 580 the extreme low weight. On both sides the fabric is siliconised in three layers thus guaranteeing high elasticity, and the water column of 1,600 mm creates a pleasant microclimate.

The design of this facial cleansing device is inspired by the shape of an egg and a bird’s nest. Its translucent body provides a view of one of the soft brushes inside. While the silicone brush is suitable for daily use, the nylon brush has been specially developed for the cleansing of oily skin and the puff head helps to remove makeup. Using high-frequency sonic vibration, the device removes dead skin and massages skincare products deeply into the skin.

materials.name: PC
materials.description: PC常用名称为聚碳酸酯或PC塑料，部分地区也称防弹胶。它是一种透明热塑性工程塑料，突出特点是抗冲击能力强、尺寸稳定、可透光并能进行注塑和热成型。PC常用于透明防护罩、电子产品外壳、头盔镜片、灯具、医疗器械及光学部件，但需要关注表面耐刮擦和耐化学性。
materials.cognitiveText: PC在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 38–70 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The Urbanaut bicycle helmet was developed especially for e-bike users and is specially designed to resist the significant forces that can occur during falls at higher speeds. This is achieved by the fusion of different materials. The inner shell is made of two expanded polystyrene materials of different density that provide support and also a shock-absorbing function. The outer shell features a combination of ABS layers and polycarbonate, which minimizes the helmet’s volume and weight, guaranteeing optimal shock protection. Ventilation is regulatable via integrated air vents.

ZUS is a smart car charger and locating device. As soon as the car has been parked, ZUS stores the actual location on the owner’s smartphone so that the car can be found again at any time. The device charges connected devices twice as quickly as conventional chargers with 4.8 amperes. By the use of a special PC / ABS plastic and titanium-coated metal components, ZUS can withstand temperatures of up to 100 degrees Celsius.

The Husqvarna Skutta electric scooter is an advanced solution for urban mobility with a look reminiscent of modern motorbikes. The scooter is easy to operate and is characterised by a removable battery and a specially developed folding design around the front axle. Thanks to the larger front tyre and the low riding position, the Husqvarna Skutta offers stability when cornering and responsive braking performance. The high-quality components and suitability for everyday use are combined in a robust and modern package.

The portable Mr Charger 10000 CH07 charging device combines an AC wall charger and power bank. Thanks to the built-in cables, it can be used to quickly charge iPhones and Android devices. Because of its discreetly integrated, detachable UK, EU and AU standard plugs, it can be used in multiple countries. To provide greater safety, PC V0 fireproof material is used for this robust charger.

The ROG Azoth Extreme is a customizable 75% gaming keyboard with premium aluminum-alloy chassis and metal frame, redefining gaming keyboards by offering customization and comfort. Featuring a full-colored OLED touch screen with three-way control knob, a paddle switch to adjust the gasket mount offering two typing experience, and a carbon fiber positioning plate. It also offers tri-mode connectivity and can achieve an up to 8K Hz polling rate with ROG Polling Rate Booster. Designed for durability and versatility, it sets a new standard in the keyboard industry for gamers, DIY enthusiasts and office workers.

The HIVE BSM has an understated elegance. The dark appearance and neutral design convey the feeling that the HIVE BSM is a reliable and professional product. The shell material is first PC injection molded then further molded by ultrasonic welding technology, making the product fully waterproof. It is affixed to the motorcycle using Velcro, which allows for quick and easy installation or removal. The purpose of the HIVE BSM is to give the rider additional monitoring support to eliminate blindspots.

Realme's first bean-shape TWS earphone is a collaboration between realme and the renowned Hermès home designer, José Lévy. He took his design inspiration from the shape of pebbles on the beach to create this realme trendsetting design. The realme Buds Q features a full curved body that is super lightweight. The device is fashionable, compact, and easy to use.

The trackball mouse “Expert Mouse TB800 EQ” enables precise input, is ergonomically shaped and reduces strain on the hand. Thanks to its symmetrical design, it is suitable for both left- and right-handed users. Four DPI levels allow for customisable speed, while a scroll ring facilitates smooth vertical navigation. The trackball supports wired and wireless connections with AES-128 encryption.

As a compact outdoor antenna unit, the TCL HH526 5G ODU provides wireless internet access in both urban and rural areas. Its IP65 weatherproof housing, with a ribbed surface, supports effective heat dissipation. An integrated 13 dBi antenna and the app-based alignment tool ensure easy installation. The accessory is available for four different mounting scenarios. Made of 95 per cent post-consumer recycled (PCR) material, the device also features an eco mode for energy-efficient operation.

The TCL Fiber Gateway Family combines Wi-Fi 7 and GPON technology to provide exceptional network performance with speeds of up to 7.2 Gbps and wired access of 2.5 Gbps. The casing is mainly made of PCR materials and all the hardware is recyclable. The packaging made from recyclable paper also stands for sustainability, while an energy-saving mode uses intelligent algorithms to reduce power consumption. The product also features an accessible design with Braille characters and voice instructions.

This espresso maker with an integrated cup can be used with either coffee powder or capsules. The water reaches brewing temperature in no time; in combination with a high-pressure system of 19 bar, an espresso extraction is achieved in just 25 seconds. The slim cylindrical housing rests comfortably in the hand. It is made of PCTG, a heat- and corrosion-resistant material that is food-safe. The product can also be used as a power bank when you’re on the go.

The ASUS ExpertBook B5 series was developed especially for businesspeople on the go. The architectural black casing is dirt-repellent and made from recycled PIR and PCR materials. The series offers various configurations, including models with and without a touch screen. With the help of four blue-bordered buttons, the pre-installed ASUS ExpertWidget software facilitates individual customisations of the stylish everyday helper.

The Bluetooth speaker JBL Go 4 delivers voluminous sound despite its compact design. The IP75 certification attests its dust and water resistance. The integrated loop facilitates transport. The battery life of up to seven hours is very practical when on the go and can be further increased via the Outdoor Boost function. The device incorporates PCR plastic and fabric for the speaker cover, while the packaging is made from FSC-certified paper with soy ink.

The Jacqueline kettle was designed with regard to an elegant preparation of tea. Its shape recalls an iconic bag and it is inspired by traditional ceramic teapots. It is made of 18 / 10 stainless steel with a PCT Tritan handle. All stages of the heating process and the infusion can be controlled and regulated: from the temperature, that can be set at a precise degree from 40 to 100 degrees Celsius, to the “keep warm” function. When in use, its base becomes bright. Simple and intuitive, the B Chef app (based on IoT) allows to programme and customise the preparation.

The WNC LAXY 5G CPE + Wi-Fi 7 Extender consists of networked 5G end devices for home use that combine high connection speed with a resource-saving design. They support the Matter smart home standard and Wi-Fi 7 and are manufactured using recycled materials, including PCR plastics, PET fibres and oyster shells. The devices are based on a symmetrical three-component structure that is manufactured using two injection moulds, thus reducing production waste.

The front compartment of the SPLIT trolley can be opened vertically, granting access to electric devices and documents. The main compartment opens horizontally. The suitcase is produced from highly impact-resistant PC-ABS through injection moulding and the front and back panel are reinforced with polycarbonate. Thanks to the wide pull handle, the case has more loading volume and can be moved around easily. It is equipped with a double TSA lock, a built-in USB port and a removable divider for flexible packing.

DoorCam is an AI-powered door-mounted security camera designed specifically for single female and elderly households. DoorCam allows users to monitor their front doors remotely through a mobile app, easily checking visitors or delivered packages. Its advanced AI recognizes visitors, categorizing them as family, friends, delivery personnel, or others, and alerts users instantly about suspicious activity. The product is carefully designed to minimize visual prominence, blending naturally with doors considering standard door heights and users’ line of sight. Its color matches darker door shades commonly used in Korean apartments, creating a harmonious appearance and reducing visual burden associated with traditional surveillance cameras. DoorCam also prioritizes environmental sustainability by using PCR plastic ( Post-Consumer Recycled) and sustainable packaging materials like soy inks and FSC-certified packaging, aligning with ESG principles.

The Square Solidity door lock series redefines home security as a lifestyle statement, offering three models tailored to modern living: the premium push-pull type, the standard lever type, and the practical mini lever type. At its core is the rectangular, angular handle, designed not only for a sturdy, ergonomic grip but also as a refined lifestyle object that complements modern home aesthetics. As American lifestyles diversify and elevate with rising economic prosperity, homes increasingly reflect personalized values and tastes. In this context, Square Solidity transcends its role as a security device, becoming a curated design element that enhances daily rituals and home identity. Constructed from PC, ABS, and metal, the locks balance durability with aesthetic excellence, while the minimized parting lines and absence of decorative pieces reinforce a sleek, modern profile. Ultimately, Square Solidity offers functional elegance, transforming the entryway into a personalized design statement that reflects contemporary lifestyles.

ZTE Qi CPE series leverages 5G technology to provide Wi-Fi via SIM, enhancing connectivity in underserved areas. Rooted in the philosophy of "Founding on Stones, Surprising with Ingenuity," it embodies robustness, stability, and sustainability. Its unique tower-like base ensures desk stability, split evenly with textured top. Crafted in eco-friendly inkstone gray PCR material, it promotes recycling. With ZTE's AI antenna, it optimizes signal selection, reducing power consumption. This series harmoniously blends technology and design, meeting internet needs while balancing functionality, aesthetics, and environmental responsibility.

BULL Wing switch series is designed in Italy. It is an ultra-thin switch developed according to the minimalist design trend of home decoration, with a completely new form of interaction. Compared with metal lever switches on the market, the button uses flexible materials to reduce the user's psychological danger concerns. The switch provides a comfortable interactive experience through a secondary injection molding process. In addition to traditional PC coating materials, we also offer users a wider selection of material colors to match their home environment.

materials.name: PVC
materials.description: PVC常用名称为聚氯乙烯或PVC塑料，可通过增塑剂和稳定剂配方形成硬质或软质材料。硬质PVC具有较好的刚性、耐化学性和阻燃特征，软质PVC则柔韧并易加工。它广泛用于管材、型材、电线护套、地板、薄膜、卡片和充气制品，性能与环境影响高度依赖具体添加剂体系。
materials.cognitiveText: PVC在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 60–70 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The ARTEVO TERRA window system guarantees sustainability throughout its entire life cycle. The profiles are made of bio-attributed PVC on the outside and up to 78 per cent recycled PVC in the core. The glazing beads contain up to 80 per cent recycled material. The fibre composite material makes steel superfluous in 80 per cent of applications, thus reducing CO₂ emissions. The LowE profile technology optimises thermal insulation and meets passive house standards. The system is fully recyclable; digital labelling facilitates end-of-life recycling.

The armoured cable lock boasts a compact carrying size and a versatile adjustable length. Thanks to an innovative Fidlock magnetic holder, the lock can be quickly and easily attached to the bicycle frame and effortlessly removed by using just one hand. The 8960 Phantom offers a high degree of security and simplifies bicycle mobility. The PVC exterior finish protects against paintwork damage  and lends the lock a simple yet stylish matt black appearance.

Xiaodu AI Speaker Donkey Kong is both a smart speaker and also a universal infrared remote control. The device can control 231 air-conditioning brands, 370 TV brands, 123 set-top box brands, and 121 electric fan brands with a 10-meter control distance, answering the urgent need for a universal remote control.

The Greta premium line combines technology with timeless elegance and the advantages of PVC window profiles with good ecological qualities. The PVC used in the sustainably produced profile system comes 100 per cent from waste windows and production waste. Since present-day production processes cannot make completely smooth-finished surfaces from recycled PVC, Greta also offers a haptic experience with its special texture and concrete look. The slightly rough surface of this material creates modern surfaces with natural appeal.

Ufo is a versatile outdoor shelter and an alternative to standard umbrellas with a central leg. Its robust frame is resistant to inclement weather and vandalism and is suitable for installation in parks and semi-public areas. It can be equipped with a variety of furniture options, from a seating platform to a table and seat combination. The construction is made of galvanised and powder-coated steel with a roof of PVC-coated polyester fabric and a stainless-steel tensioning mechanism with laminate rods.

INSTINCT by MACO is a door lock for building-entrance doors for keyless motor-driven operation. It is powerful, silent, secure and reliable – and hence perfect for comfortable use via fingerprint reader, keypad or smartphone. Practical extras like daytime unlocking, a child-lock and reliable intrusion detection are integrated as standard functions. Several finishes for aluminium, wooden or PVC doors in a number of colour combinations allow for inconspicuous installation of the lock or for making it a highlight at the door.

The Coleman Rocky Mountain 5 Plus is a spacious and comfortable tunnel tent with ample room for the whole family, along with some tables and chairs. It features the patented BlackOut Bedroom, a new sleep system for campers that blocks out 99 per cent of daylight penetrating through the bedroom – ideal for parents or anyone who is sensitive to daylight. The lightweight, yet sturdy construction with fibreglass poles allows easy assembly in a few minutes. PVC windows with covers create a good balance of light and privacy. The water column of 4,500 mm can withstand heavy rain, and an integrated welded PE ground sheet ensures clean and dry conditions inside the tent.

The design of the Lisa Filò chair captures the elegant ambience of villas on the French Riviera. The distinctive braiding of the seat and back is made using nautical rope and comes in four colours. There is also a version in woven, extruded PVC. Galvanised, powder-coated steel has been used for the chair’s frame. With sustainability in mind, all the materials employed can be recycled. The chair is suitable for outdoor use and is available as a stackable chair and in armchair and lounge versions.

materials.name: PLA
materials.description: PLA常用名称为聚乳酸或PLA生物塑料，通常以玉米淀粉、甘蔗等可再生原料发酵得到的乳酸为基础制备。它可透明、易着色，适合挤出、注塑和3D打印，并可在特定工业堆肥条件下降解。常用于包装、一次性制品、打印线材和生物医用材料，但耐热与韧性需通过改性改善。
materials.cognitiveText: PLA在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 68–85 10^-6/K。

cases.description: The design of The Eclipse atomiser is based on a new concept of the tried-and-tested manual atomiser. Designed in the shape of a disc, it breaks with the standard vertical spray bottle. This is only possible because an electronically assisted spray function from a closed container replaces the pump-injection spray process. “The innovative functionality of the spray is reflected here in a design that is as elegant as it is practical,” the jury said in praise of The Eclipse. Made from recycled aluminium and biodegradable PLA material, the atomiser also fits into any pocket and blends in with other cosmetic products.

Boost is a hearing aid for a younger generation designed to improve current hearing technology and destigmatize the look and feel of hearing aids. It is intended to help young users feel comfortable wearing a hearing aid and to create a welcoming medical product that isn’t judged by the outside world. Boost is designed with standard hearing-aid components like an amplifier, microphone, battery, and receiver with additional technology such as Bluetooth device connection, AI, and language translation. Boost’s internal components use skin-safe metals, commonly used in jewelry, and plant-based biodegradable PLA plastic.

Every year, 4,300 tons of nonrecyclable plastic toothbrushes contribute to environmental pollution. Traditional toothbrushes typically mix different materials, making them unrecyclable. The LAUDUAL Head-Up toothbrush uses the biodegradable materials PHA (Polyhydroxyalkanoate) and PLA (Poly Lactic Acid); PHA material breaks down in both soil and the ocean, making it an excellent alternative material. The toothbrush’s unique design features an 8-degree tilted brush head for improved hygiene and efficient cleaning. The edge-back design offers excellent grip while tilting the toothbrush on surfaces, preventing water from pooling on bristles.

cases.productName: AlgaMatrix: A Modular Algae-Based Bioreactor System for Sustainable Indoor Environments
cases.description: AlgaMatrix is our scalable, adaptable, algae-based bioreactor system designed to redefine sustainable architecture. In response to global climate challenges and the escalating demand for eco-friendly buildings, AlgaMatrix integrates biophilic design with advanced materials and computational technology. Our system harnesses the carbon-capturing ability of microalgae, specifically Chlorella Vulgaris, to reduce a building’s carbon footprint while improving indoor air quality. AlgaMatrix employs 3D-printed PLA frameworks and TPU membranes in an optimized tetrahedral configuration for maximum material efficiency and flexible deployment. An integrated IoT mobile application provides real-time algae growth monitoring and control, ensuring consistent performance. Preliminary tests indicate that AlgaMatrix can significantly enhance environmental performance by capturing CO₂ and producing reusable biomass. This project embodies a new paradigm in bio-fabrication for the built environment, merging material innovation, digital computation, and nature-inspired design to foster resilient, carbon-neutral urban habitats.

cases.productName: PLAECO: INFINITE GREEN-CYCLE OF FOOD DELIVERY PACKAGE
cases.description: PLAECO is a delivery food package system made of PLA, a biodegradable resin that can replace petroleum-based plastics. PLA is made of 99.3% nature-derived raw materials and returns 100% to nature by being decomposed by microorganisms after use. When completely decomposed into water, carbon dioxide, and other decomposable organic substances, it can be used as compost. The line consists of containers and carriers. They feature an interlocking stacking system for secure delivery. PLAECO takes care of all the steps in delivering food from restaurant to courier to customer.

Table and chair of the PlanHome collection feature an elegant bent wood design. The multifunctional table has a tabletop with chalkboard coating and two storage compartments; the chair is ergonomically designed according to the children’s physique. The durable furniture is made from the sustainable material PlanWood which, among other materials, is composed of sawdust resulting from the manufacture of the company’s toy production.

Good design is a deciding factor in improving the quality of products for everyday use. A feather, carried through the air by the wind, sometimes softly swaying, sometimes moving wildly and dynamically, was in the minds of the designers when it came to thinking up this toilet seat made of Duroplast. Its shape is intended to reflect the feeling of lightness and weightlessness associated with the movement of a feather.

materials.name: ABS
materials.description: ABS常用名称为ABS塑料或ABS树脂，中文全称为丙烯腈—丁二烯—苯乙烯共聚物。它综合了刚性、韧性、尺寸稳定性和较好的表面加工性能，可通过注塑、挤出、机加工与表面涂装制成复杂外壳。常见于家电、电子产品、玩具、工具外壳、汽车内饰和模型制作。
materials.cognitiveText: ABS在“线膨胀系数”尺度中的参数区间为 53–110 10^-6/K。

cases.description: This patented suitcase system features a hard top and bottom crafted from ABS with 600D polyester lamination. The rest of the suitcase is made of a robust nylon fabric, which is otherwise commonly used in hiking boots. Fibreglass connecting rods reinforce the construction and reduce its overall weight. Apart from the trolley rods, the suitcase offers an integrated handle and allows quick access to selected items thanks to pockets on the front panel.

The Sky fountain pen focuses on the essential. The combination of a plain design and good price-performance ratio with high-quality materials make this a practical pen for daily use. Sky is made of ABS and is available in a wide range of colours. In addition to opaque options, the pen also comes in transparent plastic to reveal the inner working. Core components such as the nib are made in Germany.

The Urbanaut bicycle helmet was developed especially for e-bike users and is specially designed to resist the significant forces that can occur during falls at higher speeds. This is achieved by the fusion of different materials. The inner shell is made of two expanded polystyrene materials of different density that provide support and also a shock-absorbing function. The outer shell features a combination of ABS layers and polycarbonate, which minimizes the helmet’s volume and weight, guaranteeing optimal shock protection. Ventilation is regulatable via integrated air vents.

ZUS is a smart car charger and locating device. As soon as the car has been parked, ZUS stores the actual location on the owner’s smartphone so that the car can be found again at any time. The device charges connected devices twice as quickly as conventional chargers with 4.8 amperes. By the use of a special PC / ABS plastic and titanium-coated metal components, ZUS can withstand temperatures of up to 100 degrees Celsius.
